qwen.summary: 🤖 ModelScope  |   🤗 HuggingFace  |   📑 Blog  |   🖥️ Demo  |   🫨 Discord  |   💬 WeChat We are excited to open-source **Qwen-Image-2.1**, a unified text-to-image generation and image editing model in the Qwen family. With just **7B parameters in its visual generation component** (32 Single-Stream DiT layers), Qwen-Image-2.1 balances generation quality, inference efficiency, and versatility. Four key improvements define this release: - **Compact and Efficient** — A lightweight architecture with mixed-granularity attention and prefix KV cache reuse delivers strong image quality at low computational cost. - **Native Transparency, Unified Creation and Editing** — Generate regular or transparent...
qwen.summary_zh:
Qwen-Image-2.1 是 Qwen 家族的文字生成影像與影像編輯整合模型。本次收錄的 Hugging Face 模型卡摘要，將目標定位為兼顧影像品質、推論效率與多用途創作；對需要在同一模型中完成生成與修改的工作流程，值得留意其整合方向。

摘要指出，視覺生成元件具有7B參數與32層 Single-Stream DiT，並採用 mixed-granularity attention 與 prefix KV cache reuse，以降低運算成本；也提到原生透明背景，以及統一生成與編輯。7B僅指視覺生成元件，不能當作整個系統的總參數量。這些是發布方在截取摘要中的架構與能力陳述，所提供資料沒有量化證明品質或速度提升。

目前可核對的來源只有模型頁面中繼資料與截斷的介紹，未包含完整論文、訓練細節、硬體條件、基準結果或消融實驗，亦無法從中確認授權與實際部署需求。因此應將它視為模型發布線索，保留原先不進行論文評分的處理。後續評估價值在於查證透明素材生成、編輯一致性及記憶體需求是否符合實際工作，而不能將摘要中的效率宣稱視為已驗證結論。

links.title: Context Language Models

evidence: Sections 4.1–4.3 define editable live-context files, stepwise GRPO with efficiency rewards only among successful trajectories, and Suffix Cache Reuse of surviving tokens with stale states.

Section 5.1.1 reports 59.4% BrowseComp-Plus accuracy, 11.4% relative improvement over the strongest baseline and 21.5% lower prefix-reuse FLOPs; TerminalBench 2.1 accuracy is matched at about 70% of the baseline compute.

Section 5.1.2 and Appendix E report EdgeBench-10 scores of 44.6 versus 42.3 using 179 versus 437 PFLOPs per trial for Qwen3.6-27B, but use best-of-three results on ten tasks; mathematical optimization has one run per method.

Table 2 and Appendix E report Qwen3.5-9B CLM RL improvement from 28.8% to 42.5% with 1.52 to 1.34 PFLOPs per question, using 3,040 training prompts and a held-out checkpoint-selection set; Appendix F reports a held-out KV Store gain from 38.3% to 74.2%.

Appendices B–C explicitly describe approximate stale-state reuse, a 64-question span-cap sensitivity study and omitted operations in theoretical FLOPs; Appendix B attributes 5.3 of 7.8 percentage points of extra reused prompt tokens to reasoning-token stripping.

Appendix E supplies models, prompts, budgets, sampling settings, training hyperparameters and evaluation protocols, including CLM editing turns excluded from the BrowseComp turn cap; Section 6 discusses prompt-injection risks without evaluating defenses. The title-page Code link is supplied, not independently verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A highly relevant, integrated approach to model-controlled live context, combining editable context files, skill evolution, success-gated FLOPs-aware RL, and approximate suffix-cache reuse. Evidence spans synthetic diagnostics, coding, deep research, and long-horizon single-/multi-repository optimization with meaningful compute accounting and detailed configurations. Novelty is the general editable-context interface and integration rather than wholly new memory, GRPO, or non-prefix-cache primitives. Strength is tempered by one-run mathematical comparisons, best-of-three EdgeBench reporting on ten selected tasks, unequal handling of editing turns and some budget descriptions, limited uncertainty for headline results, approximate stale-cache semantics, and no substantive safety evaluation. FLOPs savings should not be interpreted as demonstrated wall-clock latency reductions. The paper supplies a code link and extensive reproduction details, but artifact availability was not independently checked.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這是高度切題、整合完善的模型自主控制即時上下文方法，結合可編輯的上下文檔案、技能演化、以成功為門檻且考量 FLOPs 的 RL，以及近似的後綴快取重用。證據涵蓋合成診斷、程式撰寫、深度研究與長期單一／多儲存庫最佳化，並提供有意義的運算量核算與詳細設定。創新在於通用的可編輯上下文介面與整合，而非全新的記憶、GRPO 或非前綴快取基本元件。

但其優勢受到以下因素限制：數學比較僅執行一次、EdgeBench 在十個選定任務中回報三次取最佳、編輯回合的處理與部分預算說明不一致、主要結果的不確定性資訊有限、近似且過時的快取語義，以及缺乏實質安全評估。FLOPs 節省不應解讀為已證實能降低實際執行延遲。論文提供程式碼連結與大量重現細節，但未獨立確認產物是否可取得。

papers.summary: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety o
papers.summary_zh: 長時間執行的語言模型代理常因固定摘要策略遺失細節，也難以配合任務進度整理記憶。Context Language Models 將即時上下文映射為可編輯檔案，讓模型用一般程式工具自行刪改、搬移與維護內容，並延伸至多代理協作。研究另外以文字技能演化與成功條件式效率獎勵訓練管理策略，再用 Suffix Cache Reuse 重用編輯後仍保留的快取。BrowseComp-Plus 的零樣本實驗達 59.4% 正確率，相較最強摘要基準提升 11.4%，估計運算量減少 21.5%；Qwen3.5-9B 經強化學習後由 28.8% 升至 42.5%。十項長時程程式最佳化任務與多儲存庫協作也提供支持，但數學任務每種方法僅跑一次，部分結果採三次中的最佳值，且編輯回合與上下文預算設定會影響公平比較。快取重用使用舊狀態，是近似機制；主要效益以 FLOPs 衡量，不能直接當成延遲改善。這項工作對代理記憶與部署很有參考價值，但可寫入上下文帶來的提示注入風險仍待驗證與防護。

evidence: Sections 3–4 and Appendices A–B: exact terminal-loss sensitivity decomposition; improvement and loop-speedup bounds require conditional comparability, bounded temporal mismatch, curvature control, and sufficient cumulative gain.

Section 5.2, Table 1: inference-only TRM Sudoku accuracy improves from 89.67% to at most 90.19%; co-designed Maze P/S-Sign reaches 79.90% and 1.561x wall-clock speedup to the pretrained unit-step target.
Section 5.4, Tables 3–4, and Appendix C.6, Table 12: Ouro-1.4B best average 62.86% versus 61.10%; Ouro-2.6B best 71.70% versus 71.35%; Qwen Loop averages 59.22%, BB 59.37%, and Adam 58.71%.

Appendix C.1, Table 5: 50,000 Sudoku and 1,000 Maze test examples, language evaluation protocols, and 1,000-question MMLU-Pro subset; Qwen hyperparameters selected on CommonsenseQA and GPQA-Main then transferred to MMLU-Pro.
Appendix C.2, Table 6, and Appendix D: paired task-only/co-design SFT uses random seed 0 with specified recipe; Algorithms 1–8 detail schedulers, but no public implementation link is supplied.
Appendix C.5, Tables 10–11: parallel-sampling gains vary by controller and budget, and strong high-level-state noise can cause adaptive methods to underperform the fixed baseline.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to latent reasoning, recurrent language models, and inference efficiency. TAPS turns recurrent update magnitude into an online control variable using persistence/fluctuation statistics, with a clear gradient decomposition, conditional improvement proofs, six concrete controllers, and experiments across TRM, Ouro, Huginn, and looped Qwen. The evidence supports useful but uneven gains: Ouro-1.4B averages rise from 61.10% to 62.86%, while Ouro-2.6B improves only from 71.35% to 71.70%; most Qwen controllers underperform the unit-step loop. The 1.561x matched-accuracy speedup is a Maze training–inference co-design result, not a general LLM speedup. Guarantees depend on proxy–oracle alignment and drift assumptions rather than establishing them for trained models. Hyperparameters are selected on two reported Qwen benchmarks, uncertainty estimates and multi-seed training comparisons are absent, and a public implementation is not established in the supplied text. Detailed protocols and pseudocode aid reproduction, but larger-model and real-world transfer remain unproven.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本文與潛在推理、循環語言模型及推論效率高度相關。TAPS 利用持續性與波動統計量，將循環更新幅度變成線上控制變數，並提供清楚的梯度分解、條件式改善證明、六種具體控制器，以及涵蓋 TRM、Ouro、Huginn 與循環 Qwen 的實驗。證據顯示有用但不均一的增益：Ouro-1.4B 平均準確率由 61.10% 升至 62.86%，Ouro-2.6B 則僅由 71.35% 升至 71.70%；多數 Qwen 控制器反而低於單位步長循環基準。1.561 倍同準確率加速來自 Maze 的訓練與推論共同設計，不能視為通用 LLM 加速。理論保證依賴代理量與理想量對齊及漂移假設，並未證明受訓模型符合這些條件。超參數以兩個同時列入結果的 Qwen 基準挑選，缺少不確定性估計與多隨機種子訓練比較，提供的文字也未確認公開實作。詳細實驗設定與虛擬碼有助重現，但更大型模型與真實情境的可移植性仍待驗證。

papers.summary: Recurrent reasoning models have attracted growing attention for scaling test-time computation, typically by iteratively refining latent states with shared parameters. However, these models apply each learned update with a fixed unit scale, which can be conservative when updates make persistent progress and overly aggressive when they fluctuate, limiting the benefit of additional loops. To understand how the scale should vary along the trajectory, we first analyze the sensitivity of terminal loss
papers.summary_zh: 循環推理模型通常反覆使用同一組參數，卻固定每次潛在狀態更新的幅度。本文提出 TAPS，從更新方向的持續性與波動估計何時放大或抑制步長，並以終端損失敏感度分解提供條件式理論依據，不必在推論時取得標籤或重新訓練。作者比較六種控制器，並延伸至訓練時的波動懲罰、提前停止及平行抽樣。實驗中，Ouro-1.4B 四項語言基準的最佳平均準確率由 61.10% 升至 62.86%，Ouro-2.6B 則由 71.35% 升至 71.70%；Maze 的訓練與推論共同設計在匹配原始準確率時達 1.561 倍實際時間加速。這些結果指出，更新幅度可以補充推理深度與架構設計，但收益並不一致：多數 Qwen 控制器低於單位步長循環基準，理論也仰賴代理統計量能反映任務改善的假設。部分超參數以報告中的評測基準挑選，缺少多種子訓練與不確定性分析，且未提供可確認的公開實作。適合關注潛在推理與低成本推論控制的讀者，尚不能視為普遍適用的 LLM 加速方案。

links.title: CounterSteer: Suppressing Indirect Prompt Injection with Activation Steering

evidence: Sections III-A–III-B: difference-in-means behavioral contrasts, screening, causal/capability gates, and a norm-preserving prefill edit at tagged tool-result positions; four models pass bidirectional validation, while Gemma's saturated baseline makes the increase arm untestable.

Section V-A, Table II, and Appendix G Tables XV–XVIII: canonical AgentDojo rates fall from 0.100–0.489 to 0.006–0.079, with 92.9–100% benign utility; gpt-oss utility is typography-normalized and its raw certification retention is 85.2% (Section VII).

Section V-C and Appendix C Tables VI–VIII: AutoDojo AD@6 is 0.175/0.188 versus 0.673/0.730 undefended on the primary models; gpt-oss parameter framing search cracks 13/18 samples; exact-vector tool-hijack GCG yields 2/52, and LLMail replay 0/2052 observed, with replay and attack-strength caveats.

Section VI-C: pre-generation linear probes are near chance within framing families (payload AUC 0.527), while argument-value emission probes reach 0.824–0.903; safe decode steering gives no significant held-out gain (4/65 versus 5/65).

Appendix G Table XVIII: GLM multi-turn disjoint-tool compromise remains 0.781 versus 0.948 undefended, despite active steering; Table XXI reports Llama parameter classes have no viable capability-safe configuration. These qualify broad cross-model protection claims.

Section VII and Appendices B, D, G: composed-summary fidelity has an estimated 7–9 percentage-point steering-specific deficit; tool-framed MMLU/IFEval drop 10.8/15.2 points; 12/52 test templates are near duplicates, and adaptive coverage is absent for Gemma and GLM.

Appendix G Tables XIX–XX and Open Science: framing holdout applies fully to Llama and a validated gpt-oss refit, not every deployed fit; delegation partition is post-hoc but arm-blind. The artifact release specifies directions, configurations, scorers, attack drivers, and logs; models are not load-time-pinned, and Table XXIII says lower-dose transcripts were not persisted.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agents, tool-use security, and mechanistic interpretability. The contribution is a causally gated, per-model recipe and a useful separation of takeover, argument manipulation, and delegated authority, rather than a new steering operator. Five-model evaluations, paired defense comparisons, adaptive attacks, negative controls, and unusually explicit scoring audits support a substantial security benefit. It is not a complete defense: the parameter search cracks 13/18 development samples, GLM multi-turn tool hijacking remains at 0.781, and delegated authority is excluded. Limited adaptive budgets, near-duplicate test templates, incomplete framing holdouts, the post-hoc delegation partition, and material content-fidelity losses temper robustness and generalization. Detailed release specifications support reproducibility, but artifact availability was not independently checked, model loads are unpinned, and some lower-dose transcripts were not retained.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 與 LLM 代理、工具使用安全及機制可解釋性高度相關。貢獻在於經因果檢驗篩選、依模型建立的流程，以及區分指令接管、引數操控與授權委派的實用架構，而非新的引導運算。五模型評估、成對防禦比較、自適應攻擊、負向對照與格外詳盡的評分稽核，支持顯著的安全效益。但它並非完整防禦：引數搜尋攻破 18 個開發樣本中的 13 個，GLM 多輪工具劫持成功率仍達 0.781，授權委派則排除於威脅模型之外。自適應攻擊預算有限、測試範本近似重複、語氣層級保留不完整、事後劃分委派類別，以及實質的內容忠實度損失，都限制穩健性與泛化主張。詳盡的釋出規格有助重現，但未獨立查驗產物可取得性，模型載入未鎖定版本，部分較低劑量的逐字紀錄也未保留。

primary_link.title: CounterSteer: Suppressing Indirect Prompt Injection with Activation Steering

papers.summary: Indirect prompt injection makes an LLM agent treat untrusted retrieved text as instructions. We present CounterSteer, an inference-time defense that suppresses this behavior inside the model. Per model, a five-step recipe fits a residual-stream direction from paired episodes differing only in whether an embedded instruction is followed, and retains it only if it passes pre-specified causal and capability gates. At deployment, the direction is subtracted from every tool-result token during prefil
papers.summary_zh: 代理讀取網頁或工具結果時，可能把不可信文字當成指令。CounterSteer 對每個模型建立「服從注入」的殘差方向，先以行為對照、保留資料及雙向因果介入篩選，再於 prefill 對所有工具結果 token 持續減去固定向量；不需偵測器、微調或額外 token，但須能存取模型內部並標記工具內容。五個開放權重模型的 AgentDojo 妥協率由 0.10–0.49 降至 0.006–0.079，保留約 93–100% 經字體格式正規化的良性效用；兩個主要模型在 AutoDojo 六輪自適應攻擊下，成功率降至 0.175 與 0.188。研究也直接揭露邊界：引數操控搜尋仍攻破 13/18 個開發樣本，GLM 多輪工具劫持仍有高殘餘風險；使用者授權文件下指令的情境不受保護。推理所需內容若被引導，理解與指令遵循也可能退化，且部分測試範本近似重複、較大攻擊預算未測。其價值在於提供可檢驗、低推論負擔的指令接管防線，並指出仍須搭配引數來源驗證，不能視為完整安全保證。

links.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization

evidence: Sections 2–4 and Appendix A: conditional recurrence E_t=A_t E_(t-1)+epsilon_t yields non-expansive error transport under stated assumptions; lifetime-weighted mixed precision and transported-query row impact motivate the two quantization components. Appendix H explicitly limits the gate-only lifetime approximation.

Section 5.1 and Tables 1–3: 32 WikiText-2 calibration segments; seven long-generation and six short-generation benchmarks; six-bit long-task means 80.59 versus 80.60 FP32 on Qwen and 61.47 versus 61.52 on Kimi, including compatible AWQ-weight evaluations.

Table 4 and Appendix E.4 Table E6: spatial-only, temporal-only, no-pivot, and adapted Q-Mamba ablations support complementary contributions on both models. Four-bit Kimi still loses 3.00 points on the seven-task BF16 mean.

Appendices D and F: nominal six-bit formats cost approximately 6.361 and 6.300 effective bits/value; Qwen packed state compression is 5.03 times. The 68.7% total-memory result depends on the specified high-concurrency state-slot reservation, not a universal serving reduction.

Appendix F.2/F.5 Table F7: full-model decode timing includes inter-step gaps, fitting, and writeback, uses three runs and median throughput on TP4 A800; batch-512 gains are 20.53% Qwen and 11.80% Kimi, smaller than the isolated state-update speedups.

Appendix G Table G8: DAMP was not reproduced; its accuracy-retention comparison uses different generation settings and is explicitly not controlled. Header lists https://github.com/Dreamer-Toby/STEPQuant; appendices specify calibration, storage, and SGLang 0.5.12 integration.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to efficient reasoning-LLM serving and recurrent attention. The combination of lifetime-aware precision allocation, readout-sensitive dual-axis fitting, sparse FP16 protection, and packed SGLang execution is well motivated and supported by conditional error analysis, controlled probes, component ablations, and broad long/short-generation evaluations on two architectures. Near-FP32 six-bit results and measured decode-throughput improvements are compelling, with explicit effective-bit and state-pool accounting. Novelty is incremental over mixed-precision and dual-axis methods; the DAMP comparison is cross-study, generation accuracy lacks uncertainty estimates, and fixed A800 workloads plus two models limit generality. The supplied code URL and detailed appendices improve reproducibility, though repository contents were not independently checked.

Novelty is incremental over mixed-precision and dual-axis methods; the DAMP comparison is cross-study, generation accuracy lacks uncertainty estimates, and fixed A800 workloads plus two models limit generality. llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本研究直接切合高效率推理型 LLM 服務與循環注意力。結合記憶壽命感知精度配置、讀出敏感度導向的雙軸擬合、稀疏 FP16 保護，以及 SGLang 打包執行，動機充分；條件式誤差分析、受控探測、元件消融，以及兩種架構上廣泛的長短生成評估均提供支持。六位元結果接近 FP32，實測解碼吞吐量也有提升，加上明確的有效位元數與狀態池計算，具有說服力。相較混合精度與雙軸方法，新意屬漸進式改良；DAMP 比較來自不同研究，生成準確率缺乏不確定性估計，固定 A800 工作負載及僅兩個模型也限制了普遍適用性。所提供的程式碼網址與詳細附錄有助可重現性，但未獨立檢查儲存庫內容。

primary_link.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization

papers.summary: Linear attention replaces growing KV caches with fixed-size recurrent states, yet these persistent states can become a substantial memory bottleneck under concurrent serving. Directly quantizing recurrent states to low precision often leads to severe accuracy degradation, as quantization errors propagate through successive state updates. We discover that the impact of these errors depends on two complementary dimensions: temporally, errors in long-lived memory can persist across many decoding st
papers.summary_zh:
線性注意力雖以固定大小狀態取代持續增長的 KV cache，多請求併行時的狀態池仍可能成為記憶體瓶頸。逐步低位元量化又會反覆注入誤差，破壞長篇推理。STEPQuant 從誤差會留存多久、在哪些位置影響輸出兩面切入。

方法以校準資料估計記憶壽命與失真，分配混合精度，保留少量高風險單位為 FP16；再依鍵列的讀出影響，聯合擬合列、欄縮放係數，並將壓縮狀態核心整合進 SGLang。兩種模型、七項長生成與六項短生成基準中，名目六位元的長生成平均準確率為 80.59% 與 61.47%，接近 FP32 的 80.60% 與 61.52%；消融支持時間與空間設計互補，也測試了搭配 AWQ 權重量化。

含縮放及保護單位的實際精度約為 6.3 位元，狀態壓縮逾五倍。在四張 A800、批次 512 的固定工作負載下，完整模型解碼吞吐量提升約 20.5% 與 11.8%。總記憶體最多減少 68.7% 依賴特定狀態槽預留方式；四位元 Kimi 仍有精度損失，壽命近似未完整涵蓋鍵相關轉移，且缺少動態服務驗證。價值在於將低位元精度、誤差機制與實際服務成本連結。

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.3: 1,301 tasks cover six domains, 26 software platforms/workbenches, 691 CLI and 610 GUI tasks; the six task types include 60 multi-software and only ten open-ended tasks.

Sections 3.4 and 4.1; Appendix B.2: verifiers reopen submitted artifacts, check intermediate/final constraints, and gate continuous quantitative-design quality on feasibility. Main evaluation uses the same 300 stratified tasks for seven models, not all 1,301.

Section 4.2, Table 2 and Appendix C.1: highest EngiScore is 44.3; only six of 168 multi-software attempts succeed; all seven models score zero on 128/300 tasks. The evaluated subset includes only four open-ended tasks.

Section 4.3 and Appendix C.4: image placement, runtime image access, accessibility, resolution and history ablations show model-dependent gains and regressions; Kimi falls from 26.21 to 20.12 when history grows from ten to fifteen turns.

Appendix B.3, Table B.3: the completed reference audit covers 96 artifacts after review/repair; alternative valid cases are concentrated in Abaqus/ANSYS and FreeCAD, and tolerance-boundary tests are outside completed audit populations.

Appendices C.3 and D.2: a 478-byte log fails a 500-byte minimum, a mounting-hole diameter field lacks an accepted alias, and an equivalent pressure-to-force representation fails a native load check. These examples qualify claims that all failures measure engineering correctness.

Appendix B.1 lists 37 VM configurations and software versions; the paper provides a project URL but does not establish a complete public release or licensed-environment reproducibility, and no repeated-run uncertainty is reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant computer-use and tool-agent evaluation with unusually broad engineering-software coverage and artifact-based feasibility/quality checks. The shared 300-task evaluation, domain-specific verifiers, observation/history ablations and concrete failure traces provide useful evidence beyond screenshots. Novelty is mainly integration and benchmark breadth rather than a new agent method. Reported performance is conditional on one stratified subset and a fixed harness, with no repeated-run uncertainty reported. Verifier auditing is limited and some documented failures reflect brittle delivery or representation rules rather than engineering invalidity. Proprietary applications and incomplete release details also limit reproducibility.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項電腦操作與工具代理評估高度切題，工程軟體的涵蓋範圍特別廣，並依據產物檢查可行性與品質。共用的 300 題任務評估、領域專屬驗證器、觀察／歷史紀錄消融實驗，以及具體失敗軌跡，提供了超越螢幕截圖的實用證據。創新主要在於整合與基準廣度，而非新的代理方法。

primary_link.title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?

papers.summary: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, but reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach, as engineering workflows demand reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and dependencies preserved across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop: 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning 6 engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization) and
papers.summary_zh: EngiWorld 探討 LLM agents 能否在專業工程軟體中交付真正可用的成果，而不只完成介面操作。基準包含 1,301 項任務、六個工程領域與 26 種軟體及工作台，涵蓋 GUI、CLI、跨軟體協作與量化設計。方法會重新開啟提交檔案，以領域驗證器檢查幾何、物理條件、連接關係及中間成果；量化任務先確認可行性，再給予連續品質分數。七個模型在相同的 300 項分層抽樣任務上受測，最高 EngiScore 為 44.3，跨軟體嘗試僅 6／168 次成功；128 項任務所有模型皆得零分。觀察與歷史長度消融也顯示，增加影像或介面資訊未必改善成果。重要限制是完整基準尚未全部受測，驗證器已完成的參考成果稽核只有 96 件，且部分失敗來自日誌長度、欄位別名或等效載重表示未被接受，不能全部解讀為工程推理不足。論文也未提供重複執行的不確定性估計。對 agent 開發者，主要價值是把成果驗證、跨工具交付與錯誤恢復納入評估，同時提醒必須檢查驗證規則是否合理。

evidence: Section 3.1, Proposition 1 and Appendix E: QR of the shared base frame yields orthogonal skew-coordinate orientation and complementary structural updates, with separate column- and row-space derivations.

Sections 3.2–3.3 and Figure 1: a structural-strength intervention changes whole-vector TIES decisions on fixed orientation components; DiGA separately applies source-norm-weighted Gram–Schmidt and pairwise-consensus magnitude calibration.

Section 4.2, Tables 1–3: LoRA/OFT task averages are 59.18/58.60 versus strongest corresponding baselines 58.70/57.32; full-finetuned language and vision-language averages improve from 40.87 to 41.09 and 61.66 to 61.84. LoRA transfer average 39.70 is below several baselines.

Sections 4.3–4.4, Tables 4–5: whole-vector use of the same aggregator scores 58.24 versus 58.60; removing source magnitude scores 55.18; component-separated TIES/DARE/TSVM improve task averages by 0.26/0.56/0.37, while joint TSVM components lose 2.25.
Appendix F.2, Table 7: all 120 OFT orderings average 58.03±0.31, range 57.04–58.67; 118 beat OrthoMerge. The supplied text has only captions for the detailed Tables 15–17.

Appendices A, D and F plus Reproducibility Statement: expert families, evaluation harnesses, decoding, ordering, hardware and numerical tolerance are specified and an implementation repository is claimed. Table 12 gives DiGA 58.53 versus Table 1/4 default 58.60 without a clear reconciliation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant training-free LLM and VLM capability consolidation. DiGA supplies a clear base-frame orthogonal decomposition and a reusable independently aggregated two-branch construction, with derivations, diverse adaptation settings, controlled component ablations, and all-order OFT sensitivity summaries. Improvements over the strongest baselines are generally modest (0.18–1.28 points); component separation alone adds 0.36 points in its main ablation. The default OFT ordering outperforms its permutation mean, transfer gains are not uniform, and no uncertainty across training/evaluation seeds or merging-cost measurements is supplied. The full source was read; its complete-status extraction contains only captions for Tables 15–17, and Table 12 reports a different five-expert DiGA result from Table 1. Repository availability is stated, not independently verified.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項研究直接切合無須訓練的 LLM 與 VLM 能力整合。DiGA 提供清楚的基底座標框架正交分解，以及可重用、各自獨立聚合的雙分支構造，並附有推導、多樣化的調適設定、受控元件消融，以及涵蓋所有順序的 OFT 敏感度摘要。相較最強基準的提升普遍不大，為 0.18–1.28 分；主要消融中，單靠元件分離增加 0.36 分。

預設 OFT 順序優於其排列平均值，遷移收益並不一致，且未提供跨訓練／評估種子的不確定性或合併成本量測。已讀完完整來源；其標示為完整狀態的擷取內容對表 15–17 僅含表說，而表 12 所回報的五專家 DiGA 結果與表 1 不同。文中宣稱儲存庫可取得，但未獨立驗證。

papers.summary: Merging pretrained models has emerged as an effective approach for consolidating diverse capabilities into a single unified model. However, prevailing merging methods typically treat each task vector as an indivisible merging unit, overlooking the heterogeneous geometric changes encoded within it. This treatment can induce cross-component coupling: when merging decisions are derived from statistics of the complete task vector, the geometric characteristics of one component may influence how anot
papers.summary_zh: 把多個專家模型合併成單一 LLM 時，既有方法常直接處理整個參數差值，使不同幾何成分共用遮罩、符號或權重決策而互相干擾。DiGA 以預訓練權重的 QR 座標框架，將更新分成正交的方向與結構成分，各自執行去除方向冗餘、保留來源幅度及共識校準，再合回模型。研究涵蓋 Llama 的 LoRA、OFT、完整微調專家，以及 Qwen2.5-VL 多模態專家。五專家 OFT 的任務平均為 58.60，優於最強基準 57.32；完整微調語言與視覺語言設定的領先則只有 0.22 與 0.18 個百分點。相同聚合器若不分解，平均降至 58.24，顯示幾何分離有增益，但幅度有限。全部 120 種專家排序的平均為 58.03，118 種勝過比較基準，仍有排序敏感性。限制包括缺乏跨訓練或評估種子的信賴區間、未量測合併成本，且轉移任務並非全面領先；附錄一處五專家結果與主表也略有差異。論文宣稱提供程式庫，本次未另行驗證。這項工作的價值是提供可套用於既有合併器的幾何分離原則，而非證明所有能力都能無損整合。

evidence: Sections 2.1–2.4 distinguish requested-payload presence, fixed-reader accuracy, and committed-answer correctness; the strict–lenient identity is explicitly descriptive, not a causal reasoning decomposition.

Section 3.1 and Appendix B.2, Tables 10–12: five paired Qwen2.5-7B training seeds cover 26,380 trained and 2,638 initial GSM8K responses; boxed-to-hash payload changes are −35.33, −69.83, +2.50, −35.94, and −74.37 percentage points.
Appendix B.3, Tables 13–14: the same four seeds deteriorate under the original and two fixed paraphrases on 300 items; these reuse checkpoints and are not fifteen independent training replications.

Section 3.1 and Appendix D.2.1: 7,377 content-matched SFT targets differ only in the final marker; three-seed mean convention preference is +53.52 points for hash SFT and −55.40 for boxed SFT, versus −55.90 initially, while both arms reduce lenient accuracy.

Section 3.2, Table 3, and Appendix A: 625 responses receive independent, blinded non-author human calibration with unresolved-label ranges and simultaneous finite-population bounds; all three strict–human gain-gap intervals exclude zero but all human-gain intervals contain zero.

Section 3.3 and Appendix B.4, Tables 15–17: seed-83 MATH500 strict and Math-Verify crossed interactions are +9.4 and −7.2 points; 67 hash-trained responses contain a correct boxed value but an incorrect hash value, with automatic conflicts distinguished from human-confirmed contradictions.

Appendices C.2 and D.3: the strict pass@256 improvement does not survive alternate readers as a significant gain; three OLMo JSON/XML seed pairs show payload interactions of only +0.38/+0.30/+0.68 points and no opposite-request deterioration.

Reproducibility statement and Appendices A–D describe retained prompts, responses, source hashes, annotation records, readers, software versions, and analyses. Table 4 labels the native-MATH boundary model Qwen2.5 7B, while Appendix D.3.1 identifies Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong relevance to LLM post-training, reasoning, instruction following, and evaluation. The methodological advance is a controlled separation of learned reporting preference, current-request adherence, and committed-answer correctness, building on established format-sensitivity findings. Five paired RLVR seeds, fixed paraphrases, three-seed marker-only SFT, reward and reader controls, and blinded calibration of 625 responses support the narrow behavioral claim: four Qwen2.5-7B seeds lose 35.33–74.37 percentage points of requested hash-payload presence, while the fifth improves. Strict–human gain-gap intervals exclude zero, but every human-gain interval includes zero; the study does not show that RLVR cannot improve reasoning. Generalization remains limited by small open instruction-tuned models, predominantly mathematical tasks, few reporting conventions, short training horizons, and human calibration that excludes the full main crossed matrix. The OLMo JSON/XML negative boundary and substantial seed variation further constrain universality. Detailed protocols and retained-artifact descriptions support reproducibility, although public artifact contents were not verified and the native-MATH model size conflicts between Table 4 and Appendix D.3.1.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 與 LLM 後訓練、推理、指令遵循及評估高度相關。方法上的進展，是以受控設計區分學到的答案呈現偏好、當下要求的遵循程度，以及模型明確作答之答案的正確性，並建立在既有格式敏感性研究之上。五組配對 RLVR 訓練種子、固定改寫提示、三個種子的僅改答案標記 SFT、獎勵與答案讀取器對照，以及對 625 則回應的盲測校準，支持範圍明確的行為結論：Qwen2.5-7B 有四個種子的指定 hash 格式答案出現率下降 35.33–74.37 個百分點，第五個種子則改善。嚴格評分與人工評估之增益差距的區間排除零，但每個人工評估增益區間都包含零，因此研究並未證明 RLVR 無法改善推理。泛化仍受限於較小的開放指令微調模型、以數學為主的任務、少數答案呈現慣例、較短訓練期，以及未涵蓋主要完整交叉矩陣的人工校準。OLMo JSON/XML 的負向邊界結果與明顯種子差異，也限制了結論的普遍性。詳細流程與保留研究產物的說明有助重現，但未驗證公開產物內容，且表 4 與附錄 D.3.1 對原生 MATH 實驗的模型大小記載不一致。

primary_link.title: Learned Reporting Preferences in RLVR Can Conflict with the Current Request

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a prominent approach for improving language-model performance on reasoning tasks using automatically checked answers. Yet convention-matched evaluation cannot reveal whether reinforcing one reporting convention reduces adherence to a different request that the initial policy already follows. To test this, we train matched policies under two reporting conventions and evaluate each policy under both current requests, using the same i
papers.summary_zh: RLVR 常把答案正確性與輸出格式綁在同一獎勵中，因此分數上升未必代表模型更能遵循使用者當下的要求。本文交叉操弄訓練採用的 hash、boxed 慣例與測試要求，並以同一初始模型作比較；另用只改最終答案標記的 SFT、不同答案讀取器與獨立人工校準，區分格式偏好、要求遵循及明確作答之答案的正確性。在 GSM8K 上，Qwen2.5-7B 經 boxed 訓練後，五個種子中四個的指定 hash 格式答案出現率，較初始 95.45% 下降 35.33–74.37 個百分點，第五個反而改善；兩種固定提示改寫保留相同種子模式。625 則回應的人工校準顯示，三種設定的嚴格評分增益均超過人工判定增益，但人工增益區間都包含零，不能據此斷言推理退步或毫無改善。研究主要涵蓋小型開放模型與數學任務，人工校準未涵蓋主要完整交叉實驗；OLMo 的 JSON/XML 對照也未出現同等退化。實務價值是提醒評估者，同時檢查指定格式是否出現、答案是否一致與正確，而不能只依訓練格式下的準確率判定後訓練成效。

links.title: Delta-Matching: Closing the Final Gap of Native 8-bit Training for LLMs

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.4 and Appendix A.3: decompose the saved-output stale correction into probability-quantization and output-gradient-quantization mismatches. For fixed normalized probabilities and backward products, their weighted row sum uniquely restores zero score-gradient row sums before dS quantization, under the stated rounding/operand assumptions; Section 3.4 acknowledges prior direct-backward correction.

Appendix C.1/Table 10: probes on two final checkpoints from one initialization report matched pre-cast normalized residuals of 1.4e-7–7.1e-7, rising to 2.7e-3–3.4e-3 after FP8 casting. Stale residuals remain 5.29–6.25 times larger across layers. A checkpoint-dependent signed cast offset remains; these BF16 checkpoint reruns do not prove unbiased parameter gradients or describe the full training trajectory.

Section 4.2/Table 1: on the 1.67B GDN/GQA base setup, two-seed validation CE is 1.4178±0.0004 for BF16/FP32, 1.8970±0.0296 for stale FP8, 1.4667±0.0175 for consistent-dO, and 1.4162±0.0006 for Delta-Matching. The three own-kernel FP8 arms share their precision/implementation apart from correction construction. Matched RULER-8K is 47.8±0.5 versus reference 52.3±2.3, despite near-reference loss and CS9.

Sections 4.3–4.5/Tables 2–4: test NoPE, removal of QK normalization, head dimension 256, GDN/MLA, KDA/GQA, and 569M–5.29B models at 30B base-training tokens. At 5.29B, reference/stale/matched CE is 1.3349/1.9327/1.3374; at 569M stale degradation is much smaller. Precision scopes and head geometry differ across some experiment groups, so these do not isolate a universal scale law.

Appendices C.3–C.4/Tables 12–16: FP8 FFNs and attention projections compose with the correction. The protected-BF16-dP/SageBwd-style adaptation also gives near-reference CE (1.4175 versus 1.4178), while retaining gain imbalance; FA3-style max-shift variants avoid non-finite updates but retain loss gaps. Several alternative-kernel studies use single seeds and differing implementations, and no runtime comparison with the quality-preserving protected-dP alternative is supplied.

Appendix C.5/Tables 17–19: the 1.475B and 2.58B pure-GQA studies are distinct configurations. Larger pure GQA and Mamba-2/GQA can retain near-reference loss while stale-delta final-layer maximum gain products reach 878.9 and 404.1. Output masking is consistent with compensation elsewhere but does not identify it; smaller pure-GQA and Mamba-2 aggregate downstream scores do not uniformly favor matching.

Section 4.6/Table 5 and Appendix C.8/Table 23: after 8K-to-64K extension, matched/reference RULER-64K is 45.6±0.6/46.0±4.5, compared with stale 40.1±0.6; one vendor seed diverges. General capabilities are mixed, with matched TriviaQA 2.9±1.6 versus stale 13.0±1.0. All arms restart from reference checkpoints, and a mid-run corpus expansion plus vendor scaling-history reset complicates failure-onset attribution.

Appendices C.6–C.7/Tables 20–22: a three-seed standard-batch study and one-seed doubled-batch study show persistent stale-versus-matched gaps. A one-initialization Muon-based recipe gives stale/matched/reference CE 1.8077/1.3985/1.3988; QK-normalization gains still use AdamW. These tests do not establish optimizer-universal behavior or a quantitative per-update accumulation law.

Appendix C.2/Table 11 and A.4: H100 attention-kernel measurements exclude input quantization and autograd-wrapper overhead only for the authors’ kernels, while vendor FP8 includes input casting. Matched combined throughput is 470.2 TFLOP/s at head dimension 128 versus 260.7 for FA3 BF16 and 503.6 for cuDNN BF16; the correction adds 21–28% to stale backward time. End-to-end training speed, memory savings and distributed scaling are not measured.

Appendices B.2.2 and B.6: native/nearly-full FP8 refers to GEMM operands, with higher-precision softmax, reductions, accumulation, optimizer state and other components. The separate correction pass uses FP32 reductions with FP64 partial accumulation, FP8 dS tiles retain quadratic intermediate storage, and returned gradients are BF16.

Appendices B.1–B.5 and C.9–C.10: provide data splits, model geometry, precision maps, optimizer/schedule details, software versions, scorer definitions and full per-task results. Most main error bars are across two initialization seeds with fixed data order, excluding benchmark sampling uncertainty; all model-quality evaluation is BF16. Modified RULER and scoring conventions limit external leaderboard comparability. The Reproducibility statement says implementation, trained models and data recipes will be released, rather than establishing current artifact availability.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-training methodology with a well-supported numerical-consistency contribution. Building on acknowledged direct-backward correction, Delta-Matching identifies two FP8 mismatch sources and largely repairs severe stale-delta degradation in controlled training comparisons across architectures, precision scopes, sizes and context lengths. Extensive recipes, numerical probes and counterexamples strengthen the evidence. Novelty is an FP8-specific diagnosis and implementation rather than a new softmax identity. The guarantee is pre-cast under stated assumptions; actual quantization leaves residuals. Main results use two initialization seeds, several supplementary tests use one, and individual downstream regressions preclude universal BF16 parity. Unequal microbenchmark accounting does not establish end-to-end acceleration; code and model release remains promised.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項 LLM 訓練方法高度切題，在數值一致性方面的貢獻有充分支持。Delta-Matching 以明確承認的直接反向修正方法為基礎，找出兩種 FP8 不一致來源，並在跨架構、精度適用範圍、模型規模與上下文長度的受控訓練比較中，大致修復過時 delta 造成的嚴重退化。大量設定配方、數值探測與反例強化了證據。創新是 FP8 專屬的診斷與實作，而非新的 softmax 恆等式。

保證適用於既定假設下的型別轉換前數值；實際量化仍留下殘差。主要結果使用兩個初始化種子，若干補充測試僅使用一個，且個別下游任務出現退步，因此不能宣稱普遍與 BF16 相當。不一致的微基準成本核算無法證明端到端加速；程式碼與模型釋出仍停留在承諾階段。

primary_link.title: Delta-Matching: Closing the Final Gap of Native 8-bit Training for LLMs

papers.summary: Reliable FP8 attention remains a barrier to fully native 8-bit large language model training. We derive how forward-backward inconsistencies produce stale delta and empirically show how it distorts training dynamics. Our stale-delta hybrid runs show a modest loss gap at 569M parameters but substantial loss increases and downstream degradation at 1.67B and 5.29B. QK normalization, NoPE (no positional encoding), and lower-learning-rate context extension mitigate or delay degradation without elimin
papers.summary_zh: 原生 FP8 訓練的 attention 前向輸出與反向運算可能使用不一致的量化值，使 stale delta 破壞 softmax 梯度逐列總和為零的條件。Delta-Matching 以反向 FP8 運算元的乘積與量化前機率重算修正項，讓七個 attention 核心矩陣乘法維持 FP8。作者測試 569M 至 5.29B 模型、30B token 預訓練、多種 hybrid 架構，以及 8K 至 64K context extension。基準 1.67B 的 validation CE 從 stale delta 的 1.8970 降至 1.4162，接近 BF16/FP32 的 1.4178；但同組 RULER-8K 為 47.8，仍低於參考組的 52.3，不能解讀為所有能力皆等效。方法在 FP8 cast 前恢復零列和，實際量化後仍有殘差，也不保證任意訓練配方都收斂。主要結果僅有兩個初始化種子，部分補充實驗只有一個；核心函式微基準的時間計算不對等，尚未證明端到端加速，程式與模型也僅承諾發布。價值在於具體定位並修正低精度訓練的數值不一致，適合與最佳化及模型品質評估一起閱讀。

evidence: Sections 4.1.2–4.1.4 and Appendix D.1: derive the conditional Schur metric after fixing the prefix and continuously optimizing future columns; replay each candidate from the same entry state and retain the old scale for a per-group surrogate guarantee.
Sections 5.1–5.2, Tables 1–2: W4A4 evaluation on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct across seven benchmarks reports 99.35% and 100.84% question-weighted BF16 recovery.

Appendix B, Tables 4–5: removing Schur scoring, recurrence replay, or both loses 90, 15, or 115 correct answers on Qwen; these are internal controlled ablations rather than reproductions of published baselines.

Appendix D.4, Tables 7–9: 15,461 questions include 12,032 MMLU-Pro items; Qwen beats SOAR by 0.750 accuracy points (95% paired interval [0.220, 1.281], McNemar p=0.0051), while Llama has a reported 80% interval [0.013, 0.763] and trails ARCQuant on macro accuracy.

Section 5.4 and Figure 3: aligned GPTQ steady-layer times on 397B are 120.25/1824.29/2782.89 seconds for the proposed infrastructure/ModelOpt/LLM Compressor; 397B GPTQ total times are projections, and separate measured Schur Replay runs use W4A16.

Appendices A, C, and D.2–D.6: provide release plans, pseudocode, calibration and module exclusions, sampled exhaustive-grid coverage, recovery protocol, and a mock-layer storage stress test; executable patch, calibration dataset, and quantized artifacts are promised upon acceptance.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to efficient LLM deployment: Schur Replay evaluates hardware-valid NVFP4 scales using the actual sequential GPTQ recurrence and a rigorously derived conditional Schur loss, with a separate row-parallel, memory-bounded conversion system. Two large dense/MoE models, eight quantized baselines, controlled metric-by-replay ablations, exhaustive sampled-group scale audits, and paired question-level analysis provide substantial evidence. The reported W4A4 recovery is 99.35%/100.84%; the Qwen gain over SOAR is 0.750 accuracy points with a positive 95% paired-bootstrap interval, whereas the smaller Llama gain is supported only by a reported 80% interval. Interpretation requires care: MMLU-Pro supplies 77.8% of questions, Llama does not lead the task-balanced macro mean, and the surrogate guarantee does not ensure downstream improvement. Infrastructure speedups concern aligned GPTQ conversion, not inference serving or Schur Replay itself; the largest baseline full-model totals are projected and the Schur Replay timing runs use W4A16. Generalization is limited to two architectures and NVFP4, and code, calibration data, and model artifacts are promised upon acceptance rather than currently released. Detailed derivations and pseudocode aid reproduction but do not replace executable artifacts.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 與高效率 LLM 部署高度相關：Schur Replay 依照 GPTQ 實際的循序遞迴，搭配嚴謹推導的條件式 Schur 損失，評估硬體可表示的 NVFP4 尺度；另有按輸出列平行處理、限制記憶體用量的轉換系統。兩個大型稠密／MoE 模型、八種量化基準、控制變因的評分指標與重播消融、抽樣群組的完整尺度網格稽核，以及逐題配對分析，提供相當充分的證據。W4A4 回復率為 99.35%／100.84%；Qwen 相較 SOAR 的準確率增加 0.750 個百分點，95% 配對 bootstrap 區間為正，但較小的 Llama 增益僅提供 80% 區間。解讀時須注意：MMLU-Pro 占題數 77.8%，Llama 的任務等權平均並非最佳，代理目標的保證也不代表下游表現必然提升。基礎設施加速比針對設定對齊的 GPTQ 轉換，並非推論服務或 Schur Replay 本身；最大模型的基準全模型時間是推估值，而 Schur Replay 計時採用 W4A16。泛化證據限於兩種架構與 NVFP4，程式碼、校準資料及模型產物承諾於接受後公布，目前尚未釋出。詳細推導與虛擬碼有助重現，但無法取代可執行產物。

primary_link.title: Replay the Curvature: Accurate and Scalable NVFP4 Quantization for Large Language Model Inference

papers.summary: Large language models make weight storage and memory traffic major inference costs, motivating low-precision formats that represent each weight with only a few bits. Such formats use a scale to map floating-point values into a small codebook; NVFP4 improves local range utilization by letting every 16 E2M1 weights share an E4M3 block scale. Choosing that scale is difficult in GPTQ because quantizing one column updates those that follow, so evaluating a block independently can misestimate its fina
papers.summary_zh: 大型 LLM 的低位元量化可降低權重儲存與搬移成本，但 GPTQ 每次捨入都會改變後續權重，使獨立挑選區塊尺度容易失準。Schur Replay 先以條件式 Schur 損失提出候選尺度，再從相同初始狀態重播區塊內的 GPTQ 更新，選出硬體可表示且代理損失最低的尺度；另外以輸出列平行處理、分層快取與可恢復的逐層匯出限制記憶體用量。在 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 與 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 的七項測試中，W4A4 題數加權回復率分別為 99.35% 與 100.84%；Qwen 相較 SOAR 提升 0.750 個準確率百分點，並有配對統計與消融支持。不過，MMLU-Pro 占題數約八成，Llama 的任務等權平均未居首，較寬尺度搜尋也不保證更佳任務表現。最高 23.14 倍加速是 GPTQ 轉換的逐層計時，不能解讀為推論加速；397B 基準總時間仍為推估。程式碼與校準資料預計接受後公開。這項工作提供實用的量化精度與轉換資源管理方案，但跨架構泛化及最大模型完整效能仍需驗證。

evidence: Sections 3.1-3.4 and Appendix F: the framework separates distortion-freeness, soundness over keys and soundness given a key, and uses a private grader to screen and evaluate autonomous code proposals. The three finite statistical tests seek detectable violations; Appendix F explicitly says failure to reject does not establish universal validity.

Section 4.1 and Appendix D.3, Table 3: four agent configurations produce 52 submissions (14 Astra xhigh, 11 Astra low, 16 Opus and 11 Gemini). Appendix E.2 gives descriptive research trajectories rather than controlled replicated evidence that one-submission phases cause better research. Section 5 attributes new proposals to agents but component organization, ablation design and the main paper to humans.

Sections 4.2 and Appendices A/H: components include lexical/context seeding, channel or request-level geometric randomization, residual exponential clocks and predictive or position-based detectors. ConcordMark and RotationFirst combine these components; novelty lies in the framework and mechanisms/compositions, not invention of classical exponential races, probability transforms or concentration inequalities.

Appendices D.1 and F, Algorithms 1-3: private over-key screening uses 200 texts and 20,000 keys per text; fixed-key screening uses 1,000 keys and 20,000 texts per key, with beta=0.05. Distortion screening is much narrower: four 128-token contexts, a 1B generator, top-k 50, 2,048 keys and 16 head tokens plus pooled tail. An unchanged distribution is operationally rejected as inconclusive, separately from the statistical type-I guarantees.

Section 4.3, Table 1 and Appendix D.5: held-out evaluation uses 1,000 English and 1,000 Chinese WildChat prompts, Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3.8-27B, a different translation/paraphrase model, five new keys and worst-per-metric reporting. For Llama English, ConcordMark high achieves 82% paraphrase TPR versus 71% for the best baseline, and 34% deletion/48% substitution versus best-baseline 15%/12%. These are at nominal 1% FPR with fixed-key correction removed for comparison; high detection needs an auxiliary-model forward pass.

Section 4.3 and Appendix C: 23 of 52 raw agent schemes, plus raw AAR and SynthID, fail fixed-key screening. The guaranteed factor-20 correction costs a mean 16.3 percentage points of paraphrase TPR versus empirical correction; empirical correction costs at most 2.5 points versus none. Headline uncorrected transfer gains cannot simultaneously be presented as performance under the strongest soundness guarantee.

Appendix K.1, Table 5: on the regenerated research evaluation, final ConcordMark achieves guaranteed/empirical/raw paraphrase TPR of 75/84/84%, versus TextSeal 38/58/58%; ConcordMark has worse PPL deviation (5.5% versus 4.3%). RotationFirst gives 68/80/80% paraphrase TPR with 1.0/1.6/4.0% PPL/Self-BLEU2/Self-BLEU3 deviations. These correction triples reuse underlying texts within each key and are distinct from held-out Table 1.

Table 1: literal universal Pareto dominance is not supported. Qwen English ConcordMark high has PPL deviation 2.2% versus AAR 2.1%. RotationFirst offers low diversity deviations (Qwen English Self-BLEU2/3 0.3%/0.7%) but paraphrase TPR 57% versus TextSeal 70%. Perplexity and Self-BLEU are proxy measures; the supplied experiments do not establish human-rated utility or semantic fidelity of every attack.

Appendix K.2, Tables 6-9: component ablations use one watermark key and factor-20 correction, unlike five-key trajectory/held-out evaluations. Table 9 rescores identical generated texts: lexical-grouped Gamma, weighted Gamma, position evidence and weighted position evidence give paraphrase TPR 68%, 79%, 74% and 82%, respectively, with unchanged quality. Tables expose negative results and quality costs; they do not provide uncertainty intervals or independent replicate runs.

Appendix I.2, Proposition 1: Fubini plus Markov yields min(1,P/beta), bounding by beta the fraction of keys whose false-positive rate exceeds alpha for each fixed key-independent null distribution and threshold. This is not a guarantee for every particular deployed key. Appendix I.4 proves ResidualRace via exponential memorylessness; I.5 proves predictive/position evidence under conditional independence and distinct-score assumptions.

Appendices G, H.1 and I.1/I.5: proofs assume ideal independent uniform PRNG outputs and collision-free hashes. Implementations use finite PRNGs and, for ladder seeds, a 32-bit rolling hash with acknowledged birthday collisions around 2^16 distinct contexts. ConcordMark high approximates weighted exponential-sum tails using Lugannani-Rice plus a 1.02 factor; the supplied proof does not bound its universal numerical error. These are qualification gaps, not demonstrated causes of reported failures.

Appendices D.1/D.5 and Section 5: Japanese is one of ten languages in the unwatermarked verification mixture, but generation robustness is tested only in English and Chinese, on 200-300-token outputs with top-k 50 and specified non-adaptive attacks. The paper excludes stealing/spoofing security, radioactivity, open-weight applicability and multibit extensions; lexical maps and token-ID heuristics may be tokenizer/language dependent.

Section 5 and Appendices D-J: the paper claims released harness/library, final agent environments and component/selected implementations, and supplies detailed algorithms, PRNG choices, configurations, prompts and full tables. Release completeness or executability was not independently checked. GPU requirements, proprietary research/attack APIs and private evaluation configuration complicate exact reproduction; Appendix E.1 throughput comparisons also differ in top-k support for some references.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM safety and autonomous coding-research methodology: AutoMark combines private statistical screening, agent-driven watermark discovery and component-level analysis, with substantial attack-robustness gains and explicit quality tradeoffs. Detailed algorithms, idealized proofs, negative results and held-out English/Chinese transfer support a strong assessment. However, headline held-out results omit fixed-key correction, finite screening does not prove validity, implemented hashes and approximate detector tails exceed the exact proof assumptions, and single-key ablations and proxy quality measures limit certainty. Japanese appears in null-screening corpora rather than a generation/robustness benchmark; security against key-aware attackers and release executability are not established.
llm_evaluation.rationale_en: Highly relevant LLM safety and autonomous coding-research methodology: AutoMark combines private statistical screening, agent-driven watermark discovery and component-level analysis, with substantial attack-robustness gains and explicit quality tradeoffs. Detailed algorithms, idealized proofs, negative results and held-out English/Chinese transfer support a strong assessment. However, headline held-out results omit fixed-key correction, finite screening does not prove validity, implemented hashes and approximate detector tails exceed the exact proof assumptions, and single-key ablations and proxy quality measures limit certainty. Japanese appears in null-screening corpora rather than a generation/robustness benchmark; security against key-aware attackers and release executability are not established.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項 LLM 安全與自主程式研究方法高度切題：AutoMark 結合私有統計篩選、代理驅動的浮水印探索與元件層級分析，在抗攻擊穩健性上有顯著提升，並明確呈現品質取捨。詳細演算法、理想化證明、負面結果，以及在保留的英文／中文資料上的遷移表現，支持較高的評價。

然而，主要保留集結果未納入固定金鑰修正，有限次篩選不能證明有效性，實作使用的雜湊與近似偵測器尾端機率也超出精確證明的假設，且單一金鑰消融與代理品質指標限制了確定程度。日文出現在虛無假設篩選語料中，而非生成／穩健性基準；面對知悉金鑰的攻擊者是否安全，以及釋出內容是否可執行，都尚未確立。

primary_link.title: AutoMark: Enabling Autoresearch to Discover Better LLM Watermarks

papers.summary: With LLM watermarking being deployed commercially and now required by regulations, improving its reliability and effectiveness has become crucial. Yet, recent progress in the field of LLM watermarking has increasingly been driven by improving details of existing methods, an effort fundamentally limited by the pace of human researchers. In this work, we enable for the first time the autonomous discovery of new distortion-free state-of-the-art watermarking schemes. To enable this, we (i) establish
papers.summary_zh: LLM 浮水印必須在可偵測性、抗改寫能力與生成品質間取捨，研究代理又可能鑽評分漏洞。AutoMark 將私有評分器、有限樣本有效性檢驗與程式代理串成探索流程，評估 52 個方案，並拆解播種、隨機分數、抽樣及偵測元件。ConcordMark 結合詞彙分組、多通道與位置證據；RotationFirst 以每次請求的幾何隨機化及殘留時鐘改善多樣性。保留測試涵蓋英中雙語、兩個生成模型、新提示與不同攻擊模型；Llama 英文改寫後，ConcordMark high 的偵測率為 82%，最佳基準為 71%。但這組結果未套用固定金鑰健全性修正；保證修正平均使改寫偵測率比經驗修正低 16.3 個百分點，不能把效能與最強保證直接合併。論文提供演算法、證明與負面結果，但理論假設理想亂數與無雜湊碰撞，元件消融僅用單一金鑰，檢驗通過也不代表普遍有效。品質以困惑度與 Self-BLEU 衡量，尚未證實真人偏好或抵抗知悉金鑰的攻擊。日文僅納入未加浮水印語料的檢驗，並無日文生成效能測試。這項工作的重要性在於讓代理探索可稽核的新機制，同時清楚呈現品質、穩健性與統計保證的代價。

links.title: Act First, Reason Later: Accelerating On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents via Reference-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics

evidence: Sections 4.1–4.3 and Appendix E: reference-conditioned action-only rollouts with permanent autonomous fallback; asynchronous student full responses omit next-observation references, and their actions are not executed. The context distribution can differ from deployment.

Section 5.1 and Tables 1–2: Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B, three text environments, 250 updates, eight A100 GPUs; three evaluation seeds per trained checkpoint. Average speedups over Vanilla OPD are 2.3x, 1.8x, and 4.9x; WebShop-1.7B success is 39.33% versus 40.33%.

Section 5.3, Table 3: removing inverse dynamics lowers average ALFWorld success by 17.31 percentage points; removing fallback lowers success across all three benchmarks. Full reference replay is faster but less successful on average.

Section 5.4 and Appendix A.2: controlled concurrency study yields 0.80x/0.92x speedup at concurrency 16 and 1.49x/2.42x at 256 for 128-/512-token full responses; idealized bounds assume negligible environment overhead and sufficient overlap.

Appendix C.2, Table 5: references cover 100% of training tasks and use demonstrations, teacher rollouts, oracle or scripted solutions. Offline teacher training takes 4.18/22.05/18.27 hours and candidate collection 8.50/4.81/19.88 hours for ALFWorld/WebShop/ScienceWorld, excluded from headline training time.

Reproducibility statement and Appendices B–C: anonymous code repository is stated; prompt templates, history truncation, transition checks, objective, hardware, and hyperparameters are supplied. Repository contents were not independently verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to multi-turn LLM agents, reasoning, and efficient distillation. The useful contribution combines reference-conditioned inverse dynamics, divergence fallback, and asynchronous full-response supervision; its novelty is mainly this training design rather than a new distillation objective. Three Qwen3 sizes across three environments, matched hardware and update counts, reference-replay and fallback ablations, and controlled concurrency measurements provide substantial support: training is 2.3x, 1.8x, and 4.9x faster on average, with the best or tied-best mean success in eight of nine settings. However, error bars use evaluation seeds on a single trained checkpoint, references include oracle/scripted solutions with 100% training-task coverage, and the headline times exclude sizable offline preparation. Gains can disappear at low serving concurrency, and reference-guided context collection is not on-policy with respect to the deployed think-then-act trajectory distribution. Detailed prompts, checks, hyperparameters, and an anonymous code link support reproducibility, but release contents were not independently inspected; broader model families and realistic tools remain untested.
llm_evaluation.rationale_en: Highly relevant to multi-turn LLM agents, reasoning, and efficient distillation. The useful contribution combines reference-conditioned inverse dynamics, divergence fallback, and asynchronous full-response supervision; its novelty is mainly this training design rather than a new distillation objective. Three Qwen3 sizes across three environments, matched hardware and update counts, reference-replay and fallback ablations, and controlled concurrency measurements provide substantial support: training is 2.3x, 1.8x, and 4.9x faster on average, with the best or tied-best mean success in eight of nine settings. However, error bars use evaluation seeds on a single trained checkpoint, references include oracle/scripted solutions with 100% training-task coverage, and the headline times exclude sizable offline preparation. Gains can disappear at low serving concurrency, and reference-guided context collection is not on-policy with respect to the deployed think-then-act trajectory distribution. Detailed prompts, checks, hyperparameters, and an anonymous code link support reproducibility, but release contents were not independently inspected; broader model families and realistic tools remain untested.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本研究高度切合多輪 LLM 代理、推理與高效率蒸餾。實用貢獻在於結合參考條件式逆向動力學、偏離後的備援策略，以及非同步完整回應監督；新意主要是訓練設計，而非新的蒸餾目標。研究涵蓋三種 Qwen3 規模與三個環境，使用相同硬體和更新次數，並提供參考軌跡重播、備援策略消融及受控並行實驗，證據相當充足：平均訓練加速為 2.3、1.8、4.9 倍，九種設定中有八種的平均成功率最高或並列最高。然而，誤差範圍來自同一訓練檢查點的不同評估種子，參考資料包含 oracle 與腳本解法並涵蓋全部訓練任務，主要時間結果也排除了可觀的離線準備成本。低並行度下可能沒有加速，參考引導的情境蒐集亦不等同於部署時先推理再行動的軌跡分布。完整提示、檢查規則、超參數與匿名程式碼連結有助重現，但未獨立檢查釋出內容；其他模型系列與真實工具仍未驗證。

primary_link.title: Act First, Reason Later: Accelerating On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents via Reference-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics

papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains multi-turn language agents with dense teacher supervision on student-generated responses. However, standard think-then-act rollouts require lengthy reasoning before each short action, delaying environment transitions and experience collection. Generating actions directly reduces this delay but can degrade rollout quality. To address this, we propose ActFirst-OPD, an act-first, reason-later training framework that decouples environment interaction from full-res
papers.summary_zh: 多輪語言代理的訓練常被長篇推理拖慢：每次必須先生成推理，才能執行短動作並取得下一個觀察。ActFirst-OPD 將環境互動與完整回應生成拆開，先依目前情境及參考軌跡的下一個觀察推測動作；一旦轉移結果不符參考，就改為自主預測動作。同一學生模型同時非同步生成不含參考觀察的完整推理與動作回應，再接受教師的逐 token 蒸餾。實驗涵蓋 Qwen3 的 0.6B、1.7B、4B，以及 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld；相同硬體與更新次數下，平均訓練分別加速 2.3、1.8、4.9 倍，九種設定中八種的平均成功率最高或並列最高。消融支持參考引導及偏離後繼續互動的價值，但低並行度時額外生成成本可抵銷加速。方法需要高品質參考軌跡，計時未含教師與參考資料的離線準備，誤差範圍也僅反映評估種子。其重要性是改善代理訓練的互動排程；部署時仍採先推理再行動，不能據此宣稱推理本身已不必要。
papers.title: Act First, Reason Later: Accelerating On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents via Reference-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics
papers.title_zh: 先行動、後推理：以參考條件式逆向動力學加速多輪代理的 On-Policy Distillation

links.title: REALHOP: Rethinking Multi-Hop Reasoning Evaluation via Behavioral Auditing

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.3, Equation 1 and Table 1: BNR averages target-deletion failures over Full-correct items; the five existing benchmarks show panel means of 16.6–48.9%, with matched-background Control reported separately.

Sections 4.1–4.3 and Appendix I.1–I.3: entity rebinding, selected relation factorization, Flexible/Strict competitor paths, traceable realization and structural/semantic checks precede freezing; Full/Drop outcomes are not retention criteria.

Section 6.1 and Appendices B–C: on 790 paired MuSiQue questions, panel-mean BNR rises from 27.4% to 94.4%, Full accuracy remains 68.5–83.5%, common-Full gains are 66.6–69.7 percentage points, and constructed Control survival is 89.7–93.0% versus 5.7–6.2% for Drop.

Sections 6.3–7, Tables 2–3 and Appendix G: 216 long-context questions across 16 models yield a matched-MCQ spread of 59.2 versus 13.9 points; three-trial open-ended results retain broad separation; the 73-item component ablation raises mean current-model BNR from 57.9% for Gold-only to 91.3% for Full.

Section 8 and Appendices I.3–I.5: MuSiQue deletions remove whole support passages and may also remove competitors; split premises are not individually audited; FRAMES has 80/81/79 complete paired panels and unverified control trial counts, with approximate and post-hoc length matching.

Appendices J–K: adjudicated spot checks accept 98/100 MuSiQue and 50/50 LongBench items; frozen solver/judge prompts are supplied, and Appendix I.5 names an offline bootstrap script with hashes, but no public code/data-release link is established in the supplied text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant multi-hop reasoning, long-context, and LLM-evaluation methodology. REALHOP combines established deletion-based necessity ideas with entity rebinding, decomposed evidence, and complete competing paths, with construction frozen before behavioral testing. The paired 790-item audit, matched deletion controls, common-Full analyses, component ablations, human spot checks, and 16-model long-context comparison provide strong evidence for increased measured evidence dependence. BNR is a model/protocol-specific conditional average, not proof of internal reasoning or necessity of every premise; synthetic answers, a selected small FRAMES cohort, mostly single-trial interventions, imperfect deletion matching, and competitor co-deletion limit generalization. Detailed metrics and prompts help reproducibility, but the supplied text does not establish a public release of the benchmark, full construction code, or all model-generation configurations.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項多跳推理、長上下文與 LLM 評估方法高度切題。REALHOP 結合既有的刪除式必要性概念、實體重新綁定、分解後的證據與完整競爭路徑，並在行為測試前凍結建構流程。790 題成對稽核、配對刪除控制、共用 Full 條件分析、元件消融、人工抽查，以及 16 個模型的長上下文比較，都為所量測的證據依賴性提升提供強力證據。

BNR 是模型／協定專屬的條件平均值，不能證明內部推理或每個前提的必要性；合成答案、經篩選的小型 FRAMES 群組、多數僅單次試驗的介入、不完全的刪除配對，以及競爭路徑一併刪除，都限制了泛化。詳細指標與提示有助於重現，但所提供的文字未能確認基準、完整建構程式碼或所有模型生成設定已公開釋出。

primary_link.title: REALHOP: Rethinking Multi-Hop Reasoning Evaluation via Behavioral Auditing

papers.summary: Complex questions often require multi-hop reasoning that connects facts distributed across sources or distant regions of a long context through intermediate steps. Benchmarks commonly evaluate this ability with questions built around predefined reasoning chains, treating a correct answer as evidence that the intended composition was used. Yet answer correctness alone leaves open whether success depends on the evidence associated with each intended step: models may instead rely on memorized assoc
papers.summary_zh: 答對多跳問題，不代表模型依賴了每一步證據。REALHOP 以 Behavioral Necessity Rate（BNR）衡量：在完整情境答對的題目中，移除指定證據後，有多少比例無法再找回正解。方法先替換實體、拆分部分關係，加入可通往其他答案的完整競爭路徑，再以結構與語意檢查凍結資料集，最後才做刪除測試。在 790 組 MuSiQue 配對題目中，三個模型的平均 BNR 從 27.4% 升至 94.4%，完整情境正確率仍有 68.5–83.5%；背景刪除對照及共同答對子集也支持效果。216 題長情境測試中，16 個模型在相同選擇題格式下的正確率跨度由 13.9 擴至 59.2 個百分點，三次開放回答測試亦保有差異。研究價值在於把證據必要性納入基準驗證，而非只看答案或推理鏈標註。限制是 BNR 只反映外顯刪除反應，不能證明內部推理；虛構實體與規劃路徑的自然性有限，部分刪除也會帶走競爭證據，FRAMES 對照的試驗次數未能核實。
papers.title: REALHOP: Rethinking Multi-Hop Reasoning Evaluation via Behavioral Auditing
papers.title_zh: REALHOP：以行為稽核重新檢視多跳推理評估

links.title: LoLBench: Evaluating Coding Agents with Long-Horizon Proposals on Large Software Systems

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.5 and Table 1: 100 enhancement-proposal tasks from 29 systems, mean repository size 2,393.6k source LoC and reference change size 5,499 LoC; public-interface F2P and P2P checks are used, with only 7.3% of target class names mentioned in proposals.

Appendix C.1–C.2, Tables 8–9: 1,688 retained requirement-level solution mutants; added tests increase F2P count from 1,480 to 2,234, mutant killing from 61.08% to 95.97%, and reported mean F2P coverage from 60.07% to 78.50%.

Sections 4.1–4.2 and Table 2: six models across five scaffolds yield 28 available combinations, normally one attempt per task with a six-hour limit; best resolved rate is 14%, and Claude Code with Opus 5 attains 26.3% completed and 52.7% F2P pass.

Section 4.5, Figure 4 and Table 4: reference-derived file trees and API specifications improve resolved rate by 20, 22, and 16 percentage points for the three selected agents, reaching 34%, 25%, and 17%; localization measures compare inspected/modified entities against reference edits and exclude newly added entities.

Appendix A, Table 5 and Appendix G: compilers contribute 48 of 100 tasks; limitations include only functional correctness, restricted project populations, single attempts, omitted discussion context, and LLM-dependent diagnostic attribution.

Appendix F.1: 18 rule-detected and six semantic failure modes are combined through within-task confidence normalization; the outcome-blinded semantic judge cites visible trajectory steps, but the paper calls for replication across judges and comparison with human annotations.

Abstract and Appendices B–C, H: the paper provides a Hugging Face dataset link, detailed mapping/mutation/test-generation instructions, and the CPython PEP 617 task example; these are source availability claims, not independently executed artifact checks.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant evaluation of long-horizon coding agents, repository understanding, planning, and tool use. The contribution is a proposal-to-implementation benchmark with large cross-module changes, section-level progress measures, public-interface tests, and mutation/coverage augmentation, rather than a new agent method. Evaluation of 28 model/scaffold combinations and paired reference-guidance interventions provides substantial evidence of difficulty. Rigor is moderated by one attempt per task, no run-to-run uncertainty, reference-edit-based localization attribution, and partly LLM-judged failures without systematic human agreement validation. The intervention adds both reference file trees and APIs, so it supports a benefit from implementation guidance but does not cleanly isolate perception as the causal bottleneck. Coverage spans 29 projects and eight languages but is concentrated in compilers and mature proposal-driven communities; functional acceptance does not establish maintainability. The paper supplies detailed construction/audit prompts and a dataset release link, though artifact availability was not independently checked.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項評估高度切合長期程式代理、儲存庫理解、規劃與工具使用。其貢獻是從提案到實作的基準，包含大型跨模組變更、章節層級進度指標、公開介面測試，以及突變／涵蓋率擴充，而非新的代理方法。對 28 種模型／框架組合的評估與成對參考指引介入，提供了充分證據，顯示任務具有難度。

每題僅嘗試一次、未量化不同執行間的不確定性、根據參考編輯進行定位歸因，以及部分失敗由 LLM 判定卻未系統性驗證與人工的一致性，都使嚴謹程度打折。介入同時加入參考檔案樹與 API，因此支持實作指引有益，卻未能清楚隔離感知能力是否為因果瓶頸。涵蓋 29 個專案與八種語言，但集中在編譯器及成熟的提案導向社群；通過功能驗收並不能確立可維護性。論文提供詳細建構／稽核提示與資料集釋出連結，但未獨立確認產物是否可取得。

primary_link.title: LoLBench: Evaluating Coding Agents with Long-Horizon Proposals on Large Software Systems

papers.summary: Modern coding agents can deliver increasingly large repository-level changes, and recent benchmarks reflect this by emphasizing long-horizon tasks with large reference implementations. Many benchmarks evaluate coding agents' implementation capability to produce correct code edits from detailed specifications. However, practical modular development tasks also require the perception capability of grounding user intent and high-level design to derive a specification. We introduce LoLBench to evalua
papers.summary_zh: LoLBench 關注程式代理如何把使用者意圖與高階設計，轉成大型既有系統中的完整功能。它蒐集二十九個開源專案的一百項 enhancement proposal，涵蓋八種程式語言；平均程式庫約二百四十萬行，參考修改約五千五百行。評估在離線 Docker 環境執行，以公開介面的功能測試及回歸測試驗收，另用需求變異與覆蓋率導引補強測試。研究比較六個模型、五種代理框架，共二十八種組合，每項任務通常只跑一次。最佳完整解決率為百分之十四，最高功能測試通過率為百分之五十二點七。提供從參考實作整理的檔案樹與 API 規格後，三種代理的解決率增加十六至二十二個百分點，最高達百分之三十四，顯示需求落實與跨模組定位值得改善。不過這項介入同時提供解答相關線索，不能完全分離定位與實作能力；失敗歸因也部分依賴參考修改範圍與 LLM 判斷。資料偏重編譯器及成熟開源社群，單次執行難以估計變異，測試亦未衡量可維護性。它適合用來檢視代理在大型工程中的落差，而非直接推估所有開發情境的生產力。

papers.title_zh: LoLBench：以大型軟體系統的長程提案評估程式代理

links.title: vSkipper: Translating Dynamic Layer Skipping into LLM Serving Gains

evidence: Sections 3.1-3.2 and Algorithm 1: device-resident route tapes drive count-bounded RUN/Project-Only cohorts inside captured decode graphs. Skipped rows retain their own-layer KV projections; route-dependent metadata is recomputed from the current row set.

Section 3.3 and Appendix D: separate prefill/decode decisions use a roofline profitability rule and one-way dense-to-routed promotion. The A100 fixed cost is 2.67 ms; the rule predicts about 158k resident tokens versus 160k/200k served exit/enter thresholds. The claimed 2% agreement concerns the exit threshold; the sweep-interpolated crossover is about 214k.

Section 4.1 and Appendix C: upstream SGLang runs from a separate checkout with the same prompts, seeded Poisson arrivals, per-request output lengths and launch profile. Main serving cells use six paired repetitions, t-based 95% intervals, and work/accounting/execution-attestation gates.

Section 4.2, Tables 2 and 4: on A100, matched-work mean E2E falls by 36.8 +/- 2.0% on GSM8K and 13.6 +/- 1.2% on BBH at 0.95 Q*. Saturated RPS improves by 11.3 +/- 0.2% and 7.4 +/- 0.3%; CoQA has no resolved saturated-throughput change.

Section 4.3 and Table 5: native FlexiDepth changes GSM8K/BBH accuracy by -3.26/-8.39 percentage points. Serving difference-in-differences is -0.23 +/- 0.68 pp and +0.45 +/- 0.55 pp, with both intervals containing zero. Section 4.1 explicitly distinguishes unresolved effects from equivalence; Appendix E.2 explains the GSM8K composite extraction rule and single-filter sensitivity.

Appendix G, Table 11: in one natural-stopping knee cell GSM8K output grows from 116 to 330 tokens and mean E2E from 22.4 to 38.2 s; BBH grows from 255 to 405 tokens and from 21.9 to 31.9 s. Appendix G.1 finds repetitions in 11/500 native-checkpoint generations versus 0/500 base-model generations on a seeded random sample.

Section 4.4, Tables 6-7, and Appendices K-L: Qwen3-8B reduces GSM8K knee E2E by 6.6 +/- 0.3%, while Qwen3-4B shows +2.7 +/- 2.8% and no resolved gain. H100/RTX A6000 reductions are 39.4 +/- 0.2% and 30.0 +/- 4.2%, each with three paired repetitions and rule-derived thresholds.

Appendices D and H, Tables 8 and 13: nine RandomSkip policies plus prefill-only, decode-only, always-route and no-promotion ablations expose the profitability boundary, but each ablation/policy cell has one repetition. Appendix J reports that BBH overload exceeds 1024 rows in 23% of samples, where upstream executes uncaptured while vSkipper uses capture-sized chunks.

Section 6, Reproducibility statement and Appendix M: extra engines/backends, sublayer policies and distributed serving remain future work. The source names an SGLang fork, Qwen3 checkpoint release, upstream commit 602c8615a1, model revisions, training data/hyperparameters, workload protocols and rerun costs. Artifact availability is reported by the paper, not independently checked here.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM inference/serving research: vSkipper turns token-dependent interior layer skipping into a reusable SGLang interface preserving per-layer KV, batching and captured decode graphs. The novelty is the integration of RUN/Project-Only cohorts and profitability-aware switching rather than a new skipping policy. Evidence is unusually careful: matched prompts, arrivals, per-request output lengths and launch profiles; six paired main repetitions; execution-attestation gates; phase ablations; and a paired 2x2 quality analysis. However, the 36.8%/13.6% GSM8K/BBH knee-latency gains are conditional on matched work. Under natural stopping the checkpoint produces much more output and both latency comparisons reverse. FlexiDepth itself loses 3.26/8.39 accuracy points, and intervals containing zero establish no detected additional serving effect, not equivalence. Mechanism ablations, synthetic-policy cells and quality runs mostly use one repetition. Qwen3 and three-GPU transfer is useful, including the low-skip 4B null result, but deployment remains single-GPU with one engine/backend and 4B/8B dense models. Detailed revisions, training parameters, scripts and checkpoint-release claims support reproducibility; linked artifacts were not independently retrieved or executed.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項 LLM 推論／服務研究高度切題：vSkipper 將依 token 而異的中間層跳過機制轉為可重用的 SGLang 介面，同時保留各層 KV、批次處理與已擷取的解碼運算圖。創新在於整合 RUN／Project-Only 群組與考量效益的切換，而非提出新的跳層策略。證據格外審慎：配對的提示、到達流量、每請求輸出長度與啟動設定；六組成對主要重複實驗；執行驗證門檻；階段消融；以及成對 2×2 品質分析。

然而，GSM8K／BBH 在轉折點延遲上分別提升 36.8%／13.6%，以工作量配對為條件。採自然停止時，該檢查點會產生多得多的輸出，兩項延遲比較的優劣也都反轉。FlexiDepth 本身損失 3.26／8.39 個準確率百分點，而包含零的區間只能確立未偵測到額外的服務效果，不能證明等效。機制消融、合成策略實驗格與品質實驗大多僅重複一次。Qwen3 與三種 GPU 的遷移測試有用，也包含低跳層率 4B 模型的無效益結果，但部署仍限於單 GPU、單一引擎／後端，以及 4B／8B 稠密模型。詳細版本修訂、訓練參數、腳本與檢查點釋出聲明有助於可重現性；未獨立下載或執行所連結的產物。

As a result, fewer executed layers do not necessarily translate into lower serving latency: FlexiDepth skips 8 of Llama-3-8B's 32 layers on average, yet its standard generation loop decodes 14.6--21.0% more slowly than the base model. We present vSkipper, a virtualiza

links.title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation

evidence: Sections 5.1–5.3 and Appendix D: reflection proposes at most five decisions; the pre-update advisor scores the same recorded executor response with and without advice, selects by absolute contrast against a donor-calibrated threshold, bypasses original abstentions, and adds reverse-KL self-distillation to unchanged GRPO advantages. Selection uses no executor likelihoods or extra executor rollouts.

Section 7 and Table 1: Qwen3-8B advisors trained for Gemini and Claude improve BFCL-v3 over advisor-GRPO by 6.4 and 4.2 percentage points and EnvScaler by 5.1 and 3.9 points, respectively. Scores are means over three independently trained, validation-selected checkpoints, each evaluated four times.

Table 2 and Appendix E: controlled matched-count random, no-gate, inverted-gate, and no-abstention-bypass variants share the GRPO/feedback pipeline. AdviSD exceeds matched-count random by 2.5–4.9 points; random quotas are matched on that control’s own episodes rather than identical training trajectories.

Table 3, Figure 2, and Appendix E: BFCL-selected advisors transfer without retraining to ACEBench, ToolHop, tau2-bench, and RoTBench, with macro gains of 2.7/3.6 over standalone execution; cross-family gains over transferred GRPO are 3.1 points in each direction. Claude ACEBench multi-step remains 1.7 points below standalone and GRPO.

Sections 4 and 6; Appendices B–C: local reverse-KL/value-gradient decomposition and equilibrium comparisons are proved under explicit fixed-law and teacher assumptions, with random-teacher extensions and counterexamples showing why evolving detached teachers need not preserve the fixed-teacher learning limit.

Appendices D–F: full training settings (four H100s, learning rate 1e-6, support top-100, three runs), split sizes, loss schedules, donor calibration, and exact prompts are supplied; Appendix E acknowledges proprietary API reproducibility constraints. Appendix G reports a selected qualitative case that is not faster and does not provide causal or overall-accuracy evidence.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to training deployable tool-using LLM advisors for frozen API executors. The contribution is a specific advisor-response predictive selector plus feedback-conditioned self-distillation, rather than a wholly new distillation or credit-assignment paradigm. Three independent training runs, controlled no-gate/inverted/matched-count selection ablations, separate validation/test splits, and transfer across benchmarks and executor families provide substantial support. The proofs carefully state their stationary, scalar shared-parameter assumptions and do not establish convergence of the actual changing-teacher optimizer. The selector measures predictor response contrast rather than causal influence; generalization is still limited to one advisor model and one reflector, and cost/latency benefits are not established. Detailed algorithms, settings, and prompts support reproducibility, but an AdviSD code/checkpoint release is not established in the supplied text and proprietary API changes limit exact replication.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 與訓練可部署、能使用工具的 LLM 顧問來引導凍結的 API 執行模型高度相關。貢獻是特定的顧問對執行回覆之預測式篩選器，加上回饋條件化自我蒸餾，而非全新的蒸餾或信用分配典範。三次獨立訓練、控制條件下的不設篩選門檻／反向篩選／匹配數量選擇消融實驗、分開的驗證與測試資料切分，以及跨基準與執行模型家族的遷移，提供相當充分的支持。證明審慎列明平穩性與純量共享參數假設，並未確立實際使用變動教師的最佳化器會收斂。篩選器衡量的是預測器對回覆的分數差異，而非因果影響；泛化驗證仍限於一種顧問模型與一種反思模型，成本與延遲效益也尚未確立。詳盡的演算法、設定與提示有助於重現，但所提供文本未確立 AdviSD 已釋出程式碼或檢查點，專有 API 的變動也限制了精確重現。

primary_link.title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation

papers.summary: A small trainable advisor can steer a frozen language-model executor using natural-language advice. In addition to learning from task rewards, the advisor can use feedback from completed interactions to improve its advice. However, a plausible correction need not change execution, yet learning from such corrections can still affect the advisor's future decisions in other contexts. In a shared-parameter model, we prove that such corrections can limit learning if their targets favor useful advice
papers.summary_zh:
前沿 LLM 常以無法更新權重的 API 提供服務，小型顧問模型可在每次執行回覆前提出建議或選擇不介入。但看似合理的修正未必改變執行結果，仍可能透過共享參數干擾其他情境的建議。AdviSD 因此研究該從哪些修正學習。

方法結合 GRPO 與回饋條件化自我蒸餾：反思模型先標記待修正決策，再由更新前的顧問比較同一筆既有執行回覆在有、無建議下的預測分數，以差異絕對值篩選監督位置；原本未提供建議的決策另設保留機制。篩選不需執行模型的機率，也不增加執行軌跡。

三次獨立訓練顯示，Qwen3-8B 顧問搭配 Gemini 與 Claude，在 BFCL-v3 分別比顧問 GRPO 提升 6.4、4.2 個百分點，EnvScaler 提升 5.1、3.9 分；也比匹配監督數量的隨機選擇高 2.5–4.9 分，並呈現跨基準與模型遷移能力。

不過，分數差反映預測變化，不能視為因果影響；理論依賴固定教師等簡化假設，未證明實際訓練收斂。實驗只涵蓋一種顧問與一種反思模型，亦未確立成本或延遲優勢。其價值在於指出，改善工具使用代理時，選擇學習位置與產生修正同樣重要。

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.3 and Appendix C.2–C.4: fixed-horizon post-EOS padding restores reverse proposal support; proofs establish target invariance and asymptotic convergence, with an explicit warning that the worst-case bound does not certify practical finite-budget mixing.
Section 4.2, Table 4 and Appendix H.2, Table 10: Qwen3-8B PPT reaches LCB v5 58.4 at 210k decode tokens/problem versus single-chain 54.9 at 213k; AIME 78.3 at 151k versus 75.3 at 215k.

Appendix H.2, Tables 11–12: same-budget uncoupled and Best-of-N controls support single-trace exchange gains; Qwen3-8B MATH500 rises 82.2 to 85.3 to 88.0 across truncating single-chain, fixed-horizon single-chain, and PPT.
Appendix H.1, Table 8: results averaged over five seeds across Qwen2.5, Phi-3.5, Tulu and Qwen3; Qwen2.5 LCB v5 PPT 9.3 trails lower-temperature 15.1 and GRPO 16.9, so improvement is not universal.

Section 4.2, Tables 2–3: Qwen3.5-9B obtains GPQA 85.9, AIME 93.3, LCB 84.9 against externally reported frontier scores; PPT local-update time is 75.4 seconds versus 43.8 and peak KV cache 7.56 versus 3.06 GiB for a single chain.

Appendices B and G.4, Algorithm 1 and Tables 6–7: pseudocode, vLLM batching/cache design, H100 hardware and model/benchmark-specific ladders, horizons and refinement counts are described; no PPT code release link is stated in the supplied text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Very strong fit for reasoning, code, and inference-time scaling. The contribution is a useful LLM-specific adaptation of established parallel tempering plus a carefully derived correction to irreversible truncation, rather than a new MCMC principle. Broad benchmark/model coverage, five-seed extended results, token-budget controls, uncoupled/BoN comparisons, and separate truncation/exchange ablations support real gains. The theory proves fixed-horizon invariance and asymptotic convergence, not practical mixing or correctness; older-model coding exceptions, benchmark-specific tuning without a clear held-out selection protocol, and unmatched published frontier scores limit stronger claims. Detailed algorithms/configuration aid reproduction, but exact baseline checkpoints and a new-method code release are not clearly supplied. Low swap overhead does not remove substantial total decode and KV-cache costs.

這項工作非常切合推理、程式撰寫與推論時計算擴展。其貢獻是將既有平行回火方法有效調適到 LLM，並仔細推導出對不可逆截斷的修正，而非新的 MCMC 原理。廣泛的基準／模型涵蓋、五種子延伸結果、token 預算控制、未耦合／BoN 比較，以及分開進行的截斷／交換消融，都支持確實存在增益。

理論證明的是固定時域的不變性與漸近收斂，而非實務上的混合效率或正確性；較舊模型上的程式任務例外、缺乏明確保留集選擇協定的基準專屬調參，以及未配對的已發表前沿模型分數，都限制了更強的主張。詳細演算法與設定有助於重現，但未明確提供確切基準檢查點或新方法的程式碼釋出。交換開銷低並不代表整體解碼與 KV 快取成本不高。

papers.summary: Power-sharpened sampling is an inference-time alternative to reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training for enhancing reasoning in large language models (LLMs). High-probability sequences are amplified under the base model without parameter updates or external rewards, avoiding the costly optimization and jagged generalization of RL. However, this approach faces a fundamental exploration--exploitation trade-off, as % strong sharpening restricts exploration, trapping samplers in plausible but inco
papers.summary_zh: Parallel Power Tempering（PPT）針對 LLM 的 sequence-level power sampling：過度銳化會困在看似合理卻錯誤的推理路徑，探索太廣又難以集中到好答案。方法讓多個不同銳化程度的副本同時生成，以 Metropolis–Hastings 交換完整軌跡，並使用共同固定長度與 EOS 後補位，修正舊取樣器只能縮短、無法恢復較長回答的偏差。論文證明固定長度下的目標分布不變性與漸近收斂，也明確承認這不保證有限步數已充分混合。六類數學、科學與程式基準及多個模型系列支持效益；Qwen3-8B 在相近或更少生成 token 的比較中，LCB v5 達 58.4%，優於加長單鏈取樣的 54.9%，無交換副本與固定長度消融亦支持兩項設計各有貢獻。多數擴充結果報告五個隨機種子，但較舊 Qwen2.5 的程式結果並非全面改善。Qwen3.5-9B 的部分成績接近前沿模型，對照卻來自公開報告，不能推論全面同等能力。交換本身便宜，仍須付出大量重取樣與較高 KV cache 成本。其價值是更可靠地運用小模型的推論時計算，而非免費取得推理提升。
