evidence: Sections 2.2–2.4 and Appendix A: paired pre/post-memory utilities are summed over future targets; the return telescopes to factual return minus an action-independent inherited-utility baseline. The equivalence concerns the underlying gradient, not the exact finite-sample clipped PPO update.

Section 3.2, Table 1: SciREX MGPO cluster/relation F1 is 51.3/26.5, versus 37.8/15.5 for MGPO-base, with average memory length falling from 202 to 43 tokens. On AIPAN-10K F1 is 39.2/22.9, only 0.4/1.6 points above the best external-memory F1 values.

Section 3.3 and Appendix C.4: reported aggregate gradient-variance reduction is 24.9% (95% CI 6.4%–42.6%), measured at 261 states over 12,288 selected normalization parameters; Factual, Myopic and Full share chunk-aligned supervision and calibration.

Section 3.4, Table 2: one SciREX-trained writer improves no-memory results for six readers across four model families; Appendix D.2 reports selected BABILong benefits up to 128K but does not supply numerical values for the figure in this text.

Appendices C.1–C.3 and D.1: 66 SciREX and 50 filtered AIPAN-10K test documents, gold mention boundaries for AIPAN-10K, explicit scoring and hyperparameters; official SciREX relation F1 is 20.8 for MGPO versus 20.9 for MemAgent.

Appendices E.1–E.4, F and G: surrogate/exact-gain Spearman correlation 0.988, sampling and budget diagnostics, MGPO-EMA 26.9 GPU-hours versus 142.0 for MGPO-GR; dense reward evaluation is triangular and higher-order rewrite interactions are not explicitly decomposed. Appendix C.5 claims full runtime prompts are released with the implementation, without a concrete release link in the supplied text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant persistent-memory learning for language-model agents: MGPO gives rewrites long-horizon counterfactual credit using a frozen reader, with a clear potential-shaping derivation. Controlled factual/myopic/full ablations, reader-noise diagnostics and six-reader transfer support the mechanism. Evidence is promising rather than broad agent validation: principal test sets contain 66 scientific documents and 50 filtered privacy policies, the latter supplying gold mention boundaries; evaluation repeats are not demonstrated independent training seeds. Some baseline training protocols differ, OOD margins over external memory are small, and gains on the official SciREX relation metric are not uniformly best. Quadratic counterfactual training cost and interaction-attribution limits constrain deployment generality. Detailed hyperparameters and algorithm aid replication, but the supplied text claims an implementation release without a concrete repository URL.

這項語言模型代理的持續記憶學習工作高度切題：MGPO 以凍結的讀取器，為記憶改寫賦予長期反事實貢獻，並提供清楚的勢函數塑形推導。受控的事實式／短視／完整方法消融、讀取器雜訊診斷，以及跨六個讀取器的遷移，支持其機制。

證據有前景，但尚非廣泛的代理驗證：主要測試集包含 66 篇科學文件與 50 份篩選後的隱私政策，後者還提供標準答案的提及邊界；重複評估未被證實來自獨立訓練種子。部分基準訓練協定不同，分布外表現相較外部記憶的優勢很小，而在官方 SciREX 關係指標上的表現並非一律最佳。二次方級的反事實訓練成本與互動歸因限制，約束了部署的普遍適用性。詳細超參數與演算法有助於重現，但所提供文字只宣稱將釋出實作，未給出具體儲存庫網址。

papers.summary: Persistent textual memory allows language models to carry information across long interactions, but learning what to remember is fundamentally a credit-assignment problem. A memory rewrite may only become useful many steps later, while much of the observed utility may be inherited from information already stored before the rewrite. We introduce Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO), which isolates the incremental value of each memory rewrite by crediting it for its marginal contribution to curr
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型的持續記憶需要判斷每次改寫真正新增了多少價值，否則容易把既有資訊的效益誤算成新動作的功勞。本文提出MGPO，以固定reader比較改寫前後記憶對目前及後續目標的效用，再用累積差異訓練writer；理論證明這種獎勵塑形保留原始策略梯度的期望，但不保證有限樣本PPO更新完全相同。在SciREX，實體群集與關係F1達51.3與26.5，未訓練記憶策略為37.8與15.5，平均記憶從202降至43 tokens。消融與梯度變異分析支持長期信用分配的作用，同一writer亦能支援六個reader及移轉至隱私政策。限制是主要測試僅66篇科學文件與50篇篩選政策，後者提供正確提及邊界，跨領域領先幅度不大；官方SciREX關係評分也非全面最佳。訓練需額外反事實評估，尚未驗證真實長期代理任務。它提供值得借鏡的記憶學習方法，但不能直接等同於通用代理記憶能力。

evidence: Sections 2–3 and Appendix C.1, Tables 12–17: explicit reverse-KL sampled-token OPD, six prompt-count comparisons; JustRL DAPO M=4 and DeepMath M=3840 both report Math 32.55, while the number of prompts does not fix compute or generated tokens.

Section 4.2 and Appendix D.1, Table 19: fixed Qwen3-4B initialization and matched supports exhibit Math-RL versus Code-RL source-preference reversal across five support/training-seed configurations, with Avg4 interaction 13.1–14.1 points. Appendix B.1 notes the teachers differ in training history as well as data.
Section 4.1 and Appendix D.2, Table 20: GSM8K at 16.14M supervised tokens scores Math 31.56 and LCB 17.43 versus DeepMath at 16.63M tokens scoring 42.81 and 26.79; token matching is approximate.

Sections 5.1–5.3 and Appendices E.1–E.5: 43 checkpoints are not independent runs; diagnostic KL is conditional on frozen top-128 action supports. The block-30 intervention uses 20 questions, eight samples each, and requires a donor at evaluation.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant empirical study of LLM reasoning/code distillation and data efficiency. Its strongest contribution is controlled teacher-dependent source reversals, matched-update recovery branches, and cost-aware comparisons against random prompt selection, rather than the already-observed few-prompt phenomenon. Extensive benchmark tables, support/training-seed controls, approximate token matching, and alternative answer scoring support the measured transfer effects. Generality is bounded by largely Qwen-origin small students, limited independent training seeds, and unmatched budgets in some comparisons; the 20-question hidden-state intervention and frozen-prefix geometry do not establish a general reasoning mechanism. Detailed hyperparameters and support-construction rules aid replication, but the supplied text does not establish release of a complete executable artifact.

這是高度切題的 LLM 推理／程式蒸餾與資料效率實證研究。最強的貢獻是受控實驗中隨教師而異的資料來源優劣反轉、更新次數配對的恢復分支，以及與隨機提示選取的成本感知比較，而非早已觀察到的少量提示現象。大量基準表格、支持集／訓練種子控制、近似 token 配對，以及替代答案評分，支持所量測的遷移效果。

普遍性受限於學生模型多為小型 Qwen 衍生模型、獨立訓練種子有限，以及部分比較的預算不一致；僅 20 題的隱藏狀態介入與凍結前綴幾何分析，無法確立通用推理機制。詳細超參數與支持集建構規則有助於重現，但所提供文字未能確認已釋出完整可執行產物。

primary_link.title: Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation

papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains students using teacher feedback on their own sampled responses, yet how prompt choice shapes transfer across teacher-student pairs remains poorly understood. We systematically study prompt quantity, source, and selection across RL- and SFT-continuation pairs and cross-model settings. We find that OPD can be highly prompt-efficient: a few prompts can approach large-pool performance, with four DAPO prompts matching the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMat
papers.summary_zh: 這篇研究探討 On-policy distillation 中，提示數量、來源與選取方式如何影響教師到學生的能力轉移。作者比較多組 Qwen3 與 DeepSeek 衍生模型，涵蓋 RL、SFT 延續訓練及跨模型蒸餾，並固定學生與提示集合交換教師。JustRL 實驗中，四個 DAPO 提示與三千八百四十個 DeepMath 提示同樣取得 32.55 的數學分數；但更換教師後，數學與程式提示的優劣也會反轉，說明少量提示有效並不代表任意提示都可互換。近似匹配監督 token 的控制仍保留來源差距，五組種子配置也重現教師與來源的交互影響。以有效來源繼續蒸餾能修復退步，而昂貴的提示篩選並未穩定勝過隨機抽樣。研究另區分參數方向、固定前綴上的功能對齊與實際答題表現，避免將相關性當成推理機制的證明。限制包括多數比較的訓練種子有限、部分實驗的 token 或更新預算不相等，隱藏狀態介入僅用二十題探測，且未提供可核實的完整程式釋出資訊。對建立小型 LLM 蒸餾流程而言，重點是依教師、學生與目標能力驗證資料來源，並把隨機抽樣與實際運算成本納入基準。

evidence: Sections 2.2–2.5, Eqs. (2)–(8): two-key outer products create a d×E×d state; per-slice forgetting, joint-key delta updates, factorized chunk attention and value-axis tiling extend the construction.
Section 2.3 and Appendix C: minimal MQAR models compare E=1/2/4/8/16 over 32–4096 key-value pairs with 25 seeds per cell; the reported 16-fold capacity expansion costs 1.08× non-embedding parameters.

Section 3.1 and Table 1: 400M state-matched alternatives at near-matched parameter counts, averaged over three training seeds; E=4 GDN has 31.1 recall and 13.79 late-context PG19 perplexity versus base 26.2 and 14.15.

Section 3.3, Table 2: 1.3B GDN base versus E=8 from scratch reports 1360.2M versus 1378.3M parameters, recall 36.1 versus 44.4, and PG19 16k–64k perplexity 10.20 versus 9.94; 1.3B results use one seed. Upcycling recovers part of the gain.
Section 3.4, Table 3: the triadic hybrid uses 220 MB at 64k versus 407 MB for enlarged GQA-4 cache, with lower PG19 perplexity but slightly lower recall.
Section 3.5 and Figure 4: single-H100, batch-4, one-block forward/backward benchmark; E=8 is 28–30% slower than GDN, 3% slower than Transformer at 4k, and 5.1× faster at 64k.

Section 3.6, Table 4 and Appendices A–B: key-factorization/activation ablations, fixed-target distant-context analysis, and output/gradient checks against FP64 references with relative L2 error below 1%.

Sections 4–5 acknowledge training overhead, remaining Transformer recall gaps, restriction to GDN/sGLA, and prior third-order tensor-memory work; the opening code note links https://github.com/OliverSieberling/TriadicLinearAttention.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to language-model architecture, long-context memory and efficiency. The contribution is a useful modern linear-attention and kernel realization of an acknowledged older higher-order tensor-memory idea, rather than a wholly new memory principle. Matched-state/near-matched-parameter alternatives, 400M and 1.3B language modeling, multi-seed 400M results, upcycling, hybrid models, MQAR and architectural ablations support a coherent quality-capacity tradeoff. At 1.3B, E=8 raises GDN recall from 36.1 to 44.4 and lowers late-context PG19 perplexity from 10.20 to 9.94 with about 1.3% extra parameters. Limits include single-seed 1.3B reporting, incomplete uncertainty reporting, only two recurrent mixers, and no frontier-scale or end-to-end serving validation; the enlarged state is real memory overhead and the H100 block benchmark adds 28–30% cost versus GDN. Detailed algorithms, training/evaluation settings, kernel checks and a code link aid reproduction, without independently verifying the repository.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 與語言模型架構、長上下文記憶及效率高度相關。主要貢獻是將已承認的既有高階張量記憶概念，實作為實用的現代線性注意力與運算核心，而非全新的記憶原理。相同狀態大小且參數量相近的替代方案、400M 與 1.3B 語言建模、400M 多種子結果、既有模型擴充、混合模型、MQAR 及架構消融，共同支持一致的品質與容量取捨。在 1.3B 規模，E=8 使 GDN 擷取分數從 36.1 提升至 44.4，長上下文末段的 PG19 困惑度從 10.20 降至 9.94，參數僅增加約 1.3%。限制包括 1.3B 僅報單一種子、不完整的不確定性報告、只測兩種循環序列混合器，以及缺少前沿規模或端到端部署驗證；擴大的狀態確實增加記憶體需求，H100 單區塊測試的成本也比 GDN 高 28–30%。詳細演算法、訓練與評估設定、核心正確性檢查及程式碼連結有助重現，但本次未獨立驗證儲存庫。

primary_link.title: Triadic Linear Attention: Three-Dimensional Recurrent States for Long-Context Sequence Modeling

papers.summary: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) compress the historical context into a memory state of fixed size, thus allowing for constant-time inference. The memory state size is a crucial factor in their performance, as exemplified by the strong performance and resurgence of linear attention, which extends the vector-valued hidden states of ordinary RNNs to matrix-valued hidden states. Crucially, linear attention does so in a parameter-efficient way, in particular by using an outer product of the key and
papers.summary_zh:
線性注意力以固定大小的狀態壓縮歷史內容，長篇文件的記憶與擷取能力因此受限。Triadic Linear Attention 把一般矩陣狀態擴展為三維張量，以兩組 key 與一組 value 的外積寫入，再用兩組 query 讀取；新增的小型投影即可放大記憶，並相容於遺忘閘與 delta rule。

研究在 400M 與 1.3B 語言模型上比較相近參數量及相同狀態大小的替代方案，涵蓋長文本困惑度、資訊擷取、既有模型擴充與混合架構。1.3B Gated DeltaNet 的八倍狀態版本，擷取平均分數由 36.1 升至 44.4，PG19 的 16k–64k 區段困惑度由 10.20 降至 9.94；參數僅增加約 1.3%。

代價是實際狀態記憶體增為八倍，H100 單區塊前向與反向測量也比原版慢約三成。400M 多項結果平均三個種子，但 1.3B 表格僅報單一種子，部分擷取任務仍落後 Transformer。論文提供程式碼連結、核心推導與訓練細節，尚未證明更大模型及完整部署吞吐量的效益。它的重要性在於提出參數增幅很小的記憶擴充方式，並清楚呈現品質、容量與運算成本的取捨。

links.title: Prompts Live on an Arc: Gaussian Curricula in Fisher--Rao Coordinates for Rollout-Efficient GRPO

evidence: Section 3, Propositions 1–4 and Appendix B: finite-group GRPO weights, Gaussian bounds on zero-variance probability, variance-stabilized evidence, and Laplace approximations to pass@k objective derivatives motivate the sampler.

Section 4 and Appendix D: per-prompt arc-length Kalman beliefs, drift, kernel-times-yield scores, Gumbel sampling, and a 41-point yield-constrained target grid leave the GRPO loss unchanged; capped-proportional inclusion probabilities are explicitly approximations.
Sections 5.1–5.2, Tables 1–2: three main backbones on six math benchmarks; Qwen2.5-Math-7B average 46.9 versus GRPO 44.1 and DS 45.7, using 0.77M versus DS 1.48M rollouts and 24.1 versus 41.6 hours.

Section 5.3, Tables 3 and 8: coordinate, belief, dead-zone, pacing, drift, and selection ablations; replacing the Gaussian with the exact kernel gives 46.87 versus 46.90, while removing the yield factor gives 45.87.

Appendix F, Tables 7 and 11–15: three-seed mean and standard deviation, long-CoT and Llama backbones, a second training pool, sensitivity tests, and adapted Dr. GRPO/DAPO/RLOO losses; Limitations restrict demonstrated scope to math, <=7B, and groups <=16.
Appendix B.4 claims the refined variance is accurate to 1% on p in [0.2,0.8], but Table 4 lists 0.0271 versus 0.0294 at p=0.2, about an 8% discrepancy.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to reasoning LLM post-training and rollout efficiency. Arcus coherently combines a Fisher–Rao coordinate, boundary-aware Kalman evidence, objective-matched kernels, and yield-constrained pacing, while building on established sampling/filtering ideas. Three-seed, multi-backbone comparisons, rollout-matched controls, wall-clock accounting, broad ablations, and additional loss/pool tests provide unusually substantial evidence. Exact identities should be distinguished from Laplace, Gaussian-belief, and inclusion-probability approximations: the idealized waste/objective arguments are not full guarantees for clipped training with cross-prompt transfer. Evidence remains mathematical reasoning at <=7B; scripts are named but no accessible repository is identified in the supplied text.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項研究高度切合推理 LLM 後訓練與 rollout 效率。Arcus 以既有取樣／篩選概念為基礎，連貫地結合 Fisher–Rao 座標、考量邊界的 Kalman 證據、與目標相符的核函數，以及受產出率限制的進度控制。三種子、多骨幹比較、rollout 配對控制、實際執行時間核算、廣泛消融，以及額外損失／樣本池測試，提供了格外充實的證據。

應區分精確恆等式與 Laplace、Gaussian 信念及納入機率近似：理想化的浪費／目標論證，並不是對包含跨提示遷移之裁切式訓練的完整保證。證據仍限於不超過 7B 模型的數學推理；文中列出腳本名稱，但所提供文字未指出可存取的儲存庫。

primary_link.title: Prompts Live on an Arc: Gaussian Curricula in Fisher--Rao Coordinates for Rollout-Efficient GRPO

papers.summary: Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) learns only from prompts whose sampled responses disagree: a group that is entirely correct or entirely incorrect has zero reward variance, contributes no gradient, and still consumes its rollouts. Prompt-selection methods reduce this waste by steering sampling toward intermediate pass rates, but they choose the target, its width, and the uncertainty model heuristically, in raw pass-rate or logit coordinates. We show that GRPO comes with a natural coordi
papers.summary_zh: GRPO 在同一題的回答全部成功或全部失敗時，無法從群組相對獎勵取得梯度，卻仍消耗生成成本。本文提出 Arcus，將每題成功率映射至 Bernoulli Fisher–Rao 弧長座標，以 Kalman filter 追蹤難度與不確定性，結合目標相符的 Gaussian kernel 和有效群組機率挑題，再依預測產出率逐步提高難度；GRPO 損失本身保持不變。作者在三個主要 Qwen 模型、六項數學推理測試與三個訓練種子上，報告平均準確率比 GRPO 高 2.8–2.9 個百分點、比 dynamic sampling 高 1.1–1.2 點，且生成次數少 48–57%。7B 實驗的訓練時間由後者 41.6 小時降至 24.1 小時；等生成預算版本仍有改善，並提供座標、漂移、核心函數與課程步調的消融。限制是實驗仍集中於數學、模型至多 7B，理論與實作間含 Gaussian 近似、抽樣納入率近似及跨題遷移假設，不能視為一般訓練保證。其價值在於讓推理後訓練的選題更有原理且較省成本；程式路徑有列出，但所附文本未提供可確認的公開儲存庫連結。

links.title: CoEM: Empowering Long-Context Reasoning with Commit-on-Evidence Memory

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix A.2: CoEM carries only 1,024 serialized memory tokens, split into 256 pending-source and 768 committed-fact tokens; Promote/Keep/Drop decisions use currently available source spans, frozen NLI verification, and all-or-nothing replacement. Final answering occurs after pending evidence is resolved.

Appendices A.1–A.2: training uses 32,768 HotpotQA questions, evaluation 128 fixed questions from each of HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA and MuSiQue at eight document counts, 50–6,400. Distractors are 96–128-token prefixes; support passages must fit 4,096 tokens under both tokenizers. Qwen3.5-4B and 9B are the only evaluated backbones.

Appendix A.8, Table 9: at 6,400 documents, Qwen3.5-9B CoEM versus budget-matched ReMemR1 scores 89.1 versus 78.7 on HotpotQA, 81.0 versus 69.6 on 2Wiki, and 72.3 versus 61.6 on MuSiQue. The differences are 10.4 [7.6,13.4], 11.4 [8.7,14.3], and 10.7 [8.2,13.4]; intervals use 10,000 paired question bootstraps and reported means use three training seeds.

Section 4.4, Table 2, and Appendix A.10, Table 10: at 800 documents with 4B, full CoEM reaches 85.5/76.1 F1 on HotpotQA/2Wiki, versus 77.2/66.0 for eager commitment with verification. Fixing answer weight at 0.8 gives 81.0/70.5 without evidence rewards, 83.1/73.2 with immediate penalties, and 85.5/76.1 with evidence return-to-go.

Appendix A.4, Tables 5–6: 2,000 pre-verification promotion attempts are independently labeled by two human annotators with adjudication. Calibrated DeBERTaV3-small yields 97.2% accepted-claim faithfulness, 4.9% false acceptance and 6.4% false rejection at 4.3 ms/pair; Qwen3.5-9B yields 97.5% faithfulness at 295 ms/pair. Calibration and audit questions are separated from policy training and final evaluation.

Appendix A.2, Table 4, and Appendix A.6, Table 8: CoEM exceeds native archive-enabled ReMemR1 by 2.3–4.3 length-averaged F1 points across the six backbone/dataset settings. At 6,400 documents, full-scan 4B inference takes 548 s/question versus 474 for GRU-Mem, 720 for MemAgent, 870 for budget-matched ReMemR1 and 951 for native ReMemR1.

Appendix A.5, Table 7, and Appendix C.2: forced pending-record drops rise from 0.5% in ordinary order to 7.6% in source-dense stress with no token overflow; a documented capacity failure removes a needed biography before its linking passage arrives. Appendix D explicitly limits the value-of-information and learning-signal results to their assumptions.

Reproducibility statement and Appendices A–E provide prompts, action grammar, training settings, controller behavior and resource accounting, and claim code at github.com/benmagnifico/CoEM; trained weights and evaluation manifests are deferred until acceptance. Section 4.1/Table 1 contains only a nicematrix placeholder in the supplied extraction, so its full per-length result matrix and rendered figures could not be inspected.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant long-context LLM reasoning and agent-memory work. The main contribution is a coherent combination of adaptive delayed compression, bounded verbatim evidence retention, atomic source-verified memory updates, and evidence-return RL; the individual ingredients are established. Matched storage/training comparisons, independently retrained ablations, matched answer-weight controls, three seeds, paired bootstrap intervals, and a human-referenced verifier audit provide unusually detailed support. Gains are substantial on distractor-extended multi-hop QA, including two datasets without additional training. However, evaluation reuses only 128 questions per dataset, tests two sizes of one model family and English QA, and does not establish transfer to code or realistic unfiltered corpora. Verifier errors, finite-capacity evidence loss, and slower inference than GRU-Mem remain material. The formal results are conditional controller/local-decision analyses, not an end-to-end performance guarantee. Supplied HTML labels the source complete but omits the main Table 1 body and figure graphics; appendix tables independently expose key numerical comparisons. Code is claimed available, while weights and evaluation manifests are promised upon acceptance and were not externally verified.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項長上下文 LLM 推理與代理記憶工作高度切題。主要貢獻是連貫地結合自適應延後壓縮、有界逐字證據保留、經來源驗證的原子記憶更新，以及證據回傳 RL；各個組成要素本身已有先例。儲存／訓練配對比較、各自重新訓練的消融、答案權重配對控制、三個種子、成對 bootstrap 區間，以及以人工為參照的驗證器稽核，提供了格外詳盡的支持。在加入干擾內容的多跳問答上增益顯著，包括兩個未經額外訓練的資料集。

然而，評估在每個資料集僅重複使用 128 題，僅測試單一模型家族的兩種規模與英文問答，且未確立對程式任務或真實未篩選語料的遷移。驗證器錯誤、有限容量造成的證據流失，以及比 GRU-Mem 更慢的推論，仍是重要問題。形式化結果屬於有條件的控制器／局部決策分析，而非端到端效能保證。所提供 HTML 將來源標為完整，卻省略主要表 1 的內容與圖形；附錄表格則獨立呈現關鍵數值比較。文中宣稱程式碼可取得，權重與評估清單則承諾於接受後釋出，均未經外部驗證。

primary_link.title: CoEM: Empowering Long-Context Reasoning with Commit-on-Evidence Memory

papers.summary: Long-context reasoning is essential for complex and long-horizon tasks, yet the performance of large language models (LLMs) degrades as context length increases. Recent approaches address this by processing input chunk by chunk while maintaining a bounded textual memory in model context. However, premature information compression can discard critical details essential for subsequent reasoning. In this paper, we introduce Commit-on-Evidence Memory (CoEM), which learns when to convert source evide
papers.summary_zh: 長文件推理常在逐段壓縮時，丟掉當下看似無關、後來才成為關鍵的證據。CoEM 將固定的 1,024-token 記憶分為 256-token 待處理原文與 768-token 已確認事實，讓策略隨新段落到來選擇保留、提升或刪除；提升前由凍結的 DeBERTaV3-small 檢查來源支持度，再以最終答案與逐步驗證懲罰訓練策略。研究在三個多跳問答資料集、兩種 Qwen3.5 規模評估，每個資料集使用 128 題並重複三個訓練種子。6,400 篇文件下，9B 模型較同記憶預算的 ReMemR1 提升 10.4–11.4 個 F1 百分點；控制答案獎勵權重後，證據回饋仍有收益。人工稽核的已接受事實來源支持率為 97.2%，但不代表真實性或答案必然正確。限制是測試集中於加入大量短干擾段落的英文問答、同一家族模型，尚未驗證程式碼等任務；4B 最長輸入推論比 GRU-Mem 慢 15.6%，容量壓力也可能丟失證據。主要結果表未完整擷取，但附錄提供關鍵數值與信賴區間。此研究的價值在於把「何時壓縮」納入可訓練記憶決策；權重與評估清單仍待釋出。

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.4, Algorithm 1 and Appendix C: construct query-independent types, extract document-local mentions, resolve them to a shared registry, retain entities present in at least two documents and render attributed Entity Pages. Original documents remain accessible, and the agent traverses entity–document links using ordinary shell tools.

Section 4 and Appendix A: evaluate 80 multi-document EnterpriseRAG-Bench questions over 2,819 gold/one-hop documents, 79 multi-document WixQA questions over 6,221 articles and 238 HERB content questions over 6,365 documents; HERB corpus consists of evidence artifacts plus metadata. These are selected question/corpus settings, not unrestricted full enterprise collections.

Table 1 and Appendix B.1, Table 6: four GPT-model main results are means over three runs; dataset-balanced quality gains over Raw Corpus range from 6.45 to 11.74 points, with geometric-mean input-token ratios 0.43–0.66. Paired question bootstrap uses 100,000 resamples and Holm correction, reporting all five-baseline comparisons significant at p < 0.0001.

Table 1 and Table 2: token improvements are not universal. Luna HERB rises from 219.4k to 254.2k input tokens, and MAI EnterpriseRAG rises from 129.6k to 158.8k despite quality improving from 34.06 to 45.07. DeepSeek quality improves from 68.02 to 71.11 with tokens falling from 1,349.4k to 1,043.3k.

Appendix B.3, Table 8: GPT-5.5 EnterpriseRAG Raw Corpus scores 65.60 using 206.5k tokens; adding relevant raw-document candidates yields 66.19/107.4k. CorpusMap without candidates reaches 69.04/496.4k, while default relevant entity-linked-document candidates reach 76.60/88.1k; random linked-document candidates fall to 60.76/413.5k. This separates map benefit from the strong effect of relevant entry paths.

Appendix B.2, Table 7: re-judging GPT-5.5 answers with DeepSeek preserves CorpusMap as the strongest retrieval method on all five judged metrics, although context-recall ranking agreement is only Kendall tau 0.47. Appendix B.4 reports added entity–entity edges enlarge pages by 27–52% and increase tokens by up to 28%, with document-recall changes of -2.6 to +0.2 points.

Section 5.2, Table 4: Luna-built maps improve every tested answering model over Raw Corpus and have reported construction cost at most $74.65, versus at most $4,732.14 for GPT-5.5-built maps. Figures 3–5 and surrounding text discuss incremental updates, scaling, GLinker construction and Qwen reuse, but precise plotted values are not exposed in the supplied textual source.

Ethics and Reproducibility statements, Appendix A and Appendix C: discuss aggregation of sensitive information and possible permission leakage, and propose permission-aware deployment without reporting an access-control evaluation. The paper specifies benchmark subsets, API-call period and construction prompts; no code-release link or direct entity-resolution accuracy/error analysis is provided in the supplied text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to agent tool use, retrieval-augmented reasoning and reusable external memory. CorpusMap exposes a source-grounded entity–document bipartite graph directly to a shell-based search agent, combining offline resolution with query-time candidate paths; the contribution is a practical interface and empirical design study rather than a fundamentally new entity-linking algorithm. Three-run results across three benchmarks and four GPT models, further model-family checks, paired bootstrap intervals, an alternate judge and useful candidate/edge ablations provide substantial evidence. Generality is qualified by selected, gold-containing corpora and predominantly enterprise/support QA; reduced token use is an aggregate result rather than universal. Candidate initialization materially contributes, fixed-context graph-retrieval comparisons use a different inference regime, map construction can be costly, and entity-resolution errors and permission safety are not directly quantified. Detailed construction prompts aid replication, but the supplied paper provides no code-release link and leaves some budget, candidate-count and construction/scaling details to references or figures.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項工作高度切合代理工具使用、檢索增強推理與可重用外部記憶。CorpusMap 將以來源為根據的實體–文件二分圖直接提供給以 shell 為基礎的搜尋代理，結合離線實體解析與查詢時候選路徑；貢獻是實用介面與實證設計研究，而非根本全新的實體連結演算法。跨三個基準與四個 GPT 模型的三次執行結果、額外模型家族檢查、成對 bootstrap 區間、替代評判器，以及有用的候選／邊消融，提供了充分證據。

但普遍性受限於經選取且包含標準答案證據的語料，以及以企業／支援問答為主的任務；token 使用量降低是整體彙總結果，並非普遍成立。候選初始化貢獻顯著，固定上下文的圖檢索比較採用不同推論方式，圖譜建構可能成本高昂，且未直接量化實體解析錯誤與權限安全。詳細建構提示有助於重現，但所提供論文沒有程式碼釋出連結，部分預算、候選數量與建構／擴展細節也留在參考文獻或圖中。

papers.summary_zh: CorpusMap 研究 LLM 代理如何在大型文件庫中連結分散的證據。它先離線歸納實體類型、擷取文件內提及，再跨文件辨識同一實體，建立附來源事實與文件連結的 Entity Page；原始文件仍可搜尋。查詢時，BM25 先提供相關實體所連結文件的路徑，代理再透過命令列工具閱讀與探索。研究涵蓋三個問答基準與七種模型；四種 GPT 主實驗各執行三次，相較直接搜尋原始文件，跨資料集平均品質提高 6.45–11.74 分，輸入 token 的幾何平均比率降至 0.43–0.66 倍。配對 bootstrap、替換評審模型及候選路徑消融支持結果；沒有候選路徑時，品質仍改善，但 token 用量明顯上升，顯示導覽圖與入口檢索需共同設計。低成本模型建圖後可供其他模型重用，也展示增量更新與 GLinker 替代流程。不過部分模型與資料集組合的 token 反而增加，初始建圖成本高，測試語料經篩選，且未量化實體辨識錯誤或實際權限隔離成效。論文提供詳細提示詞，但未附可核實的程式碼發布連結。其價值是把跨文件關係變成可重用的代理記憶與導覽介面，為企業 RAG 提供可檢驗的系統設計方向。

links.title: Looped Transformers as Optimizers

evidence: Sections 3.2–4 and Appendix E: the closed-form update follows a local objective while holding the input map, bias, and predicted target fixed for the algebra; full end-to-end training still backpropagates through them, and the local objective differs from the causal LM training loss.
Section 5.1, Table 2: aligning Parcae read/write maps increases average commonsense accuracy from 59.14 to 59.29; HyperLoop alignment improves 58.93 to 59.47, with mixed individual-task changes.
Section 5.2, Table 3: OperLoop uses parameter ratios 0.56 and 0.48 at matched training FLOPs; EM averages are 25.58 versus 23.89 and 37.46 versus 36.42 for corresponding non-looped baselines.

Table 3: non-looped baselines remain better on Wikitext/Lambada perplexity and LL averages; smaller-scale overall EM-and-LL average is 42.68 for OperLoop versus 43.04 for the baseline, while larger-scale values are 51.68 versus 51.41.

Section 5.3, Tables 4–6: separately trained Loop6 costs 1.67x FLOPs and increases OperLoop EM average from 25.58 to 31.90; removing the delta objective reduces EM to 24.84, and non-causal or unit step-size variants score 24.02 and 24.40.

Appendices B–D, Algorithm 1 and Tables 8–10: specify four streams, loop-specific controllers, MoE architecture, Muon/AdamW settings, nominal 281.018B/503.316B tokens, and lm-eval-harness v0.4.13; Appendix D states all compared runs use the same training and evaluation seed and final checkpoints.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to language-model architecture, latent reasoning, code generation, and parameter-efficient scaling. The local optimizer formulation leads to concrete read/write-map alignment and OperLoop delta/decay/step-size design, tested at two MoE scales with matched unrolled training FLOPs and component ablations. Generative averages improve with roughly half the parameters, but gains are modest and task-dependent; perplexity and commonsense averages remain below non-looped baselines. The optimizer interpretation is a fixed-map/fixed-target local construction, not proof of descent on a common objective or convergence. All runs share one training/evaluation seed, Loop6 is separately trained with more compute, and experiments cover one backbone family; inference-only extrapolation and uncertainty of gains remain unestablished. Architecture tables, pseudocode and evaluation version help, but the supplied source omits training-corpus composition and a dedicated code/checkpoint release. Assessment is based on the complete supplied HTML text, including appendices, rather than external artifacts or figure pixels.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項工作高度切合語言模型架構、潛在推理、程式生成與參數高效率擴展。局部最佳化器形式化導出具體的讀寫映射對齊，以及 OperLoop 的 delta／衰減／步長設計，並在兩種 MoE 規模上，以展開後訓練 FLOPs 配對及元件消融進行測試。使用約一半參數時，生成任務平均表現有所提升，但增益不大且依任務而異；困惑度與常識任務平均表現仍遜於非循環基準。

最佳化器詮釋是固定映射／固定目標下的局部構造，不能證明對共用目標持續下降或收斂。所有執行共用單一訓練／評估種子，Loop6 另外使用更多運算量訓練，且實驗只涵蓋一個骨幹家族；純推論時外推與增益的不確定性仍未確立。架構表、虛擬碼與評估版本有所幫助，但所提供來源省略訓練語料組成，也未提供專屬的程式碼／檢查點釋出。此評估依據包含附錄在內的完整所提供 HTML 文字，而非外部產物或圖像像素。

papers.summary: Looped Transformers provide a parameter-efficient approach to depth scaling by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks. Recent reasoning models have likewise highlighted the value of scaling test-time computation through longer computation trajectories. However, the principles for designing effective loop transitions remain poorly understood. We view the looped hidden state as a fast weight that is updated throughout the depth. We formulate loop transitions as local gradient-based updates,
papers.summary_zh: 增加語言模型深度通常也會增加參數；本文研究共用 Transformer 區塊反覆計算時，如何設計每次隱藏狀態的更新。作者把狀態當成沿深度更新的 fast weight，以投影、局部目標與最佳化規則重述既有架構，並提出 OperLoop：讓讀取與寫回映射對齊，加入 delta objective、權重衰減及逐輪遞減的自適應步長。在兩種 MoE 規模、相同訓練 FLOPs 下，約用非迴圈基準一半參數，六項生成評分的平均值分別由23.89升至25.58、36.42升至37.46；但困惑度與常識評分仍較差。移除 delta objective 或步長設計的消融也支持各元件的作用。局部梯度推導暫時固定映射與預測目標，並不證明模型在最小化同一個全域目標。六輪模型另行訓練且增加計算量，不能當成單純推論時加算的證據。所有比較只用同一個訓練種子，亦未交代完整訓練資料或提供專屬程式與權重，限制重現及穩健性判斷。這項工作的價值在於提供可實作、可消融的迴圈架構設計方法，仍需跨資料、種子與更大規模驗證。

links.title: FocusVTC: Efficient and High-Performance Visual Text Compression with Adaptive Resolution

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.4 and Appendix B: aligned 72-DPI global pages and 144-DPI crops, 29,411 verified REL-CoT examples expanded across seven resolutions, and 10,000 GRPO prompts with correctness-gated localization/call-efficiency rewards.

Section 4.2, Tables 1–2, and Appendix C.3: LongBench averages 11 non-code tasks (56.40 versus 55.86 for Qwen3.5-9B Text); VTCBench Retrieval/Reasoning/Memory averages are 91.00/36.25/26.33, with Reasoning below the visual backbone at 41.57.

Section 4.3, Table 3: removing SFT lowers LongBench to 49.30, removing tools to 36.82, and enabling tools on the SFT-only checkpoint lowers it from 37.86 to 25.41, supporting the need for learned tool policies.
Section 4.4 and Appendix C.1, Table 10: at 72 DPI, RULER v1 scores 87.38 using 2,154 prompt plus 723 observation tokens (2.9x compression); Glyph scores 57.53 at 3.0x compression.

Appendix C.2, Table 11: 300 paired 64K–128K four-needle MRCR examples on two A100 80GB GPUs yield 187.09 versus 67.06 seconds online latency; rendering is subtracted, and generated tokens drop from 5,411.30 to 1,529.77.

Appendices A, B, C.5, and D: report controlled font diagnostics and training settings; all six general multimodal benchmark scores improve, but several MMLongBench tasks do not, and limitations acknowledge a single 9B backbone and restricted training/document diversity.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strong match for long-context LLM efficiency, multimodal reasoning, and learned tool use. FocusVTC combines low-resolution global pages with selective high-resolution crops, 29,411 spatially grounded REL-CoT examples, multi-resolution SFT, and correctness-gated GRPO rewards. Its contribution is a well-developed integration of localization supervision and crop-policy learning rather than the first adaptive-resolution approach. Extensive training-stage/tool ablations, resolution sweeps, font controls, and several long-context suites substantiate large gains over fixed-resolution baselines, with observation tokens included in compression accounting. However, the 56.40 versus 55.86 LongBench advantage covers only 11 non-code tasks and lacks uncertainty estimates; most accuracy evaluation is stochastic without reported multi-seed intervals. VTCBench reasoning averages below the unmodified visual backbone (36.25 versus 41.57), and the closest adaptive-reading methods are discussed but not directly benchmarked. The 2.79x latency result is confined to 300 paired MRCR examples, excludes page rendering, and coincides with substantially fewer generated tokens, so it does not isolate input-compression speedup. One trained 9B backbone, limited document diversity, and no equally post-trained text-input control constrain generalization and causal attribution. Detailed hyperparameters and data composition help reproduction; the supplied text advertises code, models, and data but does not establish their downloadable contents.

papers.summary: Long-context reasoning in large language models incurs substantial computation and memory costs. Visual text compression (VTC) reduces input length by rendering text as images, but fixed-resolution rendering creates a compression-performance trade-off: low DPI saves tokens at the expense of legibility, whereas high DPI spends tokens on irrelevant content. We introduce FocusVTC, which breaks this trade-off through adaptive resolution while preserving general multimodal capabilities. It combines c
papers.summary_zh: 長文件轉成影像可減少 LLM 輸入詞元，但低解析度容易看錯文字，高解析度又會浪費資源。FocusVTC 保留低解析度全頁概覽，讓模型在推理時呼叫工具，取得重要區域的高解析度影像。作者建立約 2.94 萬筆帶頁碼與框選位置的 REL-CoT 資料，先做多解析度 SFT，再以 GRPO 學習何時放大、如何定位與停止。在 72 DPI 的 RULER v1，包含工具觀測後仍達 2.9 倍輸入壓縮，分數 87.38，高於 Glyph 的 57.53；LongBench 的 11 項非程式任務平均為 56.40，略高於文字骨幹的 55.86。消融顯示，單加工具可能使表現下降，策略訓練是關鍵。不過，VTCBench 推理平均低於原始視覺骨幹，且主要準確率未提供多種子不確定性。300 筆 MRCR 範例的線上延遲改善 2.79 倍，但排除頁面轉繪，也伴隨生成詞元減少，不能完全歸因於輸入壓縮。研究僅驗證單一 9B 骨幹，尚缺同等後訓練的文字對照與其他自適應方法比較。其價值在於示範可學習的選擇性閱讀，同時揭示裁切成本、任務類型與視覺可讀性都須納入效率評估。

links.title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA

evidence: Sections 3.3-3.5 and Appendices A.1-A.4: global atomic-fact retrieval is separated from a transient verified evidence graph; verification uses extracted parent-turn fact sets, not verbatim source turns; GRPO rewards newly recovered gold parent turns with progress weighting.
Section 4.3, Table 2: with Qwen3-30B evidence/answer processing, MERA-Small, MERA-Large and MERA-RL score 68.40/73.30/77.40 on LoCoMo and 59.80/67.33/71.29 on LongMemEval-S.

Appendix B.1: evaluation uses all 1,986 LoCoMo questions but only a held-out 101-question LongMemEval-S split; Section 4.2, Table 1 mixes starred own-run entries and unstarred entries, and GPT-4o-mini FullText scores 71.83 versus MERA-RL 67.02 on LoCoMo.

Sections 4.5-4.6 and Appendix D.2: MERA-RL recall rises 55.5% to 80.5% on LoCoMo and 84.9% to 98.9% on LongMemEval-S; the graph-versus-flat comparison explicitly removes associated state-maintenance mechanisms, not only graph representation, and RL no longer beats the large planner in the flat variant.

Appendices C.1-C.2: MERA online generative token totals are 15.27k/Q on LoCoMo and 17.40k/Q on LongMemEval-S, excluding embeddings and judging; reported LongMemEval-S runtime is 48.3 s/Q for MERA-RL versus 155.5 s/Q for MERA-Large in the stated serving setup.

Appendices A.4.5, B.3 and E.2: separate reward/filtering ablations are left to future work, accuracy uses an LLM judge, and failure-attribution percentages are diagnostic labels rather than manually adjudicated causal rates; Reproducibility Statement promises code and training data only after peer review.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant agent-memory/RAG work combining globally searchable atomic facts, verifier-gated question-specific evidence state and missing-evidence GRPO for a 0.6B planner. The controlled planner comparison, two backbones, recall trajectories, aggregation tests and cost diagnostics support practical usefulness; methodological novelty is mainly the integrated state/reward design rather than a new RL algorithm. Evidence is bounded by two conversational benchmarks, only 101 held-out LongMemEval-S questions, LLM-judged accuracy without reported uncertainty, and graph ablations that change the wider workflow. Reward variants and filtering are not separately ablated; baseline provenance and differing diagnostic configurations are not fully auditable. Training hyperparameters, exact prompts and split identifiers are not fully supplied, and code/training-data release is deferred until peer review. The small planner still relies on a large evidence/answer model; superiority is not universal, since FullText exceeds MERA with GPT-4o-mini on LoCoMo.

primary_link.title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA

papers.summary: Long-term memory enables language models to use past interactions in future conversations. However, evidence needed to answer a question may be scattered across distant turns, while the question itself omits clues needed to locate it. Retrieved facts can reveal these clues, motivating retrieval decisions conditioned on evidence already found. We introduce MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation), which separates globally searchable memory from a question-specific evidence state. Verified e
papers.summary_zh: 長期對話問答常因問題未提供關鍵人物、事件或時間線索，漏掉分散在歷史中的必要證據。MERA 將可全域搜尋的 atomic-fact 記憶索引，與每題逐步更新的證據圖分開；小型規劃器依已驗證事實產生後續查詢，檢索後彙整同一對話輪次的抽取事實，再由驗證器決定是否納入。訓練採 GRPO，獎勵找回尚未取得的標註證據，重複命中不加分，其他模型與記憶索引保持固定。搭配 Qwen3-30B 驗證及作答，受訓的 0.6B 規劃器在 LoCoMo 達 77.40% 準確率，在 LongMemEval-S 的 101 題保留測試集達 71.29%，分別超過未受此訓練的 30B 規劃器 4.10、3.96 個百分點；LoCoMo 累積證據召回率由首輪 55.5% 升至 80.5%。這提供了以檢索結果訓練小型搜尋決策模型的實用方向，但仍依賴大型模型處理證據，且圖與扁平證據比較同時改變多項流程，無法單獨歸因於圖結構。評估依賴 LLM judge，缺少準確率的不確定性與獎勵項消融；程式碼及訓練資料僅承諾審查後公開，真實個人助理情境的效益仍待驗證。

evidence: Section 3.2 and Appendix C: the binary reward uses final-label correctness only, with a shared outcome-derived advantage applied to the complete generated response.
Section 4.2, Table 1: Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 improves from 60.3 to 85.2 ProcessBench F1; TIPS trains on 3.2K outcome-labeled trajectories and trails o1-mini at 87.9.

Sections 4.3–4.4, Tables 2–4: agent mean gains are 2.5–5.4 points; 8B HotPotQA declines 3.2 points; thinking-model Best-of-8 is 73.3 versus 72.8 before training; label-only prompting gains only 0.7 PRM points.
Section 3.3, Figure 6, and Appendix A: bounds depend on nontrivial verification and outcome–process coupling; Qwen2.5 process accuracy degrades at later checkpoints; multimodal settings are untested.

Appendices E, G, and H: agent training is decontaminated with task-prompt 5-gram Jaccard >0.8; 38/60 human-audited cases have both correct localization and explanation; solver-format RLVR does not reproduce verification gains.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM reasoning, reward modeling, and agent error localization: TIPS uses outcome-only GRPO to improve generative step verification without process labels. Matched-data baselines, a CoT ablation, four backbone families, and solver controls support a meaningful contribution; the 4B thinking model reaches 85.2 ProcessBench F1 from 60.3 using 3.2K trajectories. Practical gains are more modest: Best-of-8 improves only 72.8 to 73.3, and agent gains vary with a HotPotQA regression for the 8B model. The information-theoretic bound does not guarantee faithful step labels, weaker priors can degrade during training, and no repeated-seed uncertainty is reported. Detailed training settings and a stated code/data release help reproducibility, while the small human audit and text-only coverage limit broader claims.

primary_link.title: Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. However, training strong PRMs remains costly: human step annotation is difficult to scale, while Monte Carlo estimation is computationally expensive and can drift from the intrinsic correctness of steps. To get effective PRMs at low cost, we introduce TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision), an outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) framework
papers.summary_zh: 建立可靠的過程獎勵模型通常需要昂貴的逐步標註或大量 Monte Carlo 推演。TIPS 讓模型先產生 CoT，再輸出各步驟與最終結果的判斷，卻只依最終判斷是否正確給獎勵，以 GRPO 更新整段回應。其核心想法是，若驗證中間步驟有助判斷結果，結果回饋就可能間接強化過程驗證。實驗涵蓋四個骨幹模型家族、數學與代理任務；Qwen3-4B-Thinking 僅用 3.2K 條結果標註軌跡，就將 ProcessBench F1 從 60.3 提升至 85.2，代理平均錯誤定位準確率也提高 5.4 個百分點。不過，下游 Best-of-8 僅增加 0.5 個百分點，部分代理子任務仍退步，人工稽核中同時正確定位並解釋錯誤的比例為 38/60。理論提供的是條件式資訊下界，並非標籤忠實性的保證；較弱模型可能學到捷徑，且尚未測試多模態情境。這項工作提供低標註成本的驗證器訓練方向，值得關注其跨任務穩定性與實際推論成本。

links.title: Hidden Reasoning Must Leak, but Need Not Be Readable: Fundamental Opportunities and Limits for Chain-of-Thought Monitoring

evidence: Sections 2–3 and Appendix B.1–B.5, pp. 2–4 and 21–26: the monitor sees CoT but neither covert input nor final answer. Fixed-precision Transformers are related to bounded-depth circuits; for the stated hard tasks, uniform inputs and correctness on every input, information/capacity/length bounds give a near-linear footprint up to model- and depth-dependent logarithmic factors. This concerns input information, not guaranteed readability or detection of a malicious-intent bit.

Section 3.2, Corollaries B.9–B.10 and FAQ A.2, pp. 4–5, 19 and 26–27: the length-tax bound assumes a public input recoverable from CoT and the stated uniform marginals; public/covert correlation reduces the extra entropy cost. The comparison is to information-theoretically minimal aligned traces, not arbitrary verbose baselines. Theorem 3.3/B.11, pp. 5 and 27–28, limits the benefit of independent private r-bit randomness to r bits of footprint reduction.

Section 3.3 and Appendix B.8, pp. 5–6 and 28–31: online decryption/update/reencryption can be implemented by a one-layer Transformer family using local PRGs, sublinear private seeds and oblivious access patterns. Semantic security is conditional on the PRG assumption, and arbitrary polynomial-time computation requires stronger stretch assumptions. The formal family uses length-dependent positional encodings and polynomially growing hidden dimension; it is not a fixed small pretrained model for arbitrary lengths. The Goldreich candidate is explicitly unproven and has practical/subexponential attack caveats.

Appendix C.1–C.2 and C.6–C.8, pp. 36–46: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct are finetuned across four synthetic tasks with three seeds, matched covert examples, task-aware splits and 200 held-out examples per displayed difficulty per seed. All displayed difficulties are within training support. Full-CoT uses matched examples/epochs but longer targets; neither it nor the primary mechanisms are token/compute matched.

Appendix C.2, Tables 3–4, pp. 37–40: Special Tokens uses a supervised, locally aligned variation-selector codebook, decodable by a knowledgeable monitor. Exact whole-example payload recovery is high on addition/S5/parity but falls at four-digit multiplication to 33.83±8.52% for Qwen and 1.00±0.50% for Llama. Zero flags in 192,000 responses establish compliance with the explicit human-visible leakage detector, which strips the hidden payload; they do not establish security or absence of encoded information.

Appendix C.5–C.6, Tables 6–7, pp. 42–45: Qwen four-digit multiplication covert accuracy is 2.0±0.9% Vanilla, 43.8±5.0% Piggybacking and 48.3±6.0% Special Tokens. Llama primary protocols are roughly 0–1% there, and even its Full-CoT is 0.8±0.3%, versus 73.8±2.5% for Qwen. At 128–255-bit parity, Qwen Piggybacking/Special Tokens reach 99.0/94.8% and Llama 100.0/99.8%, against approximately 49–51% independent controls; piggybacking deliberately shares all but the final flipped bit.

Appendix D.1–D.4 and D.9–D.10, pp. 47–50, 58 and 73: prompting retains the 20 calibration examples in each final 100-trial evaluation and conditions accuracy on nonleaking, appropriately parsed responses. Table 10 reports 22.1% leakage for Qwen3.5 0.8B S5 Public-only, while Table 11 reports 61.3% complete parsing failure among its nonleaking responses. Conditional accuracy is therefore not unconditional success. Model-size threshold fits are observational and do not directly test the formal all-input assumptions.

Appendix D.8, Tables 8–9, pp. 58 and 71–72: averaged filler effects are small and negative, at −0.4/−0.3 percentage points covert accuracy and −0.5/−0.4 points joint accuracy for Vanilla/Public-only. Effects vary by model/task. Prompting appends ellipses to the user input, whereas finetuning generates serial filler tokens, so the two filler interventions differ.

Appendix E, Tables 13–15, pp. 75–78: separately trained one-layer, width-128, 16-head models use routing labels, supervised retrieved-bit representations, exhaustive local Boolean training and teacher-forced integration. Greedy tests on 8,192 unseen-seed examples reach 99.8291% complete encrypted-CoT plus final-answer accuracy at N=1024. Each length has one initialization/training seed; validation selects checkpoints, and earlier test aggregates informed development. These are held-out-from-fitting results rather than untouched development-independent tests.

Appendix E, Tables 16–17 and exploratory LoRA diagnostic, pp. 78–80: no-CoT/filler controls fall near chance at N=32/64, but preparatory retrieval supervision covers at most 16 positions, explicitly confounding a fundamental-threshold interpretation. Removing all intermediate supervision gives 50% final parity and zero complete/joint accuracy at N=32/64; route-label removal also fails at N=64. Qwen LoRA fails to compose long encrypted traces, with zero exact joint accuracy at N=32 in validation-only diagnostics. No monitor attack or empirical cryptographic-security test is reported.

Appendix C.9, D.11–D.12 and E Reproducibility, pp. 46, 71–74 and 81: detailed code paths, task splits, training stages, parser rules, providers/quantization and PyTorch 2.3.1 are supplied; GitHub code/metrics and Zenodo data/raw outputs/checkpoints are claimed. Neither coverage report verified an actionable archive URL or external availability. Extracted figures often supply captions without plotted pixels; no absent point estimates or theorem defects are inferred from extraction layout.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A highly relevant and original contribution to LLM reasoning, interpretability and safety: architecture-conditioned information lower bounds distinguish information leakage from efficient readability, and a conditional one-layer encrypted-computation construction makes that distinction concrete. Detailed proofs, paired three-seed finetuning experiments, payload/format audits and explicit negative results support substantial rigor. The theory requires fixed-precision models, hard synthetic tasks and distribution/correctness assumptions; encryption privacy additionally depends on an unproven PRG assumption. Empirical support is strongest for deliberately engineered, finite-length mechanisms, not practical monitor failure: encryption uses heavy intermediate supervision, one run and a separately trained model per length; development consulted test aggregates, and retrieval-limited controls confound sharp thresholds. Prompting conditions on successful parsing/nonleakage and retains calibration samples. Synthetic tasks, simplified correlated inputs, pretrained LoRA failure and no adversarial-monitor evaluation constrain generalization. Reproducibility benefits from detailed protocols and claimed archives, whose availability was not independently verified. This assessment synthesizes both complete native coverage reports; it does not claim a single reader read the full source.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項工作對 LLM 推理、可解釋性與安全具有高度相關性與原創性：以架構為條件的資訊下界，區分資訊洩漏與高效率可讀性，而有條件的單層加密計算構造則將這項區別具體化。詳細證明、成對三種子微調實驗、酬載／格式稽核，以及明確的負面結果，支持相當高的嚴謹程度。理論需要固定精度模型、困難的合成任務，以及分布／正確性假設；加密隱私還依賴未經證明的 PRG 假設。

實證最有力地支持刻意設計、有限長度的機制，而非實務上的監控失效：加密使用大量中間監督、僅執行一次，且每個長度分別訓練模型；開發時參考測試集彙總結果，檢索受限控制也使鮮明門檻的解釋受到混淆。提示實驗以成功解析／未洩漏為條件，並保留校準樣本。合成任務、簡化的相關輸入、預訓練模型 LoRA 失敗，以及沒有對抗式監控器評估，都限制了泛化。詳細協定與宣稱提供的封存檔有助於可重現性，但未獨立確認其可取得性。本評估綜合兩份完整的原生閱讀涵蓋報告，不宣稱由單一讀者讀完全部來源。

We show that the answer depends on the underlying task difficulty and the model size. papers.summary_zh: Chain-of-Thought 監控能否辨識藏在推理中的祕密計算？本文區分「留下資訊」與「監控者能讀懂資訊」：在固定精度 Transformer、均勻輸入與所有輸入皆正確等條件下，利用電路複雜度與互資訊界，證明困難任務需要接近線性的資訊足跡；與公開任務相關的輸入可重用計算，降低額外推理長度。另一方面，若局部 pseudorandom generator 的安全假設成立，單層模型也能在線更新加密狀態，使有效率的監控者難以解讀。實驗以四類合成任務、兩個微調模型及多組提示測試比較隱藏通道；資訊通道常有幫助，但長位數乘法並非跨模型有效。另以大量路由、位元及局部運算監督訓練單層模型，在長度 1024 的 parity 測試中，完整加密軌跡連同最終答案的正確率達 99.8291%。這是可學得的工程化範例：各長度分開訓練且只有單次執行，開發曾參考測試彙整，移除中間監督後失敗，也未實測密碼安全或自然語言欺騙。提示結果另排除洩漏與解析失敗案例。本文對推理監控的價值，在於釐清資訊存在、可計算地讀取與實務可偵測性之間的差距。

links.title: EasyPPO: Stabilizing the Critic Is Key

evidence: Sections 3 and 9.2, equations (3)–(4) and (21)–(24): joint actor/critic filtering targets reward conditional on completion in the accurate response-level critic limit; actor-only filtering preserves a completion-probability term while retaining selection bias.

Sections 4 and 9.1–9.4, equations (5)–(7) and (29)–(31): inverse-STD critic weighting balances return-noise contributions; empirical group weights may be biased, and the clipping proof concerns fixed-parameter averages rather than sequential Adam parameter changes.
Section 5 and Section 10.1, Table 8: best unsmoothed FrontierCS/AIME24/Search-R1 scores are PPO 12.90/64.06/39.48 and EasyPPO 14.82/65.52/43.22; the main figure uses one run per method and task.

Section 5 and Section 10.3: three FrontierCS critic initializations show no EasyPPO collapse versus two of three actor-only-filtering collapses; execution configurations vary, all three share steps 0–170, and one EasyPPO run ends at step 172.

Sections 5 and 8.1–8.4, Tables 1–7: all tasks use the Qwen3.5-9B family, with detailed data, optimizer, baseline and ablation settings; VAPO auxiliary positive-example language-modeling loss is disabled.
Title/front matter supplies https://github.com/EasyPPO/EasyPPO; only its presence in the supplied source was verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM post-training, reasoning, coding, and search agents. EasyPPO combines actor-only truncation filtering, inverse-return-standard-deviation critic weighting, and four clipped critic mini-batches. Its contribution is a useful diagnosis and practical integration rather than a fundamentally new policy optimizer. The complete supplied paper supports the mechanism with conditional-gradient and noise analyses, critic diagnostics, filtering/normalization/mini-batch ablations, and three task families. Best validation scores improve from PPO's 12.90/64.06/39.48 to 14.82/65.52/43.22 on FrontierCS/AIME24/Search-R1. Confidence in broad superiority is moderated by one main run per method/task, validation-peak reporting, a single Qwen3.5-9B model family, and only a three-critic-initialization FrontierCS repeat study with differing execution configurations. The VAPO comparison omits its auxiliary language-modeling loss. The theory explicitly idealizes clipping, state weighting, or fixed parameters; using the same samples for variance weights and critic training can bias estimation, and the mini-batch ablation also changes optimizer dynamics. Detailed configurations and a code URL aid reproduction, but repository availability was not independently checked. Overall, this is a strong, actionable PPO stability paper with narrower empirical coverage than its broad motivation.

Its contribution is a useful diagnosis and practical integration rather than a fundamentally new policy optimizer. The complete supplied paper supports the mechanism with conditional-gradient and noise analyses, critic diagnostics, filtering/normalization/mini-batch ablations, and three task families. Best validation scores improve from PPO's 12.90/64.06/39.48 to 14.82/65.52/43.22 on FrontierCS/AIME24/Search-R1. Confidence in broad superiority is moderated by one main run per method/task, validation-peak reporting, a single Qwen3.5-9B model family, and only a three-critic-initialization FrontierCS repeat study with differing execution configurations. The VAPO comparison omits its auxiliary language-modeling loss. The theory explicitly idealizes clipping, state weighting, or fixed parameters; using the same samples for variance weights and critic training can bias estimation, and the mini-batch ablation also changes optimizer dynamics. Detailed configurations and a code URL aid reproduction, but repository availability was not independently checked. Overall, this is a strong, actionable PPO stability paper with narrower empirical coverage than its broad motivation.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本文高度切合 LLM 後訓練、推理、程式設計與搜尋代理。EasyPPO 結合僅對 actor 過濾截斷軌跡、依回報標準差倒數加權 critic，以及四個採用梯度裁剪的 critic 小批次。貢獻主要是實用的失穩診斷與方法整合，而非全新的策略最佳化器。完整提供的論文以條件式梯度與雜訊分析、critic 診斷、過濾／正規化／小批次消融，以及三類任務支持其機制。FrontierCS／AIME24／Search-R1 的最佳驗證分數由 PPO 的 12.90／64.06／39.48 提升至 14.82／65.52／43.22。不過，各方法與任務的主要比較僅跑一次，採用驗證峰值，模型限於 Qwen3.5-9B 家族；三種 critic 初始化的重複實驗僅涵蓋 FrontierCS，且執行設定不同，因此廣泛優勢仍需審慎看待。VAPO 比較省略其輔助語言建模損失。理論明確採用裁剪、狀態加權或固定參數的理想化條件；以同批樣本估計變異權重並訓練 critic 可能引入偏差，小批次消融也同時改變最佳化器動態。詳細設定與程式碼網址有助重現，但未獨立確認儲存庫可用性。整體而言，這是有實作價值的 PPO 穩定性研究，實證涵蓋範圍仍小於其廣泛動機。

primary_link.title: EasyPPO: Stabilizing the Critic Is Key

papers.summary: A key strength of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is its learned critic, which uses historical trajectories collected during reinforcement learning to estimate expected returns and reduce policy-gradient variance. However, we find that the critic is also a major source of instability in reinforcement learning for large language models (LLMs). We identify two critic failure modes that destabilize PPO. First, filtering truncated rollouts from both actor and critic shifts the policy objective to
papers.summary_zh:
LLM 的 PPO 後訓練可能因 critic 學習失穩而崩潰。本文指出，連同 critic 一起排除截斷軌跡，會讓價值估計偏向已完成回應；不同提示的回報雜訊，也可能讓高變異提示主導更新。

EasyPPO 採取三項修改：僅對 actor 過濾截斷軌跡、依提示回報標準差倒數加權 critic 損失，以及將 critic 更新分成適中的小批次並裁剪梯度。理論分析說明條件式目標偏移與雜訊尺度，並保留對估計偏差及理想化假設的說明。

- 在 Qwen3.5-9B 家族上，FrontierCS、AIME24、Search-R1 的最佳驗證分數分別達 14.82、65.52、43.22，較 PPO 高 1.92、1.46、3.74 分。
- 消融支持各項修改的作用；FrontierCS 三種 critic 初始化均未見崩潰，但其他任務主要比較各僅一次。

這套方法可為推理、程式與搜尋代理的 RL 訓練提供實用配方。不過，驗證峰值並非獨立測試結果，模型規模與家族有限，小批次實驗也改變最佳化器動態；跨模型及更長訓練期的效益仍待驗證。

links.title: On-Policy Parameter Update Direction Underlies Generalization in LLM Post-Training

evidence: Section 3.1, Equations 1–6 and Figure 2: compares on-policy advantage–score covariance with SFT gradients and reports interval/cumulative update-direction similarities; this is a characterization, not a generalization theorem.

Section 3.2, Equation 7, and Appendix A.4: OPSFT masks gradients opposing the cumulative on-policy parameter displacement and projects parameters after optimizer steps to enforce support and cumulative sign constraints.

Section 4.1, Table 2: Qwen3-8B OPSFT uses 50 GRPO steps plus 100 OPSFT steps, reporting mean accuracy 41.67 and 8.9 hours versus 40.31 and 19.3 hours for 100-step GRPO; OPSFT time includes direction identification.

Section 3.3, Table 1 and Figure 4: Qwen3-8B out-of-domain mean is 76.39 for OPSFT, 76.20 for GRPO, and 75.54 for SFT; directions transfer between math datasets but transfer from code directions to math is weak.
Section 4.2, Tables 3 and 5: continued OPSFT improves GRPO-post-trained models; on code, the reported Qwen3-4B mean rises from 57.19 to 60.05, whereas ordinary SFT yields 48.71.

Appendix B, Tables A9 and A13: OPD-based OPSFT reaches 16.71 mean versus 16.75 for OPD and 13.83 for vanilla SFT; GRPO location-plus-direction constraints reach 41.15 versus 34.07 for location alone and 27.71 for random directions.

Appendix A.1–A.3: specifies verified teacher trajectories, optimizer and hardware settings, fixed seed 42, eight math samples and four code samples per problem; no training-seed uncertainty intervals are supplied.

Appendix C.2: acknowledges reliance on high-quality trajectories from a substantially stronger teacher and unresolved effects of trajectory quality and suitability; front matter links the OPSFT GitHub repository.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM reasoning and post-training research: OPSFT turns cumulative on-policy parameter signs into a practical SFT constraint, with location-only and random-sign controls supporting a contribution beyond sparsity alone. Experiments cover several 1.7B–8B models, math and code, GRPO and a smaller OPD study; the Qwen3-8B efficiency experiment reports 41.67 versus 40.31 mean accuracy in 8.9 versus 19.3 hours. Detailed settings, pseudocode, and a code link aid reproduction. Confidence is tempered by a fixed training seed without uncertainty intervals, modest out-of-domain gains, failure to reuse directions across math and code, and dependence on stronger-teacher trajectories. The gradient identities motivate the observed geometry but do not prove that direction is the universal cause of generalization.

However, these studies treat the observed behaviors only as byproducts in on-policy training, overlooking their potential to serve as optimization principles for improving the generalization of other paradigms such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT). To address this limitation, we investigate whether there exists a specific on-policy update behavior that can achieve
papers.summary_zh: SFT 容易模仿教師軌跡，卻不一定保留 on-policy 訓練的泛化優勢。本文提出 OPSFT：先從 GRPO 或 OPD 前後的權重差取得各參數更新的正負號，再遮蔽方向相反的 SFT 梯度，並在最佳化步驟後投影參數，維持位置與累積方向約束。研究涵蓋 Qwen3 1.7B、4B、8B 與 DeepSeek 蒸餾模型的數學、程式任務；僅限制位置或使用隨機方向的消融結果較差，支持方向資訊的重要性。效率實驗中，Qwen3-8B 以 50 步 GRPO 取得方向、接續 100 步 OPSFT，四項數學評測平均準確率達 41.67，高於 100 步 GRPO 的 40.31，總時間由 19.3 降至 8.9 小時。繼續訓練已完成 GRPO 的模型也有改善。不過，實驗固定單一訓練種子、缺少不確定性區間，且依賴較強教師產生的高品質軌跡；同領域方向可沿用，數學與程式之間則不理想。這提供結合 RL 泛化與 SFT 效率的具體方法，但尚不足以證明更新方向能普遍解釋泛化。

links.title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning

evidence: Sections 2–3 and Appendix C.2: conversational assistance is reduced to an assistive POMDP; REVOIR represents intents with LLM-scored particles and compares one-step cost-adjusted ask/act values. C.2 approximates correction probability by 1 minus the maximum particle weight.

Appendix A, Propositions A.1–A.2: nonnegative information value requires Bayesian updating and a common fixed action set, or sufficient near-optimal candidate coverage; the implemented verbal belief approximations are not shown to satisfy these guarantees.

Appendix C.1, Table C.1: CondAmbigQA is split by question into 3,062/380/380 examples and 1,600/200/200 unique questions for train/dev/test. Appendices G.4–G.5 tune entropy and self-consistency thresholds on development data.

Appendix D, Tables D.1–D.3: Llama-3.1-8B REVOIR at budgets (100,50) scores 0.5370 with 1.94 questions under agent termination and 0.5635 with 2.24 total clarifications under user termination. Plain ReAct costs 2.6K tokens versus REVOIR 10.6K at the first budget; sampled ReAct can cost up to 73.9K, so reduced questioning is not universal compute savings.

Section 4.2 and Appendix I, Table I.1: factored incremental ICL REVOIR reaches 58.8%/56.0% seen/unseen ADAPT PSR with 2.1/2.0 questions, versus reproduced Reflection-DPO results of 44.1%/42.9% with 9.8/9.5 questions. Four-fold evaluation covers 16 personas and eight breakfast tasks (Appendix K.2).

Appendix E, Tables E.1–E.2: human replay judgments agree with simulated acceptance on 72/89 episodes, and with answer-quality rankings on 41/57 non-tied comparisons. Appendix D.2 explicitly notes that verbose shotgun answers benefit from the QA rubric; this is not a live-user effectiveness trial.

Section 5 and Appendices F/J: stated limits include myopic one-step reasoning, no full interleaving/dual control, and need for real-user evaluation. The supplied HTML shows unresolved beigefile prompt-file references throughout F/J; hyperparameters and algorithm descriptions are present, but the actual referenced template bodies are not.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong direct relevance to LLM agents, reasoning, clarification and preference alignment. REVOIR gives a useful training-free operationalization of cost-aware value of information, including post-action corrections, rather than a fundamentally new decision-theoretic principle. Two task domains, several model backbones, tuned baselines, belief ablations, correction/noise tests and a small human replay study support its usefulness. Evidence remains simulation-heavy: the QA judge is imperfect and rewards broad answers, ADAPT uses a changed two-stage policy with baseline numbers reproduced from prior work, and the QA fine-tuning baseline is a small-data ORPO adaptation. One-step lookahead, heuristic correction probability and uncalibrated verbal belief/reward scores limit normative guarantees and deployment transfer. Complete-status HTML was fully read, but figures are represented mainly by captions and both prompt libraries contain unresolved file-inclusion placeholders instead of the promised templates; no implementation-release link was found in the supplied text. These constrain reproducibility without changing the original content status.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項研究與 LLM 代理、推理、釐清問題及偏好對齊具有很強的直接相關性。REVOIR 提供有用、無須訓練且考量成本的資訊價值操作化方法，納入行動後修正，而非根本全新的決策理論原理。兩類任務、數種模型骨幹、經調參的基準、信念消融、修正／雜訊測試，以及小型人工重播研究，支持其實用性。

證據仍高度依賴模擬：問答評判器不完美，且會獎勵寬泛答案；ADAPT 使用經修改的兩階段策略，基準數字則重現自先前工作；問答微調基準是小資料量的 ORPO 調適。單步前瞻、啟發式修正機率，以及未校準的文字信念／獎勵分數，限制了規範性保證與部署遷移。已完整閱讀標示完整狀態的 HTML，但圖主要僅由圖說呈現，且兩套提示庫都含有未解析的檔案引入預留標記，而非承諾的範本；所提供文字中也找不到實作釋出連結。這些因素限制可重現性，但不改變原始內容狀態。

papers.summary: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking v
papers.summary_zh: 使用者的要求常有歧義，但每次追問都會增加負擔。REVOIR 將澄清建模為合作式決策問題，以 LLM 產生並更新多個意圖假設，模擬問題的回答及行動後的修正，再比較提問與直接行動的預期任務報酬及使用者成本。它重視資訊能否改善決策，也納入使用者事後糾正的價值。在 CondAmbigQA 與 ADAPT 的模擬評估中，方法通常以較少澄清取得良好的正確性或偏好滿足率；ADAPT 少樣本版本在已見與未見人物設定上分別達 58.8% 與 56.0%，相較引用的 Reflection-DPO 基準提高約 13–15 個百分點，提問約少五倍。研究亦提供信念表示消融、多模型比較及小型人工重播評估。不過，少提問不代表推論成本最低；方法只做一步前瞻，修正機率與信念權重採近似估計，QA 評分偏好涵蓋多種意圖的冗長答案。ADAPT 改為先問再執行，尚未證明真實使用者與完整交錯互動的效果，提供的文字也缺少部分提示範本內容。其價值是把「該不該問」化為可檢驗的任務效益取捨，適合設計兼顧可靠性與互動負擔的 LLM 助理。

links.title: EviViT: Evidence-Adaptive Vision Transformers for Fine-Grained Perception

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.5 and Appendix A.1–A.2: 1,144 human-search records supervise a question-conditioned PTEA, context prediction, bounded box refinement, and allocation of two or three original-image regions; a coordinate-aware Sparse Bridge fuses local/global tokens while the host ViT, merger, and LLM remain frozen. Separate attachments are fitted for Qwen3-VL-4B/8B and Qwen3.5-4B/9B.

Section 4.1, Table 1: the seven-benchmark fine-grained mean increases for all nine hosts, including 60.26 to 65.86 for Qwen3-VL-4B and 61.77 to 67.86 for 8B. Individual results can regress, for example Vision-OPD-9B V* falls from 93.19 to 90.05; mixed-source proprietary-model references are explicitly descriptive.

Section 4.2, Tables 2–3: across seven 1K–20K ceilings, paired mean VP/V* accuracy improves with roughly 90–97% of global-only visual tokens. At 8B/4K the result is 68.87 versus 62.83 using 3.62K versus 3.83K tokens; median end-to-end time is 1.105 versus 1.087 seconds. At 4B/1K it rises from 0.557 to 0.738 seconds, so fewer tokens do not establish a general speedup.

Appendix A.3, Tables 7–9: shuffling only PTEA questions reduces VP-All by 4.47 and 3.31 points on two large hosts; moving otherwise fixed crops lowers pooled accuracy by 9.49/9.63 points. Exact McNemar tests support Medium-tier gains on all four foundation hosts, while several Easy/Hard gains are not individually significant.

Appendix C.1, Table 13: full internal learned fusion, native multi-image original-pixel crops, and identity-bridge crops taken from the resized global image all attain 66.57 pooled accuracy on 706 questions; original-pixel identity fusion attains 65.86. These controls support useful selected views but do not isolate a necessary advantage from new native-pixel information or internal fusion.

Appendix C.3, Table 14: deployed crops cover 12.39% of image area yet average 73.69% target coverage on 186 held-out V* examples; every target reaches 90% coverage in 120 examples, falling to 98 when the context crop is removed. The 70.43% top-eight proposal diagnostic in Appendix A.3 is distinct from deployed-crop coverage.

Section 4.5, Table 5 and Appendix C.4: full-trace versus final-box supervision uses the same 1,144-example set, training schedule, and seed; VP-All rises 56.12 to 57.28 and VP-Hard 52.83 to 56.60, while ZoomBench ties. Appendix A.3, Table 6 also shows the 8B Boxes variant has a higher eight-task mean than the full model (63.94 versus 63.40).

Appendix B, Tables 11–12: broad-task compatibility is uneven: ZwZ-8B MMStar falls 65.33 to 62.20, ZwZ-4B Visual-CoT falls 77.77 to 74.96, and some document/OCR tasks regress. Appendix A.5 reports matched language-LoRA recovery on 10K examples, not universal preservation without adaptation.

Header, Ethics Statement and Reproducibility Statement: github.com/YXNiu/EviViT and huggingface.co/datasets/YXNiu/Human-Search-Traces are named; the repository is described as containing preparation/training/evaluation/judging scripts and summaries, while the public-code release excludes model weights, images, search traces, and QA training data. These are supplied-text claims, not externally verified downloads.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In scope: this is question-conditioned vision-language inference methodology, using language embeddings and answer supervision, rather than a pure-vision application. Human-search-supervised regional allocation and a frozen-host attachment offer a useful combination for multimodal evidence acquisition and token efficiency. Nine paired host evaluations, per-sample token ceilings, location/question controls, and deployed-crop coverage support improved fine-grained answering and useful region selection. Evidence for the stronger native-detail/fusion explanation is weaker: resized-global crops match the full method in pooled accuracy, native multi-image input also matches it, and the learned bridge adds only modest gains over identity. Full-trace supervision is tested with one shared seed and improves selected metrics, not every dataset. Token savings do not generally imply latency savings; broad-task regressions appear on several post-trained hosts. Transfer is restricted to compatible Qwen-family visual architectures, with separate base attachments and only 1,144 research-team traces. A code repository and dataset URL are stated, but artifact availability was not checked; the public-code description excludes weights and trace/QA data, and main-stage optimization settings are less complete than the recovery-SFT recipe.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
屬於範圍內：這是以問題為條件、使用語言嵌入與答案監督的視覺語言推論方法，而非純視覺應用。由人類搜尋監督的區域配置，以及附掛於凍結主體模型的模組，為多模態證據取得與 token 效率提供了有用組合。九組成對主體模型評估、每樣本 token 上限、位置／問題控制，以及部署裁切區域的涵蓋率，支持細粒度回答與有效區域選取的改善。

對較強的原生細節／融合解釋，證據則較弱：縮放全圖的裁切在彙總準確率上與完整方法相當，原生多影像輸入也與其相當，而學得的橋接相較恆等映射僅有小幅增益。完整軌跡監督以單一共用種子測試，改善的是部分指標，而非每個資料集。token 節省通常不能直接推論為延遲節省；數個後訓練主體模型在廣泛任務上出現退步。遷移限於相容的 Qwen 家族視覺架構，需各自的基礎附掛模組，且只有 1,144 條研究團隊軌跡。文中列出程式碼儲存庫與資料集網址，但未檢查產物是否可取得；公開程式碼說明排除權重與軌跡／問答資料，主要階段的最佳化設定也不如恢復 SFT 配方完整。

primary_link.title: EviViT: Evidence-Adaptive Vision Transformers for Fine-Grained Perception

papers.summary: Fine-grained visual perception enables vision-language models to distinguish subtle attributes and ground their answers in visual evidence. In high-resolution scenes, processing the whole image at greater resolution spends visual tokens on irrelevant content, while isolated crops can lose the context needed to interpret the selected evidence. We introduce EviViT, a lightweight attachment that learns where a pretrained vision transformer should acquire detail. Human visual-search traces supervise
papers.summary_zh: 高解析度問答常只依賴影像中的一小塊證據；全面提高解析度會浪費 token，單看裁切又可能失去位置脈絡。EviViT 以 1,144 筆人工搜尋軌跡訓練問題條件化的證據分布，選出一至兩個關鍵區域與一個互補背景區域，分配局部解析度，再透過座標感知的 Sparse Bridge 結合全局特徵。訓練期間凍結視覺與語言主體，相容的後訓練模型可沿用模組。九個主體的細粒度平均準確率均提高；Qwen3-VL-8B 提升 6.09 個百分點，配對預算測試僅用全局基線約 90–97% 的視覺 token。不過 token 減少不代表普遍加速，部分模型的一般能力也退步。更關鍵的是，使用已縮放全局影像的裁切控制，整體準確率與完整方法相同，因此新增原始像素是否帶來獨立優勢仍未釐清。人工軌跡比較僅採單一種子，移植亦受架構相容性限制。這項工作最可靠的啟示是：依問題選對觀測位置能改善視覺語言問答，但原生細節、融合模組與實際部署效益仍應分別驗證。

evidence: Sections 3 and 4.1–4.2: the Git Agent jointly resolves requirements and historical bases with Inspect, Commit, and Reuse; branch execution selects ExactReuse, FreshSolve, or ReuseAndPatch over immutable checkpoints.

Section 5.2, Table 1: training-free GitHarness improves over Native in all 30 backbone–harness–domain cells, with 27 strict wins and one tie against the strongest competing baseline. StackPlanner/DeepSeek Search rises from Native 37.0 to 58.0.

Section 5.3, Table 2: under StackPlanner/DeepSeek, removing historical selection reduces Code resolved rate from 74.0 to 44.0 and increases token usage from 1,291.4k to 4,513.5k; removing Inspect yields 42.0 and 4,215.4k.
Appendix G, Table 10: StackPlanner/DeepSeek Code uses 1,291.43k tokens versus Native 4,900.13k (73.6% lower); Math instead increases from 43.13k to 59.98k, so efficiency is task-dependent.

Section 5.3 and Appendix F, Table 9: LoRA-GRPO trains only Qwen3-8B Git Agent for 40 updates/1,280 episodes with fixed DeepSeek executor and judge; Math/SQL test performance improves from 51/55 to 81/73, below training-free DeepSeek at 94/78 under StackPlanner.

Appendices A and C, Table 7: retrospective seven-turn trajectories preserve source-task final verifiers; each of five domains contributes 100 test tasks, only Math/SQL provide 100 training and 100 validation tasks apiece, and Search/Code/Research are held out from RL training.

Section 5.3, Table 4, and Appendix F long-horizon finalization: GitHarness scores 84.0 Math and 47.32 Research at 30 turns; the scheduler extracts separate task-local final requests, executes each against its own history/workspace, then aggregates outputs.

Section 6 and reproducibility statement; Appendices H and I: compatible-state restoration does not guarantee preservation of unaffected work; real-world interactions remain future work. Hardware, serving and training settings are supplied, but implementation/trajectories/evaluation scripts are promised for release and prompt templates are abridged.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to long-horizon LLM agents, memory, tool use, and coding: GitHarness couples explicit requirement states to restorable work checkpoints and adds a trainable requirement/base-selection policy. This is a useful extension of existing Git-style context management rather than a wholly new memory abstraction. The complete supplied text reports 500 test tasks across five domains, with task-disjoint training/validation where applicable, two backbones, and three harnesses; training-free GitHarness improves on Native in all 30 settings and matches or exceeds the strongest alternative in 28. Component ablations and token accounting support the value of historical selection and selective reuse. However, retrospective synthetic trajectories always return to a source-task final anchor, there are no reported repeated-run uncertainty estimates or human-validated judge agreement, and artifact preservation is not quantified with an explicit preservation metric. The long-horizon scheduler separately invokes task-local histories at finalization, limiting claims about unrestricted cross-task collaboration. RL improves the smaller policy relative to its untrained version but usually trails the stronger training-free configuration. Broad tasks and harnesses strengthen transfer evidence, while real-user interaction remains untested. Detailed configurations help reproduction, but the release statement is prospective and prompts are abridged; availability was not independently verified.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本研究高度切合長期 LLM 代理、記憶、工具使用與程式開發：GitHarness 將明確的需求狀態與可還原的工作檢查點綁定，並加入可訓練的需求解析與基礎版本選擇策略。這是既有 Git 式上下文管理的實用延伸，並非全新的記憶抽象。所提供的完整文本報告五個領域共 500 個測試任務；有訓練與驗證資料的領域採任務互斥切分，並評估兩種基礎模型及三種代理框架。免訓練的 GitHarness 在全部 30 種設定都勝過 Native，在 28 種設定達到或超過最強替代方法。元件消融與 token 用量分析支持歷史版本選擇及選擇性重用的價值。不過，回溯建構的合成軌跡最終都回到原始任務目標，文中未報告重複執行的不確定性估計或經人工驗證的評審一致性，也未以明確的保留率指標量化產物保存情形。長期互動排程器在最後階段分別呼叫各任務的歷史狀態，因此對不受限制之跨任務協作的主張仍有限。RL 相較未訓練版本改善了較小的策略模型，但通常仍落後於較強的免訓練設定。多種任務與框架增強了遷移證據，真實使用者互動則尚未測試。詳細設定有助重現，但發布聲明仍屬未來承諾，提示詞也經刪節；本次未獨立驗證資源是否可取得。

papers.summary: LLM-based agents increasingly collaborate with users on long-horizon tasks, accumulating evidence, code, and drafts through extensive search, reasoning, and execution. As users inspect these results, they may supply missing information requirement completion, introduce new requirements requirement elicitation, or revise existing ones requirement shift. These changes often affect only part of the accumulated work, yet agents may carry forward obsolete information or turn local revisions into glob
papers.summary_zh:
長期與 LLM 代理協作時，使用者常補充、增加或撤回需求；若保留全部歷史，過時資訊可能干擾執行，全部重做又會浪費已完成的工作。GitHarness 將需求與工作檢查點綁定成可分支的版本圖，由 Git Agent 解析有效需求、檢查歷史並選擇相容版本，再決定直接重用、從頭解題或局部更新。其 RL 版本只訓練需求決策模型，下游執行器保持固定。

- 在數學、SQL、搜尋、程式開發與研究綜整共 500 個測試任務上，免訓練版本涵蓋兩種模型、三種框架，30 種設定全部勝過 Native，28 種達到或超過最強替代方法。
- 在 StackPlanner 搭配 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的程式任務，完整方法解決率為 74%；移除歷史版本選擇後降至 44%。相較 Native，程式任務 token 用量減少 73.6%。

研究顯示，追蹤需求與重用工作可共同改善代理表現及成本。但互動由合成軌跡構成，最終回到原始任務，未報告重複實驗的不確定性，也未直接量化未受影響產物的保留率；原始碼發布仍屬承諾。真實使用者的模糊需求與更自由的跨任務協作，仍需進一步驗證。

evidence: Sections 4.2–4.4 and Appendix A: shared query–quality–cost observation encoding, 24 latent capability tokens, target-to-profile/context attention, and a permutation-equivariant candidate Transformer; 12.78M router parameters exclude the frozen encoder.

Section 5.1 and Appendix B: four pretraining sources, 212,470 query–task instances and 1,727,809 valid query–model observations; 10,000 training steps and varying candidate pools/context sizes; MMR-Bench excluded from router pretraining.
Table 1: MMR-Bench quality at K=8 is 0.7323 versus strongest baseline EmbedLLM 0.7100; the large-context comparison is 0.7614 versus UniRoute 0.7607. In-domain K=8 is 0.6192 versus 0.6108.

Table 2: removing the candidate-pool Transformer lowers K=8 quality from 0.7323 to 0.7190; in the separately controlled support protocol frozen RouteFM scores 0.7523 versus 0.7415 for target-domain training from scratch.

Appendices C.3–C.6 and D: seven MMR-Bench datasets/10,370 queries/nine candidates; five-fold disjoint context–target evaluation; new-model tests rotate all nine candidates; timing excludes embedding extraction, answer generation, I/O and checkpoint loading; ICL-Router is a method-specific text-only exception.

Appendix A.8 and Table A3: cost is episode-relative, with parameter count a RouterBench proxy and missing costs zero-filled; removing LLMRouterBench reduces K=8 transfer quality to 0.6914. Appendix F claims public architecture, training/evaluation scripts, fixed splits and checkpoints.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant reusable LLM inference routing: an anonymous behavioral-context architecture and heterogeneous episodic pretraining let one frozen router handle new candidates and multimodal queries. The complete supplied text supports matched-context comparisons, architectural and data-mixture ablations, and explicit support-controlled transfer tests. Novelty is a substantive synthesis beyond prior in-context/retrieval routers rather than an entirely new routing principle. Evidence is strongest at scarce context; gains nearly disappear with abundant context. Main tables lack uncertainty estimates, several reproduced baselines exactly equal Context-Mean, and ICL-Router uses a different text-only representation pipeline. Cross-modal transfer also benefits from a pretrained multimodal encoder; cost signals are heterogeneous normalized proxies and reported latency excludes embeddings and behavioral-data acquisition. Broad deployment language therefore exceeds the evaluated benchmark scope. Architecture, splits, hyperparameters, code and checkpoint availability are well specified or claimed in the text; external artifacts were not independently inspected.

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to assign each query to the most suitable model from a heterogeneous candidate pool, improving the quality--efficiency trade-off of LLM inference. Existing routers are typically learned through local fitting: a router is optimized for a particular query workload and candidate pool, and often requires additional supervision or retraining as the routing environment changes. We ask whether LLM routing can instead be approached from a foundation-model perspect
papers.summary_zh: LLM 路由器通常依賴固定模型池與查詢分布訓練，部署環境改變便需重新擬合。RouteFM 嘗試把路由能力預先學成可重用模型：以歷史查詢、回答品質及相對成本描述匿名候選模型，建立能力表示，再結合目標查詢對原始觀測的注意力與候選間 Transformer 比較。模型透過四個來源約一百七十三萬筆查詢與模型觀測進行情境式預訓練，部署時凍結參數，僅更換行為脈絡。未納入預訓練的 MMR-Bench 上，每個候選只提供八筆觀測時，品質由最強基準的 0.7100 提升至 0.7323；大量觀測時優勢縮至 0.0007。消融支持候選間比較與異質訓練資料的重要性，也測試新增模型及不同脈絡預算。不過，多模態遷移仍仰賴 Qwen3-VL 表示，主要表格未呈現誤差區間，部分基準結果與簡單平均完全相同。成本只是正規化代理量，延遲測量排除嵌入與收集候選回答的費用，因此尚不能推論實際服務的完整節省。這項工作對模型池常變動、標註觀測有限的推論服務特別有參考價值；文中並提供程式碼與權重連結。
