links.title: UpliftMem: Learning Set-Level Uplift for Agent Memory Retrieval

evidence: Sections 4.1–4.4, Eqs. 3–17: complete memory sets are trained on observed utility differences from the same frozen no-memory executor; training combines value regression/sign/pairwise losses and outcome-weighted retrieval paths, with EVSI probes supplying additional value labels.

Appendices A.4–A.7, Eqs. 27–47: Gaussian conditioning accounts for shared-baseline noise and derives binary EVSI; the text distinguishes local-comparison aggregation from finite-family selection and from future neural-update improvement, and shows marginal acquisition gains need not diminish.

Section 5.2, Table 1: UpliftMem records ALFWorld seen/unseen success of 76.86/70.91% (4B) and 81.43/79.10% (8B), WebShop success of 45.60/44.00%, and BigCodeBench success of 39.77/42.69%; the 8B BigCodeBench result ties random retrieval at 42.69%.

Sections 5.3–5.4, Tables 3 and 9: with identical memory stores and executors, decision accuracy averaged across five stores rises from 41.7/44.4% to 66.5/68.8%; random probing yields 55.9/54.9%, and removing policy or value losses lowers decision accuracy.

Section 5.5 and Appendix F: WebShop acquisition uses a fixed memory store and common warm-up checkpoint, comparing EVSI, random, MC-STD and EIG; at 50 probes EVSI reaches 48.0% cumulative success versus 42.0% for random. Appendix F.1 reports that EIG exceeds EVSI at some budgets/checkpoint metrics, limiting any uniform-dominance claim.

Appendices D.1–D.2, Tables 4–5: training and evaluation are separated; MemSyco uses 1,085 training and 465 test instances with dialogue grouping, while BigCodeBench uses 798 runtime and 342 held-out tasks and injects successful implementation evidence rather than source-specific contracts/literals.

Appendices D.4–D.5, Table 6: only Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B executors with independently adapted Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B scorers are evaluated; each configuration is trained once, followed by three inference runs on agent benchmarks and five on main MemSyco results. Reported standard deviations are conditional on that checkpoint.

Appendices B–E specify search, writing/admission rules, LoRA rank/scaling/dropout (8/16/0.1), learning rate (1e-5), three epochs, and prompt contracts. The supplied document does not give concrete Gaussian feature/covariance estimation or numerical values for several utility/loss/acquisition parameters, total training-cost results, or an implementation-release link.
llm_evaluation.rationale: UpliftMem is highly relevant to agent memory, retrieval learning, and coding agents. Its useful methodological contribution combines complete-set uplift relative to a frozen no-memory executor with decision-aware acquisition of costly alternative executions; the Gaussian EVSI machinery builds on established value-of-information methods. Fixed-store controls across five memory systems, matched-budget random/uncertainty/information-gain comparisons, and value/policy ablations support the mechanism. MemSyco decision accuracy improves from 41.7/44.4% to 66.5/68.8% for Qwen3-4B/8B, and end-to-end results span ALFWorld, WebShop, and BigCodeBench. However, each configuration is trained only once, reported dispersion reflects inference variability, and some headline evidence is cumulative coverage across checkpoints rather than single-checkpoint performance; 8B BigCodeBench success merely ties random retrieval. The local Gaussian acquisition surrogate does not guarantee improvement after neural retraining, and transfer beyond two separately adapted Qwen3 executors is untested. Detailed algorithms, prompts, and some hyperparameters help reproduction, but concrete surrogate feature/covariance estimation, several utility/loss/acquisition settings, total training costs, and an implementation release are not supplied. The complete supplied text was read, including proofs, prompt templates, and per-store results.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: UpliftMem 高度切合代理記憶、檢索學習與程式代理。其實用的方法貢獻，是結合相對於凍結且不使用記憶之執行器的完整集合增益，以及依決策價值選擇昂貴的替代執行；Gaussian EVSI 則建立於既有資訊價值方法。五種記憶系統的固定儲存內容對照、相同預算下與隨機／不確定性／資訊增益策略的比較，以及價值與策略損失消融，都支持其機制。Qwen3-4B／8B 的 MemSyco 決策準確率由 41.7／44.4% 提升至 66.5／68.8%，端到端結果也涵蓋 ALFWorld、WebShop 與 BigCodeBench。不過，每個設定僅訓練一次，所報離散程度反映的是推論變異；部分主要證據為跨檢查點累積解題涵蓋率，並非單一檢查點表現，8B 的 BigCodeBench 成功率也僅與隨機檢索並列。局部 Gaussian 取得策略的代理模型不保證神經模型重新訓練後改善，且尚未測試兩個分別調適的 Qwen3 執行器以外的移轉。詳細演算法、提示與部分超參數有助重現，但未提供具體的代理模型特徵／共變異數估計方式、若干效用／損失／取得策略設定、訓練總成本與實作發布。本評讀已讀完所提供的完整文字，包含證明、提示範本與各記憶系統結果。

primary_link.title: UpliftMem: Learning Set-Level Uplift for Agent Memory Retrieval

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents reuse external memory to guide new tasks, but effective retrieval requires learning which memory sets improve execution. Such learning relies on costly outcome feedback: ordinary retrieval observes only executed sets, while evaluating alternatives requires additional rollouts. We introduce \textsc{UpliftMem}, which learns memory retrieval from set-level execution uplift relative to the same executor without memory. A theoretical analysis of how retrieval prefere
papers.summary_zh:
代理常把語意相關的記憶當成有用經驗，卻可能因此採取錯誤行動；只觀察已選集合，也讓被低估的組合難以獲得修正。UpliftMem 以同一凍結執行器不使用記憶時的表現為基準，學習整組記憶的執行增益，並把不使用記憶列為選項。

方法以 Gaussian 代理模型估計 EVSI，挑選預期能改善局部檢索決策的額外訓練執行，再用價值與策略損失更新評分器；測試時以 beam search 選擇集合，不額外執行探測。

- 在固定五種記憶儲存內容的 MemSyco-Bench 上，Qwen3-4B／8B 決策準確率由 41.7／44.4% 升至 66.5／68.8%。
- ALFWorld、WebShop、BigCodeBench 的主要成功率達最佳或並列最佳，但部分提升有限；相同探測預算與消融實驗另支持主動取得回饋的效益。

每個設定只訓練一次，且僅測試兩個 Qwen3 規模；累積解題涵蓋率也不等於單一檢查點能力。文中缺少若干代理模型估計細節與實作發布。其價值在於把記憶選擇與回饋蒐集一起最佳化，證據尚不足以保證跨模型移轉。

links.title: WitnessGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents on the Construction of Bug Witnesses

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix C: bugs are injected into test-reached production code, retained after clean-baseline and buggy replay checks, and transformed while preserving the construction-time witness; that witness is removed before agent evaluation.
Sections 4.1–4.2, Tables 2–3: six framework/model pairings evaluate a random 900-case sample under NoEC and WithEC, with at most three attempts; Codex/GPT-5.4 scores 67.1% and 70.7%, averaging 68.9%.

Sections 4.3–4.5 and Appendices E–F: bug-type analysis uses 500 cases; context/depth analyses use the same 400-case Guard Predicate Inversion subset, with 25 cases per length-by-depth cell and fixed operator sequences.

Section 4.6 and Appendix H: 700 matched injected/historical patch pairs, two LLM judges, cluster-bootstrap equivalence analysis, and artifact-bearing positive controls; supplementary pairwise AUC equivalence fails for one judge, and the authors explicitly limit the broader realism inference.

Appendices A, C–D and I: implementation is limited to ten observable bug types in six Maven Java projects, 201 execution contexts and 1,300 cases; prompts and validation budgets are detailed. The abstract supplies code and dataset release URLs.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to coding-agent evaluation and evidence-grounded code auditing. WitnessGym contributes renewable, execution-validated bug-witness tasks with controlled structural transformations rather than a new agent architecture. The 1,300-case construction, six framework/model pairings on 900 cases, and controlled context/depth analyses provide substantial evidence; the best pairing averages 68.9% success. Execution checks, detailed prompts, and stated code/data releases support reproducibility. However, six Maven-based Java projects, depth/context experiments anchored to one bug type, confounded framework/model comparisons, and absent uncertainty estimates for primary agent success limit broader conclusions. Patch realism is supported only by two LLM judges under a matched-patch protocol, not developer validation.
llm_evaluation.rationale_en: Highly relevant to coding-agent evaluation and evidence-grounded code auditing. WitnessGym contributes renewable, execution-validated bug-witness tasks with controlled structural transformations rather than a new agent architecture. The 1,300-case construction, six framework/model pairings on 900 cases, and controlled context/depth analyses provide substantial evidence; the best pairing averages 68.9% success. Execution checks, detailed prompts, and stated code/data releases support reproducibility. However, six Maven-based Java projects, depth/context experiments anchored to one bug type, confounded framework/model comparisons, and absent uncertainty estimates for primary agent success limit broader conclusions. Patch realism is supported only by two LLM judges under a matched-patch protocol, not developer validation.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這項研究與程式代理評估及以執行證據為基礎的程式碼稽核高度相關。WitnessGym 的貢獻是可持續產生、經執行驗證且具有受控結構轉換的錯誤重現任務，而非新的代理架構。研究建構 1,300 個案例，以六組框架與模型組合評估其中 900 個案例，並進行受控的執行脈絡與轉換深度分析，提供相當充足的證據；最佳組合的平均成功率為 68.9%。執行檢查、詳細提示及文中聲明公開的程式碼與資料有助於重現。然而，研究僅涵蓋六個 Maven 型 Java 專案，脈絡與深度實驗集中於一種錯誤，框架與模型效果無法分離，主要代理成功率也未附不確定性估計，因此限制了更廣泛的結論。修補差異的真實性僅由兩個 LLM 在配對比較流程中支持，尚無開發者驗證。

primary_link.title: WitnessGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents on the Construction of Bug Witnesses

papers.summary: Bug validation asks a coding agent to produce an executable witness for a reported bug. The witness combines a concrete input with a testing harness and exposes faulty behavior during execution. Such evidence makes audit findings actionable, yet benchmark evaluation is difficult when cases reuse public historical bugs and witnesses or require manual construction. We present WitnessGym, an automated framework for constructing bug-validation benchmarks through bug injection. It injects bugs into t
papers.summary_zh: 程式代理指出疑似錯誤後，仍須提供能真正觸發問題的輸入與測試框架，才能讓稽核結果具有可驗證的價值。WitnessGym 利用既有測試追蹤真實專案的執行脈絡，再注入錯誤並反覆編譯、執行；只有原測試確實能揭露錯誤的案例才被保留。它也改寫呼叫、資料與控制流程，在維持錯誤可觸發的前提下調整難度，評估時則移除原本的重現測試，要求代理自行建立證據。研究在六個 Java 專案建構 1,300 個案例，涵蓋十種錯誤，並以六組框架與模型評估隨機抽出的 900 個案例。最佳的 Codex 搭配 GPT-5.4 平均成功率為 68.9%，提供執行脈絡僅提升各組 2.2 至 4.7 個百分點；受控子集也顯示脈絡較長、轉換較深時更難成功。這提供可更新的代理除錯評估方式，但目前僅涵蓋 Maven 型 Java 專案，深度與脈絡比較集中於單一錯誤類型，不能直接推廣至其他生態系。兩個 LLM 對注入與歷史錯誤差異的辨識接近隨機，也不等同開發者認可其真實性。文中提供程式碼、資料及評估腳本連結，有利後續檢驗。
papers.title: WitnessGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents on the Construction of Bug Witnesses
papers.title_zh: WitnessGym：評估程式代理建構可執行錯誤重現證據的能力

links.title: CyberPersistBench: Evaluating LLM-Based Cyber Attackers on Installation and Persistence

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix C: 203 tasks across seven categories and 46 mechanism families, restricted post-compromise contracts, private ordered verification, rotating nonces, native attribution, integrity invariants, and L1–L6 prefix scoring.

Section 4.1, Table 1, and Appendix D: three independent attempts per eligible task, pass@3, five common-scaffold agents, 40-turn and 160-message limits; GPT-5.6-sol solves 86/203 (42.4%), while Codex CLI reports 81/181 (44.8%) after safety-blocked exclusions.
Section 4.4 and Table 2: on the same 128 tasks, native defenses reduce success to 5.5–13.3%, with drops of 13.3–29.7 percentage points.
Section 4.5 and Table 3: the 65-task multi-host extension yields 10.8–29.2% success; topology-specific strengths differ across agents.

Appendix A limits claims to post-compromise capability under preconfigured defenses; the Reproducibility statement links anonymized evaluation materials, and Appendices E–G supply representative trajectories rather than controlled tests of the proposed causal explanations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM agent capability and safety evaluation, with a useful shift from initial compromise to disruption-tested persistence. The 203-task, 46-family benchmark combines hidden verification, fresh nonces, native attribution, host-integrity checks, and prerequisite-aware stage scores; five agents, three attempts per task, matched defense comparisons, and a 65-task multi-host extension provide substantial empirical coverage. The strongest common-scaffold result is 42.4% pass@3, while protected-task success falls to 5.5–13.3%. However, alternative-scaffold comparisons exclude fully safety-blocked tasks and therefore use different denominators; the proposed feedback and systems-reasoning explanations are observational rather than established by controlled ablations. No uncertainty estimates are reported, and prescribed Canary tasks, limited interaction budgets, static defenses, and post-compromise starting points constrain real-world and end-to-end conclusions. Detailed schemas, budgets, and an anonymized materials link support reproducibility, although artifact availability was not independently verified.

The 203-task, 46-family benchmark combines hidden verification, fresh nonces, native attribution, host-integrity checks, and prerequisite-aware stage scores; five agents, three attempts per task, matched defense comparisons, and a 65-task multi-host extension provide substantial empirical coverage. The strongest common-scaffold result is 42.4% pass@3, while protected-task success falls to 5.5–13.3%. However, alternative-scaffold comparisons exclude fully safety-blocked tasks and therefore use different denominators; the proposed feedback and systems-reasoning explanations are observational rather than established by controlled ablations. No uncertainty estimates are reported, and prescribed Canary tasks, limited interaction budgets, static defenses, and post-compromise starting points constrain real-world and end-to-end conclusions. Detailed schemas, budgets, and an anonymized materials link support reproducibility, although artifact availability was not independently verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 高度切合 LLM 代理能力與安全評估，將重點從初始入侵轉向經系統中斷測試的持續存取，具有價值。基準涵蓋 203 項任務與 46 種機制，結合隱藏驗證、全新 nonce、原生機制歸因、主機完整性檢查及具先決條件的分階段評分；五個代理、每項任務三次嘗試、相同任務的防禦比較，以及 65 項多主機延伸測試，提供相當廣泛的實證。共同執行框架的最佳 pass@3 為 42.4%，啟用防禦後則降至 5.5–13.3%。但替代框架排除了所有嘗試皆遭安全政策阻擋的任務，因此分母不同；回饋不足與系統推理瓶頸的解釋也屬觀察性推論，尚未由控制消融確立。研究未報告不確定性估計；指定 Canary 任務、有限互動預算、靜態防禦及入侵後起點，也限制了真實情境與端到端結論。詳細設定綱要、預算與匿名材料連結有助重現，但未獨立查證材料是否可取得。

primary_link.title: CyberPersistBench: Evaluating LLM-Based Cyber Attackers on Installation and Persistence

papers.summary: While LLM-based attackers exhibit growing proficiency in vulnerability exploitation, most existing cybersecurity benchmarks suffer from single-stage truncation, prematurely terminating evaluation upon initial access. In practice, initial footholds are exceptionally fragile across operational disruptions such as service restarts and host reboots. Whether LLM-based attackers can establish and maintain durable footholds beyond initial compromise remains a central blind spot in cybersecurity evaluat
papers.summary_zh: 多數網路攻擊代理評估在取得初始存取權後就結束，卻未確認據點能否撐過憑證撤銷、服務重啟或主機重新啟動。CyberPersistBench 從受限的入侵後環境出發，以 203 項任務、七大類與 46 種原生機制，測量安裝及持續存取。驗證採隱藏流程、全新 nonce、原生機制歸因與正常服務完整性檢查，並以六階段前綴評分定位失敗位置。五個代理在共同 Inspect ReAct 框架下的 pass@3 為 27.6–42.4%；主要落差出現在產生設定到讓系統正式登錄機制之間。同一組 128 項任務開啟原生防禦後，成功率降至 5.5–13.3%；另以 65 項多主機任務檢驗跨主機協調。研究價值在於補上初始入侵之後的能力測量，也顯示主機防禦仍能顯著壓低成功率。不過，替代框架排除全程遭安全政策阻擋的任務，不能直接視為公平的框架增益；研究也未提供不確定性估計或證明推理瓶頸的控制消融。指定 Canary、靜態防禦及受控中斷，尚不足以代表完整攻擊鏈或持續適應的真實攻防。

links.title: AgentBug-Smith: Automatically Reproducing Real-World Harness Bugs in Agentic Systems

evidence: §3.1–3.3、Appendices A–F：採用 GitHub issue–PR–commit 配對、rule-guided Dockerfile 與 smoke test、限定外部模型／網路邊界 mock，以及必要時環境和測試共同修正；以真實 buggy implementation 上的 fail-to-pass 測試作為重現依據。
§4.1、Table 1：從 225 個被識別候選中抽查 132 例，兩位標註者 Cohen’s κ=0.88；repository／issue 判定準確度報為 0.95／0.92，另有五次分類穩定性。此設計未量測被濾除項目的 recall。
§4.2、Table 2：GPT-4.1-mini、Kimi-k2.5、DeepSeek-v3.2 的重現數分別為 45/225、46/225、63/225，對應 20.00%、20.44%、28.00%；SWE-Factory 最高 31/225。AgentBug-Smith 每 issue 平均成本 0.56–2.44 美元，高於對照方法；三模型聯集 75 例經人工檢查有 74 例有效。
§4.3、Table 3、Appendix F：AgentBug-Smith 可重現沒有 in-patch test 的 21／26／29 例，兩個 baseline 都為 0；這是完整方法間比較。Appendix F 明示共同修正案例不是 component-wise causal ablation。
§4.4、Tables 5–6、Appendix I：200 例基準上三個 GPT-4.1-mini 軟體代理的正確修復率為 9.00%、8.50%、3.50%；121/79 的 repository-disjoint skill 訓練／測試切分，使正確修復率由 1.27% 升至 7.59%，function-level localization 由 34.60% 升至 66.41%。
Appendices A、C、G、I：資料限至少 50 stars、有測試、已合併到 main/master 且至少 20 行變動的修補；未成功重現仍多由依賴、容器與診斷日誌問題造成。Skill 在一輪訓練後凍結，禁止寫入 repository 名稱、file path、issue ID 或 gold-patch 原文。
llm_evaluation.rationale: 與代理可靠性、工具整合、程式除錯及評估偏好高度直接相關。貢獻是將既有 issue-to-benchmark 流程針對 harness 的外部依賴與執行狀態調整，結合環境／測試共同修正，並提供實際錯誤基準及跨專案 skill 遷移示範；主要屬系統與資料貢獻，非新的學習原理。三種 backbone、兩個公開實作 baseline、fail-to-pass 與人工語意檢查提供有力實證。不過所謂 ablation 主要是不同完整系統的分項比較，無法隔離各模組效果；成本較高且未展示等預算比較，識別評估只抽查已保留候選而不能說明 recall。修復實驗僅使用 GPT-4.1-mini，skill 的 6.32 個百分點提升相當於 79 例中多修好五例，未報告重複實驗或信賴區間。公開專案與篩選門檻限制外推；附錄規則及案例有助重現，但本次僅核讀供應全文，未獨立驗證命名 release 的下載與容器可執行性。
llm_evaluation.rationale_en:
Highly and directly relevant to the preferences for agent reliability, tool integration, code debugging, and evaluation. The contribution adapts the established issue-to-benchmark workflow to the external dependencies and execution state of harnesses, combines joint environment/test correction, and provides a real-world bug benchmark and a demonstration of cross-project skill transfer; it is primarily a systems and data contribution rather than a new learning principle. Three backbones, two publicly implemented baselines, fail-to-pass checks, and human semantic checks provide strong empirical evidence.

However, the so-called ablation is mainly a breakdown comparison of different complete systems and cannot isolate individual module effects; costs are higher and no equal-budget comparison is demonstrated, while the identification evaluation spot-checks only retained candidates and therefore cannot establish recall. Repair experiments use only GPT-4.1-mini, and the skill's 6.32-percentage-point improvement amounts to five additional repairs out of 79 cases, without reported repeated experiments or confidence intervals. Public projects and filtering thresholds limit extrapolation; appendix rules and examples aid reproduction, but this review checked only the supplied full text and did not independently verify downloadability of the named release or executability of its containers.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
與代理可靠性、工具整合、程式除錯及評估偏好高度直接相關。貢獻是將既有 issue-to-benchmark 流程針對 harness 的外部依賴與執行狀態調整，結合環境／測試共同修正，並提供實際錯誤基準及跨專案 skill 遷移示範；主要屬系統與資料貢獻，非新的學習原理。三種 backbone、兩個公開實作 baseline、fail-to-pass 與人工語意檢查提供有力實證。

不過所謂 ablation 主要是不同完整系統的分項比較，無法隔離各模組效果；成本較高且未展示等預算比較，識別評估只抽查已保留候選而不能說明 recall。修復實驗僅使用 GPT-4.1-mini，skill 的 6.32 個百分點提升相當於 79 例中多修好五例，未報告重複實驗或信賴區間。公開專案與篩選門檻限制外推；附錄規則及案例有助重現，但本次僅核讀供應全文，未獨立驗證命名 release 的下載與容器可執行性。

primary_link.title: AgentBug-Smith: Automatically Reproducing Real-World Harness Bugs in Agentic Systems

papers.summary: Agent harness bugs exhibit unique characteristics and remain challenging for state-of-the-art software agents to repair. Progress in this area is further hindered by existing benchmarks, which contain only a small and fixed number of executable harness bugs while requiring hundreds of human hours to construct. This work presents AgentBug-Smith, an automated harness bug reproduction approach that continuously discovers and reproduces real-world harness bugs from open-source agentic systems. Acros
papers.summary_zh: 代理系統的失敗也可能來自 harness 的工具、記憶與流程實作，而現有可執行錯誤基準規模有限。AgentBug-Smith 從 GitHub 探索代理專案與已修復 issue，建立 Docker 環境，再利用錯誤描述與開發者 patch 產生重現測試；只在模型或網路邊界使用 mock，必要時共同修正環境與測試。測試必須在舊版失敗、修補版成功，且符合原始故障。研究在 225 個候選錯誤上，以三種 LLM 比較兩套一般軟體基準建構工具，重現率達 20–28%，提高 10.67–27.56 個百分點，但每案成本也較高。三種模型合計重現的 75 個案例經人工檢查，74 個有效。另建成含 200 個案例的 Live-Harness-Bench；使用 GPT-4.1-mini 的三種程式代理，正確修復率最高僅 9%。跨專案切分後，從 121 個訓練案例萃取文字 skill，讓 79 個測試案例的正確修復率由 1.27% 升至 7.59%。這提供代理可靠性評估與修復知識累積的實用方向；不過改善僅增加五個成功案例，未報告重複修復試驗或信賴區間，元件比較也未隔離因果效果，尚不足以證明普遍的遞迴自我改進。

links.title: Are In-Context Images Worth 10 Dimensions?

evidence: Sections 3.1–4.1 and Appendix B.1: frozen LVLM projections are meta-trained on 32,768 episodes across ten image datasets using abstract labels; main evaluation averages 1,000 tasks, with support and query images distinct within an episode.

Section 4.1, Figure 3, and Appendix D.1 Table 6: at three shots, ablating the top 15 Text SDG dimensions lowers 82.4% model accuracy by 12.9 percentage points; boosting them adds 3.9 points, versus a 1.9-point drop for the 128-dimensional random control. Forerunner-only interventions have considerably smaller effects.

Sections 4.2–5.3, Table 1, and Figure 5: vision-to-text attention ablation costs 5.2 points; relearning probes after cross-image attention ablation in the selected 2% of heads removes the low-dimensional accuracy gain. Head selection uses the OV geometry, not a complete recovered KQ/OV algorithm.

Section 5.2 and Appendix C.1: a non-causal linear-attention construction performs gradient descent on Gram-matrix reconstruction, with full-rank initialization and a small-step condition; Appendix C.2 evaluates assumption variants over 30 seeds. Section 7 explicitly distinguishes this construction from the circuit observed in trained LVLMs.

Appendix B.3 and Appendix E Table 8: single-domain training shows both shared and domain-specific directions; five model configurations yield Text SDG effective dimensions from 7.46 to 10.28. Section 6 adds SST-2 transfer and seven multimodal tasks, with matching-task intervention effects often opposite to classification.

Reproducibility statement and Appendices B.1/F: code is said to be supplied in supplementary material and planned for public release; optimizer, hardware, runtime, and evaluation prompts are specified. No external code or experimental reproduction was performed for this review.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly relevant mechanistic work on multimodal in-context learning rather than a pure vision application. A learned, approximately ten-dimensional shared discriminative geometry is supported by intervention controls, cross-domain probes, five decoder configurations, and a constructive Gram-preserving attention analysis with a detailed convergence proof. The causal evidence supports a contribution of the geometry and selected heads, but does not establish that trained causal softmax LVLMs implement the exact idealized algorithm. Generalization beyond small-shot classification remains limited; matching tasks can respond oppositely, single-domain probes retain domain-specific features, and real-model uncertainty and dataset train/test separation are not fully characterized in the supplied text. Reproduction is aided by detailed hyperparameters and a claimed supplementary code release, whose availability was not independently checked.
llm_evaluation.rationale_en: Strongly relevant mechanistic work on multimodal in-context learning rather than a pure vision application. A learned, approximately ten-dimensional shared discriminative geometry is supported by intervention controls, cross-domain probes, five decoder configurations, and a constructive Gram-preserving attention analysis with a detailed convergence proof. The causal evidence supports a contribution of the geometry and selected heads, but does not establish that trained causal softmax LVLMs implement the exact idealized algorithm. Generalization beyond small-shot classification remains limited; matching tasks can respond oppositely, single-domain probes retain domain-specific features, and real-model uncertainty and dataset train/test separation are not fully characterized in the supplied text. Reproduction is aided by detailed hyperparameters and a claimed supplementary code release, whose availability was not independently checked.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項機制研究高度切合多模態 in-context learning，而非純視覺應用。介入控制、跨領域探測、五種解碼器設定，以及附有詳細收斂證明、具建構性的 Gram 保持注意力分析，共同支持學得的、約十維的共用判別幾何。因果證據支持此幾何與特定注意力頭有所貢獻，但無法確立經訓練的因果 softmax LVLM 確實實作了完全相同的理想化演算法。

超出少樣本分類的泛化仍有限；匹配任務可能呈現相反反應，單一領域探測仍保留領域專屬特徵，而且所提供文字未完整描述真實模型的不確定性與資料集訓練／測試分離情況。詳細超參數與宣稱釋出的補充程式碼有助於重現，但未獨立確認其可取得性。

primary_link.title: Are In-Context Images Worth 10 Dimensions?

papers.summary: There has been significant work on understanding the In-Context Learning capabilities of Large Language Models, especially on the induction circuit. For a few-shot classification task, the induction circuit leverages linear representations of each labeled example in-context in order to classify an unlabeled query. However, few works focus on how those linear representations are built in the first place. Leveraging the expressivity of the vision modality compared to text, we uncover a Shared Disc
papers.summary_zh: 這篇研究追問 LVLM 在 In-Context Learning 中，如何把影像轉成能比較、分類的內部表示。作者凍結模型，在各層學習線性投影，發現稱為 Shared Discriminative Geometry（SDG）的低維空間；Ministral 3（3B）的有效維度約十維，仍能保留跨十個影像資料集的分類能力。三樣本設定中，移除前十五個 SDG 方向使模型正確率下降 12.9 個百分點，放大則提升 3.9 個百分點，隨機子空間對照影響較小。研究也提出以 linear attention 保留 Gram matrix 的降維構造，並用選定 attention heads 的消融支持相似機制。附錄涵蓋五種模型設定、單一領域訓練與詳細重現參數；文字分類及其他多模態任務另有初步驗證。不過，理論採非因果線性假設，尚未證明真實模型完整執行同一演算法；平均池化也會遮蔽 token 層級互動，且部分配對任務在移除 SDG 後反而改善。其價值在於把表示形成與後續 induction 區分開來，提供可介入的機制假說，而非宣稱所有視覺理解都能壓成十維。

links.title: Adapting Context Compression for Long-Horizon Agents with Counterfactual Continuations

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.3 and Appendix C.1: PRE/POST continuations restore identical environment states, disable later compression, and estimate reward hazard and interaction burden; a telescoping performance-difference identity relates cumulative boundary hazard to terminal reward. The diagnostic uses nine continuations per condition over 197 AppWorld boundaries.

Section 4 and Appendix E: PAIR evaluates every boundary once, successively halves the active set up to three PRE/POST pairs, revises guidance within a fixed template, and selects among five prompts using held-out-from-test training tasks.

Table 1: AppWorld history-only PAIR achieves 84.7% accuracy and 79.8% Pass3 versus ACON-UT 81.2% and 70.8%; prefix-conditioned PAIR gives 85.9% and 80.4% versus 81.3% and 72.6%. Table 6 retains an advantage against template-locked ACON-UT.

Tables 2 and 8, Appendix D.9: reliability point estimates favor PAIR in all six main settings, but the task-paired Pass3 intervals exclude zero only in the two AppWorld settings; OfficeBench has 95 tasks and Retail 40, with three evaluation runs.

Table 1 versus Table 8 and Appendix D.10: the stated AppWorld prefix ACON-UT accuracy difference is 3.2 points in the paired analysis although Table 1 implies 4.6; D.10 reports a 3.6-point Pass3 difference while Table 1 implies 7.8. The text does not clearly reconcile these numerical discrepancies.

Appendices D.4, D.6, and D.8: additional eight-objective QA results, continuation/threshold sensitivity, and zero-shot transfer to MiniMax-M3 broaden evaluation; transfer gains vary and OfficeBench prefix Pass3 is unchanged.

Section 5.4 and Appendices A and D.7: adaptation requires checkpointable environments and 39.6–90.8M offline tokens per setting; on Retail deployment uses about 12% more tokens than uncompressed execution while retaining lower reliability.

Appendices F–G specify baseline repository commits and full compression prompts, but the supplied document does not identify a released PAIR implementation or raw evaluation traces; Appendix D.10 also records non-reproducible and unsuccessful replay cases.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to long-context LLM agents, tool use, and inference efficiency. PAIR's boundary-local PRE/POST rollouts provide a meaningful advance over trajectory-level compression-prompt adaptation; matched baselines, template locking, transfer, sensitivity analysis, and paired tests strengthen the study. AppWorld gains are persuasive, but only three evaluation runs, broad confidence intervals elsewhere, costly checkpoint-dependent adaptation, and one transfer backbone limit confidence and reach. Reporting is internally inconsistent: Table 1 implies a 4.6-point AppWorld prefix accuracy gain over ACON-UT, while Table 8 gives 3.2; D.10 reports a 3.6-point Pass3 gain versus Table 1's 7.8 without clearly reconciling the comparison. Detailed prompts and baseline versions aid replication, but no released PAIR code or traces are identified in the supplied text.

papers.summary: Long-horizon agents require context compression to manage growing interaction histories. Compression quality, however, is ultimately determined by downstream execution. Existing prompt-adaptation methods infer compression errors by comparing full-context and compressed trajectories. Such comparisons cannot isolate individual compressions and are confounded by agent stochasticity. We first find that compression degrades reliability before solvability. papers.summary_zh:
長程 LLM 代理會反覆壓縮對話與工具紀錄，但摘要看似完整，仍可能遺失任務條件、完成狀態或 API 用法。研究發現，壓縮常先破壞多次執行的一致成功率；嚴重損害集中在少數壓縮邊界，單看最終成敗容易歸因錯誤。

PAIR 從同一環境狀態，分別以壓縮前後的上下文繼續執行，停止後續壓縮，估計成功率損失與額外步數，再調整固定摘要範本內的指引。AppWorld 的歷史壓縮設定中，三次皆成功的 Pass3 達 79.8%，高於 ACON-UT 的 70.8%；另有範本控制、QA 實驗與 MiniMax-M3 遷移。

限制是離線調整須能還原環境，每個設定耗費約四千萬至九千萬 token。OfficeBench 與 Retail 的改善信賴區間仍包含零，且前綴設定的部分 AppWorld 差值在表格與附錄間不一致。它提供定位記憶損失的實用方法，但無法保證所有真實工作流程更省成本，仍須驗證整體執行結果。

links.title: Scaling Influence Functions in LLMs through Eigenbasis-Corrected One-Bit Gradient Projection

evidence: Section 3.1, Proposition 1 and Appendix A.1: minimizing expected per-example worst-case squared influence error over an inverse-curvature-normalized query ball reduces to rank-k reconstruction of half-whitened gradients; uncentered PCA attains the optimum.

Section 3.2, Proposition 2 and Appendix A.2: PCA correction is optimal within the retained EK-FAC span and no worse than choosing its leading k axes; the empirical-Fisher surrogate and EK-FAC half-whitening are explicitly separate approximations.

Sections 3.3 and 4.3, Appendix G/Table 4: representations store a sign bit per coordinate plus an FP16 scale per module; budget/dimension ablations separate projection from quantization, and GPT-2 median FP16-versus-one-bit score correlations are 0.890–0.919.

Section 4.1/Figure 2 and Appendix D.1: GPT-2 EOGP at 96 KB exceeds evaluated compression baselines at 1,536 KB in LDS; LDS uses 100 released half-data retraining subsets and 1,000 bootstrap resamples, while removal experiments use five matched training seeds and 50–300 removed blocks.

Section 4.2 and Appendices C–D: OLMo 2 SFT 1B/7B/13B/32B evaluation uses 1,000 candidates and 100 held-out queries against EK-FAC, with a separate 10,000-conversation PCA set excluding candidates, queries and curvature-fitting examples; no large-model retraining validation is provided.

Section 4.2/Figure 3 and Appendix F: GPT-2 correlations of EK-FAC fidelity with LDS are 0.95 for NDCG@20 and 0.84 for Spearman fidelity; curvature-matched LoGra/GraSS controls on OLMo 2 7B do not erase the reported advantage.

Section 4.4 and Appendix E.1–E.3: 32B per-example storage at 2,048 coordinates/module is 115.584 KB versus 62.411 GB raw, but shared PCA matrices total approximately 481 GB; reported construction is 0.247 s/example versus LoGra 0.278, with 18.4 minutes of PCA fitting from cached coordinates and curvature fitting excluded.

Appendices B–D specify algorithms, source checkpoints, loss masks, attributed parameters, damping, baselines and retraining settings; embeddings, output head and normalization parameters are excluded from attribution, and own implementation availability is not established by a linked release.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly relevant LLM training-data attribution method combining a precise half-whitened PCA objective, EK-FAC subspace refinement and scaled one-bit gradient storage. Complete proofs justify optimal linear reconstruction under the chosen normalized worst-case criterion and improvement within the retained subspace; they do not establish optimality of the full approximate, quantized pipeline. Matched-budget and matched-dimension comparisons, curvature-matched controls, GPT-2 retraining validation and 1B–32B model experiments provide substantial support. Large-model quality is nevertheless fidelity to an EK-FAC reference, on only 1,000 candidates and 100 loss queries, rather than retraining or downstream behavioral interventions. The per-example savings exclude considerable shared artifacts (481 GB of PCA matrices in the cited 32B configuration), and timing excludes curvature fitting and amortizes batched I/O. Detailed algorithms, checkpoints and experimental protocols support reproducibility, but no release of the authors’ implementation is linked in the supplied text.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項 LLM 訓練資料歸因方法高度切題，結合精確的半白化 PCA 目標、EK-FAC 子空間精煉，以及縮放的一位元梯度儲存。完整證明支持在所選正規化最差情況準則下的最佳線性重建，以及保留子空間內的改善；並未確立整套近似、量化流程的最適性。預算配對與維度配對比較、曲率配對控制、GPT-2 重新訓練驗證，以及 1B–32B 模型實驗，提供了充分支持。

不過，大模型品質仍以對 EK-FAC 參照的忠實度衡量，僅使用 1,000 個候選與 100 個損失查詢，而非重新訓練或下游行為介入。每範例的節省未計入龐大的共用產物，在所引述的 32B 設定中，PCA 矩陣達 481 GB；計時也排除曲率擬合，並將批次 I/O 成本攤提。詳細演算法、檢查點與實驗協定支持可重現性，但所提供文字未連結作者實作的釋出版本。

papers.summary: Influence functions estimate how individual training examples affect the behavior of large language models (LLMs). Analyzing how training data influence different behaviors of an LLM involves repeated influence computation. Reusing stored training gradients reduces the computational cost, but storing full gradients is prohibitively expensive at LLM scale. We study how to compress these gradients while preserving influence estimates for future queries that are unknown at storage time. Through a w
papers.summary_zh: 影響函數可追蹤哪些訓練資料影響 LLM 輸出，但保留每筆完整梯度十分昂貴。EOGP 先以 EK-FAC 投影與半白化縮小梯度，再在保留子空間內做 PCA，最後儲存每個座標的符號位元及每個模組的縮放值，讓未知的未來查詢重用梯度。論文證明半白化 PCA 在指定的最壞情況誤差與線性表示限制下最佳，並以相同儲存預算、座標數及曲率處理的對照實驗檢驗設計。在 GPT-2 重訓評估中，96 KB 的 EOGP 在 LDS 超過使用 1,536 KB 的受測壓縮基線；OLMo 2 的 1B 至 32B 模型也呈現較佳的 EK-FAC 排名保真度。不過，大模型結果只是近似參考的一致性，僅涵蓋 1,000 個候選與 100 個查詢，並未直接驗證移除資料後的行為改變。儲存節省亦須區分每例與共用成本：32B 的一項配置每例約 116 KB，但 PCA 矩陣合計約 481 GB。這項方法有助於反覆進行資料歸因；其實際價值取決於儲存規模、共用成本攤提與影響估計本身的可靠度。

links.title: EASE: Behavior-Adaptive Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix B: a shared curator adds, modifies, or deletes skills based on recent logged behavior; profiles track action validity, recovery, state tracking, efficiency, errors, and observable skill use, with unavailable signals distinguished from zeros. Curator and executor weights remain frozen at deployment.

Section 3.4 and Appendices D–E: retrieval incidence checks actual and patched repositories; a background-corrected normalized Levenshtein deviation from four skill-free reference trajectories gates GRPO updates. The paper explicitly distinguishes this approximate attribution from edit-specific causal credit, and notes potentially quadratic patched-retrieval checks.

Section 4.2, Table 1: across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, seen-executor averages are 43.1/53.6/56.6 for EASE versus 40.4/51.6/54.7 for matched SkillOS; held-out Kimi/DeepSeek/Gemini averages are 69.4/71.9/75.1 versus per-cell selected SkillOS-best 65.6/69.2/73.0. EASE loses two seen WebShop cells and one held-out ScienceWorld cell.

Section 4.5 and Appendix G, Table 5: equal-pool/equal-budget ablations show ALFWorld drops of 7.5–9.5 points without the descriptor; static metadata does not recover full performance. Section 4.5 also reports a same-admission-rate random-mask control that performs similarly to ungated training.

Appendix H, Table 6: after a shared 64-task warm-up, updating rather than freezing the profile improves the common 70-task suffix by 3.8/2.2/1.1 points while both conditions continue skill editing; this is distinct from the main full-stream evaluation.

Appendices I–J, Tables 7–12: across the three seen executors, reported aggregate deployment-token reductions are 10.7%/14.5%/9.1% on ALFWorld/ScienceWorld/WebShop, excluding training references and gate computation. ALFWorld repository size averages fall from 57.7 to 34.0 skills, and paired local edit benefit rises from 1.67 to 2.67 success-rate points.

Appendix A, Tables 2–3: Qwen3-8B LoRA training uses 60 GRPO updates, 32 groups, eight rollouts per group, ten related ALFWorld tasks per stream, BM25 top-5 retrieval, and a 16-task profile window. ALFWorld evaluation uses 134 valid-unseen tasks; Appendix K reports six orderings of a 120-task subset with a 3.3-point spread but no multi-training-seed uncertainty. The abstract links https://github.com/Eric2i/EASE, whose availability was not independently checked.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Exceptionally aligned with agent memory, tool use, and continual adaptation. EASE makes a meaningful incremental advance over learned skill curation by conditioning a shared curator on logged executor behavior and training with retrieval/deviation-based temporal masks. Three environments, six executor families/configurations including three held-out APIs, budget-matched component ablations, branched profile-freezing tests, and paired edit rollbacks provide useful support. Average gains over the strongest curator references are modest (1.9–3.8 points), some task/model cells regress, and no multi-training-seed uncertainty or significance estimates establish their reliability. The gates detect opportunities and behavioral change, not edit-specific causal benefit. Deployment-token savings exclude training overhead and do not establish latency or monetary savings. Small simulated streams, incomplete ScienceWorld/WebShop split and prompt/API-version detail, and unverified code availability limit generalization and reproducibility despite the substantial methodological appendix.

EASE makes a meaningful incremental advance over learned skill curation by conditioning a shared curator on logged executor behavior and training with retrieval/deviation-based temporal masks. Three environments, six executor families/configurations including three held-out APIs, budget-matched component ablations, branched profile-freezing tests, and paired edit rollbacks provide useful support. The gates detect opportunities and behavioral change, not edit-specific causal benefit. Deployment-token savings exclude training overhead and do not establish latency or monetary savings. Small simulated streams, incomplete ScienceWorld/WebShop split and prompt/API-version detail, and unverified code availability limit generalization and reproducibility despite the substantial methodological appendix.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本研究與代理記憶、工具使用及持續調適極為契合。EASE 以記錄到的執行器行為作為共享策展器的條件，並透過檢索與行為偏離的時間遮罩訓練，對既有可學習技能策展提出有意義的漸進改良。三個環境、六種執行器家族或設定（含三個未參與訓練的 API）、訓練預算匹配的元件消融、從共同歷史分支的行為摘要凍結測試，以及成對編輯回復診斷，提供實用支持。相較最強策展器參照，平均增益仍不大（1.9–3.8 分），部分任務與模型組合退步，也未以多次獨立訓練的不確定性或顯著性估計確認可靠程度。閘門偵測的是影響機會與行為改變，並非個別編輯的因果效益。部署 token 節省不含訓練成本，也不能代表延遲或金錢成本降低。雖有充實方法附錄，小型模擬任務串流、ScienceWorld／WebShop 切分及提示與 API 版本細節不足，以及未查驗的程式碼可取得性，仍限制泛化與重現性。

primary_link.title: EASE: Behavior-Adaptive Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents

papers.summary: Agent skills provide a lightweight mechanism for self-evolving agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. However, existing learned skill curators typically optimize curation without explicitly modeling downstream executor behavior. We show that this can cause systematic cross-executor degradation: curators trained with different executors perform best when paired with their own training executor, indicating that effective skill curation is executor-dep
papers.summary_zh:
代理累積的技能不一定適合每個執行模型：不同模型的錯誤、復原方式與指令使用習慣，可能讓同一份技能產生不同效果。EASE 從近期互動記錄建立行為摘要，讓共享策展器依據實際表現新增、修改或刪除技能；訓練時再以後續是否檢索到技能、行為是否改變，篩選接受強化學習更新的策展步驟。部署時不更新模型權重。

論文在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 與六種執行器上測試，包含三個未參與訓練的 API 模型。相較最強策展器參照，各執行器的跨任務平均分數提高 1.9–3.8 分；在訓練曾見的執行器上，技能庫縮小約 34.5%–41.0%，部署推論 token 減少約 9.1%–14.5%。凍結行為摘要與元件消融，也支持持續調適的價值。

不過部分任務組合仍退步，缺乏多次獨立訓練的誤差估計；行為變化不能直接當成個別技能的因果貢獻，token 節省亦不含訓練成本。這項方法值得關注，因為它把技能管理從通用記憶，推進到依實際執行能力調整，但真實長期工作流程仍待驗證。

links.title: Foundations of Proactive Agents: Principles, Technical Layers, and Proactivity-Gym

evidence: Sections 3–4 define the 3T objectives and five design dimensions, connecting situation modeling, backbone LLMs, and harnesses; Eq. 1 gives a weighted objective but no implemented joint optimization method.

Sections 5.1 and Appendix E.1 evaluate 23 model-harness combinations over ten scenarios, three personas, and three repetitions (90 runs per configuration); the scenarios contain 124 tasks, with only activated branches included in scoring.

Appendix D.2 uses a deterministic authorization state machine before Qwen-generated persona responses, separating permitted actions from model wording; this controls permissions but simplifies user behavior.

Section 5.2 and Table 7 report Claude Opus 5 average TC 65.1, TA 51.7%, and TR-D 52.4%; Appendix F.2 increases GPT 5.6 Sol/Codex TC from 49.96 to 58.93 with extra-high reasoning while trust changes little.

Appendix E.3 awards TA credit only when both the urgent task is selected and the competing task is explicitly deferred; it explicitly cautions that low scores need not mean incorrect priority selection and does not measure completed deferred work.

Appendix E.5 Tables 4–6 compare two judges over 2,070 trajectories: TC semantics differs by 0.170 in mean calibration, exact NOW/LATER agreement is 89.7% with kappa 0.438, and aggregate configuration rankings correlate strongly.

Section 5.3 and Appendix G report 30 participants evaluating hypothetical interaction histories: trust decreases 1.86 points after aligned-to-misaligned transitions versus a 1.27-point increase in the reverse direction; these are vignette judgments rather than a live longitudinal deployment.

The Code of Ethics and Reproducibility statement promises code and Proactivity-Gym data upon publication; Appendix I supplies judge prompts, while Appendix H identifies variable task durations, changing budgets, and real-world longitudinal evaluation as future work.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant evaluation and design work for proactive LLM agents, with a useful separation of task capability, temporal allocation, and trust. Its main novelty is an integrative framework and stateful multi-day benchmark rather than a new learning or scheduling algorithm. The 23 model-harness configurations, repeated persona-conditioned runs, judge agreement analysis, reasoning sweep, and 30-person vignette study provide substantive converging evidence. However, temporal allocation is operationalized primarily as a single NOW/LATER decision per scenario, judged trust is a proxy rather than human psychological measurement, and the ten hand-crafted scenarios and convenience-sample survey do not establish long-term deployed utility. Code and data are promised upon publication rather than demonstrated available in the supplied complete source.

這項主動式 LLM 代理的評估與設計工作高度切題，對任務能力、時間配置與信任作出有用的區分。主要創新是整合性框架與具狀態的多日基準，而非新的學習或排程演算法。23 種模型–框架設定、以人物設定為條件的重複執行、評判器一致性分析、推理設定掃描，以及 30 人的情境短文研究，提供了充實且相互印證的證據。

然而，時間配置主要被操作化為每個情境單一的 NOW／LATER 決策；評判出的信任屬於代理指標，而非人類心理測量；十個手工設計情境與便利取樣調查，也無法確立長期部署效益。所提供的完整來源僅承諾於發表時釋出程式碼與資料，未證明其已可取得。

primary_link.title: Foundations of Proactive Agents: Principles, Technical Layers, and Proactivity-Gym

papers.summary: Proactive LLM agents can turn idle compute into useful support before users ask. Yet even correct work can misread user context, impose review costs, or undermine trust. This work proposes foundations for designing, realizing, and evaluating proactive LLM agents around three joint principles (3T): Task Capability, anticipating relevant needs and correctly performing useful work; Temporal Allocation, allocating compute according to resource availability and when results are needed; and Trust, sus
papers.summary_zh: 主動式 LLM agent 即使完成正確工作，也可能因打斷使用者、爭用運算資源或超出授權而降低價值。本文以任務能力、時間配置與信任三個目標整理設計原則，並將任務範圍、預期需求時間、啟動方式、處理時機與介入深度連結到使用者情境及 agent 系統設計。作者建立 Proactivity-Gym，包含十個跨七至十天的情境、三種人物設定與有狀態工具環境，測試二十三種模型與執行框架組合，每組九十次完整模擬。Claude Opus 5 的平均任務分數為 65.1，但時間配置與介入深度符合率僅約 52%；增加推理運算也未同步改善信任指標。三十人的情境問卷顯示，正確成果仍無法抵銷未經同意介入造成的信任下降，延後至閒置時段的協助則較易被接受。這項工作提供實用的多面向評估架構，但時間配置主要檢查立即處理與明確延後的決策，尚未驗證真實運算排程；人物及資源模型較簡化，問卷也不是長期實際使用。程式與資料僅承諾於發表時公開。對設計個人助理與檢查 LLM 評審是否混淆能力及信任，具有直接參考價值。

links.title: SYNCR: Diagnosing and Learning Cross-Video Reasoning from Simulation

evidence: Sections 2.1–2.3, Appendix A.1–A.3 and Table 4: eight tasks use Habitat, Kubric and CLEVRER state for labels; 4,000 evaluation and 15,960 training questions use disjoint videos, with Habitat evaluation scenes separated from training scenes and timestamp-leakage controls.

Sections 3.1–3.3, Tables 1, 5 and 7, Appendix B.2: 22 models are evaluated; proprietary models and a four-person majority vote use 100 items/task while standard open checkpoints use 500. Human accuracy is 89.5% overall but only 68% on kinematics and 76% on spatial measurement, so complete RGB recoverability is not established.

Section 4.1, Table 9 and Appendix C.4.3–C.4.5: matched 200-item/task Qwen3-VL-8B accuracy rises from 32.6% to 61.6%; three SFT seeds average 61.6%, 61.8% and 64.6%. Seven task gains survive correction, while Object Counting does not.

Sections 4.2–4.4, Tables 2, 14–17 and 22: held-out camera rig, task–simulator pairings, matched-budget SAT, incorrect-label placebo, no-video post-training tests and alternative output formats probe transfer and shortcuts. Route Planning still reaches 39.5% without video after SFT.

Section 4.3, Appendix C.6.1, Tables 19–21: Assembly101/Panoptic ordering gains range from 9.0 to 20.5 percentage points across three checkpoints; repeated-recording clustering is not reflected in intervals. nuScenes counting transfer is inconsistent across seeds/families and does not isolate deduplication.

Reproducibility statement and Appendix C.1: evaluation/training metadata plus Habitat/Kubric assets are reported at https://huggingface.co/datasets/CrossVideoReasoning/SYNCR; original CLEVRER videos are separately required. LoRA/SFT/GRPO recipes and prompts are specified; external availability was not independently verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to multimodal language-model reasoning, targeted supervision, and evaluation. The contribution is a shared simulator-grounded diagnostic/training framework rather than a new learning algorithm. Broad checkpoint coverage, video/text and wrong-label controls, task/source shifts, three SFT seeds, paired tests, multiplicity correction, and transfer across two model families make the central learnability and temporal-ordering claims persuasive. Interpretation remains limited by visual-only multiple choice, imperfect RGB answer recoverability, reused recordings with item-level uncertainty, unequal evaluation subsets across model groups, and weak or inconsistent real cross-camera counting/synchronization transfer. Dataset assets and detailed recipes are claimed available, but this supplied text does not establish a complete released training/evaluation-code and checkpoint package.

這項工作直接切合多模態語言模型推理、針對性監督與評估。其貢獻是共用、以模擬器為根據的診斷／訓練框架，而非新的學習演算法。廣泛的檢查點涵蓋、影片／文字及錯誤標籤控制、任務／來源轉移、三個 SFT 種子、配對檢定、多重比較校正，以及跨兩個模型家族的遷移，讓核心的可學習性與時間排序主張具有說服力。

詮釋仍受以下因素限制：僅視覺的選擇題、從 RGB 恢復答案的能力不完美、重複使用錄影且以題目層級計算不確定性、不同模型群組的評估子集不一致，以及真實跨鏡頭計數／同步的遷移效果薄弱或不一致。文中宣稱資料集產物與詳細配方可取得，但所提供文字未能確認完整的訓練／評估程式碼及檢查點套件已釋出。

primary_link.title: SYNCR: Diagnosing and Learning Cross-Video Reasoning from Simulation

papers.summary: Reasoning across videos requires aligning events, matching identities, comparing motion, and integrating partial observations. Evaluating these capabilities and testing how to improve them requires both reliable labels and targeted supervision. We introduce SYNCR, a simulator-grounded framework that connects these two needs through shared task generators. Built on Habitat, Kubric, and CLEVRER, SYNCR derives answers from environment state and provides 4,000 evaluation questions and 15,960 trainin
papers.summary_zh: 跨影片推理不只要看懂單支影片，還要對齊事件、辨認同一物件並整合不同視角。SYNCR 以 Habitat、Kubric 與 CLEVRER 的模擬狀態產生可靠標籤，建立八項任務、4,000 道評估題與 15,960 道訓練題，且訓練與評估影片互不重疊。研究評測 22 個多模態語言模型，再以 LoRA 進行監督式微調；Qwen3-VL-8B 在相同每項 200 題上的平均正確率由 32.6% 升至 61.6%，三個訓練種子大致重現改善。移除影片、錯誤標籤訓練、替代資料與答案格式等控制，支持正確視覺監督確實有用。最穩定的真實影片遷移是時間排序：兩個模型家族的三個檢查點，在 Assembly101 與 Panoptic 提升 9.0–20.5 個百分點，既有基準也出現改善。不過，模擬標籤不保證答案都能從 RGB 看出，部分題目重複使用原始錄影，信賴區間未納入這種相關性；跨鏡頭計數與同步的遷移仍不穩定。其價值在於把能力診斷、針對性訓練與遷移檢驗串在一起，而非證明模型已具備通用跨影片推理。

links.title: APM-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-session Persistent Memory for Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix D: 104 activity-related trajectories comprise 549 sessions and 2,719 candidates (887 cross-session, 716 current-perception and 1,116 adaptive); adaptive candidates generate 3,768 independent causal probes. Two annotators obtain kappa 0.868 on 300 sampled questions after model-assisted filtering and human refinement.

Section 3.3 and Appendix A.3: adaptive scoring first gates on correct SILENT/INTERVENE decisions (plus ERA answer correctness), then uses DeepSeek-V4-Flash 1–5 response-quality scores with candidate-level polarity balancing; the full judge rubric is supplied.

Section 4.2, Tables 3–4: reported Gemini 3.6 Flash raw-video cross-session/overall scores are 69.37/60.21 versus text-summary 47.50/53.54; normalized storage falls from 3.01 GiB/hour to 3.09 KiB/hour. Autonomous MPA/TPG remain 26.52/25.58 under raw video.

Section 3.1 and Appendix B.7, Table 13: a balanced 260-question restricted-history test retains only two previous sessions; Gemini answers 85.38% of evidence-available questions but detects only 59.23% of unavailable cases. SimpleStream scores 3.85% and 95.38%, illustrating abstention bias.

Appendices A.2, B.3–B.5: systems use different VLM backbones; local runs share H20 hardware, while API latency is full-response rather than TTFT. OASIS replay RTF is 1.223; StreamForest/VST have 36.14%/37.05% unrecoverable format failures. Most storage figures estimate live state rather than tested persistent export.

Appendix B.6: controls on 12 EgoLife trajectories (366 candidates) compare organized history, raw intervening video and oracle evidence; oracle improves cross-session understanding by 19.78–31.21 points, while adaptive scores remain 28.98–51.86. Appendices C.3–C.4 show 628 of 1,249 inter-session candidates need evidence from only the immediately preceding session.

Appendices D–E provide annotation structures, causal task prompts and query-agnostic session-summary prompts. Section 4.1 gives 1 FPS with 1,024- versus 128-frame caps across models; the supplied front matter has Code and Website labels but no validated release contents.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant benchmark for multimodal assistants, persistent cross-session memory, evidence-aware abstention and proactive response. The contribution is a carefully specified evaluation setting rather than a new memory algorithm: activity-linked trajectories, causal independent probes, human-refined annotation, explicit availability tests, and jointly reported utility/storage/latency. Broad model/protocol comparisons and oracle/raw-lifelong controls reveal informative failure modes. Limits include two source datasets with curated activity continuity, heterogeneous backbones and frame budgets, estimated rather than exported persistent state for most systems, nonidentical API/local latency metrics, and no reported score uncertainty or human validation of the LLM response judge. The 300-question annotation agreement audit does not establish judge reliability. All supplied complete-status text including appendices was read; figures are captions rather than image evidence, and Code/Website labels do not independently verify artifact availability.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項基準高度切合多模態助理、跨工作階段持續記憶、考量證據的拒答，以及主動回應。貢獻是仔細界定的評估設定，而非新的記憶演算法：活動相連的軌跡、具因果性的獨立探測、人工精煉標註、明確的可用性測試，以及一併回報效用／儲存／延遲。廣泛的模型／協定比較，以及 oracle／原始終身資料控制，揭示了有啟發性的失敗模式。

限制包括：僅兩個來源資料集且活動連續性經過整理、骨幹與影格預算異質、多數系統的持續狀態以估算而非實際匯出取得、API／本機延遲指標不相同，以及未回報分數不確定性或對 LLM 回應評判器的人工驗證。300 題的標註一致性稽核並不能確立評判器可靠性。已讀完所有所提供、標示完整狀態的文字，包括附錄；圖僅有圖說，並非圖像證據，而 Code／Website 標籤也不能獨立驗證產物是否可取得。

primary_link.title: APM-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-session Persistent Memory for Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants

papers.summary: To serve as real-world personal assistants, streaming video models need persistent memory that retains past experiences for later use. Yet existing streaming benchmarks and methods often focus on individual continuous videos or short clips, overlooking that real-world interactions are often intermittent and require memory to persist across interruptions. To fill this gap, we introduce APM-Bench, which reformulates real-world streaming interaction as multi-session life trajectories. It contains 5
papers.summary_zh: 個人影片助理不能只理解眼前畫面，還必須在使用者中斷互動後，記得過去經驗、適時提醒，並辨認記憶是否缺少必要證據。APM-Bench 將 EgoLife 與 HD-EPIC 整理成 104 條活動軌跡、549 段互動及 2,719 個測試案例，涵蓋跨段回憶、即時感知與主動回應共 12 種任務；評測同時記錄效用、延遲與儲存成本，並以人工檢核標註及禁止讀取未來畫面的流程控制品質。依論文結果，Gemini 3.6 Flash 使用原始影片時，跨段理解得分為 69.37；改存文字摘要後降至 47.50，但每小時儲存量從 3.01 GiB 降至 3.09 KiB。另在刻意移除歷史證據的測試中，其缺證據辨識率僅 59.23%，顯示回憶能力與知道何時不該回答是不同問題。主動協助和任務進度提醒即使有豐富歷史仍偏弱。限制是軌跡來自兩個既有資料集，模型骨幹與影格上限不一致，多數持久狀態成本只是推估；開放式回答依賴 LLM 評審，未提供其人工一致性驗證或分數信賴區間。因此結果適合診斷記憶系統的取捨，不能直接當作真實部署排名。其價值在把「記住什麼、何時使用、何時保持沉默」放進同一套可比較的測試。

links.title: CTE-Bench: Counterfactual Trace Evaluation for Stateful Software Simulators

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.4: 255 scenarios across six deterministic Python services, 210 source edits drawn from 49 patches and 45 state edits; 40 future calls per scenario and 2,476 effect steps among 10,200 responses.
Section 4.1, Table 1: replaying the unchanged service achieves 75.7% all-call value match but 0% effect-step value match, motivating the intervention-sensitive primary metric.

Section 3.5 and Section 4.2, Table 2: answers revealed and free rollout both use recent 20-call windows, with correct versus predicted responses; no feedback includes all observed calls but omits prior future calls. Effect-step VM is 54.3–61.5%, 24.8–33.2%, and 23.2–28.9%, respectively.
Section 4.3, Table 3, and Appendix G: free-rollout first-error medians are call 2 or 3; whole-trace exact match is 1.2% for DeepSeek and 0% for the other three models.

Section 4 setup and Appendices B, D–F, H: 2,000 scenario-bootstrap resamples, equal-service sensitivity analysis, model serving/reasoning settings, small 24-scenario reasoning probe, and Sonnet parse failures of 13.5–16.7%.

Section 5 and Appendices M–O: six-service/Python-only scope, no window-size or prompt-sensitivity ablation, eight scenarios with effects only beyond scored call 40, and a separate unmatched 106-scenario no-effect probe; release and evaluation-card claims are explicitly bounded.

Abstract, Section 1, and Appendix O: dataset link https://huggingface.co/datasets/zhangxr7/cte-bench-core-v1 and stated release of executable oracle/services, graders, reference outputs, metadata, datasheet, and evaluation card.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly relevant to coding agents, stateful tool use, and LLM evaluation. CTE-Bench usefully separates predicting intervention effects from choosing actions, with executable counterfactual traces and effect-step scoring that defeats an otherwise strong unchanged-service baseline. Four-model results, scenario-level bootstrap intervals, field-level diagnostics, rollout survival curves, and explicit audits make the observed prediction failures credible. The matched-window answers-revealed versus free-rollout comparison shows a substantial dependence on correct history. However, the no-feedback protocol also omits prior future calls, so its gap is not a clean ablation of response feedback alone. Generalization is constrained by six deterministic Python services, 49 source patches, an over-represented rate limiter, one prompt, and mostly non-thinking configurations; Sonnet has substantial formatting failures. Core-v1 excludes no-effect cases, with only an unmatched supplementary probe, and the benchmark cannot separate state inference from execution simulation or establish agent deployment safety. The paper links a release with executable services, graders, reference outputs, and an evaluation card, supporting reproducibility without independently verifying those artifacts here.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本文與程式代理、有狀態工具使用及 LLM 評測高度相關。CTE-Bench 將預測介入效果與選擇行動分開，以可執行的反事實軌跡及效果步驟評分，排除原本表現很強的未修改服務重播基準所帶來的誤導。四模型結果、情境層級 bootstrap 區間、欄位診斷、完整軌跡存活曲線及明確稽核，使觀察到的預測失敗具有可信度。使用相同歷史視窗的正確答案揭露與自由展開比較，顯示模型高度依賴正確歷史。不過，無回饋協定也刪除先前的未來呼叫，因此其落差不能當作單純移除回應回饋的消融。可推廣性受限於六個確定性 Python 服務、49 個原始碼修改、占比過高的速率限制器、單一提示及以非思考模式為主的設定；Sonnet 也有明顯的格式失敗。Core-v1 排除無效果案例，僅另附涵蓋範圍不匹配的探測，且不能區分狀態推斷與執行模擬錯誤，也不能證明代理部署安全。論文連結的釋出內容包含可執行服務、評分器、參考輸出及評測說明卡，有助重現，但此處未獨立驗證這些產物。

A wrong expectation may surface only several calls later. Function-level code-execution benchmarks omit persistent service state, and agent benchmarks score the actions an agent takes or the final state it reaches. We introduce CTE-Bench, which measures whether a model can predict how an intervention changes a stateful
papers.summary_zh: 程式代理修改服務後，是否真的能預測數次呼叫之後的行為？CTE-Bench 固定未來行動，讓模型只預測回應，避免把規劃能力與狀態模擬混為一談。它提供六個 Python 服務的原始碼、既有互動歷史及單一程式或狀態修改，再以實際執行結果評分。255 個情境各含 40 次未來呼叫；主要指標只看修改確實改變回應的 2,476 個步驟，因為直接重播未修改服務仍能拿到 75.7% 的整體分數。四個模型在提供正確歷史回應時，效果步驟精確匹配率為 54.3% 至 61.5%；自由展開、依賴自己先前預測時降至 24.8% 至 33.2%，整段完全正確的比例最高僅 1.2%。研究提供 bootstrap 區間、格式錯誤分析與可執行評分器的釋出連結，適合檢查代理對狀態變化的掌握。限制是服務規模小、僅涵蓋 Python，速率限制器占比偏高，且無回饋協定同時移除先前未來呼叫，不能純粹歸因於缺少答案。主測試也排除無效果案例；這是診斷工具，不能用來認證部署安全。

links.title: Momentum-Coupled Rubric Adaptation for Detailed Image Captioning

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.3: shared role-conditioned SFT initializes one policy and one generator/judge momentum model; 16 candidates are sampled, four inform online image-grounded rubrics, the text-only judge scores all candidates, and only the policy receives GRPO gradients.

Sections 3.4 and Appendix D: bounded policy updates imply a bounded parameter tracking gap; stationary smoothing assumes locally constant drift and independent interval noise, and explicitly does not guarantee rubric task quality.

Section 4.2, Tables 1–2: average caption win rate is 72.83% versus RubiCap 69.93%; caption-based QA averages 67.17 versus 66.31, with gains across complementary benchmarks but not every individual metric.

Section 4.3, Tables 3–5: separate-role initialization plus EMA falls from 69.22% to 63.43%; shared initialization plus EMA rises from 66.61% to 72.14%; judge-only EMA scores 65.84%, and the best tested joint setting is m=0.99, H=1.
Appendices A.1.4 and B.1: method captions always occupy position A; a second evaluator gives 68.79% average win rate, with per-benchmark common valid sets of 498, 498, 599, 558 and 500 images.

Appendices A.2.2 and B.2–B.3: EvoLM alternates 50-step policy/generator phases for 600 total updates; human agreement uses 500 Qwen3-8B versus GPT-5.6 caption pairs; training dynamics are single-run and explicitly use different SFT checkpoints, limiting causal comparisons.

Section 4.1 and Appendix A: 20,000 GPT-5.5 SFT records, 5,000 RL samples, training schedules and role/evaluation prompts are supplied; the abstract claims a GitHub release, while Appendix A.3 does not identify the fixed text-only QA model.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A relevant multimodal language-generation and RL feedback method: shared multi-role SFT plus EMA transfer from the caption policy to jointly adapted rubric generator/judge is a useful, moderately novel combination. Five caption benchmarks, two external judges, caption-only QA, component/role ablations and an m-by-H sweep support the reported gains. Evidence is weakened by a single backbone, absent repeated-run uncertainty, fixed candidate ordering, a human-agreement study on other models rather than the proposed method, and EvoLM receiving 600 total policy-plus-generator updates rather than 600 policy updates. The EMA proof establishes parameter tracking and smoothing only. Prompts and substantial training details plus a claimed code URL aid reproduction, but the fixed QA model is unnamed and release contents were not externally verified.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這是一項相關的多模態語言生成與 RL 回饋方法：共用多角色 SFT，加上從圖說策略向共同調適的評分規準產生器／評判器進行 EMA 轉移，是有用且具中度新穎性的組合。五個圖說基準、兩個外部評判器、僅使用圖說的問答、元件／角色消融，以及 m×H 掃描，支持所回報的增益。

但單一骨幹、缺乏重複執行的不確定性、固定候選順序、人工一致性研究針對其他模型而非所提方法，以及 EvoLM 接受的是策略加產生器合計 600 次更新、而非 600 次策略更新，都削弱了證據。EMA 證明只確立參數追蹤與平滑。提示、大量訓練細節及所宣稱的程式碼網址有助於重現，但固定的問答模型未具名，釋出內容也未經外部驗證。

primary_link.title: Momentum-Coupled Rubric Adaptation for Detailed Image Captioning

papers.summary: Detailed image captioning requires accurate and comprehensive descriptions of fine-grained visual content, yet caption quality spans factual accuracy, information coverage, and clarity. Compared with conventional methods that rely mainly on high-quality supervision or holistic rewards, rubric-based reinforcement learning decomposes these requirements into explicit criteria and provides targeted, structured feedback. However, existing methods often use separate models for caption generation, rubr
papers.summary_zh: 詳細影像描述需要兼顧事實正確、資訊涵蓋與表達清晰，但產生描述、制定評分規準與執行評分的模型，可能彼此理解不一致，也跟不上訓練中的策略。MoCo Rubric 先以共享參數的多角色 SFT，讓 Qwen3-VL-8B 同時學習三項任務；再依目前候選描述、參考描述與影像建立規準，僅對描述策略執行 GRPO，並用 EMA 將策略參數逐步轉移到共享的規準產生器與評審。五個描述基準對基礎模型的平均勝率達 72.83%，比 RubiCap 高 2.90 個百分點；換另一評審仍達 68.79%，描述輔助問答平均分數為 67.17。消融顯示共享初始化搭配雙角色動量更新最有效，單獨更新評審反而退步。限制是僅測試一種骨幹，缺乏多次訓練的不確定性估計，成對評估固定答案位置，且 EvoLM 的總更新次數含產生器更新，策略訓練預算未完全對齊。理論只保證參數追蹤與平滑性，不能保證評審品質。其價值在於提供可檢驗的適應式獎勵設計，但推廣到其他語言任務仍待驗證。

links.title: Seeing What Should Be Heard: Diagnosing and Repairing Cross-Modal Shortcuts in Omni-Modal LLMs

evidence: Sections 3.2 and 4.1–4.3 define factorial image/audio swapping, answer-margin main effects, designated-modality relabeling, and the answer-only hinge loss; matched status and the non-designated input each carry chance-level label information in a complete grid.

Section 5.1 and Appendix A describe 130 development and 257 confirmation families, exclusion of diagnostic families/media from the 6,176-cell training pool, 42 training answers, full/LoRA settings, and four A800 GPUs.

Section 5.2, Table 1 and Appendix F, Table 10 report confirmation Audio SI 0.559 to 0.224 (change -0.335, 95% CI [-0.390,-0.279]) and audio-following +13.7 points [7.4,19.7]; Appendix F discloses the implemented ±10% equivalence band versus the preregistered ±20%.

Appendix D, Table 7 reports reduced conditional image effects and mean absolute family effects; Appendices F and J provide complete-grid, single-direction, mismatch-label, modality-dropout, loss, parameterization, seed, and parsing analyses.
Appendix G, Tables 12–13 reports AVQA image effect 0.852 to 0.323 and matched accuracy 68.3% to 82.2%; generated audio-following 44.4% to 62.5% is measured on 40 of its 104 families.

Appendices H and K report MiniCPM-o confirmation SI 0.604 to 0.297 and AVHBench overall accuracy 72.9% to 74.3%; Table 14 notes that the two families use different readouts. Section 5.4, Table 2 explicitly copies other methods’ results with different base accuracies.
Reproducibility statement claims core scripts and diagnostic family lists at the abstract’s anonymous repository, with complete code deferred until acceptance; Appendix L supplies experiment prompts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly relevant to multimodal LLM evaluation, hallucination, and post-training. The contribution is a complete 2x2 media-swap diagnostic paired with designated-modality labels and answer-token supervision, which removes label information from both irrelevant media and mismatch status. This is a useful refinement of existing swap-based and counterfactual methods rather than an entirely new training paradigm. Evidence is unusually careful: media/family-separated training, a sealed confirmation set, paired cluster-bootstrap intervals, construction controls, four LoRA seeds, two model families, external transfer, and subsequent-RL retention. On confirmation Audio families, full repair lowers Shortcut Index from 0.559 to 0.224 and improves generated audio-following by 13.7 points; conditional-effect analyses support a real reduction rather than mere cancellation. Limits remain: diagnostic evaluation is chiefly binary QA, the general multi-modality/open-ended formulation is untested, and swap interventions do not establish global modality independence. Published-method comparisons use different starting checkpoints and protocols, so larger gains do not demonstrate controlled superiority. The paper transparently notes a stricter implemented equivalence band than its registration and parser sensitivity. Detailed prompts and training settings plus claimed core-script/family-list availability support reproducibility, but the full code release is deferred and the linked repository was not independently inspected.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這篇研究與多模態 LLM 評估、幻覺及後訓練高度相關。主要貢獻是將完整的 2×2 媒體交換診斷，與指定模態標籤及答案 token 監督結合，使無關媒體及媒體是否配對都無法單獨預測標籤。這是對既有交換式與反事實方法的實用改進，並非全新的訓練典範。證據相當周全：訓練排除診斷題族與媒體、封存確認集、成對群集 bootstrap 區間、資料建構對照、四個 LoRA 隨機種子、兩個模型家族、外部資料轉移及後續 RL 保留測試。確認集的音訊題中，完整修復使 Shortcut Index 從 0.559 降至 0.224，生成答案遵循音訊的比例增加 13.7 個百分點；條件效果分析也支持依賴確實下降，而非正負效果抵銷。限制包括診斷主要使用二元問答，一般多模態與開放式答案仍未驗證，有限交換介入也不能證明全面的模態獨立性。已發表方法比較採不同起始模型及流程，因此較大的增益不代表受控條件下更優。論文透明交代實作的等價區間比預先登錄更嚴格，以及解析器敏感性。詳細提示、訓練設定及宣稱提供的核心腳本與題族清單有助重現，但完整程式碼延後釋出，連結儲存庫未經獨立檢查。

primary_link.title: Seeing What Should Be Heard: Diagnosing and Repairing Cross-Modal Shortcuts in Omni-Modal LLMs

papers.summary: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer a question using the modality it explicitly refers to. However, existing training paradigms rarely verify whether models actually follow this modality, because multimodal inputs from the same sample often provide redundant evidence for the same answer. In this work, we uncover a pervasive cross-modal shortcut in omni-modal LLMs: when asked an audio-related question, models rely on the image as much as on the audio, and sometimes even
papers.summary_zh:
全模態 LLM 回答音訊問題時，可能從影像猜答案；自然影片的聲音與畫面通常一致，使正確率掩蓋了這種捷徑。研究將同題、不同答案的兩筆樣本交叉交換影像與音訊，形成完整 2×2 格狀組合，以答案機率差分離兩種模態的影響。DMC-Repair 再依問題指定的模態重新標記各格，只監督答案 token，避免模型靠畫面或是否配對取得標籤。

- 在封存確認集的音訊題中，Shortcut Index 從 0.559 降至 0.224，下降 59.9%；生成答案遵循音訊的比例增加 13.7 個百分點。
- 完整組合優於單向交換、模態移除及不匹配標籤對照。效果也出現在另一模型家族，並轉移至 AVQA、AVHBench；後續 RL 保留主要改善。

研究提供題族與媒體隔離、信賴區間、隨機種子及解析方式檢查，讓結果更可信。但診斷主要限於二元問答，開放式答案與多個指定模態仍待測試，外部方法比較也使用不同起始模型。其價值是提供可測量、可修復的模態依賴方法；核心腳本宣稱已提供，完整程式碼仍待釋出。
papers.title: Seeing What Should Be Heard: Diagnosing and Repairing Cross-Modal Shortcuts in Omni-Modal LLMs
papers.title_zh: 把應該聽見的內容看出來：診斷與修復全模態 LLM 的跨模態捷徑

links.title: VISTA: Internalizing Collective Visual Experience via On-Policy Distillation for Active Multimodal Agents

evidence: Section 3 and Appendix B.1–B.3: CVED compiles all same-input rollout observations with provenance/decision alignment; HAPI applies successful-only GRPO and unsuccessful-only JSD distillation on unchanged student prefixes, using categorical outcomes but excluding added reference and generated final answers.
Section 4.2, Table 1: six-task average accuracy increases from 67.93 to 73.81 for Qwen3-VL-4B and from 68.41 to 74.22 for 8B, gains of 5.88 and 5.81 percentage points.

Section 4.3, Table 2: controlled six-task perception/general-reasoning averages are 80.73 versus 79.42 for Imagine-OPD at 4B and 82.17 versus 81.28 at 8B; base, GRPO and four distillation methods share student-side conditions.

Section 4.4, Tables 3–4 and Appendices D–E, Tables 10–11: CVED scores 83.83 versus unstructured-context 82.43, collective versus self-only hindsight is 83.83 versus 81.70, and HAPI versus uniform hybrid is 83.83 versus 82.87; neither routing mask alone improves the mean.

Appendix C, Table 9: 6,241 examples, 65 optimizer steps, eight rollouts per question, artifact budget four, EMA decay 0.99, five interaction turns/four crop calls, and three seeds; schedule matching is explicitly distinguished from equal computational cost.

Section 4.6, Table 7 and Appendix G: benefits extend to Qwen3.5-4B/9B, but broader model families, video and tool environments are untested; teacher overhead and dependence on diverse relevant observations are acknowledged.

Reproducibility statement and Appendix B.4: code is claimed available at https://github.com/jiangz20/VISTA; core prompt templates are cited as Figures 3–5, whose actual visual contents are absent from the supplied text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant multimodal LLM-agent training method that turns peer visual discoveries into privileged on-policy supervision and routes reinforcement versus distillation by trajectory outcome. Strong same-backbone comparisons, shared-budget context controls, self-only versus collective experience and crossed routing ablations support the mechanism beyond adding an extra loss. Gains are consistent across tested perception/reasoning tasks and four Qwen backbones, though the incremental advantage over the strongest distillation baseline is modest. Three-seed means lack reported dispersion, added teacher/context computation is not compute-matched, and generality remains limited to image QA with crop-and-zoom tools and Qwen-family models. Complete supplied text was read; code availability is explicitly claimed and training details are extensive, but repository availability was not independently checked and prompt-template figures are represented only by captions in the supplied extraction.

Strong same-backbone comparisons, shared-budget context controls, self-only versus collective experience and crossed routing ablations support the mechanism beyond adding an extra loss. Gains are consistent across tested perception/reasoning tasks and four Qwen backbones, though the incremental advantage over the strongest distillation baseline is modest. Three-seed means lack reported dispersion, added teacher/context computation is not compute-matched, and generality remains limited to image QA with crop-and-zoom tools and Qwen-family models. llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項多模態 LLM 代理訓練方法直接切題，將同儕的視覺發現轉為特權 on-policy 監督，並依軌跡結果分配強化學習或蒸餾。扎實的同骨幹比較、共用預算上下文控制、自身經驗與集體經驗比較，以及交叉路由消融，支持其機制不只是多加一項損失。在受測感知／推理任務與四個 Qwen 骨幹上，增益一致，但相較最強蒸餾基準的額外優勢不大。

三種子平均值未回報離散程度，新增教師／上下文運算量未進行運算預算配對，而且普遍性仍限於使用裁切與縮放工具的影像問答及 Qwen 家族模型。已讀完所提供的完整文字；文中明確宣稱程式碼可取得，訓練細節也相當豐富，但未獨立確認儲存庫可取得性，而所提供擷取內容中的提示範本圖只呈現圖說。

primary_link.title: VISTA: Internalizing Collective Visual Experience via On-Policy Distillation for Active Multimodal Agents

papers.summary: Active multimodal agents use visual tools to acquire task-relevant evidence while reasoning. Although reinforcement learning samples multiple interaction trajectories per input, outcome-based objectives primarily use the group to estimate scalar advantages, leaving complementary visual discoveries underused. We introduce VISTA, which internalizes collective visual experience through on-policy distillation by turning observations from same-input rollouts into shared supervision. Collective visual
papers.summary_zh: VISTA 研究多模態代理在同一題的多次探索中，如何把彼此找到的視覺證據轉成訓練訊號。CVED 將裁切影像、操作脈絡與來源關係整理成教師專用上下文，對齊學生原本產生的回應前綴；HAPI 則用 GRPO 強化成功軌跡，對失敗、格式錯誤或未完成軌跡做 on-policy distillation。教師只看結果類別，不取得標準答案或同伴最終答案，部署時仍由單一代理自行使用縮放工具。作者以 6,241 題訓練 Qwen3-VL 4B、8B，六項視覺測試平均較原模型提升 5.88、5.81 個百分點；跨視覺與一般推理的同骨幹比較，也分別比 Imagine-OPD 高 1.31、0.89 點。共享同伴證據比只用自身事後資訊高 2.13 點，雙重路由比均勻混合損失高 0.96 點，支持兩個設計各有作用。限制是僅報三個種子的平均、未提供變異或等總算力比較，且集中於 Qwen 與影像裁切問答。重要性在於重新利用訓練探索中原本被丟棄的資訊，但仍待更廣工具情境與成本分析驗證。

links.title: XRepoSkill: Learning Transferable Skills for Software Engineering Agents

evidence: Sections 2.3–2.5 and Appendix A: discover rules from divergent successful/failed trajectories; verify on trajectories excluding discovery pairs with issue-stratified gains; cluster predicates across at least two repositories; select at most three of 36 transferable rules.

Sections 3.2–3.3 and Appendix B.1: source pool has 12 trajectories for each of 500 SWE-bench Verified Python issues; evaluation uses 200 SWE-bench Pro issues and all 113 DeepSWE tasks, with no source/evaluation repository overlap and three backbone LLMs.

Section 4.1, Table 1: average resolution is 53.8% versus 47.8% without skills on SWE-bench Pro, and 44.2% versus 33.9% on DeepSWE; the DeepSeek/SWE-bench Pro result ties STAIR at 55.5%, rather than strictly beating it.
Section 4.3, Table 3: four DeepSeek/DeepSWE runs yield 58.6 ± 2.49% for XRepoSkill, 49.3 ± 2.69% for Trace2Skill, and 45.6 ± 2.50% for mini-SWE-agent (reported 95% confidence intervals).

Section 4.4, Table 4: all five ablations reduce the 58.4% DeepSeek/DeepSWE result; supplying all rules yields 48.7%, removing cross-repository consolidation 51.3%, and removing within-repository verification 53.1%.

Section 4.2, Table 2 and Appendix B.2: some language subsets have only 5–6 issues; most experiments are single-run, and SWE-bench Pro evaluation removes Git history and network access, so its rates are not directly comparable with official-environment results.

Appendix C: selection-associated gains cannot identify an individual rule’s causal effect because up to three rules co-occur and selection is nonrandom. Reproducibility statement claims code, data, and skill corpus at https://github.com/XREPOSKILL/XRepoSkill; external availability was not checked.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant work on reusable guidance for coding agents, combining success/failure trajectory contrasts, executable behavioral predicates, issue-stratified association estimates, and cross-repository consolidation. Three backbones and two repository-disjoint benchmarks show useful gains, with repeated DeepSWE runs and five ablations strengthening the evidence. However, rule verification remains observational and can reflect backbone differences; most comparisons use one run, several language subsets are tiny, and all experiments use one agent framework. The SWE-bench Pro environment deliberately differs from the official setting. Detailed implementation and claimed code/data release aid reproducibility, but artifact availability is not independently checked.
llm_evaluation.rationale_en: Highly relevant work on reusable guidance for coding agents, combining success/failure trajectory contrasts, executable behavioral predicates, issue-stratified association estimates, and cross-repository consolidation. Three backbones and two repository-disjoint benchmarks show useful gains, with repeated DeepSWE runs and five ablations strengthening the evidence. However, rule verification remains observational and can reflect backbone differences; most comparisons use one run, several language subsets are tiny, and all experiments use one agent framework. The SWE-bench Pro environment deliberately differs from the official setting. Detailed implementation and claimed code/data release aid reproducibility, but artifact availability is not independently checked.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這項研究高度切合程式代理的可重用指引，結合成功與失敗軌跡對照、可執行的行為判定式、依問題分層的關聯估計，以及跨儲存庫規則整合。三個基礎模型與兩個儲存庫不重疊的基準呈現實用增益，DeepSWE 的重複執行和五項消融也強化證據。不過，規則驗證仍屬觀察性分析，可能反映基礎模型差異；多數比較僅執行一次，部分語言子集很小，而且全部實驗只使用一種代理框架。SWE-bench Pro 的環境刻意不同於官方設定。詳細實作說明及作者宣稱公開的程式與資料有助重現，但本次未獨立查核資源是否可用。

primary_link.title: XRepoSkill: Learning Transferable Skills for Software Engineering Agents

papers.summary: Software engineering agents increasingly use reusable skills distilled from prior experience to resolve repository-level issues, yet such skills often fail to transfer across repositories. A central challenge is that a behavior appearing in a successful trajectory is not necessarily responsible for the successful outcome: it may be genuinely useful, merely incidental, or simply a recurring habit of the model. We introduce XRepoSkill, a trajectory-based approach for learning transferable skills.
papers.summary_zh:
XRepoSkill 研究如何讓軟體工程代理把過去修復問題的經驗，轉成能用於陌生儲存庫的技能。它先比較同一問題的成功與失敗軌跡，從行為分歧提出規則，再以可執行的判定式檢查規則是否出現在其他軌跡，估計同一問題內的成功率差異，並合併跨儲存庫重現的行為。處理新問題時，模型最多選三條規則作為提示。

研究以 SWE-bench Verified 的軌跡學習，在不重疊的儲存庫評估三個模型。SWE-bench Pro 的 200 題平均解決率為 53.8%，DeepSWE 的 113 題為 44.2%，分別高於無技能代理 6.0 與 10.3 個百分點；後者也高於最強技能基準 5.0 個百分點。重複執行與消融支持規則篩選的價值。

限制是規則證據屬於觀察性關聯，仍可能混入模型能力差異；多數比較僅執行一次，部分語言題數很少，且只測試 mini-SWE-agent。作者宣稱公開程式、資料與技能庫，本文未獨立驗證。對需要可移轉工作流程的程式代理而言，這是值得測試的方法，但尚不能證明單條規則具有因果效益。

links.title: The Unequal Influence of Bad Advice: Using Training Data Attribution to Modulate Emergent Misalignment

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.4: three wrong-advice datasets use 5,900 training examples each, rank-32 RsLoRA and one epoch; each filtering experiment combines four initializations and three shuffles (12 runs).

Section 3.2 and Appendix A.1: 44 prompts with ten completions each are judged using Qwen3-32B, with scores below 3 counted as misaligned; reported correlation with GPT-4.1-mini is about 0.9, not a human validation study.

Section 4.1 and Figure 1: for OLMo 3 7B career advice, removing the most influential 20% changes misalignment from about 45% to 40%, while removing the least influential 20% raises it toward 55%; random removal barely changes it.

Section 4.1, Figure 3 and Figures A6–A8: influence deciles grade empirical effects across the distribution, loss/length are weaker predictors, and repeating retained examples to equalize updates preserves the main filtering pattern.

Section 3.4 and Figures A3–A4: rankings built from 22/36 versus all 44 evaluation questions or from separate question categories remain predictive; evaluation still includes questions used to construct attribution.
Section 4.2 and Figures 5/A13–A17: transferred rankings are useful but target-model attribution generally works best, with dataset-dependent correlations and asymmetric size/family transfer.

Sections 4.1, 4.3 and 5: training on low-influence examples still causes misalignment; narrow-domain misalignment drops from roughly 95% to below 80% when training on the least influential 20%, and semantic rubrics do not fully explain the scores.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strongly relevant data-centric alignment and interpretability study that validates approximate attribution through actual retraining instead of relying only on correlations. Twelve initialization/shuffle combinations, random and harmfulness baselines, full-distribution deciles, fixed-update controls, multiple advice domains and cross-model transfer make the central finding that harmful examples have unequal and model-dependent influence convincing. Novelty lies in the emergent-misalignment application and its detailed empirical distinctions, rather than a new attribution algorithm. Generalization remains bounded by synthetic wrong-advice fine-tuning, a 44-question LLM-judged evaluation and attribution queries overlapping that evaluation; subset/category transfer only partially addresses this dependence. Narrow-task learning also changes, and example interactions and semantic mechanisms remain unresolved. Training settings, judge prompts and an existing attribution library are described, but the supplied paper does not link a dedicated experiment/code artifact.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這是一項與資料導向的對齊及可解釋性高度相關的研究，透過實際重新訓練驗證近似歸因，而不只依賴相關性。十二種初始化與資料洗牌組合、隨機及有害性基準、涵蓋完整分布的十分位分組、固定更新次數的控制、多種建議領域，以及跨模型轉移，讓「有害範例的影響並不相等，且取決於模型」這項核心發現具有說服力。新穎性在於湧現式失準的應用及細緻的實證區辨，而非新的歸因演算法。

可推廣性仍受限於合成錯誤建議的微調、由 LLM 評判的 44 題評估，以及與該評估重疊的歸因查詢；子集與類別轉移只部分處理了這種相依性。狹窄任務的學習也會改變，範例之間的交互作用及語意機制仍未釐清。文中說明了訓練設定、裁判提示及既有的歸因程式庫，但所提供的論文沒有連結至專屬的實驗或程式碼產物。

papers.summary: Fine-tuning large language models on narrow, misaligned tasks can undo their post-training alignment and induce novel misaligned behaviors -- a phenomenon known as \emph{emergent misalignment} (EM). EM has been linked to persona-like representations, where fine-tuning might reduce loss by amplifying a harmful or 'evil' persona. It remains unclear which properties of the training data drive this effect: whether all harmful examples contribute approximately equally to misalignment and whether diff
papers.summary_zh: 狹窄領域的錯誤建議微調可能讓 LLM 在其他情境也產生有害回答；本文進一步問，同樣被標為有害的訓練例子，影響是否一樣大。作者以 Bergson 計算 EK-FAC 近似影響函數或梯度餘弦相似度，再依分數刪除、保留或分組訓練，並與 WildGuard 有害性評分、隨機篩選及簡單資料特徵比較。主要 OLMo 3 7B 職涯建議實驗中，移除最有影響力的兩成資料，失準率約由 45% 降至 40%；移除影響最小的兩成，反而升至接近 55%。每個篩選實驗結合四個初始化與三種洗牌，共十二次訓練，另以固定更新次數、三類錯誤建議及多個模型檢查穩健性。分數可跨模型轉移，但通常以目標模型自身計算最有效。限制是評估只有 44 題且仰賴 LLM 裁判，歸因也使用其中題目；子集與跨題型測試僅部分減輕此疑慮。低影響力資料仍可能造成失準，篩選也會改變狹窄任務的學習程度。研究支持針對特定模型稽核訓練資料，尚不能視為普遍的安全保證，也未解釋哪些語意因素真正造成影響。
