links.title: Alpha Diffusion Language Models: Factorization Alone Is Not the Problem

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3, Equations 6–13: sequence-level alpha loss changes the target fitted by a factorized predictor; Appendix B derives the KL/total-correlation characterization and gradient weighting.

Section 3.2 Proposition 1 and Appendix B.1: excluding invalid combinations while preserving several completions requires disjoint Cartesian support groups and 1/m < alpha < 1; a counterexample demonstrates that increasing alpha alone is insufficient.

Section 4.1 and Appendix C Table 3: shared-initialization, 250k-update experiments achieve 34.65% GSM8K accuracy at four NFE with sequence k=16 versus 19.86% for the best tested token-wise loss; Appendix C explicitly identifies single-checkpoint, single-training-seed estimates.

Appendix E Table 6: CE-initialized sequence training achieves 35.33% at four NFE versus 19.86% for the best tested token-wise setting; Section 4.1 and Appendix C Table 4 also report gains with random ancestral reveal positions.

Section 4.2 and Appendix D: at threshold 0.99, SDAR mathematics accuracy is 51.5%/77.2% versus CE 50.6%/76.3%, with TPF increases of 31.6%/27.1%; HumanEval-Instruct matches CE+CAP pass@1 at 60.6% while TPF rises 1.74 to 1.94. Appendix D averages five runs and defines TPF excluding cache-only forwards.
Appendix C Table 2 and Appendices D–F provide architecture, optimizer, preprocessing, verifier and sampling details; baseline comparison histories and total training compute are not fully matched.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant language-model training and efficient math/code generation work. The useful novelty is sequence-level alpha loss with factorized-denoiser analysis and a precise valid-support result, rather than a new loss family. Matched objective ablations, alternative initialization and sampling controls substantiate substantial low-NFE gains; SDAR transfer adds two domains but smaller accuracy improvements. TinyGSM uses one training seed, the population theorem assumes restrictive support geometry, the best parameter depends on decoding budget, and NFE/TPF are not wall-clock speed. Detailed protocols support reproduction, but the supplied full text does not establish a release of this work's code or checkpoints.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項研究與語言模型訓練及高效率的數學／程式生成高度相關。具價值的新意是序列層級 alpha 損失、因子化去噪器分析，以及有效支撐集合的精確結果，而非新的損失函數家族。匹配條件的目標函數消融、替代初始化及取樣控制，為低 NFE 設定下的大幅改善提供支持；轉移至 SDAR 又增加了兩個領域的證據，但正確率改善較小。

TinyGSM 只使用一個訓練種子，母體層級定理假設了嚴格受限的支撐集合幾何結構，最佳參數取決於解碼預算，而 NFE／TPF 並不等於實際執行速度。詳細的實驗流程有助於重現，但所提供的全文未能確認這項工作的程式碼或檢查點已釋出。

papers.summary: Discrete diffusion language models can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but reducing the number of denoising steps can lead to inconsistent predictions. Standard cross-entropy training fits conditional token marginals, whereas parallel generation requires consistent joint predictions. We introduce Alpha Diffusion Language Models (AlphaDLM), trained with a sequence-level alpha loss that recovers cross-entropy in the limit of vanishing alpha and has a joint-mode optimum at alpha one. Our anal
papers.summary_zh: 擴散語言模型一次預測多個詞元時，即使各位置的邊際預測合理，組合後仍可能成為錯誤答案。AlphaDLM 將 generalized cross-entropy 套用到遮罩詞元的聯合機率，藉由序列層級的共同權重改變訓練目標，保留原本的因子化去噪架構。作者推導全域最適分布，並證明在嚴格的有效答案支撐集合條件下，中間區間的 alpha 能排除無效組合，同時保留多個有效補全；這不是對一般語言資料或神經網路訓練收斂的保證。實驗以相同初始化、訓練預算與取樣器比較不同目標：TinyGSM 訓練後，四次模型評估的 GSM8K 正確率達 34.6%，最佳逐詞元對照為 19.9%；改用交叉熵初始化及隨機揭露位置，改善仍然存在。在 SDAR-1.7B 上，數學任務的每次前向傳播產生詞元數增加約 27–32%，正確率小幅提升；程式任務則主要改善效率與正確率的取捨。限制是 TinyGSM 各設定只有一個訓練種子，較大的參數可能犧牲高預算表現，且計算指標不等於實測延遲。這項工作提供值得重現的低步數語言生成訓練方法。

links.title: Learning to Prove, Not Just to Answer: Reinforcement Learning from Formal Verification for Natural-Language Logical Reasoning

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.5, Equations 6–21: premises are supplied in natural language and formal logic; separate semantic/rule proof states accept verified conclusions; ASDC restricts outcome advantage to the final-answer dependency closure and maps action advantages to token spans.

Section 4.2, Table 1: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ProverQA-Overall Avg@3 is 62.80 versus PRoSFI 59.57; RVR is 41.19 versus LogicAgent 30.44. Qwen3-8B Proof-R1 RVR is 94.36 versus PRoSFI 89.28, while Avg@3 96.52 is below LogicAgent 96.87.
Section 4.3, Table 2: on Qwen3-8B Hard, full Proof-R1 has Avg@3/RVR 92.63/90.22, versus 90.28/57.73 without MCFV and 89.61/85.71 without ASDC; the ablation tables do not report uncertainty.

Appendix B, Equations 29–32, and Appendix D: FVR/RVR aggregate eligible proof steps, not whole-proof success; certificate soundness assumes faithful formal representations, consistent premises, acyclic resolved dependencies, and trusted checking components.

Appendices C and G, Tables 6, 7, 11 and 12: transfer gains appear on additional backbones and ProofWriter; FOLIO uses 51 validation problems with three outputs per model and seven additional guarded rule families. Appendix M explicitly supplies the expanded rule ontology in FOLIO prompts.

Appendix E, Table 8: frozen Qwen2.5 outputs yield identical FVR/RVR across Z3, cvc5, veriT and Isabelle; 31,588 local check attempts include 654 shared input-processing failures, and Isabelle confirms 30,932 determinate judgments without contradictions. These audits share the supplied formal representations.

Appendices J–M: baseline adaptations, LoRA settings, 1,098 training steps, prompts and computational cost are specified; PRoSFI is reimplemented because its authors had not released code. The Reproducibility Statement claims code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Proof-R1/, which was not fetched for this review.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM reasoning and reinforcement-learning work: Proof-R1 combines verifier-gated reusable proof states with answer-dependency-masked action credit, rather than merely scoring final answers. Controlled comparisons, two-component ablations, four backbones, and heterogeneous solver audits support substantial step-verification improvements; Qwen3 answer accuracy is near saturation and not uniformly best. The contribution is a useful integration of formal checking and structured policy credit, not a general guarantee of natural-language reasoning. Inputs already include formal premises; FVR/RVR are micro-averaged eligible-step metrics, soundness is conditional, FOLIO covers only 51 problems with new rules explicitly supplied at evaluation, and the strongest training baselines are not included in all transfer comparisons. Complete supplied text, including all appendices and references, was read. Detailed implementation and a source-code URL support reproducibility, but code availability and independent replication were not externally verified.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項研究與 LLM 推理及強化學習高度相關：Proof-R1 將由驗證器把關、可重複使用的證明狀態，與依答案相依關係遮罩的動作貢獻歸因結合，而不只是對最終答案評分。受控制的比較、兩個元件的消融、四個主幹模型，以及異質求解器的稽核，支持其在步驟驗證上的大幅改善；Qwen3 的答案正確率已接近飽和，且並非在所有比較中都最好。這項貢獻是形式化檢查與結構化策略貢獻歸因的有用整合，並非自然語言推理的一般性保證。

輸入本來就包含形式化前提；FVR／RVR 是對符合條件步驟進行微平均的指標，健全性保證有其條件，FOLIO 僅涵蓋 51 道問題，且評估時明確提供了新規則；最強的訓練基準也沒有納入所有轉移比較。已閱讀所提供的完整文本，包括所有附錄及參考文獻。詳細實作說明與原始碼網址有助於重現，但並未透過外部查證確認程式碼可取得性或獨立重現結果。

primary_link.title: Learning to Prove, Not Just to Answer: Reinforcement Learning from Formal Verification for Natural-Language Logical Reasoning

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for natural-language logical reasoning, where the final answer is easy to check but the proof behind it is not. In natural-language logical reasoning, an intermediate conclusion should follow from its premises, and the resulting derivation should support the final answer. Existing methods lack machine-checkable verification of intermediate conclusions and answer-supporting proof dependencies, so they may assign credit to invalid or answer-ir
papers.summary_zh: 只獎勵最終答案正確，可能讓語言模型強化無效推論或與答案無關的步驟。Proof-R1 把證明寫成含依賴、結論與規則的結構化動作，以 UNSAT 檢查決定哪些結論能成為後續可信前提，再回溯答案所需的依賴閉包，將結果獎勵分配給真正支持答案的動作。它也以規則條件基準調整逐步驗證獎勵，透過 PPO 類目標訓練模型。在 ProverQA，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 Avg@3 達 62.80%，較最強比較方法增加 3.23 個百分點；Qwen3-8B 的規則驗證率達 94.36%，但答案準確率未全面超越推論代理。移除驗證或依賴閉包均使多項指標下降，另有跨模型、跨資料集與不同求解器的檢查支持結果。不過輸入已提供形式化前提，FOLIO 僅測試 51 題，且評估提示明列新增推論規則；逐步驗證率也不等於整份證明正確率。這項工作提供可追溯的推理訓練設計，對獎勵分配與可靠 LLM 有價值，但尚未證明能處理開放語言中的歧義、隱含知識或多語情境。

links.title: When Should Agents Check External State? Budgeting Observations for Stored Intentions

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.4 and Appendix A.2–A.3: Static learns binary current-decision Outcome effects; Sequential imitates full-episode hindsight-DP schedules. Both use pre-query logistic scorers and the same hard-budget executor; 27 local features become 36 for temporal policies, with development-only fitting.

Section 5.2, Table 2 and Appendix B.4, Table 10: on 30 confirmation weeks, Static gives 0.819 Set F1 at 89.47 observations (B60) and 0.820 at 113.23 (B80), versus unconstrained 0.820 at 195.03, preserving 99.9–100% quality with about 54.1%/41.9% fewer queries.

Appendix C.2, Table 15 and C.3, Table 17: label-matched Sequential minus Myopic improves F1 by 0.0183/0.0085 at B5/B10 on severe-scarcity weeks, and 0.0137/0.0105 on disjoint boundary weeks; all four paired 95% confidence intervals exclude zero. Policies are identical at B15/B20.

Appendix C.3.1, Tables 19–20: Sequential exceeds Deadline-Outcome by 0.0192–0.0258 F1 at matched caps. Across the 20-cap sweep, Deadline needs 15 queries to match both Sequential metrics at B5 (10 queries), and 24.80/24.93 versus 20.67/20.93 at B10. The Boundary-B5 advantage over Pacing-LB has a CI crossing zero.

Appendix C.3.3, Table 21: exact-total-cost DP headroom is 0.00737/0.00367 F1 at B5/B10 and zero at B15/B20; fixing the current-greedy number of queries at each step removes all within-step headroom in the 120 week–budget cells.

Appendix C.4, Tables 22–23: 240 paired held-out seeds show structural headroom rising from zero to 0.00652 at fixed B10 after extra trigger opportunities. The learned-gain interaction is 0.00429 with 95% CI [-0.00064, 0.00922], and Sequential uses about 0.95/0.90 more queries than Myopic, so a significant learned demand interaction or matched-realized-cost causal gain is not established.

Appendices A.1–A.3 and B.1: PM-Bench events are generated independently of observations, primary Static development uses 20 weeks and GoodAI 12 trajectories; system baselines retain different adapted workflows. Split hashes and supplement audit packages are described, but no code repository URL appears in the supplied text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to long-running LLM agents, prospective memory, tool-use efficiency, and budgeted planning. The useful contribution is an observation-allocation interface plus lightweight imitation of hindsight schedules, rather than a fundamentally new optimization technique. The extensive shared-controller, label-only, exact-cost, natural-schedule, disjoint-seed, and fixed-load controls support the local-gating and severe-scarcity findings. Complete-system Mem0/PMA gaps compare adapted workflows and cannot isolate the allocator. Generalization remains limited by generated, query-independent event streams, known horizons, a fixed compiler/candidate interface, and primarily unit-cost temporal tests. The controlled-load learned interaction is not statistically resolved and learned policies there use different realized costs; exact-cost oracle headroom is a separate result. Detailed features, splits, hyperparameters, and supplement audit-package descriptions help reproduction, but the supplied text contains no directly usable project/code link or independent real-world deployment evidence.

這項研究直接相關於長時間運行的 LLM 代理、前瞻記憶、工具使用效率，以及有預算限制的規劃。具價值的貢獻是觀測分配介面，加上對事後排程的輕量模仿，而非根本全新的最佳化技術。大量共用控制器、僅標籤、精確成本、自然排程、不重疊種子，以及固定工作負載的控制實驗，支持局部閘控與嚴重資源稀缺情境下的發現。完整系統層級與 Mem0／PMA 的差距是在比較經改造的工作流程，無法單獨辨識分配器的效果。

可推廣性仍受限於生成的、獨立於查詢的事件流、已知的時間範圍、固定的編譯器／候選項介面，以及主要採單位成本的時間性測試。在受控制工作負載下，學習策略的交互作用尚未獲得統計上的明確結論，且其中學習策略的實際成本不同；精確成本 oracle 所呈現的改善空間則是另一項結果。詳細特徵、資料切分、超參數，以及補充資料中的稽核套件說明有助於重現，但所提供的文本沒有可直接使用的專案／程式碼連結，也沒有獨立的真實世界部署證據。

primary_link.title: When Should Agents Check External State? Budgeting Observations for Stored Intentions

papers.summary: Prospective memory allows an agent to retain an intention tied to a future condition, but the stored intention does not reveal whether that condition currently holds. Checking it may require web access, multi-step tool use, and paid calls. Existing systems decide when intentions require attention, but do not allocate the resulting observations under a shared budget. We introduce the first resource-allocation formulation for the external observations required by stored intentions under a shared e
papers.summary_zh: 長期運作的代理即使記得待辦，也得花費工具呼叫查證外部條件。BudgetPM 把這些查詢視為共享預算的分配問題：Static 用 Logistic regression 學習觀測能否改善當下決策；Sequential 則模仿離線動態規劃產生的完整情節排程，部署時只使用查詢前可見的資訊，並由共同執行器限制支出。PM-Bench 的標準預算實驗中，Static 保留約 99.9–100% 的無限制品質，少用約 42–54% 查詢；嚴格預算下，Sequential 比最佳自然監測排程提高 1.92–2.58 個 Set F1 百分點。相同模型與特徵、僅更換監督標籤的比較，以及固定查詢成本的事後分析，支持跨時間保留容量的作用。不過資料主要來自合成、事件不受查詢影響的軌跡，且假設已知情節長度；增加工作量的實驗雖出現較大學習增益，其交互作用信賴區間仍跨零，兩策略的實際成本也不同。本文對代理工程的啟示是先衡量需求與容量，再決定是否需要未來感知排程，不能把所有預算情境都視為同一種問題。

links.title: Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing

evidence: Sections 3.1 and 5.1; Appendix A: SA-BEP divides upfront model-execution expenditure by per-query serving savings; SA-CR amortizes over a fixed horizon. The metrics do not represent complete system-level cost.

Sections 4.1–4.3 and Appendix C: group-conditioned UCB collects distinct query–model outcomes, a two-way Ridge prior is shrunk toward local evidence, and per-model Ridge residuals use training-only TF–IDF features; unseen-query groups are predicted rather than read from test labels.

Section 5.2, Table 1; Appendix D, Tables A3–A4: at K=4, peak scores are 0.6338/0.7498/0.7540/0.8084 over the four benchmarks, with break-even volumes 5.3K/1.23M/18.2K/42.6K. All main experiments use the seed-42 20%/80% in-domain split; WISERouter, BaRP and SemiRouter are adapted reimplementations.
Section 5.3, Table 2: removing query residuals reduces LLMRouterBench peak score from 0.6338 to 0.6175; Random-K pays back earlier (3.8K versus 5.3K) despite worse peak quality and long-horizon cost.

Appendices C.2, D.2–D.3 and E.7: metrics are constructed from evaluated test frontiers with method-specific operating-point protocols and benchmark-specific costs; cached BaRP feedback reduces its break-even volumes markedly, but they remain above SaveRouter in all four main benchmarks.

Appendices E.1–E.6 and F: budget, training-fraction, regularization and target sweeps plus an additional RouterEval test broaden support; Mixinstruct K=4 remains above break-even cost at one million queries, and sparse model onboarding requires retraining and is not uniformly superior. The Abstract supplies a GitHub code URL, not independently checked here.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant practical LLM-routing work that includes the cost of collecting supervision in break-even analysis. SaveRouter combines established UCB acquisition, empirical-Bayes shrinkage and Ridge residual prediction rather than introducing a fundamentally new learner. Four primary benchmarks, an additional RouterEval evaluation, acquisition/estimator ablations, budget/quality-target sweeps, caching sensitivity and model-pool expansion provide substantial support. Confidence in deployment gains is tempered by single-seed in-domain evaluation, test-frontier operating-point selection, differing policy grids and paper-derived sparse-baseline implementations; the cost model excludes complete system overhead and uses benchmark-specific proxies. Several peak-quality differences are very small, and earliest payback is not always achieved by the proposed acquisition policy. Detailed implementation and a public-code claim aid reproducibility, but availability and execution were not independently verified.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項實務 LLM 路由研究高度相關，並將蒐集監督訊號的成本納入損益兩平分析。SaveRouter 結合既有的 UCB 取樣、empirical-Bayes 收縮估計，以及 Ridge 殘差預測，而非引入根本全新的學習器。四個主要基準、額外的 RouterEval 評估、取樣／估計器消融、預算／品質目標掃描、快取敏感度分析，以及模型池擴增，提供了相當充足的支持。

不過，單一種子的域內評估、依測試前緣選擇操作點、不同的策略網格，以及依論文重新實作的稀疏基準，都削弱了對部署效益的信心；成本模型沒有涵蓋完整系統開銷，且使用各基準特有的代理值。若干最高品質的差異極小，而最早回本也不一定由所提出的取樣策略達成。詳細實作說明與公開程式碼的宣告有助於重現，但未獨立確認其可取得性或執行結果。

primary_link.title: Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) routing reduces serving cost by assigning each query to an appropriate model while preserving response quality. Learning such a router, however, often requires executing multiple candidate models on historical queries to collect query--model quality feedback, creating a nontrivial supervision cost before deployment. Existing work largely focuses on serving-time efficiency, overlooking whether the resulting savings are sufficient to recover this upfront expenditure. We
papers.summary_zh: LLM 路由能把查詢交給較便宜的模型，但訓練路由器前大量蒐集模型回答，也是一筆必須回收的成本。SaveRouter 先依任務或查詢表示分組，以能力估計與不確定性選取少量模型回饋，再結合群組與模型的加性先驗、收縮估計及查詢層級的 Ridge 殘差修正，預測品質與成本。研究以 SA-BEP 衡量回本所需查詢量，並用 SA-CR 衡量固定部署量下的攤銷成本。四個主要基準只使用約 33–41% 訓練回饋，回本量相較最快的傳統完整監督路由器降低約 1.9–9.5 倍；例如 RouterBench 從 32.64 萬降至 4.26 萬次。消融與預算掃描也顯示，最高品質、最低服務成本與最快回本不一定由同一設定達成，隨機取樣甚至可更早回本。限制是主要結果來自單一隨機種子的同分布切分，操作點以測試前緣評估，成本未涵蓋完整系統開銷，部分基準使用成本代理值，且部分對照方法為重新實作。這項工作的價值在於提醒部署者按預期流量選擇監督預算，而非一味追求蒐集完整回饋。

Appendix B.12，Tables 24–25：SmolLM2-1.7B 在 1,024-token context、32-token greedy continuation、共同 1% 風險限制下，跨 K8/V8 與 K8/V4 的可編輯座標為 BCC 32,768、activation cost 1,024；共同風險上界 0.630%，且這項 credit 僅占固定主幹下非零 head sign code 的 0.033%。
Appendix B.6，Tables 5、14：BFMS 在十二個小型參考 decoder、三個權重預算上接近 Hessian 選擇，耗時 3.40–6.15 秒對 17.58–34.13 秒；對 HAWQ 的種子級 sign-test p=0.3125，未宣稱統計等價；分層加總是篩選啟發式，非確定性 rounding 的憑證。
Appendices B.2、B.4–B.5、B.16：跨格式族的獨立轉移風險 1.47–1.87% 未達預設 1% 目標；4,000-probe clipped-NLL 控制均未勝過直接界；GPT-2 full-FFN 界仍為 1，且 cache／後端更動會使既有 head bank 失效。這些負結果限制可推廣的範圍。
Appendices B.14–B.15，Tables 3、28–29：相同記憶體下 K8/V4 的 NLL 與預測一致性優於 K4/V8，涵蓋 GPT-2、Qwen2.5、SmolLM2；後兩者未計算行為質量或複雜度界，且結果限定於指定的 symmetric absmax quantizer。
首頁程式碼連結與 Appendix C：宣告 https://github.com/eamaz/bcc 提供程式與重現說明，附錄說明固定實驗流程、scripts、saved outputs、小模型 checkpoints、hashes 及公開模型／資料版本；本評閱依完整供應文本，未獨立執行這些產物。
llm_evaluation.rationale: 高度相關於 LLM 量化、KV cache、可靠部署與評估。核心貢獻是把完整實作的行為等價類、可計算的 margin／transition 子集合，以及獨立轉移驗證串成憑證流程；基本機率工具延續 Occam 與 PAC–Bayes，故新穎性主要在此部署建構，而非新的泛化原理。全文提供證明、完整信賴預算、多組控制與失敗案例，並在 OLMoE、SmolLM2 展示有意義的共同編輯保證。限制是完整模型的非空泛界只示範於極小 decoder 和已宣告有限分布；大型模型多固定主幹，BFMS 僅為啟發式篩選，cache 優勢也依賴指定量化器。程式庫、固定版本與重現產物有明確宣告，但本次未獨立執行或核驗其可取得性。
llm_evaluation.rationale_en:
Highly relevant to LLM quantization, KV cache, reliable deployment, and evaluation. The core contribution is a certificate workflow that connects behavioral equivalence classes of complete implementations, computable margin/transition subsets, and independent transfer validation. The underlying probabilistic tools build on Occam and PAC–Bayes, so the novelty lies mainly in this deployment construction rather than a new generalization principle. The full text provides proofs, a complete confidence budget, multiple controls, and failure cases, and demonstrates meaningful joint-edit guarantees on OLMoE and SmolLM2.

The limitations are that nonvacuous bounds for complete models are demonstrated only on extremely small decoders and declared finite distributions; the larger-model experiments mostly fix the backbone, BFMS is only a screening heuristic, and the cache advantage also depends on the specified quantizer. The repository, pinned versions, and reproduction artifacts are explicitly declared, but their execution and availability were not independently verified in this review.

primary_link.title: Behavioral Capacity Certificates for Quantized Language Models

papers.summary: Activation and key-value cache precision change what a quantized language model computes without altering its stored weights. Direct weight-code bounds, however, assign identical complexity to deployments that behave differently and charge separately for weight codes that behave identically. Behavioral Capacity Certificates (BCC) charge for behavior using the aggregate prior mass of complete implementations---weights, scales, activation and cache rules---that induce the same bounded loss. When q
papers.summary_zh: 量化部署的行為不只由權重決定，activation 與 KV cache 精度也會改變輸出；只計算權重碼長，既可能把不同部署視為同樣複雜，也無法獎勵行為相同的實作。本文提出 Behavioral Capacity Certificates（BCC），將產生相同有界損失的完整實作所占先驗機率加總，再用 Occam–KL／PAC–Bayes 界與獨立探測，計入驗證成本並判斷複雜度節省是否划算。實驗中的小型完整 decoder 在固定 Shakespeare 語料分布上，NLL 上界較壓縮編碼再收緊 0.51–1.30%；SmolLM2-1.7B 則在兩種 cache 設定共享的 1% 延續分歧風險門檻下，允許共同修改 32,768 個輸出頭座標，是 activation-cost 選法的 32 倍。這些結果提供可稽核的量化與剪枝選擇依據，但大型模型憑證主要限於固定主幹下的輸出頭，不能解讀為整個 LLM 的泛化保證；資料分布、解碼步數與數值後端改變仍須重新驗證。

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.3 and Appendix B: four signal families form 15 combination encoders; validation-selected late fusion reads closed-book and with-context passes, with AdamW training details and three-seed reporting.

Section 4.1 and Appendix A: three multi-hop training datasets and three held-out single-hop datasets; Qwen3.5-27B consensus labels discard 2.3% of Qwen examples, with 98% agreement on a 100-item blind human check.

Table 1 and Appendix D, Tables 6–7: Qwen in-domain AUROC is .839 closed-book and .932 with context; with-context baseline gains are significant, but Bayesian SE leads closed-book TriviaQA. Fusion gains over hidden-only are smaller than comparisons to external baselines.

Appendix E, Table 8: dropping the answer span changes with-context test AUROC from .932 to .919 and TriviaQA from .930 to .903; these predictive ablations leave substantial signal and are not causal circuit identification.
Appendix H, Tables 12–13: zero-shot evaluation on 3,000 questions with E5-retrieved context gives aggregate AUROC .891 on Qwen and .911 on Gemma, with some dataset-level losses on Qwen.

Appendices I and K, Tables 14 and 17: PGIR macro EM/F1 is .408/.484 at 3.56 generations on Qwen and .319/.397 at 4.63 on Gemma; probes/controllers are fitted separately for each backbone, and generation count is only a serving-cost proxy.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant white-box LLM correctness probing and adaptive RAG work. Searching early/late fusion of four established signal families is a useful incremental contribution, supported by extensive baselines, three-seed experiments, paired tests, real-retrieval transfer and a second independently fitted backbone. Evidence is strongest for short-answer QA and with-context detection; closed-book TriviaQA favors sampling, and modest span-ablation losses do not justify strong causal localization. Same-family judge labels, backbone-specific fitting, unmeasured activation-extraction/serving overhead and no explicit implementation-release link in the supplied text limit broader and deployment claims.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項白箱 LLM 正確性探測與自適應 RAG 研究高度相關。搜尋四類既有訊號的早期／晚期融合方式，是有用的漸進式貢獻，並有大量基準、三個種子的實驗、配對檢定、真實檢索情境的轉移，以及第二個獨立擬合的主幹模型支持。證據對短答案問答及有脈絡的偵測最為有力；在閉卷 TriviaQA 上，取樣方法較有優勢，而區段消融造成的損失幅度不大，不足以支持強烈的因果定位主張。

同系列裁判模型產生的標籤、各主幹模型專屬的擬合、尚未量測的活化值擷取／服務開銷，以及所提供文本缺少明確的實作釋出連結，都限制了更廣泛及部署層面的主張。

primary_link.title: Locating Answer-Correctness Signals in Frozen Large Language Models

papers.summary: Language models expose internal signals that predict whether an answer is correct, readable from a single forward pass of a frozen model without additional generations. Yet existing probes often commit to one signal family or layer and can be brittle under distribution shift; in retrieval-augmented settings, many specialized detectors instead target passage faithfulness, which can diverge from correctness when retrieved evidence is unhelpful or conflicting. We therefore ask where answer correctn
papers.summary_zh: LLM 的回答看似篤定，仍可能答錯；加入檢索內容後，忠於文章也不等於符合事實。本文提出 BEATRICE，從凍結模型產生答案的運算讀取 hidden states、token probabilities、residual streams 與 attention，訓練十五種訊號組合，再以驗證集挑選少量編碼器融合，分別估計無檢索與有脈絡回答的正確率。研究以六個問答資料集、Qwen3.5-9B 與 Gemma 4 檢驗；Qwen 的有脈絡域內 AUROC 為 0.932，真實檢索測試為 0.891。融合對部分域外資料有幫助，但無檢索 TriviaQA 仍由抽樣方法領先。下游 PGIR 依分數決定是否繼續檢索，Qwen 的整體平均 F1 達 0.484，高於 Vanilla RAG 的 0.451，平均需 3.56 次生成。這提供改善 RAG 信任判斷的具體做法，但研究主要涵蓋短答案問答，標籤依賴同系列模型裁判，兩個骨幹也各自訓練探針；移除答案區段的效應不能當作因果機制定位，額外特徵擷取成本仍需實際量測。

links.title: Lost in Conversation or Lost in Translation? Diagnosing Multi-Turn Degradation in RAG

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix A.1: 750 manually reviewed questions consist of 150 each from HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue 2/3/4-hop subsets; FULL, CONCAT, and SHARDED preserve a matched underlying question, with explicit information-preservation and leakage constraints.

Sections 4.1–4.3: ten assistants and seven retrieval methods plus a closed-book baseline; five simulations per question; normalized EM and token F1 with conversation-level BEST scoring and paired question-bootstrap confidence intervals.

Section 5.2, Table 2: retrieval-augmented mean FULL–SHARDED losses are 5.1 F1 points (11.7% relative) for HISTORY and 7.1 points (16.3%) for CURRENT; the strongest single-turn retriever, HippoRAG2, loses 6.8 and 9.9 points respectively.

Sections 5.3–5.4, Tables 3–4: BM25 loses 11.7 F1 points from FULL to CONCAT but recovers 5.2 points with multi-turn delivery; CURRENT cumulative supporting-passage recall averages 61.0 versus 56.7 under FULL despite worse answers. Cumulative recall unions multiple retrievals, so it is not a fixed-budget causal control.

Appendix B.4, Table 9: among 54,876 complete-support pairs (24.4% of eligible pairs), mean BEST F1 falls from 73.7 to 62.1, a gap of 11.6 points with paired 95% CI [9.9, 13.4]; distractors remain and the analysis conditions on complete retrieval in both settings.

Appendices B.1–B.3: consolidation is tested with three assistants; RECAP under CURRENT recovers 92–123% of the gap for HippoRAG, LightRAG, and ToG-2 but 7–39% for BM25, Dense, RAPTOR, and HippoRAG2. HISTORY unreliability grows from 13.4 to 19.7 points, using descriptive percentile estimates from five simulations.

Appendix B.5, Table 10: a three-assistant GPT-4o-mini semantic-judge check retains a mean HISTORY gap of 3.8 points versus 4.1 for token F1; gap differences have intervals including zero and condition-level correlations are 0.94 and 0.96 for HISTORY and CURRENT.

Reproducibility statement and Appendices D–E: model IDs, serving details, retrieval configurations, simulator/classifier/assistant/judge prompts, and HotpotQA construction prompts are described; the codebase and results are planned for release, and the other construction prompts are deferred to that repository.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to conversational LLMs, RAG, multi-hop reasoning, and agent evaluation. The main contribution is a useful extension and diagnosis of prior multi-turn evaluation, rather than a new retrieval algorithm: matched FULL/CONCAT/SHARDED conditions separate formulation sensitivity from delivery effects. Ten assistants, seven retrievers, 750 manually reviewed questions, five repetitions, paired question-level bootstrap intervals, complete-coverage comparisons, and semantic-judge checks provide substantial evidence that retrieval does not remove conversational degradation. Under history queries the mean loss is 5.1 F1 points (11.7% relative); the 11.6-point residual loss among complete-coverage pairs strengthens the synthesis-failure interpretation. However, those observational contrasts do not causally isolate preprocessing, distractors, or evidence integration. The corpus comprises three English benchmark families split into five subsets, conversations are simulated, BEST scoring favors repeated answer opportunities, and five-run percentile estimates are noisy. Consolidation is tested on three assistants, with gains concentrated in specific retriever families; learned conversational query rewriting is not compared. Detailed configurations and several prompts aid reproduction, but code, results, and the remaining construction prompts are only promised for release.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本研究高度切合對話式 LLM、RAG、多跳推理與代理評估。主要貢獻是延伸既有多輪評估並提供有用的失敗診斷，而非提出新的檢索演算法：配對的 FULL／CONCAT／SHARDED 條件區分問題改寫敏感性與分輪傳遞效應。十個助理模型、七種檢索器、750 道人工檢查題目、每題五次重複、以題目為單位的配對 bootstrap 信賴區間、完整證據涵蓋比較及語意評審檢查，提供相當充分的證據，顯示檢索無法消除對話退化。使用歷史查詢時，平均下降 5.1 個 F1 百分點，相對降幅為 11.7%；完整涵蓋支持段落的配對仍下降 11.6 點，也強化了證據整合失敗的解釋。不過，這些觀察性比較無法以因果方式分離前處理、干擾段落或證據整合的影響。語料來自三個英文基準家族、劃分為五個子集，對話由模擬產生；BEST 評分有利於多次作答機會，而五次執行估計的百分位數仍有較大雜訊。資訊彙整介入只在三個助理模型上測試，成效集中於特定檢索器家族，也未比較經學習的對話查詢改寫。詳細設定與部分提示有助於重現，但程式碼、結果及其餘題目拆分提示仍只是承諾發布。

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and its graph-based variant (GraphRAG) have become the dominant approaches for grounding LLM responses in external evidence, yet both are evaluated almost exclusively on single-turn, fully specified queries. We systematically investigate this evaluation mismatch through a large-scale simulation study. Buil
papers.summary_zh: 單輪 RAG 評分能否代表真實對話？本文將三個多跳問答基準的 750 道題目拆成逐步揭露線索的對話，人工檢查資訊保真性，再比較原題、一次串接所有線索與分輪提供三種條件。研究涵蓋十個 LLM、七種檢索器及閉卷基準，以每題五次模擬、配對信賴區間與語意評審交叉檢查。使用完整使用者歷史作為查詢時，平均 F1 下降 5.1 個百分點，相對降幅為 11.7%；五次模擬的高低百分位差則增加 47%。關鍵診斷是問題改寫會改變檢索結果，而找齊證據也不保證能跨輪整合：兩種條件皆取回全部支持段落的配對，仍有 11.6 點落差。重述舊線索可大幅修復部分先擷取實體或關鍵字的檢索器，但並非通用解方。限制包括英文合成對話、有限題目與語料、取最佳答案的評分方式，以及只在三個助理模型上測試彙整介入；觀察性比較也未完全排除干擾段落等因素，程式碼與完整結果尚待公開。實務價值在於提醒開發者：除了單輪準確率，也應測量對話改寫、證據保留與跨次執行穩定性，不能只靠增加檢索涵蓋率判定系統可靠。

links.title: Visual sensitivity is not claim retractability: persistence-aware credit assignment for multimodal reinforcement learning

evidence: Sections 4.1–4.4, Eqs. (3)–(7): EFS uses token-distribution KL, persistence uses a signed token log-likelihood change corrected against same-rollout residual tokens, and PACG attenuates only positive credit on routed direct visual claims.

Section 5.2, Table 1, and Appendix F.3, Table 17: Qwen2.5-VL-7B averages are 58.1±0.40 for DAPO versus 59.9±0.52 with PACG, and 59.8±0.40 for VPPO versus 60.9±0.47; reported Welch p-values are 0.010 and 0.038 with three seeds per group.
Section 5.3, Table 3: removing direct-claim routing lowers the nine-benchmark average to 38.0; removing residual correction or positive-only gating gives 59.0 and 59.3 versus 59.9 for full PACG.

Section 5.4, Table 5, and Appendices C.1–C.3/E.2, Table 12: mechanisms score 8,000 fixed Base trajectories from 2,000 questions using seed-0 checkpoints; PACG changes unsupported persistence by −0.0151 for DAPO and −0.0819 for VPPO, with question-clustered confidence intervals excluding zero.

Appendices D.1/D.5 and E.5, Tables 7/9/14: direct-claim F1 is 0.88 against human consensus; free-generation audits retain substantial visual content; three coarse image interventions yield negative PACG-minus-DAPO unsupported-persistence effects.
Appendix C.4 and Section 5.2, Table 2: HallusionBench uses one checkpoint per model and Kimi-K3 judgments; qAcc changes from 35.32 to 35.54 for DAPO and from 35.18 to 36.04 for VPPO.

Appendix H, Table 19, and Appendix J: step time rises from 464.3 to 730.4 seconds, with no added inference computation; limitations explicitly include fixed-reference scope, imperfect annotation, non-claim-localized corruption, and dependence on frozen evaluation artifacts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to multimodal reasoning, hallucination, and RL credit assignment. The distinction between unsigned visual sensitivity and residual-calibrated claim persistence motivates a useful, moderately novel positive-credit gate. Matched 7B results improve nine-benchmark means by 1.8 points for DAPO and 1.1 for VPPO across three seeds, with component ablations, human annotation audits, corruption controls, and larger/newer Qwen evaluations providing substantial support. The strongest mechanistic evidence nevertheless comes from one training seed scoring fixed Base traces; teacher-forced persistence under coarse image corruption is not a factuality test or proof of the proposed causal explanation. HallusionBench gains are modest and LLM-judged, transfer remains within Qwen models and one training corpus, and training costs rise 57.3%. Detailed recipes and prompts help reproduction, but the supplied text does not establish availability of the frozen reference artifacts or code.

papers.summary_zh: 多模態 RL 即使答對最後一題，也可能把獎勵分配給沒有影像支持的中間主張。本文區分影像干預引起的分布變化 EFS，與同一主張在證據受損後是否降低機率的「可撤回性」。PACG 以凍結的 router 找出直接視覺主張，對固定回應進行原圖與遮蔽圖的 teacher forcing，再扣除同回應其他 token 的共同漂移；只降低過度持續主張的正向 credit，不使用支持與否標籤，也不增加推論成本。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的九項基準、三個訓練種子上，DAPO 平均準確率由 58.1% 升至 59.9%，VPPO 由 59.8% 升至 60.9%；較大模型、新一代骨幹與 HallusionBench 亦有改善。消融、人工標註稽核與不同影像干預補強證據，但主要機制分析只有單一種子與固定 Base 回應，遮蔽亦非精準移除每個主張的證據，因此不能把可撤回性當成真實性的保證。訓練每步耗時增加 57.3%，且重現需要相同的凍結評估資料。對關心視覺推理、幻覺與 RL credit assignment 的讀者，重點是區分「依賴影像」與「能撤回無支持主張」。

links.title: The Default Trap: Rethinking Plan Evaluation in Tool-Using LLM Agents

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3, Eqs. 1–4, Appendix B.1: matched A/B priority spans and shared no-plan inputs define distinct directional and removal contrasts; eight endpoint categories remain in denominators. Customer-cluster bootstrap uses 10,000 initial-study or 5,000 follow-up resamples; intervals are pointwise and not multiplicity-corrected.

Sections 4.1 and 5.1, Tables 1 and 3: 160 selected tasks and two executors produce 3,200 windows. Retail/Luna A-selection probabilities are 90.89% with A, 84.90% without a plan, and 0.26% with B, yielding 90.63 percentage-point directional control versus 5.99-point A-plan removal contrast.

Sections 4.3 and 6.1, Appendix D.2, Table 5: 40 tasks crossed with two orders, three plan conditions, three executors, and three repeats yield 2,160 windows. Reversal changes no-plan A selection by 63.3–98.3 points; directional control remains 96.7–100.0 points in either order. Ninety-seven YIELD outcomes remain included.

Sections 6.2–6.3, Table 2, Appendices D.4–D.5: 1,080 full-task episodes over 40 selected tasks show success changes from -19.4 to +8.3 points. All Retail/Airline plan-versus-none success intervals include or touch zero. Airline/Gemini executor-token increases are 43.1 thousand [2.8, 101.1] and 47.7 thousand [7.7, 105.2] with A/B plans.

Section 6.4 and Appendix E, Tables 8–10: 3,240 component windows contrast full plans, isolated priority sentences, neutral guidance, and no plan; Retail/Mini full-minus-sentence B-direction control is -10.0 points [-20.0, -1.7], while neutral guidance changes Airline/Mini A selection by 26.7 [8.3, 46.7] points.

Appendices A.2–A.3 and D.1–D.3: plans remain visible in developer messages; models are gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.4-mini, and gemini-3.8-flash. Some selected states appeared in engineering tests. Mini prepares/reviews plans, simulates users, and judges required natural-language assertions, allowing correlated errors.

Reproducibility statement, Appendices B.4 and D.6, Table 7: source/task manifests, result CSVs, frozen requests and raw trajectories are reported; model-based endpoint audits cover 145 component and 78 order windows, but zero full-task local endpoints. Review agreement is explicitly distinguished from human ground truth.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Very strong relevance to tool-using LLM agents, prompting, planning, and evaluation. The main contribution is a useful measurement protocol and controlled empirical demonstration, rather than a deep theoretical result: its accounting identity is elementary, but paired priorities, exhaustive outcome categories, list-order manipulation, component controls, and joint success/cost reporting make the default-baseline confound concrete. The 3,200-window initial study and 2,160-window order intervention convincingly support local priority responsiveness and presentation-sensitive defaults within selected states. Customer-cluster bootstraps, repeated inputs, alternate weighting, explicit recovery records, and unusually careful distinctions between control, plan structure, and utility strengthen rigor. The 1,080 full-task episodes do not establish completion benefits: all Retail/Airline success intervals include or touch zero, and AgentDojo represents four fixed worlds. Generalization is limited by selected two-read tasks, reused/previously tested cases, persistent developer-channel plans, three proprietary executors, and only a few repetitions. Mini contributes plan preparation, simulation, assertions, and model-based audits, permitting correlated errors; full-task local endpoints were not independently audited. Detailed settings, frozen-source hashes, tabular results, and reported artifact contents support reproducibility, but actual artifact accessibility and raw records were not independently verified from this supplied text. All 74,636 supplied source characters were read, including appendices and references; complete source status and confidence are retained.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本研究與使用工具的 LLM 代理、提示、規劃及評估高度相關。主要貢獻是實用的量測流程與受控實證展示，而非深層理論成果：其恆等式本身簡單，但成對優先順序、涵蓋所有結果的分類、清單順序操弄、組成控制，以及共同報告成功率與成本，使預設基準造成的混淆具體可見。初始研究的 3,200 個決策視窗與順序介入的 2,160 個視窗，有力支持所選狀態中的局部優先順序反應，以及預設行為對呈現方式的敏感性。以顧客為叢集的 bootstrap、相同輸入重複執行、替代權重、明確的復原紀錄，以及仔細區分控制能力、計畫結構與實用價值，提升研究嚴謹度。1,080 次完整任務執行尚未證明完成率獲益：Retail/Airline 的成功率差異區間均包含或接觸零，AgentDojo 則只代表四個固定世界。泛化受到所選雙讀取任務、重用或先前測試過的案例、持續可見的 developer 訊息計畫、三個專有模型及少量重複次數限制。Mini 同時參與計畫準備、模擬、文字斷言與模型稽核，可能產生相關錯誤；完整任務的局部端點未另行稽核。詳細設定、凍結來源雜湊、表格結果及所述研究產物內容有助重現，但未從供應文字之外獨立確認產物可存取性與原始紀錄。已讀完全部 74,636 個來源字元，包含附錄與參考文獻，並保留完整來源狀態與信心係數。

papers.summary_zh:
刪除計畫後行為變化很小，不一定表示 LLM 代理不理會計畫：原先的優先順序可能剛好符合預設行為。本文以僅修改一段優先指示的 A、B 計畫，搭配共同的無計畫條件，分別量測優先順序控制、刪除效果與任務效益，並保留錯誤、停止及其他讀取結果。

在 160 個所選任務、3,200 個決策視窗中，切換優先順序的效果達 67.36–99.11 個百分點。另有 2,160 個視窗反轉帳戶清單順序，讓預設目標選擇改變 63.3–98.3 個百分點，但優先指示的控制仍強。組成實驗顯示，單句指示也能產生強烈反應，無法據此歸功於多步驟計畫結構。

links.title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3: curate 11,897 English offline-compatible skills; build tasks through fit, executable validity, and reviewer quality gates; collect successful trajectories for SFT. Appendix F Tables 7–9 report 6,772 tasks from 3,494 skills and 19,070 successful trajectories.

Section 4.2, Table 1: Qwen3.5-9B rises from 41.3 to 59.5 on SkillGym, 65.7±1.1 to 74.7±1.2 on SkillEval, 14.8±3.5 to 22.4±4.2 on SkillsBench, and 14.8 to 49.6 SU; MiniCPM5-2B falls from 10.8±2.7 to 6.1±0.8 on SkillsBench. Only SkillEval and SkillsBench have three-run statistics.
Section 4.2, Figure 3: held-out-skill success increases 42.5%→62.0%; the skill-access benefit grows from 7.5 to 16.5 percentage points, while SFT also improves the no-skill condition by 9.2 points.

Sections 5.1–5.2, Figures 4–5: relevant-skill triggering increases 28.0→96.0, compliance 32.5→49.0, and boundary 57.7→64.0; SkillsBench gains concentrate on reference documentation rather than domain methods, shipped tools, or modifying existing systems.

Section 5.3, Table 2: token-matched review-approved data beats validated-only data, but the four-profile mix is no better than procedural-only; reduced-data models underperform full SkillGym and suffer repeated-reasoning output exhaustion on SkillEval.

Section 5.4, Table 3: Kimi-K3 success increases 60.5%→68.8% with skills; 52 tasks succeed only with skills and 19 only without (reported exact McNemar p≈10^-4). Appendix G describes bootstrap intervals and regression controls, with broad structure-effect intervals.

Appendix F Tables 8–9: the 6,772 total comprises 5,191 passed and 1,581 unresolved-review tasks, explicitly excludes separate partial-order construction runs, and trajectory counts enumerate MiniSwe-Agent, AgentFly, and Terminus-2 but not OpenCode. Appendix H estimates $5.7k–8.4k excluding environment building, annotation, and evaluation, with reviewer costs assumed because transcripts were not stored.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant skill-use agent training with a substantial verifiable environment and trajectory resource. The skill-first builder/reviewer design is a useful extension of existing skill-synthesis approaches, supported by six backbones, four benchmarks, held-out skills, access ablations, and token-matched data comparisons. Gains largely concern consulting skills; method/tool-centric SkillsBench tasks do not improve, the 2B model regresses there, and four-profile training does not beat procedural-only training. Causal attribution and reproducibility are limited by unmatched reported SKT results, partly single-run evaluation, reduced-data ablations below the base model, and dataset accounting inconsistencies: Appendix F includes unresolved-review tasks, excludes partial-order runs from its task counts, and lists only three of the four claimed collection harnesses. Complete supplied HTML text including appendices was read; linked code/data availability is claimed in the paper but was not independently verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale_en: Highly relevant skill-use agent training with a substantial verifiable environment and trajectory resource. The skill-first builder/reviewer design is a useful extension of existing skill-synthesis approaches, supported by six backbones, four benchmarks, held-out skills, access ablations, and token-matched data comparisons. Gains largely concern consulting skills; method/tool-centric SkillsBench tasks do not improve, the 2B model regresses there, and four-profile training does not beat procedural-only training. Causal attribution and reproducibility are limited by unmatched reported SKT results, partly single-run evaluation, reduced-data ablations below the base model, and dataset accounting inconsistencies: Appendix F includes unresolved-review tasks, excludes partial-order runs from its task counts, and lists only three of the four claimed collection harnesses. Complete supplied HTML text including appendices was read; linked code/data availability is claimed in the paper but was not independently verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項技能使用代理訓練研究高度相關，並提供規模可觀的可驗證環境及軌跡資源。以技能為優先的 builder／reviewer 設計，是既有技能合成方法的有用延伸，並獲得六個主幹模型、四個基準、保留技能、存取消融，以及詞元數匹配的資料比較支持。改善主要在於查閱技能；SkillsBench 中以方法／工具為核心的任務沒有進步，2B 模型在這些任務反而退步，而四種任務型態的訓練也未勝過僅用流程型任務的訓練。

因果歸因與可重現性受到幾項因素限制：所引用的 SKT 結果未匹配實驗條件、部分評估僅執行一次、減少資料的消融結果低於基礎模型，以及資料集計數不一致。附錄 F 納入審查尚未解決的任務，任務計數排除了偏序建構的執行，且所聲稱的四種軌跡收集執行框架只列出三種。已閱讀所提供的完整 HTML 文本，包括附錄；論文宣稱連結中的程式碼／資料可取得，但未經獨立查證。

primary_link.title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation

papers.summary: Skills equip LLM agents with professional knowledge and guidance to complete long-horizon and complex tasks. Although skills have been widely adopted in recent agent paradigms and harnesses, how to synthesize reliable training data and how to train agents for skill use remain underexplored. In this work, we propose SkillGym, an automatic pipeline to build verifiable environments, collect trajectories, and train skill-use agents. SkillGym first crawls a large volume of skills from the internet, t
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理即使拿到技能文件，也未必會主動閱讀或正確執行。SkillGym 從社群技能建立可離線重現的任務環境，以 builder–reviewer 流程檢查初始狀態失敗、參考解答成功，以及驗證器是否過嚴、過鬆或洩漏答案，再收集成功軌跡進行 SFT。研究提供約 6,800 個任務與 19,000 條成功軌跡，測試六個不同規模模型與四套基準。Qwen3.5-9B 在 SkillGym 的成功率由 41.3% 升至 59.5%，未見技能子集由 42.5% 升至 62.0%；相關技能的讀取率則由 28% 升至 96%。這顯示訓練能學會尋找並利用外部知識，但不能等同掌握所有工作流程：SkillsBench 中需要領域方法或附帶工具的任務沒有改善，2B 模型也出現退步。消融支持品質審查的價值，卻未證明混合四種任務結構優於單一流程任務。另須注意部分評估僅跑一次，附錄任務總數包含審查未解決項目，且未納入另行建立的部分順序任務。這份研究適合關注代理訓練資料與技能採用的人，核心啟示是先改善技能查閱行為，再針對實際方法執行補強證據。

llm_evaluation.rationale: 高度切合 LLM agents、跨系統記憶、multimodal reasoning 與效率需求。創新在於共同演化文字與視覺證據、分離的小型記憶控制／樹狀整理模型，以及可跨 harness 重用的經驗庫，較屬有實證的系統整合。完整來源提供 11 個基準、兩種 harness、跨 backbone 轉移與多項消融；單次解題及凍結經驗庫控制有助排除額外重試的主結果混淆。但未報重複試驗或不確定區間，跨 harness 擴充沒有等量同 harness 新資料控制，題內控制相對 No Memory 的收益含額外嘗試；部分基準退步。訓練超參數與切分詳述，資源連結僅屬文內宣告，尚未獨立驗證可用性。
llm_evaluation.rationale_en:
Highly aligned with LLM agents, cross-system memory, multimodal reasoning, and efficiency needs. The innovations are the co-evolution of textual and visual evidence, separate small models for memory control and tree-structured organization, and an experience repository reusable across harnesses. This is primarily an empirically supported systems integration.

The complete source provides 11 benchmarks, two harnesses, cross-backbone transfer, and multiple ablations. Single-attempt problem solving and frozen-experience-repository controls help rule out extra retries as a confound in the main results. However, repeated trials or uncertainty intervals are not reported; cross-harness expansion lacks a control using an equal amount of new same-harness data; the gains of within-problem controls over No Memory include additional attempts; and performance declines on some benchmarks.

Training hyperparameters and splits are described in detail. Resource links are only stated in the text, and their availability has not been independently verified.

primary_link.title: EpiCon: Collective Agent Learning through Co-Evolving Multimodal Memory

papers.summary: Agents can learn from past executions, but enabling different agents to reuse and build on one another's experience remains challenging. We introduce EpiCon, a shared multimodal memory framework for agent collective learning without updating host model parameters. EpiCon links question-level memory evolution to a persistent experience bank through two independently trained 2B models: a memory controller and a tree self-organizer. The controller jointly refines textual guidance and visual evidenc
papers.summary_zh: 代理累積的解題經驗，如何讓不同模型與執行框架共同受益？EpiCon 將題內記憶更新與跨題經驗庫連接起來，以兩個獨立訓練的 2B 模型分別修訂文字指引及影像裁切證據、控制視覺注入，再用樹狀結構整理與檢索可重用規則，無須更新主模型參數。研究以兩種 harness、不同 backbone，在文件理解、圖像轉程式、視覺數學與一般視覺推理共 11 個基準、4,538 題測試。主比較固定每題單次解題且凍結經驗庫；小型記憶模型相對 No Memory 的平均分數提高 1.7–4.9 分，相對大型記憶模型的記憶操作時間降低約 67–74%。跨 backbone 與 harness 重用也帶來平均改善，顯示經驗可成為共享資源。但這不是所有任務都進步：部分基準退步，跨系統擴充也混合了新增資料與不同貢獻者的效果，缺少等量資料控制及不確定區間。題內記憶消融最多嘗試五次，不能把相對單次基線的收益全歸因於記憶。對建構可持續學習的多模態代理很有參考價值，實作前仍需衡量建庫成本、檢索品質與實際工作分布。

evidence: Sections 2.1–2.3 and 3: evaluate 13 predictive, attention and activation signals plus 234 rank-pair ensembles over 4,705,657 greedy NLA explanations; four released model/verbalizer pairs cover 14 dataset-model cells, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash labels each explanation without the original transcript.

Section 2.3 and Appendix E: candidate choice, rank normalization and orientation are refitted within five whole-transcript folds; dataset-shared folds align transcripts across models, and ensemble-minus-single uncertainty uses paired 95% bootstraps over whole transcripts.

Sections 4.3 and 4.5, Table 2 and Appendix K/Table 9: the learned chat-structure baseline exceeds the best individual signal in pooled AUROC in 12/14 cells and the selected ensemble in precision in 11/14 cells at one explanation and 12/14 at eight; across ten sparse cells at budget eight, precision is 0.491 versus 0.392 for the ensemble and 0.191 for random selection.

Section 4.5: at a 5% position budget, structure retains 0.995, 0.958 and 1.000 of exhaustive-verbalization success on OpenPromptInjection, taboo organisms and Tensor Trust, respectively, versus 0.813 on Liars’ Bench. Success means at least one on-task explanation, not attack detection; requiring three explanations lowers the first three values to 0.785, 0.568 and 0.998.

Section 4.2 and Appendix H/Table 5: unchanged verbalizers recover the organism’s secret at approximately 14–27% of positions across twelve adapters; on identical shared prompt text own-word recovery is 12–25% while another organism’s word is at most 2.8%. The secret itself appears in only 3 of 384 rendered transcripts.

Appendices C and G: dataset-specific judge questions measure relevance; Tensor Trust can label normal access-code protection on-task, and its successful-attack versus other-transcript lift is negative across all four models. For Llama on Liars’ Bench, 85.5% of on-task positions are in instructed-deception examples and 67.5% are in system messages.

Appendix D: label-free leave-one-model-out case-macro AUROCs average 0.802, 0.599, 0.470 and 0.647 across the four datasets; the taboo ensemble is 0.075 below its transferred single-signal comparator, and Liars’ Bench has only one source model for each holdout.

Appendix L/Tables 10–12: model-best ensembles improve held-out case-macro AUROC in all 14 cells, but one of 14 paired confidence intervals includes zero; dataset-shared held-out case-macro AUROC is 0.7613, 0.5669, 0.5407 and 0.7752, revealing weaker within-transcript discrimination on Tensor Trust and Liars’ Bench.

Section 5 and Reproducibility statement: evaluation uses one judge and one verbalizer layer per model on relatively short transcripts, with no long-agent-transcript validation or human review. Authors link github.com/federicotorrielli/nla-token-selector for code/data/results and state up to 4xB200 for the largest model; availability was not independently checked.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant empirical work on LLM interpretability, prompt-injection auditing and concealed knowledge. Its main contribution is a systematic position-selection study and a useful structural baseline rather than a new autoencoder: exhaustive verbalization exposes how AUROC can hide failure at small budgets, while whole-transcript cross-validation, synchronized cross-model folds, bootstrap comparisons, shuffled/random controls and within-role analyses strengthen the comparison. The evidence supports cheaper retrieval of judge-relevant explanations, not reliable threat detection or faithful explanation of model behavior. A single unvalidated judge, benign-protection false positives on Tensor Trust, substantial system-message concentration, only one verbalizer layer per model and weak transfer for some datasets materially limit the safety and generalization claims. The twelve-adapter secret-word control provides more specific evidence against mere text copying. Code, generated data and results are claimed available, with detailed equations/prompts, but the repository was not independently fetched or reproduced and the largest run requires up to four B200 GPUs.

The evidence supports cheaper retrieval of judge-relevant explanations, not reliable threat detection or faithful explanation of model behavior. A single unvalidated judge, benign-protection false positives on Tensor Trust, substantial system-message concentration, only one verbalizer layer per model and weak transfer for some datasets materially limit the safety and generalization claims. The twelve-adapter secret-word control provides more specific evidence against mere text copying. Code, generated data and results are claimed available, with detailed equations/prompts, but the repository was not independently fetched or reproduced and the largest run requires up to four B200 GPUs.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項實證研究與 LLM 可解釋性、提示注入稽核及隱藏知識高度相關。主要貢獻是系統性的位置選擇研究與實用的結構性基線，而非新的自編碼器：窮舉式文字化揭示 AUROC 如何掩蓋小預算下的失敗；以完整對話紀錄為單位的交叉驗證、跨模型同步的資料折分、bootstrap 比較、打亂／隨機對照及角色內分析，則強化了比較的可信度。

證據支持以較低成本檢索與評判器相關的解釋，並未證明能可靠偵測威脅或忠實解釋模型行為。僅有一個未經驗證的評判器、Tensor Trust 上對良性保護行為的誤判、大量結果集中於系統訊息、每個模型只採用一層 verbalizer，以及部分資料集的轉移效果不佳，都實質限制了安全性與泛化主張。十二個 adapter 的秘密詞控制實驗，提供了更具體的證據，反駁結果只是複製文字的解釋。

作者宣稱程式碼、生成資料與結果皆已公開，並提供詳細方程式與提示；但並未獨立取得儲存庫或重現結果，且最大規模的執行需要多達四張 B200 GPU。

primary_link.title: Selecting The Most Informative Tokens in Natural Language Autoencoders

papers.summary: Natural language autoencoders translate a language model's internal activations into readable explanations. Explaining every token position is costly. Which positions should an auditor inspect to understand a potential threat? We study this question across $4.7$ million explanations on prompt injection and concealment. We compare signals from model computation with a ranker trained only on chat structure. Chat structure usually selects more relevant explanations than the computational signals, w
papers.summary_zh: Natural Language Autoencoders 能把 LLM 內部活化轉成文字，但逐一解釋所有 token 成本很高。本文研究稽核提示注入與隱瞞行為時，應優先解釋哪些位置。作者在四種模型、四個資料集產生約 471 萬則解釋，比較 13 種運算訊號、234 種雙訊號組合，以及只依對話角色、區段與位置訓練的 logistic regression。以完整對話為單位進行五折驗證後，對話結構在多數條件比運算訊號更有效；選取 5% 位置，在三個資料集保留至少 95.8% 的完整解釋相對成功率，但 Liars’ Bench 僅為 81.3%。成功只代表至少取得一則被評為相關的解釋，不能當成威脅偵測準確率。另一實驗讓原有 verbalizer 讀取微調模型，在相同提示下恢復各模型刻意隱瞞的不同詞，支持活化確實帶有文字表面以外的資訊。限制包括單一評審模型、缺乏人工標註驗證、每個模型僅測一層，以及未測長篇代理對話；Tensor Trust 的評分也會接受正常保護密碼的解釋。價值在於降低稽核取樣成本，仍須另行確認解釋內容與安全結論。

evidence: Section 3, Equations (1)–(2) and Algorithm 1: top-q frontier votes drive development-case ownership, globally solved cases are removed, and branch guidance is periodically revised; deployment selects one development-best head before execution.
Section 4.1: 250/200 development/test math cases, 30/58 Terminal-Bench tasks, and 50/250 SWE-bench Lite tasks; B=2, N=20, q=5 and ownership margin 2.
Table 1: routed versus Meta-Harness held-out scores are 62.0 versus 46.0 and 30.5 versus 29.0 on the two math settings, 50.0 versus 44.8 on Terminal-Bench, and 66.0 versus 63.6 on SWE-bench Lite.

Tables 2–3 and Appendix D.2, Table 6: routing trails the stronger individual head in two settings; Math–Gemini component scores are 51.0 with neither adaptation, 50.0 with guidance alone, 54.0 with pruning alone and 62.0 with both; extra router context has mixed benefits.

Appendix A, Table 5 and Section 5: full-run total tokens for ours versus Meta-Harness are 172.90/79.92 million on Math–Sonnet, 4001.39/2366.80 million on Terminal-Bench and 2951.48/1907.17 million on SWE; unequal compute and limited repeated evaluations constrain efficiency and reliability conclusions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant agent, coding, retrieval and reasoning methodology: adaptive case ownership and branch-local proposal guidance produce complementary harnesses, deployed with development-trained routing. The four held-out benchmark/model settings, component factorial, router ablations, and explicit separation of test-best analysis support the approach. However, two-branch search uses substantially more total tokens than Meta-Harness, component ablations are confined to Math–Gemini, repeated-run uncertainty is limited, and the Sonnet and SWE improvements are small. Detailed algorithms, splits, prompts and token accounting aid reproduction, but the supplied full text does not establish release of its search code, generated harnesses, or exact split artifacts. Novelty is principally the combination of adaptive search objectives and local guidance rather than a new base-model learning method.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項方法與代理、程式設計、檢索及推理直接相關：自適應的案例歸屬與分支內的提案引導，產生互補的 harness，並搭配在開發資料上訓練的路由器部署。四組保留測試的基準／模型設定、元件因子實驗、路由器消融，以及明確分開呈現的測試集最佳結果分析，都支持此方法。

然而，雙分支搜尋使用的總 token 數明顯多於 Meta-Harness，元件消融僅限於 Math–Gemini，重複執行的不確定性資訊有限，而且 Sonnet 與 SWE 的改善幅度小。

詳細的演算法、資料切分、提示及 token 用量核算有助重現，但所提供的全文未能確認其搜尋程式碼、生成的 harness 或確切的資料切分產物已釋出。新穎性主要在於結合自適應搜尋目標與局部引導，而非新的基礎模型學習方法。

primary_link.title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization

papers.summary: Harness optimization provides a practical setting for recursive self-improvement (RSI), where agent-generated modifications inform subsequent changes through execution feedback. Recent work such as Meta-Harness implements this process through iterative code generation and evaluation, but retains a fixed development set and proposal policy. These constraints channel evolution along a single search trajectory, increasing the risk of converging to a local optimum. We make the improvement process it
papers.summary_zh: 固定開發集與固定提案指引，可能讓 agent harness 搜尋忽略總分較低、卻能解決不同問題的候選。本文把搜尋拆成兩個分支，依各分支前五名 harness 的解題覆蓋率分配開發案例，移除所有領先候選皆能解決的題目，再定期從分支紀錄修訂提案指引。部署時以開發資料挑選各分支代表，透過 GEPA 調整 router，針對新問題先選一個 harness 執行。四組保留測試中，Math–Gemini 正確率由 Meta-Harness 的46%升至62%，Terminal-Bench 完成率由44.8%升至50%，SWE-bench Lite 則由63.6%升至66%；另一組數學模型提升較小。消融顯示案例分配與指引更新搭配效果最佳，但只在一組數學設定檢驗。方法的價值在於讓搜尋目標本身適應不同能力，並避免靠測試答案選專家；限制是總 token 用量明顯較高、重複實驗不足，router 在兩組設定仍略遜最佳單一分支，尚不能據此主張相同運算成本下穩定勝出。

links.title: Tracing the Evidence: Faithful Token Attribution Through Vision-Language Reasoning

evidence: Sections 4.1–4.3, Appendix C and Algorithm 1: modality-wise mean subtraction constructs positive pairwise attribution weights; the strictly upper-triangular graph permits exact finite Katz path aggregation; three additional masking passes determine two-player Shapley modality weights. Appendix D retains original scores when required calibration contributions or attribution sums are nonpositive.

Section 5 and Table 1: Qwen3-VL-8B is evaluated against seven attribution baselines on MMStar, MathVista, MMMU, MMMU-Pro, MathVerse and VisualPuzzles; the reported joint RISE insertion/deletion improvements over per-benchmark best baselines are 7.1% and 18.0% respectively.

Table 2: removing multi-hop aggregation reduces joint insertion from 0.610 to 0.470 and raises deletion from 0.187 to 0.273; centering and calibration each also improve the joint metrics, while calibration leaves image-only rankings unchanged.

Appendices F–G: the same greedy-generated trace, capped at 2,048 output tokens, is frozen for every method; image regions are replaced with blurred pixels and text with padding over at most 20 groups. Scores use normalized teacher-forced trace likelihood, with monotonicized/clipped RISE and MAS curves; token-level ground-truth evidence labels are unavailable.

Appendix H.3, Tables 7–9: additional tests cover Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3.5-2B/8B on three benchmarks. Gains are broad but not universal: InternVL3.5-8B VisualPuzzles image RISE insertion is 0.617 versus Attention Rollout 0.622, and MMStar joint deletion is 0.103 versus FlashTrace 0.101.

Table 4 and Appendix F.1: attribution-weighted GRPO on Qwen3-VL-4B raises the eight-benchmark mean from 63.99 to 65.27; MathVista and MMMU-Pro slightly decline. Training uses eight rollouts, two epochs, and weight 1.5 for the top 40% response tokens, with no repeated-run uncertainty reported.

Appendix A and Appendix I: multi-image, long-context and longer-horizon agentic extensions remain future work; case studies include ties and failures where relevant visual regions are missed. The abstract supplies a project-page URL, while algorithm and experimental details are provided in the text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LVLM reasoning/interpretability methodology: VTrace combines modality-centered token interactions, exact all-path aggregation in its chosen attribution graph, and intervention-based two-modality Shapley calibration. Six-benchmark comparisons with seven baselines, component ablations, multiple model families/scales, correct/incorrect splits, and preliminary attribution-weighted GRPO provide substantial evidence. The contribution is a useful synthesis and multimodal adaptation rather than a new causal identification principle: fixed-trace likelihood under perturbation is a faithfulness proxy, and exact graph-path summation does not establish the true neural causal mechanism. Cross-model improvements have exceptions; training gains lack repeated-run uncertainty and are not uniform across benchmarks. Pseudocode, generation settings, masking protocol and hardware aid reproduction, but the supplied text does not establish a released implementation and omits several training configuration details. Multi-image, long-context and agentic settings remain untested.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項 LVLM 推理／可解釋性方法高度相關：VTrace 結合以模態為中心的 token 互動、在其選定歸因圖中精確彙總所有路徑，以及透過干預進行的雙模態 Shapley 校準。六個基準上與七個基線的比較、元件消融、多個模型家族與規模、正確／錯誤結果切分，以及初步的歸因加權 GRPO，提供了相當充分的證據。

其貢獻是實用的整合與多模態調整，而非新的因果識別原理：擾動下固定軌跡的概似是忠實度的代理指標，精確加總圖中路徑也不能確立真正的神經因果機制。跨模型的改善存在例外；訓練收益缺少重複執行的不確定性資訊，也不是在每個基準上都一致。

虛擬碼、生成設定、遮罩流程與硬體資訊有助重現，但所提供的文字未能確認已有釋出的實作，並省略數項訓練設定細節。多影像、長上下文及代理情境仍未測試。

primary_link.title: Tracing the Evidence: Faithful Token Attribution Through Vision-Language Reasoning

papers.summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet the visual and textual evidence supporting the generated responses remains difficult to identify. Faithful token attribution explains an LVLM's response by assigning scores that rank image and prompt tokens by how much the model relies on them, such that removing higher-ranked tokens causes the likelihood of the generated response to drop more rapidly. However, existing token-attribution methods have been developed m
papers.summary_zh: LVLM 產生正確答案時，仍不容易判斷它真正依賴哪些圖像區塊與文字。VTrace 指出，既有歸因方法容易讓文字壓過視覺證據，也會漏掉經由多個中間推理步驟傳遞的貢獻。方法先扣除各模態的平均 value 表示，建立 token 兩兩歸因矩陣，再以 Katz 閉式運算彙整直接與間接路徑，最後根據遮蔽模態後的回應機率變化，以 Shapley 分配校準圖像與文字總分。作者在六個視覺推理基準比較七種方法；Qwen3-VL-8B 的 joint 評估中，平均 RISE insertion AUC 相對各基準最佳基線提高 7.1%，deletion AUC 降低 18.0%。消融顯示移除 multi-hop 的退步最大；Qwen3-VL-4B 加入歸因引導的 GRPO 後，八項基準平均由 63.99 升至 65.27，但並非每項都進步。限制是評估依賴固定生成軌跡的擾動機率，不能直接證明真實因果推理路徑；亦未提供多次訓練的變異估計，且多圖像、長上下文與 agent 情境仍待驗證。它的價值在於讓視覺證據更容易被追溯，並提供值得進一步驗證的訓練訊號。

links.title: Correct Answers, Invalid Traces: What Verifiable Grade-School Math Reveals About Chain-of-Thought Traces

evidence: Section 4, Figure 3 and Table 3: at op=23, 750 of 2,376 correct answers (31.6%) have invalid traces; 384 of those 750 failures pass syntactic/arithmetic checks and fail semantic checks.

Section 4, Tables 1–2: swapped traces retain 81.7% aggregate in-distribution accuracy but only 19.9% at op=15; 10%-sentence-prefix shuffling achieves 60.1% at op=23 versus clean 58.0%, with no trace passing verification.

Section 4, Tables 4–5: non-minimal supervision changes output minimality, while re-asked wide-world questions produce padded traces in 9.6% of correct op=20 answers versus 1.3% for original questions.

Appendix B and Tables 10–11: 124M models train from scratch for 100k steps, batch size 512; clean runs differ by about ten points at op=23 and fall short of the prior reported reproduction, with selected alternative-supervision models replicated using seed 43.
Section 3 and Appendix D, Example 9: dependency-set and arithmetic checks can accept wrong pairings of products; 20 accepted traces at op=15 yield incorrect final answers.

Sections 5–6 explicitly exclude causal-faithfulness or monitor-accuracy measurement and caution against frontier extrapolation; Reproducibility statement links code and trained models, whose availability is claimed by the document rather than independently tested.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant controlled study of reasoning-trace validity, distribution shift, and oversight. Mechanical checks, trace-supervision interventions, query counterfactuals, multiple clean runs, and selected second-seed replications support answer/trace decoupling. Novelty is incremental to existing trace-faithfulness and reasonless-token work. Conclusions are appropriately limited: one 124M synthetic iGSM setting, substantial reproduction variance, and a verifier that checks dependency sets but not the correct operator or pairing prevent equating accepted traces with fully valid derivations or extrapolating to frontier-model monitorability.

Mechanical checks, trace-supervision interventions, query counterfactuals, multiple clean runs, and selected second-seed replications support answer/trace decoupling. Novelty is incremental to existing trace-faithfulness and reasonless-token work. Conclusions are appropriately limited: one 124M synthetic iGSM setting, substantial reproduction variance, and a verifier that checks dependency sets but not the correct operator or pairing prevent equating accepted traces with fully valid derivations or extrapolating to frontier-model monitorability.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項受控研究與推理軌跡有效性、分布偏移及監督高度相關。機械式檢查、軌跡監督干預、查詢反事實、多次乾淨執行，以及部分設定以第二個種子重現，支持答案與軌跡可以解耦。相較於既有的軌跡忠實度及無推理 token 研究，其新穎性屬漸進式。

結論恰當地維持在有限範圍內：僅有一個 124M 模型的合成 iGSM 設定、重現結果變異大，而且驗證器只檢查相依集合，未檢查運算子或配對是否正確，因此不能將獲接受的軌跡等同於完全有效的推導，也不能外推至前沿模型的可監測性。

primary_link.title: Correct Answers, Invalid Traces: What Verifiable Grade-School Math Reveals About Chain-of-Thought Traces

papers.summary: Chain-of-thought traces are widely read as records of how models reach their answers, informing debugging, agent auditing, and claims about reasoning. Testing this interpretation is difficult because natural-language thinking traces are rarely mechanically verifiable. We revisit it in iGSM, a synthetic grade-school mathematics benchmark designed to study thinking traces and used to support claims of learned reasoning and planning. Crucially, iGSM exposes the exact quantities and dependencies tha
papers.summary_zh: 這篇研究區分「答案算對」與「輸出的思維鏈是有效推導」，檢驗能否僅憑可讀的推理文字推斷模型如何解題。作者使用具完整依賴圖、可逐步驗證的合成數學資料集 iGSM，從頭訓練 1.24 億參數模型，並比較乾淨、互換、打亂與非最短的訓練軌跡，再以更深的運算鏈及改問中間變數測試泛化。即使只用正確軌跡訓練，在最難的 23 步題目中，31.6% 的正確答案仍搭配無效軌跡，其中 51.2% 未被語法與算術檢查攔下，卻引用錯誤的語意依賴。打亂前 10% 句子的模型仍接近乾淨模型的答案準確率，反映中間文字具有運算用途，不代表可直接當成可信解釋。非最短監督與改問實驗亦顯示，軌跡是否精簡受訓練格式及問題生成方式影響。作者公開程式與模型連結，並提供部分重複種子實驗；但結果限於小型模型及模 23 的合成任務，而且驗證器會漏掉運算配對錯誤，並未直接量測因果忠實度或安全監控成效。對思維鏈評估的重要提醒是：正確答案不能替代逐步、反事實及分布外驗證。
papers.title: Correct Answers, Invalid Traces: What Verifiable Grade-School Math Reveals About Chain-of-Thought Traces

links.title: Weights Read and Write Features: Scalable Parameter Decomposition Grounded in Activation Space

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.4, Equations 4–9: ASPD replaces explicit feature-component intervention optimization with a shared sparse latent gate plus activation and local matrix-output reconstruction; read-write interaction scores rank candidate dependencies.

Section 4 setup and Appendix C.1–C.3: 2B-token training, average sparsity 32, one target matrix each in GPT-2 small, Gemma-2-2B and Qwen-3-8B; the model-wide case study decomposes 72 GPT-2 matrices into 442,368 components.

Section 4.1, Tables 1–2 and Appendix C.4/C.6: Qwen Intruder scores are 0.57 for ASPD, 0.22 for VPD and 0.60 for PD Transcoder; semantic matching uses an independent SAE and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct judging of 200 component-feature pairs.

Section 4.2, Table 3 and Appendix C.5, Equations 23–24: direct weight deletions evaluated over one million tokens yield Qwen single/multiple random-normalized ratios 6.7/11.1, while absolute target fractions of total feature change are 0.053/0.044; these are activation-localization measures rather than behavioral-safety guarantees.

Section 4.3 and Appendices D–F: local-loss, parameter/ablation-loss, firing-threshold and adaptive-sparsity ablations are reported, with mixed effects; ASPD does not dominate PD Transcoder on all metrics.

Section 5.1 and Appendices G–H: IOI component-pair interventions suppress selected attention patterns, with induction/duplicate/repeated-name probes; Appendix G.1 omits intervening LayerNorm from cross-layer composition, and G.2 acknowledges missing name-specific mechanisms and no ABC-prompt exploration.

Abstract footnote and Appendix C: the paper supplies https://github.com/tue147/weights-read-write and detailed datasets, objectives, optimizers, architecture and evaluation protocols; code availability is a document claim, not externally verified here.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM mechanistic-interpretability research connecting activation dictionaries to data-conditioned rank-1 weight components through shared sparse gates and local reconstruction. Independent output-SAEs, direct frozen-weight interventions, VPD variants, PD Transcoder comparisons, and detailed IOI probes substantiate a useful methodological contribution. Evidence supports improved selected-matrix decomposition more strongly than broad scalable mechanism discovery: quantitative comparisons cover one matrix per model, model-wide circuits are GPT-2 case studies following the known IOI blueprint, semantic metrics rely on one LLM judge, and no multi-seed or broad final-behavior preservation results are reported. The shared-gate grounding is a surrogate, not a demonstrated causal-identifiability guarantee; interaction scores include acknowledged LayerNorm approximations. Strong ratios over random edits coexist with small absolute target-change fractions, and PD Transcoder wins some metrics. Extensive training/evaluation details and a code link support reproducibility without independently verifying the repository.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這项 LLM 機制可解釋性研究高度相關，透過共用稀疏閘控與局部重建，將活化字典連結至以資料為條件的 rank-1 權重元件。獨立的輸出 SAE、直接對凍結權重進行的干預、VPD 變體、PD Transcoder 比較及詳細的 IOI 探測，為這項實用的方法貢獻提供實質支持。

相較於廣泛且可擴展的機制發現，證據更有力地支持選定矩陣分解的改善：量化比較在每個模型中僅涵蓋一個矩陣，涵蓋整個模型的迴路分析是依循已知 IOI 藍圖的 GPT-2 案例研究，語意指標依賴一個 LLM 評判器，且未報告多種子結果或廣泛保留最終行為的結果。共用閘控所提供的連結是替代性機制，並非已證明的因果可識別性保證；互動分數包含作者明示的 LayerNorm 近似。

相較隨機編輯的比率優勢很大，但目標改變的絕對比例仍小，且 PD Transcoder 在部分指標勝出。詳盡的訓練／評估細節與程式碼連結支持可重現性，但儲存庫尚未經獨立驗證。

primary_link.title: Weights Read and Write Features: Scalable Parameter Decomposition Grounded in Activation Space

papers.summary: Activation space and parameter space provide complementary views of model computation. Activations represent information, while weights read, transform, and write that information. Yet existing interpretability methods largely study the two spaces separately, leaving the connection between represented information and parameter-level computation underexplored. We introduce Activation-Supported Parameter Decomposition (ASPD), which jointly decomposes activation and parameter spaces and grounds eac
papers.summary_zh: ASPD 嘗試把 LLM 的 activation features 與實際讀寫資訊的權重連起來。方法用共享稀疏表徵，同時控制 rank-1 權重元件與特徵，再聯合重建 activation 及目標矩陣輸出，讓分解取得局部學習訊號。作者在 GPT-2、Gemma-2-2B、Qwen-3-8B 各一個矩陣比較 VPD、PD Transcoder，並分解 GPT-2 的 72 個矩陣，追蹤 IOI 的 induction、重複名字及 S-inhibition 機制。Qwen 的 Intruder score 為 0.57，VPD 為 0.22；單一與多目標編輯相對隨機基準的 localization 比率達 6.7、11.1 倍。不過絕對 localization 僅 0.053、0.044，不能直接解讀為沒有廣泛副作用。評估主要依賴 LLM judge 與獨立 SAE，大模型只測個別矩陣，完整機制案例集中於 GPT-2，PD Transcoder 在部分項目仍較佳。其價值在於提供從特徵到權重再回到特徵的分析方法；文中附程式碼連結，但跨任務與最終行為效果仍待驗證。

links.title: Scale Sensitivity in Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization: Curvature of the Quantization Error Landscape

evidence: Section 4.1, Theorem 1, and Appendix A.2 establish a high-probability uniform-in-scale RTN approximation under iid Gaussian weights and effective rank at least C log^8 d; Appendix A.4, Theorem 5 verifies a sufficient regime for wide randomly initialized MLPs with odd Lipschitz activations and Gaussian inputs.

Section 4.2, Proposition 1, and Appendices A.5–A.5.2 give uniqueness/nondegeneracy and decreasing optimal scale with level count, derive relative-scale curvature, and numerically examine its approximately exponential bit-width trend. The exponential trend is numerical, not a proved rate.

Sections 5.1 and B.1 specify five decoder-only models from OPT-125M to Llama/Qwen 8B, weight-only symmetric quantization at 2, 3, 4, 6 and 8 bits, 128 C4 calibration windows of 2,048 tokens, and matched scale-rule comparisons; W2 is ternary and embeddings/LM heads remain fp16.

Tables 1, 2 and 6: raw Llama-3.1-8B W3 Proxy-static obtains WikiText-2/C4 perplexities 11.756/16.328 versus Shrink-2.4 14.050/17.177. With HIP, Analytic obtains 9.214/14.602 and mean six-task accuracy 0.721, close to searched rules; the raw Analytic perplexity exceeds 930,000 on WikiText-2.

Section 5.3 and Appendix B.6 use 32 predetermined rows per matrix, five precisions, five models and three calibration draws for finite-window local sensitivity; the authors distinguish this statistic from differential curvature. Appendix B.2.4 tests matched ±5% scale perturbations in ten fresh runs per bit-width and notes nonmonotonic end-to-end responses and degraded low-bit baselines.

Appendix B.3 and Table 7 show remaining W2 limitations: HIP Llama-3.1-8B Analytic has WikiText-2 perplexity 119.45 versus Proxy-static 31.38. Zero-shot results use one calibration seed, and the text explicitly cautions against resolving small accuracy differences.

Section 5.3, Appendix B.4 and Table 9: on ten selected difficult W2 rows, diagonal scaling+HIP and whitening+HIP reduce median analytic/search scale gaps from HIP’s 0.187 to 0.0298 and 0.00406, but worsen best-searched reconstruction losses by median factors 3.63 and 20.8; these are selected local cases, not general end-to-end gains.

Reproducibility statement and Appendix B.1 report anonymous supplementary code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SOQ-345F, per-run frozen configurations, REPRODUCE.md, pinned checkpoint revisions, and quantization settings. Section 6 explicitly limits the theory to initialization and RTN rather than trained compensated quantizers.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to efficient local LLM deployment: a substantive uniform Gaussian-limit analysis and relative-scale sensitivity framework, plus a practical GPTQ-aware selector. Explicit assumptions, detailed proofs, five-model experiments, controlled perturbations, calibration/granularity ablations and six-task evaluation support the central low-bit sensitivity claim. Novelty builds on classical Gaussian scalar quantization, and the guarantees concern Gaussian RTN at initialization, not trained GPTQ; W2 remains weak, end-to-end accuracy is mostly single-seed, and models stop at 8B. The supplied complete HTML text contains duplicated/flattened mathematics and figure captions rather than readable plotted values; quantitative assessment uses reported prose and tables. An anonymous code release and frozen configurations are stated but were not independently accessed.

Explicit assumptions, detailed proofs, five-model experiments, controlled perturbations, calibration/granularity ablations and six-task evaluation support the central low-bit sensitivity claim. Novelty builds on classical Gaussian scalar quantization, and the guarantees concern Gaussian RTN at initialization, not trained GPTQ; W2 remains weak, end-to-end accuracy is mostly single-seed, and models stop at 8B. The supplied complete HTML text contains duplicated/flattened mathematics and figure captions rather than readable plotted values; quantitative assessment uses reported prose and tables. An anonymous code release and frozen configurations are stated but were not independently accessed.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項研究與高效率的本機 LLM 部署高度相關，提供具實質內容的一致 Gaussian 極限分析、相對尺度敏感度框架，以及實用、考量 GPTQ 特性的選擇器。明確假設、詳細證明、五個模型的實驗、受控擾動、校準／粒度消融及六項任務評估，都支持低位元敏感度這項核心主張。

其新穎性建立於經典 Gaussian 純量量化之上，保證所針對的是初始化時的 Gaussian RTN，而非訓練後的 GPTQ；W2 的表現仍弱，端到端準確率多半只使用單一種子，模型規模也僅到 8B。

所提供的完整 HTML 文字含有重複／被攤平成純文字的數學式與圖說，並沒有可讀取的圖中數值；量化評估因此採用正文與表格中報告的結果。文中表示已有匿名程式碼釋出與凍結設定，但尚未獨立存取確認。

primary_link.title: Scale Sensitivity in Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization: Curvature of the Quantization Error Landscape

papers.summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods in the GPTQ family minimize a layer-wise reconstruction error on a uniform grid whose scale must be chosen; the common max-based choice degrades sharply at low bit-widths. We study how sensitive this objective is to the scale. For a layer with i.i.d. Gaussian weights and calibration activations of sufficiently large effective rank, we prove that, as the width grows, the normalized round-to-nearest loss converges with high probability, uniformly over all s
papers.summary_zh: 低位元 LLM 量化為何對縮放尺度特別敏感？本文把逐層 RTN 重建誤差連結到 Gaussian 純量量化：在獨立 Gaussian 權重與校準活化矩陣具有足夠有效秩的條件下，證明誤差對所有尺度一致收斂，並刻畫唯一、非退化的最佳尺度；相對尺度擾動的曲率則在數值計算中隨位元數近似指數下降。五個模型的 GPTQ 實驗比較尺度規則、分組大小、校準資料量與固定比例擾動，支持 2–3 位元比 6–8 位元更需要仔細選尺度。Llama-3.1-8B 的未處理 W3 權重使用 Proxy-static，WikiText-2 困惑度從 Shrink-2.4 的 14.05 降至 11.76；加入 Hadamard incoherence processing 後，免搜尋解析尺度得到 9.21，接近搜尋法的 9.09。限制是理論僅涵蓋初始化與 RTN，未保證訓練後 GPTQ；解析尺度在原始權重上可能崩潰，W2 即使旋轉後仍明顯落後。六項下游評測主要只有單一校準種子，小幅準確率差距不宜視為確定排名。研究價值在於指出何時值得付出尺度搜尋成本，也警告提高有效秩或讓尺度更接近解析預測，不代表重建品質必然改善。

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix A: ToxicBench changes successful tool observations while preserving source CSVs; clean/toxic pairs and separately defined validation, poison adoption, blind compliance and recovery metrics distinguish checking from correctness. The core numerical/semantic tables have median 5.5/3.5 rows, and task variants share tables and templates.

Section 4.2, Table 1: over 118 retained GPT tasks, LangGraph/smolagents/AutoGen clean TSR is 0.99/0.98/0.92 and poisoned TSR 0.67/0.59/0.66; poison delivery differs by adapter, so exposure-conditioned behavior is not a common-exposed-set ranking. Table 2 adds three model families and three common adapters on the smaller overlapping suites.

Section 4.3, Appendix D.1 and Table 18: under one-shot shared-state poisoning with Claude Haiku 4.5, Double-pass TSR is 1.00 versus Base 0.89, Verification-only 0.90 and Generic Guard 0.97. Double-pass minus Base is +0.110 with template-cluster 95% CI [0.056,0.171]; methods match caps rather than actual computation, and later clean evidence is available to the ordinary retry.

Section 4.4 and Appendix B.1, Table 7: the frozen scorer agrees with independent human TSR labels on 192/200 trajectories from 20 task IDs disjoint from development, but not template-disjoint; RR recall is 0.867, BCR 0.800 and ADR 0/1. Human Verification-only ties Double-pass at 1.00 on the 20-task core subset despite an automatic Verification-only score of 0.80.

Appendices D.2 and E.1: 1,572 retained repeated-poison trajectories contain 101 VPA cases, all surviving flagged-event exclusion; 78 have only corrupted qualifying checks and 23 include an unmodified check, only one with an automatically identifiable clean-reference match. This establishes adoption after checking, not universal rejection of sufficient clean evidence; there is no single-route Base stress control.

Appendix E.1: 204 of 3,319 historical corruption events are flagged across 157 trajectories, primarily from off-target sign flipping; excluding all eight sign-flip instances preserves retry gains on the remaining 110 defense tasks. Fresh repaired-injector controls are small selected subsets, and their 16-task Base already achieves 16/16 toxic success rather than replicating the main retry advantage.

Appendix E.2, Table 24: 24 tasks across Penguins, Auto MPG and Bike Sharing use fixed target-aggregate calls and structured numeric answers; primary correctness is 24/24 clean, 20/24 partial-alias corruption and 0/24 full-target corruption. Second-stage clean/full correctness is 48/48 versus 0/48 for retry and 47/48 versus 0/48 for review, with two completions per task and matched poisoned parents for review. Alternative queries remain clean, but full-poison reviews do not make additional checks beyond the mandatory observation.

Section 6, Appendices A–C and E.2: the paper explicitly limits production/natural-error generalization, notes 0/133 source-independent core recovery coverage, preserves versioned scorer/reference/delivery audits, and describes anonymized supplementary task data, trajectories, hashes, code and offline reproduction instructions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant empirical work on LLM tool-agent reliability, grounding and recovery. Its strongest contribution is careful separation of checking, poison adoption and evidence availability, including an ordinary-retry control that limits claims for verification prompting. Novelty is incremental over prior silent-tool-error benchmarks, but paired fixed sources, exposure-conditioned behavior, repeated poisoning, scorer audits and matched-parent public-table controls make the diagnosis useful. Evidence supports vulnerability and local effects of supplied evidence; it does not establish a superior defense or show that most agents reject sufficient correct evidence. Main results retain a historically flawed injector, small synthetic tables and non-independent task variants; sensitivity analyses are transparent but do not substitute for a repaired full-matrix rerun. Frozen human evaluation supports broad conclusions while changing fine-grained method comparisons. Supplementary trajectories, hashes, scoring versions and protocols are described in detail, although their external availability was not independently verified from the supplied text.
