這項實證研究與 LLM 工具代理的可靠性、依據建立及復原高度相關。最強的貢獻是審慎區分檢查、採納投毒內容及證據可用性，並納入一般重試對照，以限制對驗證提示效果的主張。相較先前的靜默工具錯誤基準，其新穎性屬漸進式；但成對的固定來源、以暴露情況為條件的行為分析、重複投毒、評分器稽核，以及配對相同起始軌跡的公開表格對照，使這項診斷具有實用價值。

證據支持存在弱點，以及所提供證據的局部效果；它未能確立更優越的防禦，也未顯示多數代理會拒絕充分且正確的證據。主要結果仍採用先前已知有缺陷的注入器、小型合成表格，以及彼此不獨立的任務變體；敏感度分析雖透明，卻不能取代修復後重跑完整實驗矩陣。固定版本的人工評估支持整體結論，但改變了細部的方法比較。

補充軌跡、雜湊值、評分版本及流程均有詳細說明，但尚未依據所提供的文字獨立驗證這些資源在外部是否可取得。

primary_link.title: When Tools Silently Lie: Evaluating and Mitigating Blind Compliance in Tool-Augmented Data Agents

papers.summary: Tool-augmented data agents rely on tool outputs for analytical decisions. Yet successful execution can return plausible but incorrect evidence, requiring agents to decide whether to trust or verify it. Understanding this failure requires examining both the evidence obtained through checking and the answer ultimately adopted. We introduce ToxicBench to measure checking and adoption under numerical, label, schema, and retrieval errors, pairing clean and poisoned observations over fixed source data
papers.summary_zh: 工具順利執行，不代表回傳的證據可信。ToxicBench 保持來源表格不變，只改寫工具傳回的數值、實體標籤、欄位語意或檢索內容，區分未查核就採信、查核後仍採信錯誤，以及真正恢復正確答案。118 項 GPT 任務跨三種代理框架，遭污染後的成功率下降 26–39 個百分點；在 Claude Haiku 的單次污染比較中，普通第二次嘗試達到 100%，Base 為 89%，明確驗證提示並未顯示額外優勢。重複污染下有 101 條軌跡出現查核後採信錯誤，其中 78 條的後續有效查核全遭污染，因此不能解讀為代理都忽略了充分正確的證據。三份公開表格的控制實驗也顯示，重試取得乾淨證據時為 48/48 正確，目標欄位全部別名持續污染時則為 0/48。凍結評分器後的 200 條人工檢查，任務成功判定一致率為 96%，但部分行為指標召回率較低。核心任務仍以小型合成表格為主，歷史注入器存在已揭露的傳送缺陷，公開資料實驗又固定初始工具呼叫，尚不能代表正式環境。對代理開發的啟示是：應同時追蹤查核取得什麼證據、最後採用哪個答案及其成本，而不能只增加查核次數。

links.title: Retrieval Capacity of Self-Attention Under Competition

evidence: Section 2, equations (7)–(10): Top-N selection is recomputed at every query/head/layer without retraining; the primary deletion leaves retained weights unchanged, and effective set size is defined by average loss tolerance rather than a recovered latent useful set.

Section 3 and Appendix C.3, Table 2: nine checkpoints are evaluated on 50 documents per corpus; OpenWebText attention-ranked 5% thresholds range from 12 for Gemma-2-9B to 226 for Gemma-7B at 1024 positions.

Appendices B.3 and C.4, Tables 3–5: matched final-128-target context sweeps cover 256–2048 positions; the six complete model–corpus pairs grow 4.12–6.63-fold at 5% tolerance, while only 27 of 32 planned conditions are complete and threshold intervals are conditional on tested sizes.

Appendices D.1–D.3, Tables 6–7: 86 span-validated fixed-support examples per background show mean support displacement increasing 50-fold and recall@64 declining 63.8 percentage points; 100-example answer-loss thresholds are model dependent and Qwen is nonmonotonic.

Appendix E.1, Tables 9–10: Gemma-7B OpenWebText 5% attention threshold changes from 226 under deletion to 7 with renormalization; historical document pairing is unverified, and renormalized QA does not provide a matched natural-context-length sweep.

Appendices F.1–F.5 provide conditional proofs and an identical-value counterexample; Section 4 explicitly states that dense attention is computed before selection and no inference speedup or universal scaling law is demonstrated.

Reproducibility Statement and Appendix B.5: the accompanying archive contains manuscript and figure assets; raw measurements, experiment code, and environment manifests remain needed, and the 24B checkpoint has unpinned 8-bit implementation details.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to LLM attention, long-context retrieval, and mechanistic evaluation. The main contribution is a carefully qualified functional measurement and competition/aggregation analysis rather than a new efficient attention algorithm. Nine checkpoints, two corpora, matched-target context sweeps, fixed-support QA, random/positional controls, and renormalization establish useful intervention-dependent results; conditional proofs distinguish retained mass from distinct useful information. Evidence is constrained by 50-document functional cohorts, mostly 256–2048-token natural contexts, 100-example six-choice QA, incomplete conditions, locally refined rather than globally certified thresholds, and unverified document pairing for historical renormalization comparisons. Detailed protocols and numerical checks help, but the source archive lacks the experiment code, raw per-document measurements, and environment manifests needed for independent reproduction.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
主題直接涉及 LLM 的注意力、長脈絡檢索與機制性評估。主要貢獻是界定嚴謹的功能量測，以及競爭與聚合分析，而非新的高效率注意力演算法。

九個模型檢查點、兩個語料庫、目標相匹配的脈絡長度掃描、固定支持內容的問答、隨機與位置控制，以及重新正規化實驗，建立了有用但取決於介入方式的結果；附帶條件的證明則區分了保留下來的注意力質量與彼此不同的有用資訊。

證據仍受多項限制：功能量測樣本組僅含 50 篇文件，自然脈絡大多只有 256–2048 個 token，六選一問答僅有 100 個樣本，條件不完整，門檻值只經局部細化、未獲全域認證，以及歷史重新正規化比較中的文件配對未經驗證。詳盡的實驗流程與數值檢查有所幫助，但來源封存檔缺少獨立重現所需的實驗程式碼、逐文件原始量測資料及環境清單。

primary_link.title: Retrieval Capacity of Self-Attention Under Competition

papers.summary: How many tokens from its context does a language model actually use, and what determines that number? We study this question through self-attention. Without retraining, we retain only the tokens with the highest attention weights at each head, layer, and query, keeping their original weights unchanged. By varying the selected set size and measuring the increase in negative log-likelihood (NLL), we estimate the effective attention set size needed to stay within a chosen loss tolerance. Relatively
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型究竟需要保留多少上下文 token，才能維持預測表現？本文在每層、每個 attention head 與查詢位置保留分數最高的 Top-N token，不重新訓練，並以 NLL 增幅定義有效注意力集合大小。九個模型與兩種語料的實驗顯示，依注意力或貢獻大小選擇優於隨機選擇，但幾何分離本身不能保證功能充分。固定最後 128 個預測目標、將上下文由 256 增至 2048 時，六組完整模型與語料配對的所需集合增為 4.12–6.63 倍。BABILong 固定支持事實後加入背景，也使支持 token 排名、注意力質量與召回率惡化。關鍵控制是重新正規化保留權重：Gemma-7B 在 OpenWebText 的 5% 門檻從 226 降至 7，說明集合大小同時受資訊檢索與加權聚合影響。限制包括樣本量有限、部分條件未完成、門檻僅搜尋已測尺寸，且正規化比較的文件配對未驗證；程式與逐文件原始結果亦未隨來源提供。研究有助解讀長上下文的競爭與注意力稀疏化，但不能直接推出模型真正使用的資訊量或實際推論加速。

links.title: SEED: Self-Speculative Decoding via Implicit Encoder-Decoder

evidence: Sections 4.1–4.3: draft using the final two layers and raw embeddings conditioned on verified deep KV caches; combine next-token and block-causal speculative losses and verify with the full model.
Section 5.2, Table 1: Qwen3-1.7B/4B average speedups are 2.6x/2.7x across GSM8K, KodCode, ScienceQA, and CNN/Daily Mail; 4B KodCode accuracy is 81.0% versus AR 76.2%.

Appendix B.3, Table 4: controlled E2D2 comparison matches training budget, block size four, decoder split, and fixed draft length; two-layer SEED reaches 57.5% GSM8K accuracy at 74.3 tokens/s versus 23.7% at 75.9 for E2D2.

Section 5.4 and Appendix D.2, Tables 6–7: decoder size, block size, loss weight, confidence, tree verification, and parameter sharing are ablated; removing parameter sharing reduces GSM8K accuracy from 57.5% to 44.1%.
Appendix C.3: EAGLE-3 uses released Qwen3 instruct-target checkpoints because corresponding base-model drafter weights are unavailable; PARD instead uses the task-specific fine-tuned AR target.

Appendices A and C.1–C.6: only 1.7B/4B Qwen3 models, single A6000 evaluation, training seed 1, greedy decoding, and task-specific short-sequence training; larger models and serving-system optimizations remain future work.
Appendix E.1: linear probes use 20,000 target-token positions from 1,000 test-split examples to examine one-to-five-token lookahead; the mechanism is presented as planning-ahead intuition.
Abstract and Appendices C–D: code availability is claimed at https://github.com/lhk2004/SEED; dataset construction, hyperparameters, prompts, and training/inference algorithms are supplied.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM inference work: SEED adapts encoder-decoder amortization into self-speculation, training the final layers to draft from embeddings while reusing verified deep KV caches. Four task-specific benchmarks across two Qwen3 sizes show 2.6x/2.7x average throughput gains with comparable or improved task quality; controlled E2D2, parameter-sharing, decoder-size, loss-weight, and tree-verification ablations strengthen the mechanism. However, the headline EAGLE-3 comparison uses instruct targets rather than the task-fine-tuned base targets used by SEED, so it does not isolate decoding-method superiority. Main experiments use one training seed, greedy decoding, one evaluation GPU, short sequences, and only 1.7B/4B models; the future-predictive probe results support an interpretation rather than prove causal planning. Detailed algorithms, dataset processing, hyperparameters, and an advertised code repository aid reproduction, but the repository was not independently verified.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這項 LLM 推論研究高度符合偏好：SEED 將 encoder-decoder 的成本攤提概念引入自我推測解碼，訓練最後幾層從嵌入向量產生草稿，同時重用已驗證前綴的深層 KV cache。兩種 Qwen3 規模、四項任務專用基準呈現平均 2.6 倍與 2.7 倍吞吐量提升，任務品質相當或更佳；受控 E2D2 比較，以及參數共享、解碼器大小、損失權重和樹狀驗證消融，增強了機制證據。不過，主要 EAGLE-3 比較使用指令模型，而 SEED 使用任務微調的基礎模型，因此無法單獨判定解碼方法的優越性。主要實驗僅採一個訓練種子、greedy decoding、單一評估 GPU、短序列及 1.7B／4B 模型；預測未來 token 的探針結果支持一種解釋，並未證明因果性的規劃能力。詳細演算法、資料處理、超參數與文中宣稱提供的程式碼儲存庫有助重現，但儲存庫未經獨立查核。

primary_link.title: SEED: Self-Speculative Decoding via Implicit Encoder-Decoder

papers.summary: Self-speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by drafting tokens from the target model itself, but faces a sharp tradeoff between the quality and cost of the draft. Early-exit methods produce drafts cheaply by terminating computation at intermediate layers, but forgo the deeper representations that later layers provide and thus suffer in draft quality. Multi-token prediction preserves draft quality by emitting from the model's final hidden states, but pays for a full
papers.summary_zh: LLM 自我推測解碼常在草稿品質與成本間取捨：提早退出容易失去深層語境，多 token 預測又需要昂貴的模型計算。SEED 把既有 decoder-only Transformer 視為隱式 encoder-decoder，讓最後兩層從原始 token 嵌入產生草稿，重用上次完整驗證留下的深層 KV cache；訓練時加入區塊因果草稿損失，推論時搭配動態草稿與樹狀驗證。四項任務專用基準涵蓋數學、程式、科學問答及摘要，Qwen3 的 1.7B 與 4B 模型平均吞吐量分別提升 2.6 倍、2.7 倍，品質相當或改善。受控 E2D2 比較與參數共享等消融支持其設計。然而 EAGLE-3 採指令模型，與 SEED 的任務微調基礎模型不同，優勢幅度不能視為純方法比較；主要測試也限單一 GPU、greedy decoding、短序列與小模型。未來 token 探針支持表徵更具預測性，仍非規劃能力的因果證明。這項工作為低成本 LLM 推論提供值得實作驗證的方向，較大模型及實際服務效益仍待確認。

links.title: Beyond Semantic Narrowing: Robust and Efficient LLM Watermarking with Hamming Neighborhoods

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.4, Eqs. 1–12: defines natural acceptance mass, eight-bit random-hyperplane hashing with a previous-sentence-centered neighborhood, and Edge Vote/Global Bits detection without generator access.

Section 4.1, Table 1: across Mistral-7B and Qwen2.5-7B on C4 and BookSum, Global Bits reports attacked TPR@1% of 0.82–0.97; watermarked perplexity differs from unwatermarked perplexity by at most 0.30.

Sections 4.2 and 4.5, Table 2: 2.2 candidates per accepted sentence versus 8.1 for SimMark; identical 37/256 code coverage yields natural acceptance 0.58 for HammingMark versus 0.15 for Random Code, estimated on 100 prompts with 300 candidates each.
Section 4.3, Table 3: Mistral-7B obtains TPR@1% 0.95/0.91 and ROUGE-L 0.33/0.36 on ELI5/Multi-News; unwatermarked ROUGE-L is 0.34/0.36.

Appendices E–G, Tables 6–7: the ambient-space diversity proposition explicitly does not ensure sentence realizability; separate all-mpnet-base-v2 evaluation reports 94.7% pairwise-diversity retention over 100 fixed prompts.

Appendices J–M: 500 test examples per open-generation dataset, 100 per constrained dataset, 500 disjoint calibration examples, 200-token targets and three seeds; correct/wrong-key TPR is 0.99/0.08, and matched-acceptance continuous cosine control reaches 0.68 TPR@1%.

Section 5 and reproducibility statement: dependence on semantic encoder, sentence segmentation and finite rejection sampling is acknowledged; source code is promised upon paper acceptance rather than provided in the supplied text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant LLM provenance and robustness methodology: a simple context-centered Hamming acceptance rule improves the quality–detectability–sampling trade-off over eight watermark baselines. Novelty is a useful arrangement of established semantic hashing and rejection sampling, supported by clear probabilistic analysis with explicit fixed-key and natural-language-manifold caveats. Experiments span two 7B models, open and constrained generation, four rewriting attacks, equal-code-coverage and continuous-similarity controls, independent-encoder diversity, threshold/hash-length ablations, and cross-key detection. Strong reported gains are tempered by small constrained-task test sets, 200-token generations, dataset-specific low-FPR calibration, no adaptive watermark-aware or multilingual evaluation, limited uncertainty reporting, and code promised only upon acceptance. All supplied complete text, including references and Appendices A–M, was read.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項 LLM 來源追溯與穩健性方法研究具有直接相關性：簡單的脈絡中心式 Hamming 接受規則，相較八種浮水印基準方法，改善了品質、可偵測性與取樣之間的取捨。其新穎性在於將既有的語意雜湊與拒絕取樣做出有用的組合，並以清楚的機率分析支持，同時明確說明固定金鑰與自然語言流形相關的限制。

實驗涵蓋兩個 7B 模型、開放式與受限生成、四種改寫攻擊、相同編碼覆蓋率與連續相似度的控制實驗、獨立編碼器的多樣性檢驗、門檻值與雜湊長度消融，以及跨金鑰偵測。

雖然回報的增益很大，仍須考量受限任務測試集偏小、生成長度僅 200 個 token、低 FPR 校準因資料集而異、缺少能感知浮水印的適應性攻擊或多語評估、不確定性回報有限，以及程式碼僅承諾於論文獲接受後釋出。已讀完所有提供的完整文字，包括參考文獻與附錄 A–M。

primary_link.title: Beyond Semantic Narrowing: Robust and Efficient LLM Watermarking with Hamming Neighborhoods

radar.summary: Semantic watermarking improves robustness against watermark removal attacks by embedding detectable signals into sentence-level representations. However, existing watermarking methods typically impose watermark-specific semantic preferences on generated sentences without explicitly accounting for the highly non-uniform and context-dependent semantic preference of LLM generation. When these two preferences are poorly aligned, many natural continuations become incompatible with the watermark, caus
radar.summary_zh: 語意浮水印常把下一句限制在與自然生成不相容的區域，增加重抽成本，也可能壓縮內容多樣性。HammingMark 將前一句的語意嵌入轉成八位元雜湊，接受至少六位元相同的候選句；短雜湊的多對一映射讓不同語意仍可能落入有效鄰域。偵測端只需編碼器與投影矩陣，以相鄰句的有效票數或匹配位元總量累積證據。作者以 Mistral-7B 與 Qwen2.5-7B，在 C4、BookSum 及兩項受限生成任務比較八種基準。四組開放生成設定中，Global Bits 在改寫攻擊後的 TPR@1% 為 0.82–0.97；每個接受句平均抽樣 2.2 次，相較 SimMark 減少 72.8%。相同有效碼數的隨機控制與獨立編碼器多樣性評估支持鄰域配置的效益。然而測試主要限於兩個七十億參數模型、約兩百 token 輸出，尚未驗證多語言或知悉浮水印的適應性攻擊；低誤報率也依賴各資料集校準，程式碼僅承諾接受後公開。這項工作提供降低來源驗證成本的實用方向，但不能直接視為跨領域可靠性保證。

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3, Equations 4–20: reconstructs the current weight gradient from backward signals and activations, adds a position-count normalization only to the normal branch, uses G_perp=(I-UU^T)G(I-VV^T), and updates base weights without new Adam momentum/variance buffers.

Sections 4.1–4.3, Tables 1–3: GDLoRA averages 85.26/88.71 on RoBERTa GLUE versus LoRA 83.44/86.64; Llama-3-8B mathematical reasoning is 70.01 versus 67.51 for LoRA and 70.63 for FFT; Gemma-7B commonsense is 85.15 versus 83.40 and 85.70.

Section 4.5, Figure 2: normal updates outperform LoRA+Full by 0.59/1.40 GLUE points; the tested normal learning-rate range gives 69.46–70.01 math accuracy. Llama memory is 21.6 GB, 1.2 GB above LoRA and below FFT 61.79 GB.

Appendices A–B, Figures 3–4 and Tables 5–6: compares drift and Fira refresh costs, reports 21-minute GDLoRA versus 47-minute Fira at a 50-step refresh interval on Math10K, and explicitly counts the extra full-gradient matrix multiplication and thin-factor QR costs.

Appendices C–E and H: supplies tangent-space and finite-step proofs, explicitly distinguishes Euclidean induced gradients from AdamW, limits normal-descent guarantees to fixed adapters, and notes the unpivoted thresholded QR procedure can miss the true column space for nonzero rank-deficient factors.

Appendices F–G, Tables 8–12: rank-8/16/32 math ablations, additional PEFT baselines, per-task training settings, a shared language-task learning-rate search grid and three random seeds are given. The abstract announces an anonymous code repository; its actual availability was not verified from outside the supplied source.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM adaptation work with a clear, implementable complement to LoRA: AdamW factor updates plus a two-sided normal-gradient base-weight update. The tangent-space characterization and finite-step analysis are carefully qualified, and three-seed comparisons across language understanding, two reasoning backbones, vision, ranks, gradient components, learning rates, memory and runtime support useful but moderate gains. Novelty is bounded by established tangent/normal geometry and related full-rank residual methods. The claimed optimizer-state parity does not mean identical total memory or adapter-only storage: the base weights change and peak memory rises. Local fixed-adapter descent does not establish convergence of the joint optimizer; thresholded unpivoted QR is not generally rank revealing. Evaluation is mostly small encoder or 7–8B models, exact evaluation/selection details are incomplete, and the announced anonymous code release was not independently checked.

Novelty is bounded by established tangent/normal geometry and related full-rank residual methods. llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項 LLM 調適研究高度相關，為 LoRA 提出清楚且可實作的補充方法：結合 AdamW 因子更新與基底權重的雙側法向梯度更新。切空間刻畫與有限步分析都謹慎交代了適用條件；涵蓋語言理解、兩個推理骨幹模型、視覺、秩、梯度分量、學習率、記憶體與執行時間的三個隨機種子比較，支持有用但幅度適中的增益。新穎性仍受既有的切向／法向幾何與相關全秩殘差方法所限。

作者宣稱最佳化器狀態開銷相同，但這不代表總記憶體用量相同，也不代表只需儲存 adapter：基底權重會改變，且記憶體峰值上升。固定 adapter 下的局部下降性，無法證明聯合最佳化器收斂；加上門檻值的無樞紐 QR 一般也不具秩揭示能力。

評估大多使用小型編碼器或 7–8B 模型，精確的評估與選擇細節不完整，且所宣告的匿名程式碼釋出未經獨立查核。

primary_link.title: Beyond Low-Rank Parameterization: Narrowing the Gap Between LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning via Gradient Decomposition

radar.summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used approach to parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), yet a performance gap can remain relative to full fine-tuning (FFT). Many LoRA variants improve the initialization or optimization of low-rank factors. At each training step, however, their first-order weight-space directions are constrained by the current parameterization. We characterize the corresponding LoRA-accessible gradient space and show that it coincides with the tangent space induced by the
radar.summary_zh: LoRA 能減少微調的最佳化器狀態記憶體，卻可能漏掉目前低秩參數化無法表達的梯度方向。GDLoRA 將完整權重梯度分解成 LoRA 切空間內的分量與正交的法向分量；前者仍由標準 AdamW 更新介面卡，後者經輸入位置數縮放後直接更新基底權重，不另存基底權重的動量或變異數。作者在 RoBERTa、Llama-3-8B、Gemma-7B 與 ViT 上比較多種微調方法，並以三個隨機種子回報結果。Llama-3-8B 的六項數學推理平均準確率由 LoRA 的 67.51% 升至 70.01%，接近完整微調的 70.63%；記憶體為 21.6 GB，仍比 LoRA 多 1.2 GB。梯度分量、學習率及秩的消融支持法向更新的作用，但局部下降證明不保證聯合訓練收斂，數值 QR 在部分秩不足情況也未必取得精確子空間。此法實際修改基底權重，因此不能直接保留僅儲存小型介面卡的部署方式；價值在於以較低最佳化器成本取得更完整的適應能力，仍需更大模型與長序列驗證。

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.5 and Appendices B, G–I: adopt the TRB geometric bridge, prove correction probability equals TV(p,q), bound it by sqrt(epsilon/2), and preserve exact-q sampling through first-rejection commit/rollback.
Section 4.2, Tables 1–2: macro Mean@8/Pass@8 are 29.0/47.5 versus TRB 27.9/44.6 for 1.7B, and 18.4/35.6 versus 17.2/33.6 for 0.6B across seven math benchmarks.
Appendices D and F, Tables 6 and 8: Random-TM scores 28.30/45.50, TV-Weighted-TM 28.24/46.77, teacher-sampled targets 28.38/45.94, and SAKI 29.00/47.50 for 1.7B.

Section 4.3 and Appendix E: a fixed 2,048-position, 213-prompt probe uses prompt-clustered bootstrap; matched probe runs share one seed, and step-200 teacher Top-1/Top-16 gains over TRB are 4.26/2.94 percentage points.
Section 4.4 and Appendix K, Tables 3 and 10: engine-resident rollout reaches 3,276 tokens/s versus external exact-q 776 and student-only 7,760; representative integrated step time is 232.6 seconds.

Appendix A and reproducibility statement: Qwen3 Base students share a 4B GRPO teacher, 17,917 math prompts, 200 training steps, and a 50-step guidance anneal; a reference implementation is linked, with no independent execution verification.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM reasoning distillation and efficient training. SAKI adds a coherent supervision-routing mechanism to the existing TRB bridge: realized maximal-coupling corrections trigger teacher-Top-1 targets, with exact sampling and intervention-rate derivations. Seven math benchmarks, two student sizes, matched random/TV-weighted placement controls, and fixed-prefix probes provide substantive support. The 1.7B model improves macro Mean@8/Pass@8 from 27.9/44.6 to 29.0/47.5 over TRB, but the advantage over TV-weighted routing is only 0.76/0.73 points. Generality and certainty are limited by a single Qwen model family, math-only training/evaluation, and absent multi-seed downstream uncertainty; probe bootstrap intervals do not resolve training-run variability. The 4.22x speedup is over an external exact-q implementation, not ordinary OPD or an end-to-end compute-matched baseline. Detailed appendices and a linked reference implementation help reproducibility, although execution and public code availability were not independently verified.

SAKI adds a coherent supervision-routing mechanism to the existing TRB bridge: realized maximal-coupling corrections trigger teacher-Top-1 targets, with exact sampling and intervention-rate derivations. Seven math benchmarks, two student sizes, matched random/TV-weighted placement controls, and fixed-prefix probes provide substantive support. The 1.7B model improves macro Mean@8/Pass@8 from 27.9/44.6 to 29.0/47.5 over TRB, but the advantage over TV-weighted routing is only 0.76/0.73 points. Generality and certainty are limited by a single Qwen model family, math-only training/evaluation, and absent multi-seed downstream uncertainty; probe bootstrap intervals do not resolve training-run variability. The 4.22x speedup is over an external exact-q implementation, not ordinary OPD or an end-to-end compute-matched baseline. Detailed appendices and a linked reference implementation help reproducibility, although execution and public code availability were not independently verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本研究高度切合 LLM 推理蒸餾與高效率訓練。SAKI 在既有 TRB 橋接分布上加入有一致理論依據的監督分配機制：以實際發生的 maximal coupling 修正事件觸發教師 Top-1 目標，並推導精確取樣與干預率界限。七個數學基準、兩種學生規模、配對的隨機與 TV 加權位置控制，以及固定前綴探測，提供實質支持。1.7B 模型相較 TRB 的整體 Mean@8／Pass@8 從 27.9／44.6 提升至 29.0／47.5，但相較 TV 加權分配僅增加 0.76／0.73 個百分點。僅測試單一 Qwen 模型家族、數學訓練與評估，且未提供多個訓練種子的下游不確定性，使通用性與結論確定程度受限；探測的 bootstrap 區間無法消除訓練執行間的變異。4.22 倍加速是相對外部 exact-q 實作，並非一般 OPD 或端到端計算量相等的基準。詳盡附錄及參考實作連結有助重現，但未獨立驗證程式執行或公開程式碼的可取得性。

primary_link.title: SAKI: Maximal-Coupling-Routed Teacher Supervision for On-Policy Distillation

radar.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) reduces train-test state mismatch by training a student on its own generated trajectories, but weak students may visit teacher-misaligned prefixes where supervision is less representative. We introduce SAKI (Supervision Allocation with KL-constrained Interpolation), which combines a KL-constrained teacher-guided rollout with maximal coupling and reuses realized accept/correction events to route token-level supervision. Accepted positions retain sampled-token reverse-
radar.summary_zh: 弱小語言模型自行產生訓練軌跡時，容易走入教師罕見的前綴，削弱蒸餾效果。SAKI 沿用 TRB 的 KL 約束橋接分布，再以 maximal coupling 決定保留或修正學生提案：保留處使用 reverse-KL，修正處改學教師 Top-1 token；真正延續軌跡的殘差取樣 token 與訓練目標分開。修正機率等於分布的 TV 距離，且受信賴區域上界限制。研究以 Qwen3 的 0.6B、1.7B 學生和 4B 教師，在七個數學基準驗證；1.7B 的平均 Mean@8／Pass@8 從 TRB 的 27.9／44.6 升至 29.0／47.5。等量隨機與 TV 加權監督控制支持分配位置的價值，但相對後者增益只有 0.76／0.73 個百分點。引擎內推測驗證維持取樣語義，相對外部 exact-q 實作加速 4.22 倍，仍慢於純學生生成。結果限於單一模型家族與數學，缺少多種訓練種子的下游誤差估計，也未證明端到端計算效益。價值在於把必須修正的生成事件直接轉成監督訊號，並提供理論、位置控制與實作細節供後續檢驗。

llm_evaluation.rationale: 高度符合 LLM、推理、RAG 與小模型訓練偏好。主要貢獻是把受控種子、異質任務與推理軌跡整合成合成語料，並以多尺度模型、同架構資料消融及種子外測試支持單階段學生訓練。創新偏整合與實證；訓練 token 優勢不能等同端到端算力優勢，事實測試主要衡量已見種子回憶，推理消融僅單次執行。能力與語言覆蓋受種子限制；正文的完整釋出宣稱與檢核表的未來釋出說法不一致，且訓練／生成程式未公開。
llm_evaluation.rationale_en:
Highly aligned with preferences for LLMs, reasoning, RAG, and small-model training. The main contribution is combining controlled seeds, heterogeneous tasks, and reasoning trajectories into a synthetic corpus, with models at multiple scales, same-architecture data ablations, and tests beyond the seeds supporting single-stage student training.

The innovation is primarily integrative and empirical. An advantage in training tokens cannot be equated with an end-to-end compute advantage; the factual tests mainly measure recall of previously seen seeds, and the reasoning ablation was run only once.

Capability and language coverage are constrained by the seeds. The main text's claim of a complete release conflicts with the checklist's statement of a future release, and the training/generation code has not been made public.

radar.summary_zh: 這篇研究探討能否把預訓練、指令遵循與推理學習整合成單一訓練階段。Synth 以約五萬八千篇 Wikipedia 文章為主要種子，先蒸餾查詢與推理生成器，再依任務、語言、難度與回答立場等條件，產生近八百億 tokens 的合成語料；內容涵蓋記憶問答、RAG、算術與編輯，並加入拒答及不確定性標記。作者從頭訓練小型 dense 模型與 MoE，在固定架構、tokenizer 與訓練步數的 600M 比較中，Synth 的二十二項選擇題平均為 42.2%，高於經額外後訓練的 FineWiki 26.1% 與 FinePDFs-Edu 25.1%；八項開放問答亦達 24.3%。移除推理軌跡後，開放問答降至 22.0%，但選擇題幾乎不變。種子內事實回憶表現良好，然而 MoE 在種子外實體的拒答率達 66.8%，有作答時的事實精確率降至 61.7%。資料效率因此不能直接視為全面知識或端到端算力優勢，生成成本與教師監督仍須計入。完整語料與模型的釋出說法在正文與檢核表間不一致，訓練及生成程式未公開。其價值在於展示可控合成語料能塑造小模型能力，但泛化與重現仍待更完整驗證。

links.title: DatalogBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Text-to-Datalog Synthesis

evidence: Sections 4.1–4.2, Table 1, and Appendix D: 136 human-annotated tasks from four public artifacts cover four domains; 78 reference programs are recursive, 59 use auxiliary predicates, and the benchmark has 247 held-out evaluation variants, including 58 tasks with only one variant.

Section 4.3 and Appendix G: three mutation operators generate 1,948 mutants; held-out variants distinguish 1,877 (96.4%), with all 71 survivors adjudicated equivalent. The authors explicitly exclude any claim of arbitrary-program equivalence and note missing negation, aggregate-function, and grouping-scope mutations.

Sections 5.1 and 6.1: six model/mode settings crossed with four prompts produce 24 Direct cells; best reported exact match is 68.4%. Each cell ran once; inference uses 10,000 seeded task bootstrap resamples and paired sign-flip tests, which quantify task sampling rather than generation variability.

Section 6.2, Table 3, and Appendix N: Codex with requested GPT 5.6 Sol improves signature-only exact match from 55.9% to 82.4%, and Claude Code with requested Claude Opus 5 from 52.2% to 83.8%; paired gains are 26.5 points (95% CI 19.1–34.6) and 31.6 points (24.3–39.7). These settings jointly add feedback, persistent sessions, and file/shell tools.

Sections 6.2–6.3 and Appendix N: held-out inputs reject 17 and 14 of the 128 demonstration-exact candidates from Codex and Claude Code respectively; declaration-only repair increases mean Direct exact match by 4.9 points. Tasks with both recursion and auxiliary predicates remain below the 97.8% both agents achieve on tasks with neither.

Appendices C.2, C.6, H.3, and O: output budgets differ across providers, several direct models use a third-party endpoint, agent server-side builds are not verified, public-source normalization does not exclude structural recall, and transfer beyond Souffle is unmeasured.

Reproducibility Statement and Appendices B, C, H: the source gives https://github.com/ZJU-PL/DatalogBench for benchmark, prompts, harness, and analysis scripts; documents Souffle 2.5, 30-second execution limits, pinned agent environments, and symbolic-baseline patches. This is a source-reported release, not an independently checked download.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM coding, logical reasoning, agent tooling, and evaluation. The contribution is a carefully instrumented text-to-Datalog benchmark rather than a new synthesis algorithm: held-out execution, mutation-tested oracles, declaration-only diagnostics, and structural failure slices make its findings unusually interpretable. A 24-cell direct-prompting grid and paired agent comparisons substantiate large improvements from the interactive configuration and persistent semantic difficulty. Limits are 136 curated Souffle-only tasks, sparse held-out inputs for many tasks, one generation per LLM/agent setting, public-source exposure, and mutation operators that omit important error classes. Feedback and tooling are bundled; unequal request budgets and unverified agent server builds also limit causal attribution and model comparisons. The source supplies extensive protocols and a repository release claim, but external availability and results were not independently rerun.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
主題與 LLM 程式撰寫、邏輯推理、代理工具及評估高度相關。貢獻是具備周密量測與診斷設計的文字轉 Datalog 基準，而非新的程式合成演算法：保留測試資料上的執行、經變異測試的 oracle、僅提供宣告的診斷，以及結構化的失敗案例切片，使其結果格外容易解讀。包含 24 種組合的直接提示實驗網格，以及成對的代理比較，支持互動式設定帶來大幅改善，同時也顯示語意上的困難依然存在。

限制包括僅有 136 項人工整理、只適用於 Souffle 的任務，許多任務的保留測試輸入稀少，每種 LLM／代理設定僅生成一次，使用公開來源所帶來的接觸風險，以及變異運算子遺漏重要的錯誤類型。回饋與工具配置被綁在一起；請求預算不等，以及代理伺服器建置版本未經驗證，也限制了因果歸因與模型比較。

來源提供了詳盡的實驗流程，並宣稱已釋出程式碼儲存庫，但未獨立查核外部可用性，也未重新執行實驗以驗證結果。

primary_link.title: DatalogBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Text-to-Datalog Synthesis

radar.summary: Datalog underpins reasoning tasks such as program analysis, but its programs are hard to write. Existing synthesizers automate this task but require users to state their intent as input-output examples. Large language models (LLMs) suggest a more natural route, text-to-Datalog synthesis from a natural-language question, yet how well they do so has not been systematically evaluated. We present DatalogBench, a benchmark of 136 text-to-Datalog synthesis tasks curated from existing Datalog-based art
radar.summary_zh: DatalogBench 針對將自然語言需求轉成 Datalog 程式的能力，整理來自四個公開專案的 136 項任務，涵蓋程式分析、圖形分析、形式推理與知識探索。每題提供關聯結構，並分開示範資料與隱藏測試；評估區分編譯成功及輸出完全正確，避免把可執行誤當成語意正確。作者比較六種模型／推理模式與四種提示設定，直接提示最佳正確率為 68.4%；加入執行回饋與工具的 Codex、Claude Code 分別達 82.4%、83.8%。宣告補全僅提升平均正確率 4.9 個百分點，剩餘問題集中在遞迴規則與輔助述詞分解。測試可辨識 1,948 個變異程式中的 1,877 個，但變異範圍未涵蓋否定、聚合與分組錯誤，不能保證所有通過程式都等價。基準僅使用 Soufflé，58 題只有一個測試變體；代理設定也未分離工具與回饋效果，模型服務版本及公開來源記憶仍有限制。其價值是提供可重現的執行式評估，並具體顯示編譯修正之後，邏輯語意驗證仍不可省略。
radar.title: DatalogBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Text-to-Datalog Synthesis

links.title: Traverse: Learning When to Remember, Reset, and Redirect for Long-Horizon Web Search

evidence: Sections 2.2–2.3: Seal Memory records structured state and resets context; the Rubric–Answer–Verify workflow can return a failed candidate to search, and Read Memory restores details from the previous checkpoint.

Section 3.2, Eqs. 4–5: final-segment-only RL avoids directly propagating a single outcome advantage through all context segments; Section 4.1 applies RL only to Answer, using Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, 256K context and a 512-turn limit.
Section 4.2, Tables 1–2: Traverse reports BrowseComp 72.83, DeepSearchQA 82.8 and WideSearch 72.1 versus base 61.0, 68.5 and 57.1; GAIA is 80.26 versus 61.81, and FinSearchComp 58.06 versus 38.36.
Section 4.3, Figure 2: BC185 Avg@3 is 65.2 for final-segment RL, 60.4 for SFT, 51.7 for all-segment RL and 57.8 for inverse-segment-count weighting; these evaluations disable answer verification.
Section 4.3, Table 3: active sealing improves Avg@3 from 54.95 to 65.23 but increases average turns from 112.2 to 217.7; median first memory use shifts from 231.4K to 67.5K tokens.

Appendix D: BC185 was selected by retrospectively calibrating fixed-permutation prefixes on five Best-of-1 and four Best-of-5 historical runs; observed subset deviations are three and five percentage points. Appendix F.3 limits FinSearchComp to 391 time-stable questions.

Appendices A, C and F describe synthesis filters, reward terms and tool schemas; several coefficients, exact training-set sizes and teacher identity are not specified in the supplied text. The paper header provides code and dataset links.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant work on long-horizon LLM agents, active memory, tool use and RL. The combination of a rubric/answer/verification harness with final-segment-only optimization is useful and supported by targeted all-segment and trajectory-weighting ablations, although the architectural ingredients have substantial prior art. Broad search and domain-transfer results strengthen the case, but evidence is centered on one 35B MoE, provides no uncertainty estimates, and does not isolate rubric or verification contributions. Active sealing nearly doubles average search turns relative to automatic compaction, so its accuracy advantage is not an equal-total-compute efficiency result. The calibrated 185-question subset and incomplete teacher/data-count/optimization-detail disclosure further limit rigor and reproducibility. Supplied source status is complete; linked code and dataset availability are reported by the paper, not independently verified.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項研究與長時程 LLM 代理、主動記憶、工具使用及 RL 高度相關。將評分規準、答案與驗證組成一套執行框架，再搭配僅最佳化最後一段的做法，具有實用價值；針對所有分段最佳化及軌跡加權的消融實驗也提供支持，但其架構組件已有相當多先前研究。

廣泛的搜尋與跨領域轉移結果強化了論點，但證據集中在單一 35B MoE，沒有提供不確定性估計，也未單獨釐清評分規準或驗證的貢獻。相較自動壓縮，主動封存使平均搜尋輪數接近加倍，因此其準確率優勢並非在相同總計算量下的效率成果。

經校準的 185 題子集，以及教師模型、資料筆數與最佳化細節揭露不完整，進一步限制了嚴謹性與可重現性。提供的來源狀態為完整；連結程式碼與資料集的可用性是論文所述，未經獨立驗證。

primary_link.title: Traverse: Learning When to Remember, Reset, and Redirect for Long-Horizon Web Search

radar.summary: Long-horizon information-seeking agents often accumulate noisy or misleading context, causing early mistakes to persist and making recovery increasingly difficult. We introduce an autonomous search harness in which the agent manages its own search process through three states: Rubric, Answer, and Verify. The agent first defines criteria for a valid answer, searches under these criteria, and then independently verifies the result before deciding whether to terminate or continue searching. It is f
radar.summary_zh: 長程網路搜尋常把錯誤假設與雜訊留在上下文，讓代理反覆走進死路。Traverse 將任務拆成 Rubric、Answer、Verify 三個狀態，由代理先列出答案條件，再搜尋與獨立查證；Seal Memory 讓模型自行決定何時整理證據、保留排除過的候選與下一步計畫，清空上下文後繼續探索。作者發現，把最終獎勵傳給所有記憶分段會造成 Seal Collapse，因此只最佳化最後一段，搭配遮罩式監督微調及資源使用懲罰。以 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 為底座，BrowseComp 達 72.83，DeepSearchQA 為 82.8，WideSearch 為 72.1；財務與購物搜尋也優於原始模型。BC185 消融中，最後分段訓練達 65.2，高於全分段的 51.7；主動記憶整理比固定門檻壓縮高約 10.28 個百分點。不過主動整理的平均搜尋回合也接近翻倍，不能直接解讀為較省成本；實驗主要使用單一底座，未完整拆解驗證狀態的貢獻，且部分訓練設定未充分揭露。這項工作提供可實作的代理復原與記憶訓練設計，但跨模型穩定性與等成本效益仍待確認。

links.title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation

evidence: Sections 4.1–4.3: heading-level BM25 retrieval feeds Cross-Harness Adaptation; RASI uses task/harness descriptions without task rollouts, while RASU retrieves against failed trajectories and accepts changes only when validation improves.

Section 5.1, Table 1: across two backbones and four benchmarks, three-seed means favor RASO; GPT-5.6-Luna SpreadsheetBench is 63.33 ± 2.69 versus SkillOpt 57.02 ± 3.60, and Qwen-3.5-9B WebShop is 24.73 ± 0.41 versus the strongest listed update baseline 13.43 ± 2.01.

Section 5.2, Tables 2–4: factorial initialization/update and adaptation ablations support both components; under common RASI initialization the GPT model reaches 63.33 on SpreadsheetBench versus 60.24 for SkillOpt, narrowing the full-pipeline comparison.

Appendices A.1 and A.3, Table 5: identical task/harness descriptions, two training epochs, top-five retrieved sections, and disjoint train/validation/test splits are specified; benchmark-keyword matches trigger exclusion of entire source repositories.

Appendix A.5, Tables 9–10: GPT optimization costs are reported separately from test evaluation; RASO uses the same rollout counts as TextGrad/WikiSkill and costs $10.28 on WebShop versus $41.03 for TextGrad, while SpreadsheetBench is $0.49 versus WikiSkill $0.43.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant to practical LLM agents, reusable procedural memory and retrieval-augmented prompt optimization. The contribution is an incremental but well-motivated retrieval/adaptation pipeline applied at both initialization and feedback-driven update. Four benchmarks, two backbones, three-seed reporting, disjoint validation/test splits, fixed-initialization comparisons and adaptation ablations make the empirical case comparatively strong. Improvements are not uniformly large relative to standard errors, most controlled analyses cover only OfficeQA and SpreadsheetBench, and public-corpus decontamination is keyword/repository based rather than a comprehensive overlap audit. The supplied text gives useful hyperparameters and costs but no explicit code release link or full optimizer prompts/corpus snapshot, limiting reproducibility.

The contribution is an incremental but well-motivated retrieval/adaptation pipeline applied at both initialization and feedback-driven update. llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
主題直接涉及實用的 LLM 代理、可重複運用的操作流程記憶，以及檢索增強的提示最佳化。其貢獻是一套漸進式但動機充分的檢索與調適流程，同時應用於初始化與回饋驅動的更新。

四個基準、兩個骨幹模型、三個隨機種子的結果回報、互不重疊的驗證／測試切分、固定初始化條件的比較，以及調適消融，使實證依據相對扎實。相對於標準誤，改善幅度並非一律很大；大多數受控分析僅涵蓋 OfficeQA 與 SpreadsheetBench，公開語料庫的去污染處理則以關鍵字／儲存庫為依據，未進行全面的重疊稽核。

提供的文字包含有用的超參數與成本資訊，但沒有明確的程式碼釋出連結，也沒有完整的最佳化器提示或語料庫快照，因此限制了可重現性。

primary_link.title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation

radar.summary: An agent skill is a reusable, actionable natural-language artifact that guides an agent to perform a task effectively under a given harness. Recent studies have explored the optimization of agent skills, contributing to a growing collection of publicly available skills spanning diverse tasks, domains, and harnesses. Despite millions of publicly shared skills, existing skill optimization methods largely overlook this accumulated knowledge, instead relying solely on expensive agent rollouts to ite
radar.summary_zh: RASO 研究如何把公開 agent skill 的程序知識轉移到不同任務與執行環境，避免每次只靠昂貴 rollout 重新摸索。方法先用 BM25 檢索技能段落，再將來源流程改寫為目標工具、物件及限制可支援的指引。RASI 在沒有任務 rollout 時建立初始技能；RASU 則根據失敗軌跡找出缺漏、重新檢索並更新，僅接受驗證集表現較好的版本。四項 benchmark、兩個模型與三個種子的實驗中，RASO 的平均結果皆優於比較方法；GPT-5.6-Luna 在 SpreadsheetBench 得到 63.33，相較 SkillOpt 的 57.02 提升 6.31 點。固定相同 RASI 初始技能後，RASU 仍比最強替代更新法高 3.09 點，較能支持更新流程本身的貢獻。研究亦提供適配、檢索量與語料規模消融，並報告 API 成本。限制是主要控制實驗集中於兩項任務，部分增益接近種子間誤差，公開語料僅靠關鍵字與 repository 排除來控制污染，未提供完整發布資源連結。其價值在於讓技能重用成為可驗證的跨環境知識轉移流程。
radar.title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation

links.title: LongHarness Bench: Stress-Testing Language Model Harnesses for Long-Context Reasoning

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.4 and Appendix B: four tasks use scattered constraints, executable program mutants, dependent tracing, and cross-memo contradictions; gold labels derive from hidden structured records and deterministic checks.
Section 4.1 and Table 2: five models, direct inference and four harnesses; best macro accuracy is 68%, while GPT-5.6-sol memo accuracy/cost is 92%/$7.23 for RLM versus 100%/$0.583 for mini-swe-agent.
Section 3.2 and Appendix B.3–B.4 explicitly limit program equivalence labels to tests/contracts, rather than proving unrestricted semantic equivalence.
Section 4.5 and Appendix B.5: prior-benchmark comparisons use 50-example subsets; LongBench-v2 is intentionally hard-heavy and length-controlled.
Section 4.1 declares a 3M cumulative-token budget, but Appendix A Table 4 reports mean Kimi/OpenCode execution-tracing input of 5.83M tokens; the supplied text does not explain this discrepancy.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant benchmark of agent harnesses, long-context reasoning, retrieval and code semantics. Four deliberately confusable tasks expose meaningful accuracy–cost differences across five model families and four harnesses. Structured answer generation and deterministic validators are strengths. Synthetic task coverage, small comparison subsets, absent uncertainty/repeated-run analysis, and limited harness implementation detail constrain broad conclusions. The stated 3M-token budget is also hard to reconcile with Appendix A averages above 3M for several execution-tracing configurations. A project URL is given, but artifact availability was not independently verified.

Four deliberately confusable tasks expose meaningful accuracy–cost differences across five model families and four harnesses. Structured answer generation and deterministic validators are strengths. Synthetic task coverage, small comparison subsets, absent uncertainty/repeated-run analysis, and limited harness implementation detail constrain broad conclusions. The stated 3M-token budget is also hard to reconcile with Appendix A averages above 3M for several execution-tracing configurations. llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這項基準與代理執行框架、長上下文推理、檢索及程式語意高度相關。四項刻意加入易混淆內容的任務，揭示五個模型家族與四種執行框架之間有意義的正確率與成本差異。以結構化方式產生答案、採用確定性驗證器，是其優點。任務覆蓋偏向合成情境、比較子集規模小、缺少不確定性與重複執行分析，以及執行框架實作細節有限，都限制了廣泛結論的可信度。此外，文中宣稱的3M token預算，難以與附錄A中數種執行追蹤設定超過3M的平均用量相互吻合。論文提供專案網址，但未獨立查證相關產物是否可取得。

primary_link.title: LongHarness Bench: Stress-Testing Language Model Harnesses for Long-Context Reasoning

radar.summary: Language-model (LM) harnesses enable LMs to operate effectively over long contexts using additional compute. However, existing long-context evaluations are insufficient for distinguishing modern harnesses, reflected by saturated accuracy across harnesses and largely similar evaluation costs. In this paper, we introduce a benchmark for evaluating both the effectiveness and efficiency of long-context harnesses. Our tasks require diverse retrieval strategies, including lexical search and semantic m
radar.summary_zh:
LongHarness Bench 關注長上下文代理執行框架是否真正善用額外運算。現有測試常只需簡單檢索或獨立處理片段，難以分辨搜尋順序、證據重用與逐步推理策略。作者設計條件搜尋、等價程式配對、程式執行追蹤及矛盾備忘錄偵測四項任務，在大量語意相近的干擾內容中要求完整且精確的答案；標準答案由隱藏的結構化資料與確定性檢查產生。

研究比較五個模型的直接推論與四種執行框架。GPT-5.6-sol 搭配 mini-swe-agent 的最高宏平均正確率為68%；同一模型在備忘錄任務使用 RLM 達92%，每題估計7.23美元，mini-swe-agent 則達100%、0.583美元。結果顯示更多呼叫不保證更好表現，也沒有框架在所有任務占優；整理可重用事實比反覆讀取更可能兼顧成本。

links.title: Louder, Longer, Livelier: Acoustic Shortcuts and Underspecified Rationales in Speech LLM Judges

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3, Table 1 and Appendix A.1–A.3: six judges include a scalar BTRM, four Qwen2.5-Omni-based specialists and two Gemini models; stimuli comprise an 80-utterance intensity pool, 149 ASSET concise/richer pairs and 800 ESD recordings, with both presentation orders tested.

Section 4.1 and Appendix B.2, Table 4: all five pairwise judges prefer +6 dB, with rates 0.541–0.616 and mean 0.578; SQ-LLM pointwise changes are zero despite pairwise preference 0.591. Appendix D.1 reports human loudness preference 0.612, making the invalid-quality interpretation dependent on the intended criterion.

Section 4.2, Table 2 and Appendix B.3, Tables 6–8: richer-content preference is approximately 0.71, versus 0.41 for silence padding and 0.46 for repetition; richer versus duration-matched padding remains approximately 0.70. A Gemini-3.1 anti-length/position instruction changes 0.701 to 0.695.

Section 4.3, Appendix B.4 and Appendix D.1, Tables 9 and 14: mean judge Happy preference is 0.531 versus humans 0.407; Sad is 0.403 versus humans 0.217. The human calibration uses 15 listeners, 449 valid judgments and only 60 unique pairs.

Sections 5.1–5.2 and Appendix C.1, Tables 12–13: UniSRM loudness words occur at 0% for loud/loudness/volume and 0.94% for amplitude/dB/level; content-richness naming is sparse, while repetition naming ranges from 5.7% to 27.9% in the four listed judges. These are lexical user-visible rationale findings, not causal evidence about hidden reasoning.

Section 7 and Appendices A.2, B.1, B.2 and B.4: English-only pools and heterogeneous quality criteria restrict generalization; methods specify 80 intensity base utterances and 200 matched speaker–sentence emotion sets, whereas some pointwise loudness Ns are 99–160 and emotion pairwise N is 400, leaving the mapping between tabulated counts and independent analysis units insufficiently explicit.

Appendix A.3 claims release of SpeechJudgeAudit stimuli, manifests, prompt templates and analysis scripts, with ESD file lists/preparation scripts rather than redistributed recordings. Section 6 proposes preprocessing and grounded-rationale training; training-based mitigation is not experimentally demonstrated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly relevant LLM-as-judge and reward-model reliability research rather than a pure audio application. Controlled waveform changes, duration/repetition controls, order counterbalancing and human calibration expose meaningful modality-specific evaluation failures, and the paper carefully separates visible rationale underspecification from internal reasoning faithfulness. Evidence spans six judges but only two backbone families, English stimuli and a small 60-pair human calibration. Loudness is also preferred by humans, so calling it invalid evidence depends on the chosen quality construct; content-richness and emotion comparisons retain perceptual/linguistic complexity. Narrow lexical rationale audits and some insufficiently explained sample counts limit stronger conclusions. The released-suite claim and detailed stimuli/prompts support replication, though no independent artifact execution or availability check was performed; no effective mitigation training is demonstrated.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項研究直接涉及 LLM-as-judge 與獎勵模型的可靠性，而非純粹的音訊應用。受控的波形變更、時長與重複控制、順序平衡設計，以及人類校準，揭露了具有意義、與模態相關的評估失誤；論文也謹慎區分了可見評估理由交代不足與內部推理忠實性。

證據涵蓋六個評判模型，但僅涉及兩個骨幹模型家族、英語刺激材料，以及規模僅 60 對的人類校準。人類也偏好較高響度，因此將其稱為無效證據，取決於所選的品質構念；內容豐富度與情緒比較仍存在感知及語言層面的複雜性。範圍狹窄的評估理由詞彙稽核，以及部分交代不足的樣本數，限制了更強的結論。

宣稱已釋出測試套件，加上詳盡的刺激材料與提示，有助於重現；不過，未獨立執行研究產物或查核其可用性，也未展示有效的緩解訓練。

primary_link.title: Louder, Longer, Livelier: Acoustic Shortcuts and Underspecified Rationales in Speech LLM Judges

radar.summary: LLM-as-a-judge is widely used for evaluating text, but extending this paradigm to speech requires models to interpret acoustic as well as linguistic evidence. This introduces a modality-specific risk: a speech judge may treat a perceptually salient cue as evidence of quality even when that cue is irrelevant to the target criterion or receives more weight than human listeners give it. We call this behavior an acoustic shortcut. To study it, we audit six speech LLM judges using controlled manipula
radar.summary_zh: 語音 LLM 評審可能把容易察覺的聲學線索當成品質證據，讓評測與獎勵模型偏離原本目標。本文稽核六個評審，涵蓋以 Qwen2.5-Omni 為基礎的專用模型及兩個 Gemini 模型，操控音量、內容豐富度與情緒表達，並比較單筆評分、雙向交換順序的成對選擇，以及評語是否指出改變的線索。五個成對評審都偏好提高 6 dB 的語音，平均偏好率為 0.578；內容較豐富的語音獲得 0.707 偏好率，人類則為 0.547。補靜音與重複語句未重現此優勢，顯示效果不能只歸因於片長。情緒結果較細緻：人類也不偏好悲傷語氣，快樂語氣才有較明顯的人機差距。詞彙稽核發現，評語常使用自然度、韻律等泛稱，少有明確點出操控線索。研究提供 SpeechJudgeAudit，並建議先正規化音量、處理邊界靜音，同時檢查兩種評分模式。不過資料僅含英語，人類校準只有十五位聽者、六十組配對；人類同樣偏好較大音量，因此何者屬於無效品質線索仍取決於評測定義。詞彙缺漏也不能證明模型內部推理不忠實。這項研究對使用 LLM 評審做模型選擇與訓練獎勵有直接警示，但未驗證完整的去偏訓練方案。

links.title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.3: sequential failed-attempt insights are inserted while running success is at most 50%; an SFT loss predicts insight tokens directly from the task, rather than training the feedback generator on full rollouts. The reported overall walltime overhead is 1.5×.

Sections 4.1–4.2, Figure 2 and Table 1: Pass@128=0 filtering leaves 458 SAPI, 34 Appworld and 123 Leetcode tasks; three-seed curves evaluate without insights. Heldout RLTL;DR versus GRPO Pass@1 is 91.1% versus 57.8% on SAPI, 61.7% versus 33.7% on Appworld, and 49.1% versus 55.1% on Leetcode. Appworld training includes test-normal, so these are explicitly not standard benchmark scores.

Section 5, Table 2 and Appendix E.3: on the 386/256 SAPI hard-task split, RLTL;DR reaches 18.9% heldout Pass@1; removing GRPO reaches 17.0% with about 25% more interactions. Deduplicated SFTL;DR uses about 4k task-insight pairs and 68k backward tokens for 16.9%, versus 20.9% for SFT on all 3.5k full rollouts; rollout collection remains about 1B tokens.

Section 6, Table 3: removing failed-unit-test information lowers train/eval Pass@1 to 3.4%/10.0% from 21.4%/19.2%; longer diagnostic feedback and corrected code do not improve no-insight evaluation over short hints.

Sections 7.1–7.3 and Appendix E.7: the smoothness explanation is a hypothesis; Leetcode overfitting and domain specificity limit transfer, and normal-difficulty tool-use tasks show no final advantage over GRPO.

Appendices A–B and D: prompts, mask construction, training hyperparameters, 8×B200 compute, macro-averaged metrics and asynchronous-rollout confound controls are specified; Section 4.1 identifies SAPI as proprietary.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-agent post-training work: sequential verifier-informed retries supply exploration, while a simple task-to-insight SFT objective internalizes short procedural feedback without requiring it at inference. Extensive loss, feedback-format, generator, and difficulty ablations plus three-seed curves support this specific mechanism. Strong heldout gains in simulated tool-use tasks are balanced by worse Leetcode generalization, dependence on privileged verifier feedback, a single 9B policy, and proprietary SAPI data. Compact insight training reduces policy-update tokens, not the roughly 1B-token rollout-collection cost; its 16.9% heldout result remains below full-rollout SFT at 20.9%. Detailed prompts and hyperparameters help reproduction, but no public implementation or SAPI release is established in the supplied text.

primary_link.title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback

radar.summary: The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones. This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from. radar.summary_zh: 當任務困難到模型嘗試128次仍無成功，GRPO便可能缺乏有效學習訊號。RLTL;DR讓代理讀取失敗軌跡與驗證器輸出，產生一句精簡提醒，供下一次嘗試使用；同時對提醒詞元施加SFT損失，學習從任務直接預測重點，使測試時不必附帶提醒。研究以Qwen 3.5 9B進行三組任務實驗，包含三個種子的訓練曲線與多項消融。在困難任務上，無提醒的Pass@1由GRPO約0–1%提高至12–13%；保留集的工具操作表現亦改善，但Leetcode低於GRPO，顯示遷移並不普遍。進一步的SFTL;DR只訓練約四千組任務與提醒，保留集達16.9%，接近完整方法的18.9%，但低於完整軌跡SFT的20.9%。省下的是參數更新計算，產生軌跡仍需約十億詞元。結果支持將經驗濃縮後寫入模型參數的方向；限制包括主要資料集未公開、僅驗證單一9B模型，且移除失敗測試資訊後成效大幅下降，尚不能視為無外部驗證器的通用自我改善方法。

links.title: SERA: Scale-Equalized Rollout Allocation for Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Sections 2–3 and Appendix B.1–B.3: derive kappa(p,N)=1-(1-p)^(N-1), retained-set conditional gradient scaling, and the bounded continuous fixed-budget max–min allocation; Appendix C.4 derives the N0/Nq multiplicity correction.

Section 4.1 and Appendix D.2.1: ImageNet uses oracle correct-class probabilities; mean sampled-to-exact CE gradient cosine is 0.6266 versus 0.4317 at N0=128, measured along each method’s own trajectory, rather than a same-parameter cross-method comparison.

Section 4.3, Table 1, and Appendix D.2.3 Table 5: SmolLM2 Pass@256 rises from 72.21 to 77.34 under token-mean and from 68.24 to 73.37 under Seqnorm; Seqnorm gain has a fixed-checkpoint question-paired 95% interval of [2.48,7.86]. PKPO retains higher large-K coverage but lower Pass@1; DARS-HW uses 1.49 times the rollouts.

Section 4.4 and Appendix D.2.4 Tables 6–9: Qwen3-4B BeyondAIME Pass@512 is 63.00 versus 55.00, with a gain interval [0.00,17.00]; Minerva Math gains 4.78 points with [1.84,8.09], while MATH-500 drops 0.40 points and AIME 2025 ties at Pass@512.

Appendices B.2, C.1, C.3, and D.2.5: theory conditions on a retained set; historical estimates are frozen by epoch; integerization can break prefix-search monotonicity and fallback can miss the observability threshold; all prompts remain active in analyzed Maze, SmolLM2, and Qwen2.5 windows.

Reproducibility statement and Appendix D.1: code/supplement availability and experimental settings are claimed, with training configuration and prompt details delegated to Figures 5–13 whose contents are not included in the supplied text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM reasoning and RLVR efficiency: SERA targets the finite-rollout attenuation of the existing centered MaxRL estimator through a fixed-budget waterline allocation and multiplicity correction. The conditional derivations, matched-response comparisons across three language-model scales, exact-gradient ImageNet diagnostic, normalization comparisons, and question-paired intervals provide substantial support. SmolLM2 gains 5.13 points at Pass@256; Qwen gains are benchmark- and budget-dependent, and several intervals include zero. Novelty is a focused estimator/allocation refinement rather than a new RL objective. Confidence is limited by the absence of systematic component ablations and training-seed uncertainty, success-estimate and retained-set assumptions, and response-budget matching without measured wall-clock or token-cost equivalence. Code availability is claimed, but not independently checked; several detailed configurations are only referenced through figures absent from the supplied text.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 與 LLM 推理及 RLVR 效率高度相關：SERA 以固定預算的水位式配置與 multiplicity correction，處理既有中心化 MaxRL 估計器在有限 rollout 下的梯度衰減。條件式推導、三種語言模型規模的等回應數比較、ImageNet 精確梯度診斷、正規化比較與題目配對信賴區間，提供相當支持。SmolLM2 的 Pass@256 提升 5.13 個百分點；Qwen 的增益則依基準與取樣預算而異，部分區間包含零。創新主要是估計器與配置方式的精準改良，並非新的 RL 目標。限制包括缺乏系統性元件消融與訓練種子變異分析、依賴成功率估計及保留題目集合的假設，以及僅匹配回應數、未實測時間或 token 成本是否相等。論文聲稱提供程式碼，但未獨立查驗；部分詳細設定只在所提供文字未呈現的圖中引用。

primary_link.title: SERA: Scale-Equalized Rollout Allocation for Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning

radar.summary: Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (MaxRL) targets prompt-wise log-success and has shown strong performance on reasoning tasks. Under finite rollout budgets, however, the estimator used by MaxRL attenuates each prompt's likelihood gradient by a factor that depends on its success probability and rollout count. Under uniform rollout allocation, the common rollout count fails to compensate for success-dependent attenuation, leaving low-success prompts more strongly attenuated and distorting
radar.summary_zh:
SERA 處理語言模型推理強化學習中的取樣預算問題：MaxRL 雖以每題成功率的對數為目標，有限次 rollout 卻會更強烈地削弱低成功率題目的梯度，扭曲整批題目的相對貢獻。作者推導這項縮放係數，以固定總預算下的最大最小準則分配 rollout，再以 multiplicity correction 消除不同取樣數帶來的額外題目權重。

方法用歷史成功率估計配置預算，並加入可觀測性篩選與整數化。ImageNet 控制實驗中，取樣梯度與精確梯度的平均餘弦相似度由 0.4317 升至 0.6266；SmolLM2 在 GSM8K-Platinum 的 Pass@256 比 MaxRL 高 5.13 個百分點。Qwen3-4B 在 BeyondAIME 的 Pass@512 高 8 點，但並非所有基準與取樣數都改善。

理論針對固定保留題目集合；實務上仍受成功率估計、篩選與損失正規化影響。部分 Qwen 差異的信賴區間包含零，bootstrap 也未涵蓋重新訓練的變異，且缺少完整元件消融與實測時間成本。其價值在於提出可解析的預算配置原則，改善多次取樣涵蓋率，而非保證所有情境都提高單次準確率。
radar.title: SERA: Scale-Equalized Rollout Allocation for Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
radar.title_zh: SERA：以尺度等化的 rollout 配置改善最大概似強化學習

links.title: FlowMAS: Learning Multi-Agent Workflow Topology via Information-guided Generative Flow Network

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.3 and Appendix A: construct DAG workflows using graph-edit forward/backward policies, intermediate curiosity and information rewards, and a terminal accuracy-minus-token-cost reward; workflows use predefined operators.

Appendices B–D, Equations 15–26: derive reward-augmented trajectory balance and explicitly compute PID-inspired terms per example with normalized answer/message embeddings and cosine similarities, without estimating empirical mutual information; ground-truth targets are used only in training.

Section 4.1, Tables 1–2 and Appendix G.1/Table 6: six benchmarks, three LLM backbones and five independent trials; the 1:4 optimization/test split leaves HumanEval with 33 train/validation and 131 test examples. Llama-3.1-8B average is 70.50 for FlowMAS versus 67.73 for MaAS.

Sections 4.3–4.4, Tables 3–5: HumanEval accuracy 69.6 with 384,278 training and 900,287 inference tokens versus AFlow 65.1 with 6,253,861 and 13,690,205; removing both CDM and IOM lowers FlowMAS accuracy to 62.8 and average explored executable topologies from 81 to 51.

Appendix G.2.2–G.2.6, Tables 9–13: 20-operator HumanEval accuracy is 65.6 versus MaAS 59.5; BBH trains on examples from 10 task types and evaluates 5,000 examples across seen and unseen types, reporting aggregate 69.0/85.0 for Llama/GPT. HumanEval wall-clock measurements use one RTX 5090, and IOM/CDM consume 1.81/0.74 of 39 training minutes.

Appendix H and NeurIPS checklist items 4–6 and 13: supplied registry and operator implementations aid reconstruction, while checklist claims supplementary source and future public code/data release; the supplied text does not provide a complete executable training package or full optimizer/training configuration.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant work on learned LLM-agent orchestration, reasoning and code generation. The combination of reward-augmented graph-edit GFlowNets, structural exploration and local message rewards is a meaningful methodological contribution, with unusually broad multi-backbone comparisons, five-run main results, component/backbone ablations and cost measurements. However, the information reward is explicitly a cosine-embedding heuristic rather than an estimated PID, and the reward-augmented derivation does not establish the original terminal-reward proportionality claim. Evaluation remains benchmark- and operator-pool-bound, BBH aggregates seen and unseen tasks, and supplied operator code plus promised public release do not constitute a fully specified reproducible trainer. These limit rigor, generalization and reproducibility despite consistent reported gains.

這項工作聚焦於學習式 LLM agent 編排、推理與程式碼生成，具有高度相關性。結合獎勵增強的圖編輯 GFlowNets、結構探索與區域訊息獎勵，是有意義的方法貢獻；研究也提供少見的廣泛多骨幹比較、五次執行的主要結果、元件與骨幹消融，以及成本量測。

不過，資訊獎勵明確採用嵌入向量餘弦相似度的啟發式方法，並非對 PID 的估計；獎勵增強的推導也未確立原先宣稱的終端獎勵比例關係。評估仍受基準與運算子集合限制，BBH 將已見及未見任務合併計算；所附運算子程式碼與承諾的公開釋出，也不等同於規格完整、可重現的訓練程式。儘管報告的提升一致，這些限制仍影響嚴謹性、泛化性與可重現性。

primary_link.title: FlowMAS: Learning Multi-Agent Workflow Topology via Information-guided Generative Flow Network

radar.summary: Automated multi-agent systems offer clear advantages over manually designed ones in scalability and adaptability, but existing workflow topology methods still face important limitations. Search-based methods are often computationally expensive, textual-gradient-based methods rely on coarse-grained feedback, and existing generation-based methods are not well suited to discrete workflow topologies with complex dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose FlowMAS, a multi-agent workflow t
radar.summary_zh: FlowMAS 研究如何依查詢自動組成 LLM 多代理工作流程，在回答品質、拓樸多樣性與 token 成本間取得平衡。方法以 GFlowNet 逐步新增運算節點與連線，生成有向無環圖；中間獎勵結合隨機網路蒸餾式的新奇性、PID 啟發的訊息互補性，以及 Gram matrix 的頻譜熵。互補性實際以訊息與標準答案的嵌入相似度近似，答案只在訓練時使用，因此不應把它視為嚴格的互資訊估計。研究涵蓋六個程式、數學與閱讀理解基準、三種 LLM，主要結果報告五次試驗的平均與標準差。Llama-3.1-8B 的六項平均為 70.50，優於 MaAS 的 67.73；HumanEval 使用約九十萬推論 token，AFlow 則約一千三百六十九萬。移除探索與資訊模組後，HumanEval 從 69.6 降至 62.8，支持兩者的實用價值。BBH 與擴大運算子集合也提供延伸證據，但 BBH 混合已見及未見任務，尚不足以單獨量化未見任務遷移。限制包括固定 DAG 與運算子設計、資訊獎勵的啟發式假設，以及完整程式碼仍宣稱待公開；附錄的運算子程式不等同完整可重現套件。這項工作對代理編排與推論成本最佳化很有參考價值。

links.title: Do Agent Benchmarks Do What They Say? An Executable-Contract Audit of Tool-Using Agent Environments

evidence: Sections III–IV define six tool-boundary defect classes, provenance tiers and static/dynamic contract checks; MedAgentBench is inspected manually without an adapter, and MM-ToolSandbox evaluator tracing stops at an unavailable appworld package.

Section V-A and Tables III–IV report 34 anchor tools, seven confirmed tool defects and one evaluator property at pinned commits; the sample includes known-defect benchmarks and hand-chosen controls, so the cross-benchmark totals are existence evidence rather than prevalence.

Section V-B2 and Tables V–VI distinguish exposure, trigger reach and verdict changes: ten sampled gold replays trigger neither tau2-bench defect, while the constructed suspend/refuel/resume paths pass all 1,120 telecom tasks with the defective tool and fail with its repair. These paths are fixed by construction and do not measure naturally occurring agent failures.

Section V-B3 reports the static scanner finds 14 of 17 confirmed sites with 9 false flags in its 49-tool population; a blind audit adds one previously unsuspected calendar defect, and the complete 25-tool AgentDojo surface has at least five checker-confirmed divergent tools, with three untestable.

Section V-B4 and Table VII show low mutation recall: 29 of 33 real-tool misses have a covering clause but no revealing probe, and two of five negative controls falsely flag. The pooled 25 injected-defect flags have no false positives, which the paper explicitly does not generalize to shipped-tool precision.

Sections V-A, V-B5 and V-C report an MIT-licensed GitHub artifact and Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22182792, offline reproduction and pinned-clone ledger commands; contract agreement is 98/99 comparisons from two model-session annotator sets, while registration history, missing probes and source-selection limitations are disclosed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant audit of tool-using LLM benchmark validity: provenance-bound contracts and state/evaluator tracing produce concrete, pinned examples of misleading success signals and unenforced behavior. The novelty lies mainly in the audit target and integration of established contract, metamorphic and provenance techniques. Extensive controls, mutation experiments, transparent null results and disclosed selection biases support the existence findings, but do not establish reliable automated discovery or practical leaderboard impact. Most anchor findings predate the checker; recall is low, negative controls expose false positives, some adapters and traces are unavailable, and annotation checks use model sessions rather than independent humans. The complete AgentDojo surface gives a bounded within-benchmark result, while other populations are deliberately selected. The source reports archived code, pinned commits and reproduction commands, not independently executed here.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項研究稽核使用工具的 LLM 基準是否有效，具有高度相關性：與來源溯源資訊綁定的契約，以及狀態與評估器追蹤，提供了具體且鎖定版本的例子，呈現誤導性的成功訊號與未受強制執行的行為要求。新穎性主要在於稽核對象，以及整合既有的契約、蛻變測試與溯源技術。

廣泛的對照、突變實驗、透明呈現的陰性結果，以及揭露的選擇偏差，支持這些問題確實存在，但未能確立可靠的自動發現能力或對實務排行榜的影響。多數作為錨點的發現早於檢查器；召回率偏低，負對照揭露偽陽性，部分轉接器與追蹤紀錄無法取得，而且標註檢查採用模型工作階段，而非獨立的人類標註者。

完整的 AgentDojo 檢查範圍提供了界線明確的基準內結果，其他受檢群體則是刻意挑選的。來源報告了封存的程式碼、鎖定的 commit 與重現命令，但本次未獨立執行驗證。

primary_link.title: Do Agent Benchmarks Do What They Say? An Executable-Contract Audit of Tool-Using Agent Environments

radar.summary: Tool-using agents are entering settings where a wrong action carries real cost, and the benchmarks certifying them grade what each simulated tool call reports having done, assuming the tool did what its interface advertises. The audit taxonomies we survey publish no category for that assumption, and a defect beneath a score is present on every rerun. We treat a tool's advertised surfaces as an executable contract, check the implementation against it, and trace each score's provenance through the
radar.summary_zh: 代理評測常假設工具回傳成功就代表狀態真的改變；若模擬工具違反介面承諾，分數可能衡量錯誤的能力。本文將工具文件、提示與回傳訊息轉成可執行契約，結合靜態掃描、動態前後狀態檢查，並沿評分程式追蹤受影響欄位。作者在四個基準的34個變更狀態工具中確認七項工具缺陷與一項評分器性質；完整檢查 AgentDojo 的25個工具後，至少五個違反契約。MedAgentBench 的案例顯示，工具宣稱寫入成功，但評分器只檢查訊息與請求內容。於1,120條刻意構造的電信路徑中，原評分器獎勵違規加值，修補工具後反而判失敗；這不代表實際有同等數量任務受害，原始標準軌跡也未觸發兩項 tau2-bench 缺陷。方法的價值在揭露分數來源與可重現證據：動態檢查器只新增一項先前未知缺陷，多數注入缺陷未被找到，五項負對照也有兩項誤報。研究提供封存程式與固定版本，但跨基準樣本偏向已知問題，契約解讀仍需人工確認。因此，採用代理基準選模型時，應同時稽核工具的狀態變化與評分依據，不能把這些案例直接換算成排行榜修正幅度。

links.title: When Upstream Messages Override Correct Answers: A Controlled Study of Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration

evidence: Sections 2.1 and 3.1; Appendix A.20: the design holds task evidence fixed while changing message availability, crosses five benchmarks with five receivers, and classifies independent solvability using at least two correct answers in three temperature-zero evidence-only runs; 750 items and 11,250 evidence-only calls are reported.

Section 3.3; Appendix A.11, Table 14: 274/2,184 independently solvable cases flip from correct to wrong across the 20 non-DROP cells; including DROP gives 297/2,667 (11.1%). The largest reported cell is kimi-k2.6 on BIRD, 24/75 (32%).

Section 3.3; Appendix A.3: the peer-answer adoption audit covers all 82 correct-to-wrong transitions in four HotpotQA receiver cells and one LBM cell; 77/82 match the upstream wrong answer, with a reported bootstrap 95% interval of 87–98%. This is a selected five-cell audit, not the entire 25-cell population.

Section 3.4; Appendices A.15 and A.19, Tables 21 and 24–25: full reversal retains 60–73% token overlap in the reported overlap analysis; minimal-edit tests preserve substantially more text and yield significant effects in four of nine cells, with no significant BIRD result.

Section 3.5; Appendices A.21–A.22, Tables 26–27: matched-review controls retain directional harm, while source-label comparisons are non-significant; equivalence testing is informative for many HotpotQA pairs but limited by small LBM samples and low kimi flip counts.

Section 4; Appendices A.16–A.18: 60 strong-model traces receive two independent annotations, with 59/60 agreement and reported Gwet AC1 of 0.98; the retained label is evidence-engaged because finer behavioral subcategories were not reliably distinguished.

Section 3.6; Appendix A.8, Tables 7–10: the gemini-2.5-pro detector has precision 91.8% on BIRD, 81.1% on LBM, and 35.0% on L2W. Gated removal plus a different-family receiver changes accuracy from .400 to .493 on BIRD and .539 to .614 on LBM; unconditional same-receiver removal has negative mean effects on all three reported benchmarks.

Section 6; Appendix A.8: authors limit mechanism claims, identify oracle-quality evidence and discrete-answer tasks as scope restrictions, and acknowledge that receiver replacement changes capability and other properties together. Same-family replacements also recover performance.

Appendices A.24–A.26: a three-layer pilot has only 30 HotpotQA items; model identifiers, temperature, token budgets, prompt templates, and scoring rules are supplied. Appendix A.17 refers to supplementary traces, but the supplied full text contains no public code/data artifact link or exact evaluation item list.
llm_evaluation.rationale:
Highly relevant to LLM agents, reasoning, evidence use, and reliability evaluation. The contribution is a useful controlled diagnosis of answer substitution, rather than a new agent architecture: fixed-evidence, item-paired message interventions distinguish harmful copying from the average benefit of communication, extending familiar conformity and knowledge-conflict findings.

The five-benchmark, five-receiver study has unusually extensive controls, including three-run evidence-only capability classification, matched review calls, delayed receipt, source labels, and conclusion reversal. The reported 297/2,667 correct-to-wrong transitions and 77/82 peer-answer matches support a behavioral failure mode. However, the 94% adoption estimate covers five audited cells rather than all 25, full reversals also change substantial supporting text, and minimal edits reach significance in only four of nine cells. Trace annotations establish visible evidence engagement, not a uniquely identified internal mechanism.

Applicability is limited by oracle-quality evidence, small benchmark subsets, discrete QA/SQL outputs, and a primarily two-node handoff. Recovery depends on detector precision and replacement-model capability: gated removal plus replacement improves BIRD and LBM, but indiscriminate removal can discard useful messages. Detailed prompts, model identifiers, and statistical procedures aid replication; the supplied text provides no public code/data artifact link or exact evaluation item list, and supplementary-trace availability cannot be independently verified here. This is strong diagnostic evidence with qualified deployment implications, not a generally validated repair method.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
本研究與 LLM 代理、推理、證據運用及可靠性評估高度相關。其貢獻是對答案替代現象提出實用的控制實驗診斷，而非新的代理架構：固定證據並逐題配對操弄訊息，將有害的答案抄用與溝通的平均效益分開，延伸既有從眾與知識衝突研究的發現。

研究涵蓋五個基準測試及五種接收模型，控制實驗相當完整，包括以三次僅提供證據的獨立執行判定解題能力、配對的複查呼叫、延後接收訊息、來源標籤及結論反轉。文中報告的 297/2,667 次由對轉錯，以及 77/82 次與同儕答案相符，支持這項行為失效現象。不過，94% 的採納率僅涵蓋五組受稽核的模型與基準組合，並非全部 25 組；完整反轉也修改了相當多的支援文字，而最小修改僅在九組中的四組達顯著。推理軌跡標註能確認可見的證據運用，卻無法唯一辨識內部機制。

適用範圍受限於理想品質的證據、較小的基準子集、具離散答案的問答與 SQL 輸出，以及主要採用雙節點交接。恢復效果取決於錯誤偵測器的精確率與替換模型的能力：先偵測再移除訊息並替換模型，可改善 BIRD 與 LBM 的表現，但一律移除訊息可能丟失有用資訊。詳細提示詞、模型識別碼及統計程序有助重現；然而，提供的文字未列出公開程式碼或資料產物連結，也未列出確切的評估題目清單，此處亦無法獨立核實補充推理軌跡是否可取得。這是有力的診斷證據，部署意涵仍須附帶條件，尚非已普遍驗證的修復方法。

primary_link.title: When Upstream Messages Override Correct Answers: A Controlled Study of Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration

radar.summary: Multi-agent LLM systems rely on message passing among specialized agents to accomplish complex tasks. However, an upstream agent may provide useful information or an incorrect answer that causes a downstream agent to override a correct answer supported by its own evidence. Prior work has not clearly separated the benefits of communication from the damage caused by incorrect messages. We study this problem with controlled experiments across five benchmarks and five receivers, keeping the downstre
radar.summary_zh:
多代理 LLM 仰賴訊息交接，但接收端即使握有足夠證據，也可能被上游錯誤答案帶偏。本研究固定題目與證據，比較隱藏訊息、原始訊息及反轉結論，並以五個基準測試、五種接收模型，檢查問答與 SQL 生成中的「答案替代」。

在原本能獨立答對的 2,667 個模型與題目組合中，297 個收到訊息後答錯，約占 11.1%，單一組合最高達 32%；另行稽核的 82 個有害案例中，77 個採用了上游的特定錯誤答案。延後接收、改換來源標籤及配對複查仍觀察到影響；只改結論的最小修改實驗則僅九組中的四組達顯著，顯示效果依模型與任務而異。

移除可疑訊息並更換接收模型，在錯誤偵測器介入後改善了部分基準表現；但丟棄正確訊息也會造成損失，實際效益取決於偵測精確率。研究使用理想品質證據與離散答案，主要限於雙節點流程，尚不能直接推論至開放式生成或長鏈協作。其價值是提醒系統設計者同時量測訊息帶來的幫助與傷害，並保護接收端的獨立判斷，而非假定增加溝通必然提升可靠性。

links.title: Tail-Influence Sampling for CVaR Policy Evaluation

evidence: Sections 2–4; Theorems 1–3; Appendices C.1–C.2 and D.3: independent queryable conditional laws, shared Bellman influence, fixed-design efficiency, and pilot-inclusive oracle asymptotic MSE require fixed dimension and a positive categorical quantile margin. The guarantee concerns the categorical target, with a separate HΔ approximation bound in Appendix E.1.

Section 4, Equation 10; Appendix D.4, Proposition 4 and Corollary 1: the equal tail-influence/occupancy mixture has a component-relative variance safeguard and an asymptotic constant between V* and 2V*. The paper explicitly does not claim a finite-budget MSE guarantee.

Appendix E.2.4, Table 6: at 400 charged queries/kernel and 500 replications, CliffWalking TIS MSE is 1.884×10^-3 versus learned occupancy 3.189×10^-3, learned mean 2.307×10^-3, and rollouts 7.954×10^-3. Covariance-deleted TIS is 1.875×10^-3, so empirical benefits mainly support pooling rather than a large covariance correction.

Appendix E.2.6, Tables 7–12 and Equation 66: six LLM generators use 50 fixed MMLU-Pro questions, 91 directly queryable kernels per question, frozen restricted answer/confidence token laws, and 300 replications. At H=6 and 400 queries/kernel, plain TIS/uniform MSE is 1.38 for Qwen3-4B and 1.77 for GLM-4-32B; the respective anchored ratios are 0.057 and 0.065. Uncertainty is Monte Carlo error conditional on the panel, not population generalization.

Appendices E.3 and E.5, Tables 14–15: the held-out FinQA panel admits 50 of 312 screened questions after development/protocol freeze. The mean-influence/occupancy blend has lower point MSE in all 16 primary blending cells and resolved lower MSE in 15; improved estimation does not resolve anchor superiority over occupancy or rollouts for Phi workflow selection at 100/200 queries.

Appendix E.5; Appendix E.8, Table 17: anchored TIS beats the equally regularized mean blend in 23 of 24 MMLU-Pro confident-error cells. For six-call FinQA Phi at 400 queries/kernel, anchor/rollout MSE is 0.29 for ordinary review and 0.41 for unit checks, whereas Qwen ratios are 2.02 and 2.13.

Appendix E.9: a pilot-distance threshold of 0.21 chooses a design without resolved higher MSE in 141 of 148 setting–budget cells, but four near-deterministic six-call FinQA Qwen errors incur 1.4–2.3× mean-blend MSE. Appendix E.10 also warns that 300 replications can miss rare variance-carrying deviations.

Title-page code statement links https://github.com/paulinebourigault/TIS. Appendices D and E specify pseudocode, grids, pilot/floor schedules, replications, metrics, screening, and CPU accounting; Appendix E.2.7 distinguishes frozen-law replay times from live model-call costs. Code availability is reported by the paper, not independently verified in this review.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant methodology for budget-efficient tail-risk evaluation of LLM review and reusable agent workflows. The substantive contribution is learning Bellman-dependent CVaR influence, including shared-kernel reuse, rather than inventing Neyman allocation or defensive mixtures. Detailed efficiency and oracle-adaptation proofs, exact targets, charged pilots, matched-cost baselines, blending controls, and candid negative results make the work unusually rigorous. Evidence remains conditional on small fixed panels and frozen, restricted-output LLM laws: direct conditional access is stronger than rollout access, plain TIS can fail badly, and the mean-influence blend outperforms the anchor in 15 of 16 held-out FinQA cells. No finite-budget MSE guarantee or live-call cost validation is established. Detailed protocols and a public code link support reproducibility, but the repository was not independently inspected or executed.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這套方法與在有限預算下有效率地評估 LLM 審查及可重用 agent 工作流程的尾端風險高度相關。實質貢獻在於學習具有 Bellman 相依性的 CVaR 影響量，並支援共用核心重用，而非發明 Neyman allocation 或防禦性混合。詳細的效率與 oracle 調適證明、精確的目標量、計入成本的先導試驗、成本相同的基線、混合對照，以及坦率呈現的負面結果，使這項工作格外嚴謹。

證據仍以小型固定評估組，以及凍結且輸出受限的 LLM 機率法則為條件：直接條件式存取比 rollout 存取更強，單純的 TIS 可能嚴重失敗，而平均影響量混合方法在 16 個保留集 FinQA 實驗格中，有 15 個優於錨點方法。研究未確立有限預算下的 MSE 保證，也未驗證實際呼叫成本。

詳細的實驗流程與公開程式碼連結支持可重現性，但本次未獨立檢查或執行該儲存庫。

primary_link.title: Tail-Influence Sampling for CVaR Policy Evaluation

radar.summary: Policies with similar mean returns can differ sharply in rare failures, yet estimating lower-tail conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) accurately can require many costly rollouts. When different conditional components of a stochastic workflow can be queried separately, we ask how to allocate a fixed evaluation budget to estimate a fixed policy's CVaR most accurately. We derive a tail influence for each queryable conditional law that aggregates how its uncertainty affects CVaR across every Bellman re
radar.summary_zh: 評估 LLM 審查流程時，平均分數可能掩蓋少數嚴重失敗，而直接重跑完整流程又很耗查詢預算。本文提出 Tail-Influence Sampling（TIS），先用均勻試採樣建立條件轉移模型，再計算各條件分布對 CVaR 的影響；同一分布跨步驟重複使用的效應先合併，再依影響變異分配新查詢。混合造訪頻率的 anchored TIS 則降低試採樣漏見罕見結果造成的預算不足。在固定維度、正分位數間距等條件下，作者證明 TIS 達到 oracle 的漸近均方誤差，並把試採樣成本納入。實驗中，CliffWalking 的 MSE 比學得的造訪分配低約 41%；MMLU-Pro 高信心錯誤設定下，anchor 在 24 組中有 23 組優於同等混合的平均影響基準。六次呼叫的 FinQA Phi 流程在每條件 400 次查詢時，MSE 約為完整 rollout 的 0.29–0.41 倍。不過 LLM 實驗使用凍結分布與受限雙 token 輸出，沒有驗證實際線上費用；FinQA 的平均影響混合通常更好，原始 TIS 也可能因試採樣失敗而退步。價值在於提供可分析的尾端風險評估分配方法與適用條件，而非保證所有代理流程都省成本。

evidence: Setup and Tables 1–2 follow thirteen Qwen3 endpoints, using 70 competition-mathematics problems, 16 samples each, temperature 0.7 and a 24,576-token evaluation cap. Primary intervention results cover English plus Chinese, Spanish, French, Arabic and Russian; the five extra languages are audited only at release, and Japanese is not evaluated.

Supervised Fine-Tuning and Table 1 report Qwen3-4B non-English adherence 39.8% to 99.4%, non-termination 4.7% to 21.1%, and J@16 35.7% to 84.6%; mean C@1 falls 76.2% to 61.4%. English-only and specialists also lose accuracy, while the 8B replication uses a different corpus.

Reinforcement Learning and Table 1 show correctness-only versus gated endpoints at C@1 60.5%/60.1%, adherence 8.7%/99.8%, non-termination 0.3%/0.5%, and J@16 15.4%/81.7%. The gated endpoint continues additive training while halving the response cap and doubling batch size (Table 2; Appendix B.4, Table S7), so reward gating is not isolated by a matched arm.

Appendix A specifies math_verify final-answer checking, majority segment language identification, zlib repetition detection, 2,000 problem-block bootstrap replicates and Holm-corrected paired tests; a blind judge correlates 0.979 with language fractions, but the cap-versus-loop distinction has kappa 0.519.

Appendix C.3, Table S14 discloses 14/70 evaluation problems in the RL training corpus. On the clean 56, J@16 is 82.1% for SFT, 15.0% for correctness-only, 80.4% for additive and 78.2% for gated RL; the clean subset preserves the language-reward contrast, not a gated-over-additive capability advantage.

Analysis, Table 3 and Appendix C.4 distinguish adjusted-token efficiency (102% of English for gated RL) from raw-token efficiency (87%); Table 4 shows that an English problem plus a target-language instruction still rarely switches visible reasoning to the requested language.

Limitations acknowledges one model family, one training seed per run and nonmatched controls. Appendix B.4 gives full SFT/PPO recipes, while B.5 claims retained traces, analysis scripts and cached judge outputs in an accompanying artifact.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A highly relevant, unusually detailed audit of multilingual LLM reasoning, post-training rewards and practical delivery metrics. Tracking correctness, visible-language adherence, termination and token cost across thirteen endpoints exposes important trade-offs hidden by answer-only accuracy. Strengths include a second SFT scale, single-language/English controls, instrument audits, problem-clustered intervals and a clean-subset contamination analysis. However, one seed and 70 mathematics problems limit breadth; SFT data/configuration and the sequential gated RL cap/batch changes are not fully matched causal ablations. Fourteen test problems overlap RL training, and gated RL mainly improves termination/cost without recovering released-model accuracy or improving SFT joint success. Detailed recipes and a claimed accompanying artifact aid reproducibility, but artifact access is not independently established by the supplied text.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這是一項高度相關且格外詳盡的稽核，涵蓋多語 LLM 推理、後訓練獎勵與實務交付指標。跨十三個模型端點追蹤正確性、可見輸出的語言遵循、終止情形與 token 成本，揭露僅看答案準確率會掩蓋的重要取捨。優點包括第二種 SFT 模型規模、單一語言與英文對照、量測工具稽核、以題目分群計算的區間，以及乾淨子集的資料汙染分析。

不過，單一種子與 70 道數學題限制了涵蓋範圍；SFT 資料與設定，以及依序進行的 gated RL 回應上限與批次大小變更，並非條件完全匹配的因果消融。十四道測試題與 RL 訓練資料重疊，而 gated RL 主要改善終止情形與成本，既未恢復發布模型的準確率，也未提升 SFT 的聯合成功率。

When a model can solve a problem but cannot deliver a complete solution in the user's language, language becomes an access barrier rather than merely a source of performance variation. We audit Qwen3 checkpoints on competition-mathematics tasks in eleven languages. Across the ten non-English languages, only 15.4-17.9% of problems receive a correct, terminating solution with visible reasoning in the requ
radar.summary_zh: 多語推理不能只看最後答案是否正確：模型也可能改用英文解題，或在目標語言中反覆重複而無法結束。本文追蹤 Qwen3 系列的 13 個模型端點，將正確性、可見推理的語言遵循及正常終止合併成「成功交付」，並計算每千個 token 的交付效率。評估採用 70 題競賽數學題、每題 16 次取樣；發布版另擴及 11 種語言。Qwen3-4B 經多語 SFT 後，五種主要非英語的語言遵循率由 39.8% 升至 99.4%，但未終止率也從 4.7% 增至 21.1%。只獎勵正確性的 RL 可減少未終止，卻使語言遵循率降至 8.7%；先加入語言獎勵、再以答案正確為給獎條件的流程，則維持 99.8% 遵循率並把未終止率降至 0.5%。它主要改善完成率與成本，沒有恢復 SFT 前的正確率。限制包括單一模型家族、單一訓練種子、不同批次與回應長度，以及 14 題與 RL 資料重疊；排除後仍保留主要趨勢。所謂接近英文效率是調整編碼成本後的結果，原始 token 效率僅為英文的 87%，且未測日語。研究提醒多語產品應同時驗證答案、語言及完成狀態，避免單一指標掩蓋新的失敗模式。

llm_evaluation.rationale: 直接切中 LLM 數學推理與 RLVR 的 token-level credit assignment。以排除目標軌跡的正負同題參考改善 critic，是具體而實用的 PPO 延伸；理論支持巢狀模型類別下的最小風險不增加，並未證明實際獨立 sibling context 必然降低 Bayes error。完整文本提供四種主要基線、兩種 Qwen3 尺寸、context 消融、小型 critic 與 MC 診斷，數學結果一致；但缺少主結果的跨訓練種子不確定性、完整 critic 運算與時間成本、其他模型家族及程式或 agent 任務驗證。OOD 優勢混合，實作參數與演算法可供重建，本文未提供專案程式或 checkpoint 釋出連結。
llm_evaluation.rationale_en:
Directly relevant to LLM mathematical reasoning and token-level credit assignment in RLVR. Improving the critic with positive and negative references for the same problem, excluding the target trajectory, is a concrete and practical extension of PPO. The theory supports non-increasing minimum risk under nested model classes; it does not prove that independent sibling context in practice necessarily reduces Bayes error.

The complete text provides four main baselines, two Qwen3 sizes, context ablations, smaller critics and MC diagnostics, with consistent mathematics results. However, it lacks uncertainty across training seeds for the main results, complete critic compute and time costs, and validation on other model families or coding or agent tasks.

OOD advantages are mixed. Implementation parameters and algorithms support reconstruction, but the paper provides no release link for project code or checkpoints.
