radar.summary: Assigning credit to intermediate steps remains a central challenge in training Large Language Models (LLMs) on multi-step reasoning tasks with sparse terminal rewards, and actor-critic methods such as PPO address this by learning value functions to construct token-level advantages. Their effectiveness, however, hinges on reliable value estimation, a difficult task requiring the critic to both assess progress toward a correct solution and anticipate an evolving policy's future behavior; errors in
radar.summary_zh: LLM 在長篇推理中往往只拿到最後答案的對錯獎勵，PPO 的 critic 因而難以判斷中間步驟的價值。本文提出 πPPO：每題先產生八條軌跡，再把排除目標本身的正確與錯誤解答加上標籤，作為 critic 專用參考；只有負例時另補標準答案，actor 仍只看到原始題目與自己的前綴。這種設計重用既有 rollout，不需額外生成參考，並保持部署時的輸入形式。以 DAPO-17K 訓練 Qwen3-4B 與 8B 後，五項數學評測平均達 50.3% 與 51.6%，較 DAPO 高 4.1 與 2.3 個百分點；改用 0.6B、1.7B critic 仍有競爭力。移除正誤標籤或改用同極性參考，大部分增益消失；MC continuation 診斷也支持價值預測改善。不過，證據集中在同一家族的數學訓練，跨領域優勢並不一致，主結果缺少跨種子誤差與完整運算成本比較。其價值在於提出可測試的 critic 資訊設計，而非單靠增加模型容量；對程式推理或 agent 工作的效果仍待驗證。

evidence: Sections 2.1–2.3 and Appendix D.1, Propositions 1–2: diagonal-Gram normalization followed by full-spectrum matrix-sign or rank-budgeted super-unit spectral refinement; localized refinement is a low-rank change to a dense update.

Sections 3.1–3.2, Algorithms 1–2, and Appendix B: relaxed tangent momentum, alternating row/column orientation, target update RMS 0.2, five Newton-Schulz iterations, or randomized interaction sketching with rank 32.

Section 4.1, Table 1: GPT-2 Small validation loss is 3.1064 ± 0.0054 for Muon, 3.0667 ± 0.0049 for NormPre-G, and 3.0826 ± 0.0034 for NormPre-L over three matched seeds; larger LLaMA and Qwen3 models use single runs. Both variants beat all three baselines in six settings.

Section 4.2, Table 2: on LLaMA-1.3B, NormPre-L optimizer latency is 333.3 ms versus Muon's 1010.1 ms, a 67.00% reduction, while end-to-end step time falls only 3.13%; both NormPre variants are slower per step than AdamW and MANO.

Appendix A.1, Tables 3–4: 10,000 steps, sequence length 1,024 and effective batch 512, approximately 5.24B nominal token positions; matched initialization/data order/evaluation, detailed optimizer settings and A100 80GB hardware. No optimizer-specific learning-rate sweep or downstream evaluation is reported.

Appendix A.4, Tables 6–8: relaxed tangent processing improves loss, post-normalization interaction geometry outperforms pre-normalization geometry, and increasing rank from 8 to 64 improves NormPre-L validation loss from 3.0962 to 3.0827. Row-only normalization slightly outperforms the default alternating orientation in this single-seed comparison.

Theorem 1, Remark 2 and Appendices D.2.2–D.2.3: O(T^-1/2) convergence is proved for deterministic fixed-orientation updates without momentum, RMS scaling or weight decay; NormPre-G uses exact matrix sign and full row rank, while the sketch extension assumes controlled preconditioner error.

Section 5 and Reproducibility statement: SWAN and MuonEq are acknowledged close predecessors but are absent from experimental baselines; configurations, pseudocode and proofs are supplied, with https://github.com/zx-gong/NormPre linked as the reproduction repository. Repository contents were not independently verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly relevant to LLM training and efficiency: NormPre separates marginal normalization from interaction-spectrum preconditioning, with a useful global-versus-localized design and sketch implementation. The conceptual contribution is meaningful but builds closely on existing normalization/orthogonalization optimizers rather than introducing wholly new machinery. Matched initialization, data order and budgets across six model/dataset settings, three-seed GPT-2 results, component/rank ablations and transparent end-to-end timing support the gains; GPT-2 validation loss falls from Muon's 3.1064 to 3.0667 with NormPre-G. Confidence is limited by single runs for larger models, a 10,000-step budget with 1,024-token sequences, no reported optimizer-specific learning-rate sweep or downstream evaluation, and no empirical comparison to the closely related SWAN or MuonEq. The convergence proof assumes deterministic, fixed-orientation updates without momentum, RMS scaling or weight decay, with restrictive geometric conditions and controlled sketch error. Detailed configurations, pseudocode, proofs and a linked repository support reproducibility, although the repository was not independently inspected. Evidence spans three architectures and corpora up to 1.7B parameters, supporting useful but still bounded generalization.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本研究與 LLM 訓練及效率高度相關：NormPre 將邊際正規化與交互作用頻譜預條件化分開，提供實用的全域與局部設計，以及隨機草圖實作。概念貢獻有意義，但與既有正規化及正交化最佳化器關係密切，並非全新技術體系。六組模型與資料集設定採相同初始化、資料順序和訓練預算，加上 GPT-2 的三個隨機種子結果、元件及秩消融，以及透明的端到端計時，支持其改善；NormPre-G 將 GPT-2 驗證損失從 Muon 的 3.1064 降至 3.0667。不過，較大模型僅執行一次，訓練限定一萬步及 1,024 詞元序列，未報告各最佳化器專屬的學習率搜尋或下游評估，也未實測比較密切相關的 SWAN 或 MuonEq，因此仍限制信心。收斂證明假設確定性、固定方向的更新，排除動量、RMS 縮放與權重衰減，並要求較嚴格的幾何條件及受控草圖誤差。詳細設定、虛擬碼、證明和程式碼儲存庫連結有助重現，但未獨立檢查儲存庫。證據涵蓋三種架構與語料，模型最大為 1.7B 參數，支持有用但仍有限的泛化。

radar.summary: Matrix optimizers have emerged as a promising direction, with Muon standing out as a prominent design. Revisiting Muon through its full-Gram representation, we observe that it jointly processes marginal-scale and interaction information. This opens an alternative way to organize geometric information hierarchically, motivating the Normalize-Then-Precondition framework. Specifically, it first uses diagonal-Gram information to construct a marginally normalized update, then applies spectral precond
radar.summary_zh:
LLM 訓練的矩陣最佳化器常同時處理更新尺度與方向相關性，可能讓大範數主導幾何結構。NormPre 先以 Gram 矩陣對角資訊正規化，再處理方向交互作用：NormPre-G 使用 Newton-Schulz 近似全頻譜正交化；NormPre-L 以隨機草圖找出主要模式，只收縮超過閾值的部分，更新本身仍是稠密矩陣。

在六組 GPT-2、LLaMA、Qwen3 預訓練設定中，兩者於相同初始化、資料順序及一萬步預算下，均優於 AdamW、Muon、MANO。GPT-2 三個隨機種子的平均驗證損失，從 Muon 的 3.1064 降至 NormPre-G 的 3.0667；LLaMA-1.3B 上，NormPre-L 相對 Muon 的最佳化器延遲減少 67%，但端到端步驟時間僅減少 3.13%。

元件、交互作用來源與頻譜秩消融支持此設計。不過，較大模型僅有單次結果，最大規模為 1.7B，且未提供下游能力或各最佳化器的學習率搜尋；收斂保證也僅適用於受限的簡化更新。此研究提供可重現設定及程式碼連結，適合關注預訓練損失與運算成本取捨的讀者，尚不能推論完整大規模訓練的效益。

Section 5.1, Table 1: AppWorld GPT-4.1 success is 56.0% uncompressed, 56.5% FOCUS-O and 64.9% FOCUS-D; OfficeBench FOCUS-O reaches 78.90% with peak tokens 3.81K versus 7.27K. Table 1(c) shows FOCUS-D 8-QA dependency 4.05M versus 3.32M uncompressed.

Section 5.1 Tables 3–4 and Appendix A.4 Tables 9–10: multiple draft families; OfficeBench N=1/3/5/10 success 71.6/77.9/74.7/74.7%; WebVoyager uses 135 text-only tasks, with additional retail/airline results.

Appendix A.2–A.2.6: guarantees assume dependency-directed perturbation, bounded impact and interactions, utility margins and draft/main coverage; the direct KL-reference comparison uses 30 compression events per benchmark and reports keep-set overlaps 0.85/0.90 and rank correlations 0.39/0.48.

Appendices A.5–A.6, Tables 12–13: OfficeBench total API cost falls from $9.47 to $5.96 sequential or $6.16 parallel; AppWorld same-size draft costs $41.92 versus $41.18 uncompressed, while mini-draft costs $37.82 and uses more total tokens (20.11M versus 19.80M).

Appendices A.9–A.11 and Reproducibility Statement: prompts, temperatures and budgets are supplied; set-generalized plans can prune per-entity records, and compression risks dropping safety/consent constraints. No public FOCUS code-release location is supplied.

Small benchmark splits, limited reported repeat-run evidence, a text-only web subset and no supplied implementation release limit certainty and reproduction. primary_link.title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents

radar.summary: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories.
radar.summary_zh: 長程 LLM agents 累積大量工具呼叫與觀察紀錄，既增加推論成本，也可能讓重要資訊被淹沒。FOCUS 把上下文壓縮視為保留未來決策所需資訊：小型 draft model 抽樣數份後續計畫，引用會用到的歷史片段，再依引用頻率保留完整的推理、動作、觀察單元；防禦檢查另救回失敗紀錄與狀態限制，全程不需額外訓練。以 GPT-4.1 評測時，AppWorld 的防禦版本把成功率從 56.0% 提升至 64.9%；OfficeBench 的樂觀版本達 78.9%，並降低約 48% 尖峰上下文。另有 QA、文字版 WebVoyager 與 τ²-bench 測試，以及抽樣次數、模型與成本分析。效果並非全面等價：QA 的防禦版本反而增加累積計算代理指標，AppWorld 使用同級 draft model 的總成本也略增。理論保證依賴依賴關係、片段交互作用與 draft／主模型一致性等假設，引用頻率不能直接當成真實因果效果；集合型任務仍可能遺漏個別對象。價值在於可接封閉模型的實用壓縮設計，部署前仍須驗證約束與安全資訊不會被刪除。

evidence: §3.1–3.4，式 (7)–(12)：昂貴 anchor network 每 K 步更新，shared network、fusion、denoiser 每步運作；成本以 Transformer-layer calls 估算，沒有將融合與輸出頭算入該代理量。
§4、§6.1 與附錄 C.1：DiffusionGemma-26B 採 2／20／8 層切分，只訓練約 3.1M 融合參數；300K no-think 範例，18,750 步，短程 rollout cache age 0／1／2 搭配 CE 與 KD；評估為 256-token canvas、固定 48 步且關閉 adaptive early stopping。
§6.1，表 1：K=3 在六項測試達 1.49–1.79 倍吞吐量，準確率相對基線差為 −0.84 至 +1.11 個百分點；結果取三種子平均，並非統計上證明等效。

附錄 D，表 4–5：快取間隔增加會傷害品質，尤其步數小時；T=128 的 TADM† MAUVE 由 K=1 的 0.135 降至 K=8 的 0.016。ADLM 未訓練時間重用時，T=1024、K=1→8 的 Gen PPL 為 25.97→144.97；該 diagnostic 對照每設定僅 20 次生成。

附錄 A、C.1–C.2：提供 T-ANELBO 推導、融合公式、資料組成、sampler 與訓練設定；後訓練採四個 GB200 節點、預訓練採 32 個 GH200 節點，評估單一 GH200；本文未給出 TADM 程式或權重的明確釋出連結。
llm_evaluation.rationale: 完整正文與附錄顯示，TADM 與 LLM 架構、推論效率及程式／推理評估高度相關。其貢獻是學習可跨時間重用的潛在表示與 current-state fusion，並提供固定大型骨幹後訓練和從頭預訓練兩種實例，具實用但非根本性的創新。固定步數下的實測吞吐量、六項任務三種子平均、快取間隔消融及 naive reuse 對照提供良好支持，T-ANELBO 亦附推導；但不證明語意持續性或品質不降。大型模型僅測 DiffusionGemma 的 no-think、關閉 adaptive stopping，未直接比較先進快取基線或完整拆分 fusion 與 stale-anchor training 的效應，也未報告誤差區間。附錄揭露困難任務退化率增加；預訓練快取結果亦明顯落後 ADLM 的 MAUVE。完整超參數與硬體資訊有助重現，但來源未提供本方法明確程式／權重釋出入口。
llm_evaluation.rationale_en:
The complete main text and appendices show that TADM is highly relevant to LLM architecture, inference efficiency, and coding/reasoning evaluation. Its contribution is learning temporally reusable latent representations and current-state fusion, with examples of both post-training with a frozen large backbone and pretraining from scratch. This is a practical, though not fundamental, innovation.

Measured throughput at fixed step counts, three-seed averages across six tasks, cache-interval ablations and naive-reuse controls provide good support, and a derivation of T-ANELBO is included. However, these do not prove semantic persistence or the absence of quality degradation. Large-model experiments cover only DiffusionGemma in no-think mode with adaptive stopping disabled. They do not directly compare advanced caching baselines or fully disentangle the effects of fusion and stale-anchor training, and no error intervals are reported.

The appendices disclose increased degeneration rates on difficult tasks; the pretrained caching results also fall clearly behind ADLM in MAUVE. Complete hyperparameters and hardware details aid reproduction, but the source provides no explicit release location for this method's code or weights.

In this work, we introduce time-based (self-supervised) anchoring, which learns and reuses latent anchors without requiring such targets. radar.summary_zh: Diffusion Language Models 需要反覆處理整段文字，推論成本高。TADM 將模型拆成昂貴的 anchor network、輕量路徑與 fusion module，定期更新深層潛在表示，其餘步驟利用當前文字狀態修正快取。後訓練版本凍結 DiffusionGemma-26B，只訓練約 310 萬個融合參數，並以短程自我生成軌跡及知識蒸餾適應過期表示；預訓練版本則直接學習時間間隔內可重用的表示，不必提供人工重要 token 標記。在固定 48 步、no-think 設定下，六項數學、程式與知識測試的三種子平均結果顯示，更新間隔為三步時吞吐量提高 49%–79%，準確率變動介於 −0.84 至 +1.11 個百分點。但這不代表輸出品質完全不變：AIME26 的退化率仍由 11.11% 升至 20%。預訓練實驗也呈現品質與速度取捨，2048 步的 MAUVE 為 0.650，高於 ReMDM 的 0.610，卻低於 ADLM 的 0.788。研究提供快取間隔消融、跨資料集困惑度與詳細設定；尚缺自適應停止、多個大型模型及先進快取方法的直接比較。其價值是把快取容忍度納入訓練，但部署前仍須量測實際解碼模式下的收益與退化。

links.title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It

evidence: Sections 2 and 4; Appendix A.2 and C.1: the rank-8 residual intervention includes a learned scalar and 65,537 added Qwen3-8B parameters; 24-line exact accuracy rises from 15.5% to 198/200 (99%, Wilson 95% interval 96.4–99.7%), with separate training seeds at 94.7–97.5%.

Section 4; Appendices C.1, C.3 and J, Tables 5 and 11–13: longer-trained Qwen reaches 50 lines; Ouro reaches at least 160 with eight loops and every-loop intervention, while first-loop-only intervention reaches about 25; interleaving, chain count, seed variation and excessive-loop degradation are reported.

Section 5; Appendices D and E: causal state restoration, ancestor-name probes, split-sample attention-head identification, targeted versus layer-matched random head ablations, and zeroing versus renormalizing edge cuts support a middle-layer relay dependent on parent attention.

Section 6; Appendix F.2, Tables 7–8: the preregistered cutoff prediction meets tolerance in three of four held-out models, with 2.25-layer mean absolute error; across nine models its 2.22-layer error nearly matches a post-hoc 48%-of-depth rule at 2.27.

Section 7; Appendix G.2–G.4, Tables 9–10: separately trained MuSiQue adapters use matched prompts and paired bootstrap intervals; Qwen layer-6 EM rises from 52.9% to 64.3% on 900 gold-context development questions, with no separate layer-selection split; early projection LoRA largely retains all-layer gains.

Section 9 and Appendix L: limitations include task-specific adapters, synthetic mechanistic evidence, limited looped families and untested general behavioral retention; the project page is stated to provide experiment and analysis scripts plus claim-to-command guidance.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM reasoning, transformer internals, recurrent inference, and parameter-efficient adaptation. The contribution is a well-supported account of an extended context-side relay and its placement constraints, rather than a new LoRA parameterization. A 65,537-parameter residual intervention raises Qwen3-8B's 24-line exact accuracy from 15.5% to 99%; longer training reaches 50 lines, while Ouro reaches at least 160 with eight loops and an intervention in every loop. Causal restoration, parent-edge and head ablations, matched random controls, multiple model families, seed checks, and detailed uncertainty estimates make the synthetic findings convincing. Separately trained MuSiQue adapters also provide meaningful early-layer gains. Generalization remains narrower than the title suggests: longest-chain results use level-ordered synthetic programs, interleaving and extra chains degrade accuracy, excessive recurrence reverses gains, and MuSiQue mainly supplies gold contexts and selects layers on the evaluated development set. MuSiQue does not establish the same relay mechanism or transfer of a program-trained adapter. The prospective placement predictor succeeds within tolerance in three of four held-out models but essentially ties a post-hoc relative-depth rule overall; traces condition on successful examples and broad behavioral retention is untested. Detailed protocols and claimed public scripts support reproducibility, although the linked artifacts were not independently executed.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本研究高度符合 LLM 推理、Transformer 內部機制、循環式推論與參數高效率調適等主題。主要貢獻是以充分證據說明上下文端接力計算的延伸及其介入位置限制，而非提出新的 LoRA 參數化形式。僅含 65,537 個參數的殘差介入，便將 Qwen3-8B 在 24 行參照鏈上的完全正確率由 15.5% 提升至 99%；較長訓練可達 50 行，Ouro 則在八次循環且每次皆介入時達到至少 160 行。因果狀態還原、父節點注意力連線與注意力頭消融、配對隨機對照、多個模型家族、種子檢查及詳細不確定性估計，使合成任務的發現相當可信。另行訓練的 MuSiQue 調適器也展現實質的早期層增益。然而，可泛化範圍比標題暗示的更窄：最長參照鏈結果使用按深度排列的合成程式，交錯排列及增加鏈數會降低正確率，過多循環也會使增益逆轉；MuSiQue 主要提供正確的支持段落，並在同一開發集上選層與評估。MuSiQue 並未證實相同的接力機制，也未證明程式任務調適器能直接轉移。事前登錄的位置預測器在四個留出模型中的三個符合容許誤差，但整體表現幾乎與事後選定的相對深度規則相同；追蹤分析以成功作答樣本為條件，也尚未測試廣泛行為的保留。詳細實驗流程及文中宣稱公開的程式有助重現，但未獨立執行連結中的實作。

primary_link.title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It

top5.summary: Pretrained transformers use little of their depth to follow references in context. Thirteen base models reliably follow only 1.4-3.6 lines, and extra pretrained loops add little. A task-trained rank-8 LoRA at one early layer extends this computation with all model weights frozen. Qwen3-8B improves from 15.5% to 99% exact accuracy on 24-line chains; a longer-trained LoRA reaches 50 lines. Ouro-1.4B reaches 60 lines after four loops and at least 160 after eight. The LoRA starts a relay: program li
top5.summary_zh: 這篇研究探問：為何預訓練 Transformers 即使有許多層，仍只能沿上下文中的變數參照追蹤少數步驟？作者凍結模型權重，在早期單層加入 rank-8 殘差 LoRA，並以答案監督和文字分布保留損失訓練。Qwen3-8B 僅增加 65,537 個參數，24 行參照鏈的完全正確率即由 15.5% 升至 99%；較長訓練可達 50 行。Ouro 在每次循環都套用調適器時，八次循環可處理至少 160 行。狀態還原與注意力消融顯示，介入讓原有中間層持續傳遞鏈的身分，父節點注意力則是接力不可或缺的環節。另行針對 MuSiQue 訓練也支持早期層調適的效益，Qwen 的完全正確率增加 11.4 個百分點。不過，最長結果依賴規整的合成任務，交錯排列或更多鏈會降低表現，過多循環亦會退步；MuSiQue 主要使用正確支持段落，且選層未另設留出集，不能據此認定相同機制已推廣到開放式推理。價值在於區分模型預設表現與小幅調適後可用的計算能力，並為選擇介入層及重複運算區段提供可測試的依據。
top5.title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
top5.title_zh: Transformers 太早停止思考，小型 LoRA 即可改善

links.title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?

evidence: Sections 2.1–2.4 and Appendix E, Table 7: 15 library-design tasks across Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Haskell contain 242 expert-reviewed downstream problems. Two or three visible example problems per design remain in the scored evaluation set.

Section 2.2, Equations 1–2, and Appendix A: the score multiplies squared test-pass fraction by capped reference-to-program ratios averaged over cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, Halstead volume, and formatted SLOC; these are consumer-code metrics, not full library-quality guarantees.

Sections 2.3 and 3: each designer produces three libraries per task, each evaluated by three fixed implementers, totaling 2,178 evaluated problems per designer. Task-stratified rerun standard errors preserve within-library dependence; the authors acknowledge that three runs do not guarantee nominal confidence-interval coverage.

Section 3.1, Table 1: Opus 5.5 scores 48.9 [48.0, 49.9], production libraries 46.6 [46.1, 47.2], and no library 34.4 [33.9, 34.9]. Mean test-pass fractions range from 84.1% to 86.6%; no library reaches 86.4%.

Section 3.2 and Appendix F: 810 partially passing, oversized solutions are classified once each by GPT-5.6 Luna without human labels, agreement checks, or executing the proposed best library path. Rigidity and Verbosity account for 64% of primary excess-code classifications; Coverage accounts for 14%.

Section 3.3, Table 3, and Appendix H: increasing Luna reasoning effort raises mean test-pass fraction from 51.4% to 84.5%; the default prompt raises simplicity from 48.7 to 60.4 relative to the minimal prompt. Under the minimal prompt, approximately 24% of trials never inspect the library.

Section 3.4 and Appendix I: the combined consumer-first sketches, runnable examples, and subagent-testing prompt raises Astra (Codex) from 44.1 to 46.4 while mean design cost rises from $4.51 to $8.24. The intervention is bundled, not component-wise ablated.

Section 5, Appendix B, and Introduction footnote 1: utility is conditional on tasks, consumers, and budgets; security, runtime efficiency, and maintainability are outside the measured outcomes. Detailed harness limits and formatter versions are supplied, with code/data linked at https://github.com/SprocketLab/librarydesignbench.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to coding agents, tool reuse, prompting, and agent evaluation. The distinctive contribution is an open-interface library-design benchmark scored through downstream agents rather than interface matching or correctness alone. Expert-reviewed problems, production/no-library baselines, three independent design runs, three consumer model families, task-aware uncertainty estimates, and detailed prompt/setup disclosure make the main comparisons credible. Opus 5.5 scores 48.9 versus 46.6 for production libraries, with most separation coming from consumer simplicity rather than correctness; bundled agent-first guidance improves Astra from 44.1 to 46.4 at nearly twice the design cost. Important qualifications are that visible design examples remain scored, reference-relative static metrics do not establish maintainability or security, and confidence intervals describe reruns of only 15 fixed tasks. The headline 64% failure attribution comes from one unvalidated model auditor on selected partially passing, oversized solutions, not verified causal repairs or representative human labels. The guidance components are not separately ablated. Public code/data are explicitly linked and experimental details are extensive, although availability was not independently checked.

Opus 5.5 scores 48.9 versus 46.6 for production libraries, with most separation coming from consumer simplicity rather than correctness; bundled agent-first guidance improves Astra from 44.1 to 46.4 at nearly twice the design cost. Important qualifications are that visible design examples remain scored, reference-relative static metrics do not establish maintainability or security, and confidence intervals describe reruns of only 15 fixed tasks. The headline 64% failure attribution comes from one unvalidated model auditor on selected partially passing, oversized solutions, not verified causal repairs or representative human labels. The guidance components are not separately ablated. Public code/data are explicitly linked and experimental details are extensive, although availability was not independently checked.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本文與 coding agents、工具重用、提示設計及代理評估高度相關。其主要新意是以其他代理的下游使用表現評估開放介面的程式庫設計，而非只比對介面或檢查正確性。專家審查題目、正式程式庫與無程式庫基準、三次獨立設計、三個使用端模型家族、考慮任務結構的不確定性估計，以及詳盡的提示與環境說明，使主要比較具有可信度。Opus 5.5 得分 48.9，正式程式庫基準為 46.6；差異主要來自使用端程式的簡潔度，而非正確性。合併的代理導向設計指引讓 Astra 由 44.1 升至 46.4，但設計成本接近加倍。重要限制包括：設計階段可見的範例仍納入計分、相對參考解的靜態指標不能證明可維護性或安全，以及信賴區間僅描述固定 15 項任務的重跑變異。文中醒目的 64% 失敗歸因，來自單一未經驗證的模型稽核者，樣本僅限部分通過且程式偏長的解答，並非經修補驗證的因果證據或具代表性的人工標註。設計指引各部分也未分別消融。本文明確連結公開程式碼與資料，實驗細節充分，但本次未另行查核其可用性。

primary_link.title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?

top5.summary: Agents increasingly build on code written by other agents, and they reimplement rather than reuse, growing the codebases later agents must work in. To measure how well agents design libraries for other agents, we introduce LibraryDesignBench, a two-phase benchmark in which an agent implements a full-featured library from a specification that defines required capabilities and potential use cases without prescribing the design. We evaluate the library through the correctness and simplicity of prog
top5.summary_zh:
當 coding agents 不斷重寫已有功能，問題可能在程式庫介面，而不只是模型能力。LibraryDesignBench 讓代理依開放規格設計程式庫，再由三個不同模型家族的代理完成下游工作，以測試通過比例的平方乘上相對參考解的簡潔度評分。資料涵蓋四種語言、15 項設計任務及 242 道專家驗證題目，每項設計重複三次。

Opus 5.5 得分 48.9，高於正式程式庫基準的 46.6；但各條件的平均測試通過比例接近，差異主要來自下游程式是否精簡。810 個部分通過且程式偏長的案例中，單一模型稽核將 64% 的多餘程式碼歸因於僵化或繁瑣介面。這是受限樣本的判讀，沒有人工標註或一致性檢查，不能視為普遍因果結論。

把使用端草稿、可執行範例與子代理測試合併加入設計指引，讓 GPT-6 Astra 分數由 44.1 升至 46.4，設計成本卻接近加倍。研究的重要性在於以實際使用衡量代理產出的可重用性，並提示文件與介面值得共同改進；靜態簡潔度仍不代表安全、效能或可維護性，且指引各部分的效果尚未分別驗證。
top5.title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?
top5.title_zh: 代理能為其他代理設計程式庫嗎？

links.title: Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers with Teacher Supervision

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.2 and Appendix A: top-k next-token distributions are fused with token embeddings; teacher-forced input states, KL state alignment, prefix dropout, and a final 10% own-state adaptation phase support parallel training.

Section 4 and Appendix B.1: a three-seed two-layer S5 study reports 100% at length 12 for a LIFT student of a failing Transformer teacher, but explicitly says this student fails beyond the training range; an RNN-teacher student reaches 65% at length 64.
Section 5.2, Table 1: the 1B LIFT reaches C4 perplexity 18.81 versus 19.79 token-matched and 19.17 compute-matched; 1B arithmetic BPB is 1.99, slightly worse than distillation at 1.95.

Appendices B.4 and C, Tables 7–12: excluded math/code generation tasks remain near floor, and the 1B main LIFT arithmetic exact-match average is 5.9%, so probability gains do not establish reliable multistep arithmetic solving.
Appendix D: teacher-input/target, no-teacher, channel-width, adaptation, and teacher-strength ablations isolate the mechanism; Section 5.1 limits larger-scale training to one seed.

Appendices E–F: one additional parallel prefill pass recovers 93–104% of the reported states gain; compute budgets include teacher forward passes and extra adaptation passes but do not add the teacher’s original pretraining cost.

Abstract footnote and Appendix B: the paper states that code and trained models are released at https://github.com/dortirosh1/LIFT/ and supplies architecture, data-mixture, optimizer, schedule, seed, and evaluation details; external artifact accessibility was not checked.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant language-model architecture and latent-reasoning work. Teacher-forced next-token distributions provide a distinct, parallelizable route to recurrent feedback, with unusually broad ablations, token/compute-matched baselines, three-seed small-model studies, and explicit prefill tradeoffs. Evidence is strongest for perplexity and synthetic state tracking: real math/code generation stays near floor, multi-operand arithmetic accuracy remains low, larger models have one seed, and the compute comparison treats teacher pretraining as sunk. Scaling beyond the tested small-model and training regimes remains unproven.
llm_evaluation.rationale_en: Highly relevant language-model architecture and latent-reasoning work. Teacher-forced next-token distributions provide a distinct, parallelizable route to recurrent feedback, with unusually broad ablations, token/compute-matched baselines, three-seed small-model studies, and explicit prefill tradeoffs. Evidence is strongest for perplexity and synthetic state tracking: real math/code generation stays near floor, multi-operand arithmetic accuracy remains low, larger models have one seed, and the compute comparison treats teacher pretraining as sunk. Scaling beyond the tested small-model and training regimes remains unproven.
llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 這是與語言模型架構及潛在推理高度相關的研究。以 teacher forcing 提供的下一個 token 分布，為循環回饋提出一條有別以往、可平行化的路徑；研究包含相當廣泛的消融實驗、token 與算力預算分別相同的基準、小模型的三種訓練種子實驗，以及明確的 prefill 取捨。證據在困惑度與合成狀態追蹤上最強：實際數學題與程式碼生成表現仍接近低分，多運算元算術正確率仍低，較大模型僅使用一個訓練種子，且算力比較將教師預訓練視為既有投入。能否擴展至超出已測試的小模型規模與訓練設定，仍未獲驗證。

primary_link.title: Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers with Teacher Supervision

top5.summary: Transformer language models (LMs) are feed-forward: deep-layer representations are never fed back to shallower layers, and the only pathway for information to flow downward across generation steps is the decoded token. This narrow channel forces models to recompute intermediate results and to discard alternative continuations. In this work, we remove this bottleneck during pretraining, introducing the LIFT (Latent Information Feedback Transformer) architecture and training method which enable LM
top5.summary_zh:
Transformer 主要靠已生成的單一 token，把深層計算結果傳回後續位置的淺層，限制了中間資訊的保留。LIFT 在預訓練時加入回饋通道：將教師模型預測的下一個 token 分布取 top-k，與輸入詞嵌入融合，並以 KL 損失對齊狀態。教師可平行提供各位置的狀態；最後一成訓練改用自身狀態適應，推論時便不再需要教師。

實驗涵蓋 135M 至 1B 模型。1B 的 C4 困惑度為 18.81，低於相同 token 預算的 19.79 與相同算力的 19.17。兩層模型在 S5 狀態追蹤的長度 12 測試達到百分之百，即使教師在此長度已失敗；但這個學生仍無法泛化至訓練範圍外。消融實驗支持教師輸入、狀態對齊及通道寬度的重要性。

限制是較大模型只用一個訓練種子，算力比較未納入教師原始預訓練成本；數學與程式碼生成仍接近低分，1B 多運算元算術平均精確匹配率僅 5.9%。額外一次平行 prefill 可取回大部分狀態收益，但增加預填算力。本研究提供可平行訓練的潛在回饋路線，尚不能據此認定已具備可靠的多步推理能力。
top5.title: Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers with Teacher Supervision
top5.title_zh: LIFT：以教師監督預訓練潛在資訊回饋 Transformer

links.title: Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation from Off-the-Shelf Teachers

evidence: Sections 3.2–3.4 and Appendix B.3: shared locators retrieve at most one successful and one failed complete source, preserving provenance; historical anchors/fallbacks and student hindsight condition teacher scores on unchanged student thought–action tokens, with no graph or teacher at deployment.

Section 4.2, Table 1: original-teacher ScienceWorld 4B success rises 24.70%→48.78%; ALFWorld Unseen 53.36%→85.26%; WebShop 29.10%→37.65%. The strongest GRPO-teacher comparisons are 46.66% for ScienceWorld 4B and 85.07% for ALFWorld Unseen.

Section 4.3, Table 2(a): ScienceWorld 1.7B hindsight-only reaches 31.64%, minimum-prefix retrieval 33.70%, success-only sources 43.68%, and full GC-OPD 46.18%; continuation budget and vanilla-OPD parent are matched for the hindsight and failure controls.

Section 4.3, Table 2(b) and Figure 3: K=1→16 increases student success 38.06%→46.18%, but the K=1 pool is separately preselected; with an 8B scorer, exchanging 8B for higher-coverage 32B sources lowers success 27.03%→20.97%, showing source coverage alone is insufficient.

Appendices A.1 and B.1–B.2: reported standard deviations use four inference seeds for one fixed trained model; source libraries use training tasks, task-specific privileged state descriptors and collection-specific retry rules that differ from no-free-retry student evaluation.

Section 4.4 and Appendix C, Table 6: K16 collection plus student training sums to 281.27 H20 GPU-hours versus 1,216.59 for GRPO teacher preparation plus vanilla OPD, while GC-OPD student training alone costs 68.79 versus 47.31 GPU-hours. The front matter lists https://github.com/hanyi2021/GC_OPD.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant agent-training work that combines source-preserving execution retrieval with privileged hindsight to strengthen frozen-teacher on-policy distillation. Three environments, multiple student sizes, shared acting protocols, substantial gains over original-teacher baselines, and hindsight/reference/failure/source-budget controls make a persuasive empirical case. Novelty lies mainly in careful state/history-conditioned evidence selection rather than a new distillation objective. Generalization is constrained by environment-specific privileged locators and fixed task libraries; four inference seeds do not quantify training variance, and the 0.19-point ALFWorld Unseen lead over the strongest GRPO-teacher baseline is not established as statistically meaningful. The source provides a code URL and extensive implementation details, but external artifacts were not inspected.

Three environments, multiple student sizes, shared acting protocols, substantial gains over original-teacher baselines, and hindsight/reference/failure/source-budget controls make a persuasive empirical case. llm_evaluation.rationale_zh:
這項代理訓練工作高度切題，結合保留來源的執行檢索與特權事後資訊，強化以凍結教師模型進行的 on-policy 蒸餾。三種環境、多種學生模型規模、共用的行動協定、相較原始教師基準的大幅提升，以及針對事後資訊、參考資料、失敗案例與來源預算的控制實驗，共同構成有說服力的實證。創新主要在於仔細依狀態與歷史紀錄選取證據，而非提出新的蒸餾目標。

泛化能力受限於環境專屬的特權定位器與固定任務庫；四個推論種子無法量化訓練變異，而在 ALFWorld Unseen 上領先最強 GRPO 教師基準 0.19 分，尚未證實具有統計意義。來源提供程式碼網址與詳盡實作細節，但未檢查外部產物。

primary_link.title: Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation from Off-the-Shelf Teachers

top5.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains compact language agents with teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories. In multi-turn tasks, compounding errors can move students beyond the teacher's effective supervision. We introduce Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation (GC-OPD), which enriches an off-the-shelf teacher's scoring context with execution evidence. A graph indexes repeated teacher executions by shared states while preserving complete successful and failed histories. After ea
top5.summary_zh: 多輪語言代理一旦偏離熟悉軌跡，固定教師對學生行動的評分就可能失去幫助。GC-OPD 先蒐集現成教師在訓練任務上的重複執行，以共享狀態建立索引，同時保留每次成功或失敗紀錄的完整來源。學生完成一回合後，系統從當前或歷史狀態尋找參考，把完整紀錄與學生後見資訊交給凍結教師，重新評分學生原有的思考及動作 token；只更新學生，部署時無須教師或圖檢索。ScienceWorld 的 4B 學生成功率由一般 OPD 的 24.70% 升至 48.78%，ALFWorld Unseen 由 53.36% 升至 85.26%，WebShop 由 29.10% 升至 37.65%。消融顯示，僅提供後見資訊不足，移除外部失敗紀錄也損失 2.50 個百分點。研究展示不用微調大教師也能改善代理蒸餾，但四個種子只衡量同一模型的推論變異，未測訓練變異；狀態索引依賴環境特定資訊，蒐集時的重試規則亦不同。ALFWorld 相對最強已訓練教師基線僅高 0.19 個百分點，不能視為明確優勢。程式碼有列出連結，成本比較則限於指定 ScienceWorld 設定。

top5.title_zh: 以圖條件化的同策略代理蒸餾，善用現成教師的執行經驗

links.title: LeapQuant: Efficient Linear Attention with Accurate Recurrent State Quantization

evidence: Sections 3.1–3.4 and Appendices A–B: derive a diagonal-decay/rank-one recurrence, store a fixed quantized boundary state for 16 tokens, buffer higher-precision updates, and reconstruct with low-rank compensator tokens and residual smoothing. Appendix A describes broader recurrence compatibility without validating all those architectures experimentally.

Sections 4.1–4.2 and Table 1: Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, and Kimi-Linear downstream results average three random seeds; eight-bit mean 75.5 equals the FP32 mean across 12 model-task pairs, whereas six-bit and four-bit means decline to 72.4 and 60.4. No seed uncertainty is displayed.

Section 4.4 Tables 2–3: per-window INT8 improves Qwen3.5-9B AIME from 7.1 to 82.4; compensator tokens and smoothing reach 87.9, matching FP32. Window 16 and rank 4 trade accuracy against kernel speed; rank 16 becomes slower than FP32.

Section 4.3 Figures 7–9: evaluates B200, RTX PRO 6000, and RTX 5090; state-boundary representation is reported as 1.19 bytes/element plus a separate active-request update buffer. Up-to-56% total-memory savings rely on checkpointed prefix caching.

Sections 4.1 and 4.3 and Appendix D: Qwen3.8-Flash/GLM-5.3-Flash are eight-layer efficiency-only models. End-to-end Kimi timing uses Qwen3.5-9B length distributions; these qualifications limit generalization of full-serving gains.

Section 4.1 and Appendix E: describes vLLM/TileLang implementation, power-iteration fitting, precision/window settings, and sampling parameters, but supplies no method repository URL or complete kernel reproduction details.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to efficient long-reasoning LLM inference. Window-boundary quantization plus high-precision low-rank compensator updates is a useful synthesis of recurrent replay and outlier handling, with an explicit update/readout derivation and no calibration requirement. Three-model downstream evaluations, three hardware platforms, precision baselines, and component/window/rank ablations support near-FP32 eight-bit accuracy and practical speedups. Claims need workload qualification: two newer models are only eight-layer efficiency proxies, Kimi end-to-end timing uses simulated Qwen length distributions, and the compact boundary-state count excludes active update buffers. Missing uncertainty bars, limited baseline-adaptation/kernel detail, and no supplied implementation-release URL temper confidence and reproducibility.

llm_evaluation.rationale_zh: 本研究高度切合高效率長篇推理 LLM 推論。視窗邊界量化搭配高精度低秩補償更新，實用地整合了循環重播與離群值處理，並提供明確的更新及讀出推導，且不需要校準資料。三個模型的下游評估、三種硬體平台、不同精度的基準，以及元件、視窗與秩的消融實驗，支持接近 FP32 的八位元準確率與實際加速效果。相關主張需限定於所測工作負載：兩個較新模型僅是八層效率代理，Kimi 端到端計時採用模擬的 Qwen 長度分布，而緊湊邊界狀態的容量計算不含活動更新緩衝。缺少不確定性誤差棒、基準改寫與核心細節有限，以及未提供實作發布網址，均使可信度與可重現性受到限制。

primary_link.title: LeapQuant: Efficient Linear Attention with Accurate Recurrent State Quantization

top5.summary: Recent LLMs increasingly adopt hybrid designs that replace standard attention with linear attention, such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA). Although they compress the context into a fixed-size recurrent state and substantially reduce the cost of long-context processing, repeatedly reading and updating that state remains a major inference bottleneck. Quantization offers a natural way to reduce this cost, but can significantly degrade model quality, due to the accumulation of
top5.summary_zh:
混合式 LLM 的循環狀態大小雖固定，解碼時逐步讀寫仍耗費記憶體頻寬；直接降低精度又會因反覆捨入及列、欄離群值而損害長篇推理。LeapQuant 無須訓練或校準資料，將量化延後至每個十六 token 視窗的邊界，期間固定低位元狀態，另以高精度緩衝更新。

方法以四個 FP16 Compensator Tokens 表示主要低秩結構，沿用真實 token 的更新路徑，再平滑殘差後量化。三個模型、十二組模型與任務配對中，八位元平均準確率 75.5%，與 FP32 相同；六與四位元分別降至 72.4% 與 60.4%。元件消融顯示，視窗化先大幅恢復精度，補償項與平滑再縮小差距；視窗或補償秩過大則會拖慢核心。

實作整合 vLLM 與 TileLang，在三種 GPU 測得核心加速，端到端推論平均提升至 1.47 倍。邊界狀態每元素約 1.19 位元組，但另需活動請求的更新緩衝；最多 56% 總記憶體節省也依賴前綴快取。兩個新模型僅以八層代理測效率，Kimi 端到端計時採模擬長度分布，且缺乏不確定性區間及實作發布網址。研究價值是把降低量化頻率與離群值保護整合成可部署的狀態壓縮方式。
